store_data.about_the_game:
Build a Kingdom From Your Own Actions

Your cursor is your first worker.

Record 15 seconds of movement and clicks, and a ghost cursor will repeat those actions forever. Record more workers, assign them new tasks, and transform a single cursor into a fully automated kingdom.

Every worker is a recording of your past self.

Record => Repeat => Expand

Start by gathering wood yourself.

Then record that routine.

A new cursor appears and repeats it endlessly.

Use your freed-up time to create another worker, then another, building a growing workforce capable of running an entire economy without your direct involvement.

Design Automated Production Chains

Create efficient workflows by assigning workers to different tasks:

  • Gather resources

  • Craft materials

  • Sell goods for gold

  • Operate defenses

  • Support your expanding kingdom

Optimize your recordings and discover better ways to organize your workforce.

Defend Your Castle

Your kingdom isn't safe.

Enemy raiders attack in regular waves, forcing you to balance economic growth with survival.

While your workers keep production running, you'll need to prepare defenses and protect the kingdom's core from destruction.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE GAME

KINGPIN is a criminal enterprise management simulator where you build and operate a gang across real-world cities. Unlike typical gang sims, your crew aren't puppets—they're autonomous agents with 500+ personality traits that drive their decisions independently.

THE CORE LOOP

  • Select a starting location (Miami, NYC, Boston, LA..) — rendered from real map data with fictional crime overlay

  • Manage your crew — Start 1-3 autonomous gang members with individual traits, motivations, and psychology

  • Give orders — "Buy cocaine," "Sell to addicts," "Bribe the cop," "Extort that shop"

  • Watch them work — Each member autonomously navigates to targets, negotiates deals, and avoids cops

  • Manage consequences — Crime heat rises in your section; police patrol increases; The Director spawns emergent threats

  • Adapt strategy — Move operations, buy buildings for cover, promote loyal crew, deal with traitors

CORE FEATURES

Autonomous Gang Members

  • Each crew member has 20+ personality traits (Greed, Loyalty, Aggression, Ambition, Caution, etc.)

  • Traits evolve based on actions (selling drugs increases Greed, bribing cops increases Confidence/Corruption)

  • At trait thresholds, special behaviors unlock:

    • Greed ≥90 + Loyalty <30 → Member starts their own rival gang

    • Corruption ≥50 → Cop becomes bribeable

    • Loyalty ≤20 + Fear >70 → Member becomes police informant

    • Stress ≥95 → Mental breakdown; member goes catatonic

  • Same crew member can be loyal in one playthrough, traitor in another

Real-World Map Management

  • Global Scale, Dynamic Simulation: Start your empire within a localized bounding box, then seamlessly expand across the United States and the entire globe using genuine, real-world street layouts. This authentic geography is seamlessly layered with tailored fictional data, creating a unique, deeply simulated sandbox built for limitless strategic gameplay.

  • Territory Sections: Divided into distinct zones with independent heat levels (0–100 scale). Toggle dynamic map layers to track Neighborhoods, Crime Rate, Properties For Sale, Owned Properties, and Protection to manage your territory effectively.

  • Building Ownership: Buy drug labs, laundry fronts, safe houses, chop shops; each generates passive income

  • Heat Mechanics: Crime activities raise heat in your section; police patrols increase; heat decays over time

  • Strategic Placement: Spread operations across cool zones; use buildings as cover; time activities by heat forecast

 Multi-Path Economy

Players choose their profit strategy:

  • Retail Drug Dealing: Buy 200g cocaine for $1000, sell 50g crack to addicts for $500 each (4 sales = $1000 profit, 100% margin, high risk/heat)

  • Wholesale Bulk Deals:: Move large quantities fast. Fulfill bulk orders for distributors—like 200g for $1,400 ($400 profit, 40% margin)—for a quicker turnaround than street-level sales.

  • Business Laundering: Build laundries/labs that generate passive income; convert heat to profit; build legitimate empire

  • Extortion Rackets: Threaten/protect shops; collect "protection money" regularly

  • Debt Collection: Intimidate street-level debtors for cash payments

Result: No single "best" strategy; playstyle varies based on crew traits and player preference.

Heat System (Dynamic Pressure)

Crime heat is a strategic pressure mechanic:

  • Heat Range: 0–100 per section

    • 0–30: Routine patrols, easy dealing

    • 31–65: Moderate police presence, moderate arrest risk

    • 66–100: Heavy police everywhere; building raids possible; hair-trigger arrests

  • Heat Generators:

    • Drug deal: +8 heat

    • Arrest: +5 heat

    • Intimidation: +4 heat

    • Extortion: +7 heat

  • Heat Mitigators:

    • Guard corner (−2 heat, 60-second action)

    • Lay low (−2 personal heat)

    • Launder money (−5 heat)

    • Time decay (passive reduction)

    • Bribe corrupt cops (bypass heat)

Strategy: Adapt constantly. Busy section? Move to cooler zones. Heat critical? Bribe the cop or lay low.

Building System

Acquire properties for passive income and operational cover:

  • Drug Labs: Produce cocaine automatically; +1 Cocaine/day per lab

  • Laundry Fronts: Convert Cocaine to Cash (cleaned money); −5 heat per laundry operation

  • Safe Houses: Hide inventory from raids; store excess product

  • Chop Shops: Steal/fence vehicles for additional income

  • Legitimate Businesses: Liquor stores, restaurants, etc.; appear legitimate on police radar

Each building requires:

  • Property Acquisition: Secure financing via loans from underground entities to negotiate and buy real estate. Invest in converting properties into specialized asset types to maximize revenue, monitor fluctuating market values for opportunistic flips, or liquidate assets quickly when rising heat puts you at risk of a devastating SWAT raid.

  • Maintenance: Heat from dirty money laundering

  • Protection: Guard rotation to keep ownership

27+ Autonomous Goals

Gang members pursue goals based on player direction and trait-driven priority:

  • Buy Cocaine: Restocks cocaine from suppliers via repeated purchases. Goal completes after each bulk purchase, then immediately replans if inventory is below the player slider target.

  • Sell Drugs: Offloads inventory stock directly to street buyers. Active at full priority whenever a member is carrying a product.

  • Sell Wholesale: Sells cocaine to a wholesale distributor via bulk sales. Goal completes after each sale, then immediately replans if inventory remains above the target threshold.

  • Collect Debt: Tracks down street-level debtors to intimidate them and collect outstanding payments.

  • Bribe Officer: Pinpoints corrupt officers on the beat and offers cash payoffs to systematically lower police heat.

  • Collect Protection: Shakes down neighborhood businesses to establish a recurring weekly protection racket.

  • Launder Money: Delivers accumulated dirty cash to laundering fronts to convert it into clean, usable capital.

  • Guard Corner: Moves to a territory zone post and stands guard to actively suppress local section heat and deter rivals.

  • Guard Owned Property: Defends owned business properties, labs, or safe houses from rival gang or police raids.

  • Execute Mission: Follows direct player orders to move to a specific mission target, automatically engaging in combat upon arrival.

  • Lay Low: Finds a quiet safe house to hide out in until personal heat levels cool down, reducing the risk of arrest.

  • Stash Product: Safely deposits surplus product inventory into a secure drug stash building for warehousing.

  • Pick Up Product: Withdraws product from an owned drug lab to restock when a member's personal inventory runs low.

  • Recruit Gang Member: Attempts to convince high-potential civilians to join the syndicate based on player-directed targets.

  • Threaten Witness: Searches for known civilian witness leads and intimidates them to eliminate legal liabilities.

  • Mutiny / Form Sub-Gang: Triggered internally by low loyalty, high ambition, and high greed; the member betrays you, splits your assets, and starts a hostile rival gang.

AI Advancement: Each action triggers 10+ trait changes and often goal chaining (if Cocaine is low, re-plan BUY_COCAINE; if arrested, SURRENDER chain begins).

Trait System: 500+ Psychological Attributes

Crew members evolve based on actions and thresholds:

Core Personality Traits (17 categories):

  • CorePersonality: Greed, Loyalty, Aggression, Ambition, Caution, Confidence, Dominance

  • MoralEthical: Empathy, Honesty, SenseOfJustice, Ruthlessness, Impulsivity

  • SubstanceUse: DrugTolerance, Addiction, Anxiety, Depression, ParanoiaLevel

  • TraumaMentalHealth: PTSD, Stress, Paranoia, Isolation, Resilience

  • CriminalHistory: ArrestRecord, ConvictionRecord, PrisonYears, EscapeHistory, RapSheet

  • LawEnforcement: CopKills, CorruptionLevel, Bribed, Bribery, HeatGenerated, ArrestRecord

  • And 11 more...

Trait Evolution:

  • SELL_DRUGS goal → Greed +2.5, Empathy −0.5

  • BRIBE_OFFICER goal → Confidence +5, Dominance +4, Corruption +3

  • CONFIRM_BRIBE action → Updates 21 different traits simultaneously

  • Threshold events unlock when traits hit critical levels

Gameplay Impact:

  • High Greed, Low Loyalty → Will steal from crew, seek side deals

  • High Ambition, Low Loyalty → Starts own gang; becomes permanent rival

  • High Aggression → Fights more readily; may challenge your authority

  • Low Loyalty, High Fear → Becomes police informant; sells out crew locations

  • High Stress → Can go catatonic (mental break); unavailable for 5+ days

store_data.about_the_game:
You are Henry.

It was supposed to be a normal workday. Wake up, go to the station, get on Train 8, and head to work. Nothing special. No surprises. No reason to worry.

But after only a short time, you realize that something is wrong.

The environment feels strange. Things look familiar, but also somehow wrong. Everything seems to repeat itself, as if you were trapped in an endless loop. Rooms, paths, objects, and people appear again and again. But each time, something may be different.

Maybe an object suddenly stands in a different place. Maybe something that was there before is now missing. Maybe a person behaves in an unusual way. Or maybe something changes so subtly that you only notice it when it is already too late.

In SU8WAY, you must look closely, remember your surroundings, and recognize every change. Because not everything is as it should be.

The goal sounds simple: Help Henry reach Train 8 and escape the loop.

But the way there is anything but easy.

SU8WAY is an anomaly game with over 60 different anomalies that can appear. Some of them are completely harmless and only change small details in the environment. Others are creepy, strange, unexpected, or even absurdly funny. Every run can feel different, and every decision matters.

To escape with Henry, you must be correct 8 times.

The rule is simple:

If you find no anomaly, move forward.

If you discover an anomaly, go back.

Sounds simple. But it is not.

Because in SU8WAY, almost anything in the level can change. Objects, people, wall details, sounds, positions, shapes, or entire scenes may be different from before. Some changes are obvious. Others are so small that you can easily miss them.

You must stay alert, compare what you see, observe carefully, and trust your memory.

Will you solve the mystery and finally bring Henry to Train 8?

Or will you remain trapped in the loop forever?

store_data.about_the_game:
In Domefender you are sent to a hostile alien planet with the goal of collecting solarite - an extremely rare material, formed only under very specific conditions. However the exact same conditions required for creation of solarite led to some obscure evolution of local wildlife.

The planet is uninhabitable for humans, luckily with modern technological advancements in cloning, we managed to create (totally) non-sentient life forms, capable of surviving local conditions - H.O.O.M.A.N.S. (Humanlike Organic Operationally Minimally Assisted Non-Sentients) - as long as they stay under the dome.

Taking into account local environment and hostile wildlife attracted to electricity, establishing a permanent base is out of the question. Surviving there for a month would be nothing short of a miracle.

Mining solarite will also require highly specialized infrastructure that we sadly can't transport over there with you.

Your job will be to establish a mining outpost, and develop it using local resources to a point where it is capable of extracting it, and then escaping with it before the waves of enemies get too overwhelming.

We are counting on you!

P.S. Our funding is finite, and with all the lawsuits (falsely) alleging that hoomans are sentient (they aren't), you should really hurry to bring some solarite back home.

store_data.about_the_game:
...What if the proof you existed started deleting you?

In Mado Marks, a short (~30 minute) psychological horror visual novel, you follow a group of students who discover a door at the back of their classroom... A door that should not be there.

One day, they record vertical videos to their future selves...

The videos start as a joke. Half-cringe, half-sincere... Messages to the people they hope they might become.

Then they leave the room. It is the next morning.

The school says they were absent for an entire day. Their phones say only minutes passed. Attendance records are wrong.

And then one of them disappears...

Through subtle choices and shifting memories, decide how the remaining students respond...

Key Features:

  • Short but impactful psychological horror visual novel, with each playthrough lasting around 30 minutes.

  • A focused narrative about memory, identity, proof, friendship, and the fear of becoming impossible to remember.

  • A confined school setting built around one ordinary classroom and one impossible room behind it.

  • Choice-driven progression that shapes how the characters interpret corrupted videos, altered records, and disappearing memories.

  • Three distinct endings based on whether the remaining students preserve the proof, reject it, or become part of the erasure themselves.

  • Grunge-inspired school atmosphere with liminal classroom spaces and low-key supernatural dread.

  • Original ambient soundtrack built around fluorescent hum, distorted audio...

store_data.about_the_game:
The original and classic piano game, remastered for PC.

------------

Piano Tiles 2 is a semi-casual music rhythm game with a stunningly easy mechanic: simply tap the black tiles to create the melody of the music. Play casually or competitively! A relaxing, beautiful melody: how hard could it be? Don't be fooled— it takes more than just concentration to maximize your score with your fast reactions!

CREATE the melody. Piano Tiles 2's song notes are played when you tap, just like a real piano. This means you don't always have to follow the beat of the original song— spice it up, throw in some swing, and become the next contemporary Mozart. Your Full Combo will be different than your friend's— maybe they don't know what triplets are and you're here playing Jazz Beethoven.

The music is yours to command.

------------

Explore a catalogue of 700+ songs, different genres and musical eras all uniting under the common musical staff. A vast library of songs including those of famous classical composers like Beethoven, Liszt, Mozart, Chopin, as well as incredible beats by the artists of today! Play the Piano Tiles original tracks, and explore what a world of music has to offer.

------------

Spice up the gameplay~ Explore the Events Hall, featuring the classic game with a fun new twists!

• Compete in HALL CHALLENGES, each starring a unique tile type: Single, Double, Accompaniment, Slider, Combo -- the notes get faster at an incredible rate! Do you have what it takes to hit 13 tiles per second?
• Take a JOURNEY TO THE STARS in our stage-by-stage monthly campaign as you unlock 8 new songs, 16 stages of rewards, and a hidden narrative through the images revealed by your music.
• Step up in our PIANIST CHALLENGE as you play through a randomized song list of scaling difficulty -- the better you do, the harder it gets. But be careful not to shoot above your weight class -- one loss and all your progress comes crumbling down.

------------

FEATURES:

  • Unlock over 700+ songs! Mostly classical, some contemporary, and some a little mix of both.

  • Assisted Mode! For the moments when you want to hang out with the tunes and not worry about dying if you miss a beat.

  • 100+ achievements for all you trophy hunters out there, some hidden a little better than others.

  • Settings so you can customize your game: sound, graphics, mini-features, accessibility, keybinding.

  • A music game that couldn't be easier! Or harder, depending on how you like your music games.

In the end, you should play however you'd like, whenever you'd like, because isn't that what music's all about?

------------

store_data.about_the_game:
You Must Die is a dice-building roguelike. Defeat enemies, take their faces, and graft them to your dice to shift the odds in your favor. Prepare for your expeditions by visiting the merchant, and unlock new purchase options for every collected bounty.

Swap out and combine faces in the die editor. Want to fill a die with critical hits? You can do it. Want to turn a die into an exploding die? You can do it. Weigh the odds for each die however you want.

Choose a bounty at the bounty board in town and make preparations for your expedition. With each collected bounty comes rewards, new items at the merchant, and new ways to enhance your build. If you die, it all goes away.

Each expedition consists of a series of encounters with a boss at the end. Each bounty provides unique rewards, so choose wisely which ones to chase and the order in which you choose to do them. After completing three bounties, you can choose to attempt the final boss... or you can complete remaining bounties to gather more rewards. Beware, the enemies are also getting stronger as you do.

store_data.about_the_game:
【A Tale of Honor and Vengeance in a Fractured Empire】

Plagued by corruption and border threats, the mid-Ming Dynasty teeters on the brink. Amidst the chaos of the Jianghu, where rival sects scheme in the shadows, who will emerge as a hero of the era, and who will vanish amidst the changing tides? The prelude to the story is about to unfold...

Walking the path of Cyrus, a disciple of the Azure Peak Sect, players will step into a vast Eastern world where state righteousness clashes with deep personal vengeance. Navigate through intricate political intrigues and martial conspiracies alongside a diverse band of companion heroes. Master a deeply tactical party-based combat system to shatter your foes, unfold an epic chronicle of honor, and make choices that define your own path of chivalry.

⚔️ Unleash a 13-Hit Burst of Pure Fury!

Break away from dull numerical exchanges and turn the tide of battle in the blink of an eye! When the moment for ultimate awakening arrives, unleash the protagonist's definitive technique—a relentless 13-hit combo bursting past a staggering 70,000+ damage threshold!

With cinematic character-cut-in illustrations paired with highly impactful visual feedback, experience the absolute peak of tactical tension and satisfying turn-based combat!

Key Features:

  • An Epic Chronicle of the Ming Dynasty: A compelling historical martial arts narrative featuring rich dialogue and deep emotional weight. Experience a masterfully written story of revenge, national crisis, and lighthearted humorous camaraderie.

  • Strategic Party-Based Combat: A classic yet refined turn-based battle system where coordination and tactics are key. Balance attacks, defenses, and unique character skills to outsmart dangerous adversaries in tight tactical engagements.

  • Assemble Your Companions: Meet and recruit distinct heroes on your journey. Customize your party layout, combine their unique martial techniques, and delve deep into their individual backstories.

    👥 Bonds of Brotherhood & Martial Mastery

    • A Journey of Connection & Parting: Begin your journey with your two fellow disciples. As you navigate the shifting tides of the Jianghu, encounter and bond with 3 additional distinct heroes, experiencing a narrative woven with intense reunions and poignant partings.

    • Unprecedented Tactical Depth: Command a vast arsenal of nearly 30 unique, masterfully animated ultimate techniques! From the protagonist’s 8 definitive variations to each companion’s specialized 4-hit ultimate toolkit, the battlefield is your canvas.

    • Synergize Your Martial Style: Customize your tactical party layouts based on your current companions, cross-combine distinct martial disciplines, and build the ultimate combat synergy tailored to crush any adversary.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Black Sanctification: Goku] is a high-quality placement game. Players assume the role of Goku and travel to the 5 major sacred sites for training. By continuously upgrading and strengthening, they can gain greater power and eventually achieve sanctification and ascension to become the Buddha of All Victories.

Worldview Background

Originally, the three realms were peaceful and stable, with immortals and deities performing their respective duties, and all things operating in an orderly manner. But for no apparent reason, a strange black divine power suddenly emerged from the void fissures, completely disrupting all the rules of the world. This power could distort divine light, erode Buddhist doctrines, and cause all things in the universe to undergo changes. The immortals fell into the path of evil, while the demons and beasts gained divine power. The well-ordered world of Tang Sanzang completely collapsed, plunging into chaos. The Sun Wukong, who had once caused chaos in the heavens, finally managed to attain the status of the Great Victorious Buddha and peacefully ruled the Ling Shan Mountain. However, on the night of his consecration as a deity, the strange black divine power invaded his body, contaminating his soul and darkening his Buddha bones. Completely breaking free from the constraints of the Heavenly Court and Buddhism, he was no longer an orthodox immortal or deity, nor was he an ordinary demon. He transformed into a unique black divine warrior, existing outside the rules of the three realms.

Core gameplay system

1. Auto-play leveling system: Characters automatically defeat monsters to gain experience, equipment, and various materials and items.

2. Character Equipment System: As the character continuously defeats monsters and levels up, it will obtain a large amount of equipment. The equipment is divided into 5 qualities: ["Villager Spirit", "Battle Might", "Holy Light", "Celestial Heaven", "Buddhist Supreme"]. Buddhist Supreme is the highest quality and can only be obtained by transforming [Celestial Heaven] equipment. The equipment enables you to acquire a large number of attributes, helping you level up.

3. Gemstone Equipment System: By embedding gemstones into the equipment, the equipment's attributes can be enhanced. Three gemstones of the same level can be combined to form a more advanced gemstone. The highest level of gemstone is V.

4. Character Skill System: Characters can learn both active skills and passive skills. Active skills are divided into two types: [Physical] and [Spell]. There are two levels for skills: one is the enhancement level, which requires upgrading with skill fragments; the other is the skill level, which requires soul upgrades and can enhance the attributes of the skills.

5. Character Skill Point System: After a character absorbs the blood of the demon spirit, they can increase various attributes ["Strength", "Intelligence", "Agility", "Luck", "Physique"]. Each attribute can enhance the strength of the character itself.

PS: This is our first attempt at developing a placement and auto-play game. The numerical values and mechanics may have some flaws, but we will continuously improve and correct the content to make this game an excellent placement game. We welcome everyone to contact us for communication.

In a deserted city from the Middle Ages, many mutated zombies appeared. The army had previously developed gas here. The higher-ups were worried that the zombies would invade the surrounding cities, so they sent Lucy to investigate the situation. It would be best to eliminate all the mutated zombies. The higher-ups gave Lucy 6 high-tech weapons, but there were simply too many zombies here. Lucy might have to stay here for a long time. Get ready. The mission begins!

You need to control Lucy to kill the zombies around her. After killing the zombies, you will gain experience. When the experience is sufficient for upgrading, you will have the chance to enhance your attributes. However, each time you die, one of your random attributes will be reduced in level. Therefore, you need to choose the most suitable attribute to enhance. The weapon is an automatic attack and doesn't require any operation. You just need to control Lucy's movement.

🟠 Background music that is in line with the theme (BGM).

Face impossible dilemmas, meet strange characters, and discover how every switch changes the story. As the trolley keeps moving, your choices will decide who you trust, who you betray, and whether you become someone you never meant to be.


Every level puts you in the middle of a strange dilemma. Choose carefully, because the trolley never waits and every decision leaves a mark on the story.

Meet 30+ side characters for you to SAVE ! Or, you know... to sacrifice. Some may help you later, some may haunt your journey, and some may only exist to test what kind of person you really are.

Depending on who you are fighting against, who stands on your side, each fight can turn into a different kind of challenge.

There is no single right way to play. Side with outlaws, trust the scientists, protect your conscience, or chase power at any cost. In the end, Trolley Dilemma is not only about who lives or dies. It is about what your choices turn you into.

store_data.about_the_game:
MultiScope Air Traffic Control puts you in the controller's seat at one of Europe's busiest airports.

You are the approach controller for Amsterdam Schiphol Airport (EHAM). Arrivals pour down the STARs; departures climb out beneath them. Your job is simple to say and hard to master: turn, climb, descend and slow every aircraft into a clean, safe stream onto the ILS, without ever losing separation.

MultiScope Air Traffic Control features real push-to-talk voice control using authentic ATC phraseology. Key the mic and say "KLM four five six, descend flight level five zero, turn left heading two seven zero, reduce speed two two zero knots." The aircraft reads back in a pilot's voice over simulated VHF radio, squelch clicks, AM band-limiting, background hiss and all. Voice recognition is available on Windows. Prefer to click? Every single command is also available through the on-screen command panel.

A sweeping radar updates your traffic picture in real time, with data tags, history trails, and FMS-style descent-path prediction so you can plan your sequence miles ahead. Holding patterns, direct-to clearances, STAR/SID route following, and ILS localizer + glideslope capture are all faithfully modeled.

Live QNH, wind, and ATIS shape every shift. Set the correct altimeter, manage the active runway, and read the conditions just like a real controller. The weather isn't just set dressing, it changes how you work.

One airport, never the same shift twice. Traffic is generated fresh every session, and you control the pressure. Dial the density from a quiet afternoon to a relentless rush-hour peak. Pick from a range of scenarios and runway/weather presets, then find out how cleanly you handle it: your performance is rated on the separation and sequencing you deliver. Chase the perfect, conflict-free flow.

Realistic mode enforces proper procedures and handoffs for a true-to-life challenge. Arcade mode smooths the rough edges so newcomers can learn the ropes at their own pace.

Features at a glance

  • Push-to-talk voice control with authentic ATC phraseology (Windows) — plus full click-command support on every platform

  • Live radar scope with data tags, history trails and FMS descent-path prediction

  • Full procedure set — ILS localizer + glideslope, holding patterns, STAR/SID routing, direct-to clearances

  • Dynamic weather — QNH, wind, ATIS and active-runway management

  • Endless replayability — randomized traffic, adjustable density, multiple scenarios, performance scoring

  • Two ways to play — Realistic for the full challenge, Arcade to learn

Whether you're an aviation enthusiast, a flight-sim pilot who's always wondered what the voice on the other end is doing, or just someone who likes the satisfying click of a perfect sequence — the scope is yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
A mining colony in a distant solar system far in deep space has been attacked by unknown aliens that emerged from far below the moon's surface. The survivors' only hope is the galaxy's latest search and rescue ship - The Rescue Hornet!

Take command of the Rescue Hornet with its powerful claw arm, explore the deepest caverns of a hostile alien world, defend yourself from a variety of bizarre creatures, find upgrades along the way and most importantly - find and rescue all the survivors.

RESCUE HORNET

The galaxy's state of the art search and rescue ship is equipped with blaster cannons and a powerful claw arm. Upgrades found within the caves of the alien moon can be used to equip new abilities and upgrades to the ship. Be sure to explore everywhere!

THE CLAW

The Rescue Hornet's claw arm is vital for success! Control mechanisms to solve puzzles, carry heavy objects, hold extra weaponry for added firepower or secure attacking creatures in place to render them defenceless.

RESCUE SURVIVORS

Some of the colonists have been taken alive and hidden deep underground. Your mission priority is to find and rescue all survivors. You will be rewarded for your efforts.

HOSTILE ALIENS

The underground caverns of the moon are home to a variety of strange alien life that will destroy you if given the chance. Use all your tools if you want to survive!

HIDDEN SECRETS

Will you discover all the mysteries hidden within the depths of this dangerous moon?

store_data.about_the_game:
Every murder is different.

Yet somehow, they are all connected.

Thousand Wheels is a detective-puzzle game set in a surreal Ottoman-steampunk multiverse, featuring a fully hand-drawn visual style inspired by Ottoman medieval art, Victorian printmaking, and paper theatre aesthetics.

Investigate mysterious deaths across parallel realities. Explore crime scenes at your own pace, collect evidence, and uncover hidden connections between seemingly unrelated cases. There are no shortcuts to the truth—every conclusion must be earned through observation, deduction, and careful analysis.

As you progress, you'll combine clues, identify suspects, and construct storyboards that reconstruct events piece by piece, revealing what happened, why it happened, and who was responsible.

Every case begins with a different death. But the deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: these murders are not isolated incidents. Across countless realities, different versions of the same person are dying under mysterious circumstances.

Follow the trail across worlds and uncover the truth behind the cycle.

FEATURES

* Investigate detailed hand-crafted crime scenes and discover hidden evidence

* Collect items, analyze information, and craft new clues

* Identify suspects through observation, logic, and deduction

* Build storyboards to reconstruct events and solve complex mysteries

* Explore a mystery that unfolds across parallel universes

* Experience a unique Ottoman-steampunk setting inspired by miniature art, Victorian print design, and paper theatre aesthetics

* Immerse yourself in a fully hand-drawn world brought to life through hundreds of original illustrations

* Uncover an interconnected narrative where every case reveals another piece of a larger puzzle

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Desal

You were just passing through.

A quiet road. A small café. A quick stop for food.

Then your card gets declined.

Now you owe them.

Welcome to Desal is a short psychological horror experience where an ordinary job slowly turns into something deeply unsettling. Forced to work off your debt, you take on simple café tasks-serving customers, cleaning, and following orders-but something about this place isn’t right.

Strange conversations echo through the walls at night. Employees act like they’re hiding something. Customers don’t always behave… normally.

And no matter what you do, leaving doesn’t seem to be an option.

Key Features:

- Immersive Job Simulation

Perform everyday café tasks that gradually become tense and uncomfortable.

- Psychological Horror

No cheap jumpscares-just slow-building dread, subtle storytelling, and a constant feeling that something is wrong.

- Dynamic Storytelling

Overhear conversations, notice details, and piece together the truth behind Desal.

- Player Choice & Dialogue

Decide what to say-and what to hide-as others begin to suspect what you know.

What’s Really Going On?

The longer you stay, the more questions you’ll have:

Why doesn’t anyone talk about what happens at night?

Who was behind the wall?

Why won’t your car start?

And why does it feel like you were never meant to leave?

Sometimes, the scariest thing isn’t being trapped somewhere.

It’s realizing you might already belong there.

تبدأ القصة لما يجيك اتصال من عمك، ويبشرك إنه لقى لك وظيفة بـ "محطة الجنوب". وظيفة في محل شاهي بـ شيفت ليلي في محطة مقطوعة على خط سفر، ومعها شقة رخيصة تسكن فيها. فرصة ما تتفوت، صح؟

تدور أحداث القصة حول شخصيات المحطة الأساسية، والزبائن اللي مو كلهم بشر، والأصوات المريبة اللي تسمعها وأنت بشقتك

سؤال واحد بيبقى يدور في بالك طول الشيفت: هل الوظيفة ذي كانت تستاهل كل هذا ؟

 : مميزات اللعبة

بيئة محلية: دمجت تفاصيل كثيرة من ثقافتنا وبيئتنا. بتشوفها في تصميم المكان، في حوارات الزباين، وحتى في الرعب اللي استوحيته

جرافيكس عالي الجودة: قدمت لكم بيئة تعكس واقعنا بدقة

تنوع كبير بالشخصيات: زباين المحطة ما يخلصون، الحوارات تتدرج من حوارات عفوية وكوميدية، إلى الرعب النفسي اللي يوترك، وبتلاحظ إن فيه صناع محتوى معروفين ووجوه مألوفة متواجدين في عالم اللعبة

تمثيل صوتي عربي: اللعبة تدعم الأصوات العربية بمشاركة مؤديين أصوات عشان تندمج مع الحوارات

الاستكشاف (اللقافة): دقق بكل زاوية بالمحطة وشقتك. اللعبة مليانة تفاصيل دقيقة، أسرار مخفية، و "ايستر ايقز" بتكافئ لقافتك

📌

 ⭐ حط لعبة محطة الجنوب بالويشليست الآن

وإذا ودك تعيش معي رحلة صناعة اللعبة وتشوف الكواليس، حياك بحسابي في التيك توك، دايم أنزل هناك آخر أخبار التطوير والتحديثات أول بأول

 🙏🏻 شكراً لكل شخص دعمني سواءً مادياً أو معنوياً


Janob Station



The story begins when you get a phone call from your uncle, bringing you the good news that he found a job for you at "Janob Station". A night-shift job at a tea shop in a remote station on a highway, and it comes with a cheap apartment for you to live in. An opportunity you can't miss, right?

The events of the story revolve around the station's main characters, customers who aren't all human, and the creepy sounds you hear while in your apartment. One question will keep lingering in your mind throughout the shift: Was this job really worth all of this?

Game Features:

Local Environment: I integrated a lot of details from our culture and environment. You will see it in the design of the place, the customers' dialogues, and even in the horror that I inspired.

High-Quality Graphics: I presented to you an environment that accurately reflects our reality. Every cup of tea, every table, and every dark hallway received its fair share of attention.

Great Character Diversity: The station's customers are endless. Dialogues range from casual and comedic to psychological horror that tenses you up, and you'll notice that there are well-known content creators and familiar faces present in the game's world.

Arabic Voice Acting: The game supports Arabic voiceovers featuring voice actors to help you fully immerse yourself in the dialogues.

Exploration (Curiosity): Examine every corner of the station and your apartment. The game is full of fine details, hidden secrets, and "Easter Eggs" that will reward your curiosity.📌

Add "Janob Station" to your Wishlist now!⭐

And if you want to experience the game development journey with me and see the behind-the-scenes, welcome to my TikTok account! I always post the latest development news and updates there first-hand.

Thanks to everyone for your financial and moral support  🙏🏻

Local Environment: I integrated a lot of details from our culture and environment. You will see it in the design of the place, the customers' dialogues, and even in the horror that I inspired.

High-Quality Graphics: I presented to you an environment that accurately reflects our reality. Every cup of tea, every table, and every dark hallway received its fair share of attention.

Great Character Diversity: The station's customers are endless. Dialogues range from casual and comedic to psychological horror that tenses you up, and you'll notice that there are well-known content creators and familiar faces present in the game's world.

Arabic Voice Acting: The game supports Arabic voiceovers featuring voice actors to help you fully immerse yourself in the dialogues.

Exploration (Curiosity): Examine every corner of the station and your apartment. The game is full of fine details, hidden secrets, and "Easter Eggs" that will reward your curiosity.📌

Add "Janob Station" to your Wishlist now!⭐

And if you want to experience the game development journey with me and see the behind-the-scenes, welcome to my TikTok account! I always post the latest development news and updates there first-hand.

Thanks to everyone for your financial and moral support  🙏🏻

store_data.about_the_game:
One position. One breath. One shot.

Hunters Trial: One Breath is a fixed-position, scope-only hunting game built around stillness and timing. You never

walk and you never chase. Rooted to a single vantage point, you pan a 90° view across the wild, read each animal's

behavior, hold your breath to steady the crosshair, and squeeze off one clean shot at the perfect moment.

How it plays

  • Stationary marksman gameplay — no movement, pure aim, patience, and timing.

  • Hold your breath to steady the scope, and trigger slow-motion to thread a shot through a bolting herd.

  • Multi-zoom scope with a realistic aim-down-sights transition, reloading, and weapon handling.

  • Read the wild: passive animals graze and flee when startled, while aggressive predators charge straight at you — drop them before they reach you, or you take damage and fail.

  • Weather and conditions (clear skies, fog, and more) change visibility and difficulty on every hunt.

A full campaign

  • 40 hand-built levels across three distinct biomes: forest, savanna, and mountain.

  • Varied objectives — clear every animal, reach a kill count, survive a charging wave, hunt a specific species, or protect a marked animal where hitting the wrong target fails the trial.

  • Six difficulty tiers from Rookie to Legend, ending in a final Boss hunt. Later trials demand no-miss runs, no damage taken, headshots, and one-shot kills.

Progress and mastery

  • Earn money to unlock and buy 8 distinct scoped rifles, each with its own zoom, handling, and power.

  • Spend XP on hunter upgrades — steadier breath, faster handling, and more — all the way to the Master Hunter rank.

  • Every level is scored 1 to 3 stars on accuracy and clean shooting, with combo bonuses for back-to-back hits. Replay to perfect your score and fully clear the trials.

  • 25 Steam Achievements to hunt down.

At a glance

  • Genre: arcade hunting / fixed-position marksman

  • Single-player

  • Playable with mouse and keyboard or a controller

  • Roughly 2 to 3 hours for a first clear, more to master every star and achievement

  • No story mode, no co-op, no online — just you, your breath, and the shot you were waiting for.

Just you, your breath, and the shot you were waiting for.

store_data.about_the_game:
We think Deforestation is So Relaxing©, and we think you will too!

Welcome to AGRO. We are an agribusiness. We do business with agriculture. Mostly we remove it.

For decades AGRO has led the world in turning forests into not-forests. Now, for the first time, we are letting YOU do it. We see potential in everyone. Even you. Especially you, if you are reading this, because that means you have not been hired by a competitor yet.

You will operate a state of the art forest removal combine across 46 levels of beautiful, thriving, soon to be gone wilderness. Your job is simple. There is a tree. Then there is not a tree. You did that. Good work. The Ecosystem Optimization meter goes up. We are not legally allowed to tell you what Ecosystem Optimization means but our lawyers assure us it tests very well.

As you advance, you will lobby the local town. Then the county. Then the state. Then a man named Congress. Then the entire planet, which is smaller than you think once you get going. Each promotion unlocks a bigger, stronger, faster combine. The trees do not get a promotion. That is the difference between you and the trees.

You may encounter protesters. They will hold signs. The signs have words on them. We recommend the Fire Hose, available in Supplemental Assists, which redirects protesters out of your lane in a manner we describe as gentle and a court once described as something else.

Some trees will glow. We do not know why. Drive over them anyway. It is fine. Everything is fine.

AGRO. We chop down the trees you eat, the bark you spend, and the sap you covet for your rituals. Our corporate finger thumbs the pulse of all human’s.

Buy now. Teach them young.

Just rad™.

store_data.about_the_game:
FEEL THE BEAT. BREAK THE LOOP.


ECHOLASH is a top-down hack & slash where combat, music, and progression collide into something that shouldn't work — but does.


Every sound you hear is generated in real-time. Every dungeon is built from scratch. Every enemy is drawn with code. The entire game is 5 MB. And it will consume hours of your life.

⚔️ SPATIAL TIMING COMBAT


Forget button mashing. Two circles surround your character:


  • The outer circle is your attack range
  • The inner circle breathes slowly — this is your timing window

When an enemy enters the inner circle and you strike — COMBO. Hit it on the music's beat — PERFECT. Chain them together and watch the damage multiply up to 3.5x.


This isn't a rhythm game that punishes you. The beat is a bonus, never a penalty. But once you feel it... you can't stop chasing it.

🎵 PROCEDURAL DUBSTEP SOUNDTRACK


No audio files. No pre-recorded tracks. ECHOLASH generates its own dubstep music in real-time:


  • Wobble bass that reacts to your power level
  • Drum patterns that intensify with your combo
  • Dark pads that shift with dungeon biomes
  • Tempo that accelerates as you chain kills

The music isn't background — it's a weapon.

🔄 REBIRTH & PRESTIGE


Kill. Grow. Hit the power threshold. Rebirth.


Each rebirth resets your progress but multiplies your power permanently. 10 rebirths unlock the Final Boss. Defeat it, and you unlock Prestige — resetting everything for an even greater global multiplier.


  • 10 Rebirth layers with scaling difficulty
  • Prestige system with exclusive upgrades
  • Echo Shards — permanent currency across rebirths
  • 11 upgrades including Prestige-only abilities

🗡️ 4 WEAPON TYPES


  • Sword — balanced melee with reliable combos
  • Hammer — massive AoE and knockback
  • Bow — ranged precision, fires toward your cursor
  • Staff — magic missiles with splash potential

Each weapon drops with random prefixes, suffixes, and 5 rarity tiers from Common to Legendary.

👹 10 UNIQUE ENEMIES


Every enemy is hand-designed with geometric art and unique abilities:


  • Wraith — teleports behind you
  • Spider — shoots webs that slow you
  • Knight — energy shield blocks your attacks
  • Golem — ground slam AoE
  • Cultist — dark orb projectiles from range
  • Shadow Demon — turns invisible
  • Boss Demon — 3-phase projectile patterns
  • Boss Dragon — triple fire breath cone

🔥 ACTIVE ABILITIES


  • Z — Fireball: Launch a massive projectile toward your cursor
  • X — Heal: Restore 35% HP (unlocks at Rebirth 2)
  • C — Shield: Block 80% damage for 3 seconds (unlocks at Rebirth 5)

🌍 4 BIOMES


Each rebirth cycle shifts the dungeon's biome:


  • Forest — tanky enemies, slower pace
  • Ice — fragile but fast enemies
  • Lava — heavy-hitting foes, high rewards
  • Void — everything is dangerous

💾 SMALL SIZE. BIG DEPTH.


  • Zero audio files — music is math
  • Zero image files — characters are geometry
  • Zero pre-built levels — dungeons are algorithms
  • Written entirely in C with OpenGL
  • Runs on almost anything

🎮 FEATURES


  • Procedurally generated dungeons (BSP algorithm)
  • Real-time procedural dubstep music
  • Spatial timing combat with combo system
  • 10 enemy types with unique abilities
  • 4 weapon types with prefix/suffix loot system
  • 5 rarity tiers (Common → Legendary)
  • Rebirth system (10 layers)
  • Prestige system (infinite scaling)
  • Echo Shards permanent upgrade shop
  • 3 active abilities with cooldowns
  • 4 distinct biomes
  • Local leaderboard
  • Settings menu with volume control
  • Pause menu
  • Auto-save every 30 seconds
  • English & Turkish localization
  • Runs at 60 FPS on integrated GPUs

🌍 DAILY CHALLENGE & GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS


Every day brings a new dungeon. Same seed for all players for 24 hours.


  • Seed changes daily at midnight
  • Compete for the highest score on Steam leaderboards
  • Victory gives +50% score bonus
  • Score = kills + power + combo + rebirths

Steam leaderboards track:


  • Total Score (all-time best)
  • Max Rebirths
  • Max Prestige
  • Fastest Victory Time

Steam achievements are also included — first kill, 100 kills, 1000 kills, first rebirth, rebirth 5, rebirth 10, 50 combo, first prestige, legendary item, and final boss.

💧 FOUNTAINS & CHESTS


Each cleared room may contain:


  • Fountain — fully restores your HP (one-time use per room)
  • Normal Chest — drops 1 piece of loot
  • Gold Chest — drops 2-3 pieces of loot
  • Echo Chest — grants Echo Shards for permanent upgrades

⚡ PARRY SYSTEM


Time your attack perfectly as an enemy strikes — PARRY!


  • Negates all incoming damage
  • Stuns the enemy briefly
  • Chains into bonus combo damage
  • Screen flash and "PARRY x2/x3" feedback on successful chains

🎮 FULL GAMEPAD SUPPORT


  • Left Stick / D-Pad — Movement & Menu Navigation
  • A (South) — Attack / Confirm / Respawn
  • B (East) — Heavy Attack / Cancel
  • X (West) — Fireball
  • Y (North) — Heal
  • LB / RB — Pickup / Open Shop
  • Back / Select — Rebirth
  • Start — Pause Menu
  • Dynamic button prompts — switches automatically when gamepad is detected

📝 NOTE


This game is actively in development. We're open to feedback and community suggestions. As the game evolves, new weapons, enemies, abilities, and mechanics will be added — some features may change, diversify, and expand over time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Depths of Selubra

You wake up in a forgotten, dark subterranean world. This is not just a place where you must struggle to survive; it is a massive open world where you write your own fate. Whether you dive into perilous, dark dungeons, conquer the legendary Tower leading to freedom, or lay down your weapons to build your own peaceful (or eerie) life underground, the journey is yours to define.

A Deep and Immersive Sandbox Experience

  • Build and Craft: Construct your own wooden home from scratch, set up crafting stations, and create a fortified sanctuary against the harsh underground conditions.

  • Dynamic Survival: Struggle against hunger, thirst, and the unforgiving nature of the underworld. It is not just the monsters—the environment itself is a constant threat.

  • Deep RPG Mechanics: From woodcutting to athletics, mining to swordsmanship, develop and shape your character through every action you take.

Three Different Destinies

Selubra does not force a single goal upon you. You choose your adventure based on your playstyle:

  • Mystery of the Depths: Dive deeper, clear dangerous dungeons, face terrifying bosses, and bring the secrets hidden in the heart of the darkness to light.

  • Ascent of the Tower: Step into the legendary Tower, the only path to the surface. Can you complete this deadly climb where every floor holds different challenges and foes?

  • A New Life: Perhaps returning to the surface is not that important. Forage, farm, expand your home, and live forever in the strange yet mesmerizing underworld of Selubra.

store_data.about_the_game:
Red Rooms is a time-sensitive, hour-long, tense, free-roam, strategy game in which you must defend yourself against ominous entities. Defend yourself by using your camera flash, holding doors shut, and closing curtains. Each entity requires a specific action to defend against it. If you do not act quickly, you will die. 

You will start in a distorted version of your world. You are told by a disembodied voice that you have made a deal you must uphold. It tells you you've done this before. Only, you have no recollection of this deal. You must find out what this deal is and why you made it in the first place. 

Will you accept the entity's deal, or will you refuse? There are consequences to your actions. 

Red Rooms contains an original soundtrack with guest appearances to amplify feelings of fear, dread, and calm. While the soundtrack was intended to be its own project, it blossomed into a game as well. 

Features:

  • First-person horror gameplay focused on arcade-like survival (FNAF inspired). 

  • Nearly an hour of gameplay.

  • Works based on a night system. 

  • Multiple hostile entities, each with unique mechanics and counters (available in tutorial section of the main menu UI).

Red Rooms is a time-sensitive, hour-long, tense, free-roam, strategy game in which you must defend yourself against ominous entities. Defend yourself by using your camera flash, holding doors shut, and closing curtains. Each entity requires a specific action to defend against it. If you do not act quickly, you will die. 

You will start in a distorted version of your world. You are told by a disembodied voice that you have made a deal you must uphold. It tells you you've done this before. Only, you have no recollection of this deal. You must find out what this deal is and why you made it in the first place. 

Will you accept the entity's deal, or will you refuse? There are consequences to your actions. 

Red Rooms contains an original soundtrack with guest appearances to amplify feelings of fear, dread, and calm. While the soundtrack was intended to be its own project, it blossomed into a game as well. 

Features:

  • First-person horror gameplay focused on arcade-like survival (FNAF inspired).

10-20 minutes per playthrough.

Infinite variations.

store_data.about_the_game:
Kicked out? Build a better party.

After being thrown out of the hero party, there is only one reasonable thing to do: start your own.

My Own Hero Party is a party-building casual incremental game about clearing dangerous dungeon expeditions, collecting gold, and turning each run into permanent progress. Push through room after room, survive the pressure of your stamina timer, and use every reward to grow stronger before the next attempt.

Lead your own expedition

Each expedition sends your party through a chain of dungeon rooms filled with enemies, coins, and escalating danger. Clear rooms before your stamina runs out, grab what you can, and decide how far your current build can go.

Recruit and upgrade your party

Start with the Warrior, then unlock allies like the Archer and Healer to build a stronger formation. Each character brings their own upgrade paths, from cleaving attacks and taunts to piercing arrows, explosive shots, healing, barriers, and party-wide bonuses.

Grow between runs

Gold earned during expeditions feeds a persistent upgrade tree. Increase damage, health, armor, crits, lifesteal, healing, economy, stamina, and class-specific abilities. Every purchase changes how far the next expedition can push.

Unlock harder dungeons

Defeat dungeon difficulties to unlock new contracts and tougher challenges. Fight through Goblin's Dungeon, Minotaur's Sanctuary, Werewolf's Den, and higher difficulty tiers as your party grows from barely surviving into a force that can break through the late rooms.

Features

  • Room-based dungeon expeditions with escalating enemy pressure

  • A stamina timer that makes every run a race

  • Persistent upgrade tree progression

  • Multiple dungeons and difficulty tiers

  • Gold economy, first-clear rewards, and long-term progression

  • Pixel-art combat with growing party power and enemy density

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore the Ultimate Chaotic Nation! As one of the illustrious and caricature figures of popular imagination, prepare to face the pure essence of daily national life and relentless myths. In a fast-paced rhythm, you will dictate your own rules and chart your strategy to decide the fate of a country on the brink of collapse.

O Último Brasileiro is an epic 2D action-platformer that merges acrobatic combat with modern roguelike progression. Explore striking territories, master archetypes with unique mechanics, and face powerful bosses in a vibrant journey inspired by Brazilian cultural diversity.

Game Features

  • Choose your path Mega Man style! Freely select between 8 states and plan your own combat order. Travel through the beaches of Rio de Janeiro, brave the deep mysteries of the Amazon, face the urban chaos of São Paulo, and dive into the colors of Bahia.

  • Acrobatic action and visceral combat! Feel the influence of the agile and precise movement of Hollow Knight and Dead Cells as you dance between enemies in dynamic platforming arenas.

  • Master 3 classes with completely unique gameplay!

    • The Metallurgist: Forged in mechanical strength, he utilizes a bronze steampunk suit with brutal attacks and relentless resistance.

    • The Gravedigger: An enigmatic figure who controls the rhythm of the shadows with long tactical reach and his massive scythe.

    • The Judge: The enforcer of the law, applying high-damage punishments and surgical precision in the arena.

  • Deep progression inspired by Slay the Spire 2! Build your perfect deck of abilities with every run. Earn attribute modifiers, new tactical approaches, and permanent skill trees to adapt your strategy and master the challenges.

  • Face legendary state bosses! Each state features unique environmental mechanics, specific hazards, and a major boss waiting for you at the end of each journey.

  • Sharp satire and vibrant art direction! Enjoy a stylized pixel art visual style and a soundtrack that masterfully pays homage to Brazil's most exciting rhythms, packed with references that instantly stand out.

store_data.about_the_game:
IDLE. UPGRADE. DOMINATE.

BreakEven is an idle ARPG for people who love the loop: kill, loot, upgrade, hit harder, repeat.

The combat runs itself while you make the decisions that matter, what to equip, where to spec, which build to chase. Step away and your hero keeps fighting. Come back and there's always one more upgrade waiting.

It plays like an action RPG and respects your time like an idle game.

The depth is there when you want it, and it never gets in your way when you don't.

Pick your hero

  • The Knight: a physical bruiser who walks into the fray, shrugs off status effects, and turns raw Strength into bone-breaking melee damage.

  • The Mage: a ranged caster who bends Wisdom into spellfire, weaving a mana-driven spell rotation that stacks devastating ailments on everything it touches.

  • The Archer: a precision ranged striker who lives and dies by crit, attack speed and bleed, raining arrows that pile on physical punishment from across the screen.

  • The Necromancer: a dark summoner who raises the dead to fight at their side and rots the living with curses, poison and fear.

Every class is a completely different playstyle with its own progression path and gear identity: plate and steel for the Knight, robes and staves for the Mage, and distinct arsenals for the rest.

Run multiple characters and build them your way.

A combat engine with real depth

  • Seven status ailments: Burn, Poison, Bleed, Freeze, Paralysis, Sleep and Fear, each with its own mechanical bite, shredding defense, amplifying incoming damage, slowing attacks, forcing misses, and more.

  • Seven damage elements: Fire, Ice, Shock, Toxic, Arcane, Mental and Bleed. Resistances are real mitigation, not a footnote, and they matter on both sides of the fight.

  • True ARPG math: crit, crit damage, crit resistance, penetration, dodge, attack speed, lifesteal, spikes and regen all interact the way a loot-game veteran expects.

  • Dozens of themed enemies and bosses, each with their own attacks and ailments to play around.

Loot worth grinding for

  • Six rarities from Common all the way up to Ultimates, and the higher you climb, the better the floor gets.

  • Deep affix system with item levels, set items, and uniques to hunt and assemble.

  • Crafting and smithing: forge your own gear, reroll for the perfect stat line, and turn raw materials into upgrades.

  • Forbidden Stashes full of loot to crack open, with the dopamine hit of a great drop front and center.

Built to respect you

  • No seasons. No seasons, no reset chasing you off your own progress.

  • No forced prestige or account wipes. What you earn stays earned.

  • No pay-to-win. Cosmetics only. Your power comes from play, not your wallet.

BreakEven is the grind without the FOMO. Idle when you want it, hardcore when you don't.

Start a hero. Find one more upgrade. Break even, then break everything.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chase Your Dreams

After years of training under the legendary Master Hill, CJ Lightning finally has the chance to pursue his dream of becoming a professional wrestler. Step into the ring and discover a world where determination, ambition, and heart can make all the difference.

Forge Lasting Friendships

No one reaches the top alone. From lifelong allies to unexpected companions, the bonds you build will help shape your journey through triumphs, setbacks, and everything in between.

Find Romance Beyond the Ring

Between matches and mayhem, meaningful relationships can blossom. Spend time with a colorful cast of characters and discover where your heart truly belongs.

Learn What It Means to Stand Tall

Master Hill taught his students that true strength isn't measured by victories alone. The choices you make will influence not only CJ's future, but the person he becomes along the way.

Wrestling's Biggest Personalities

Professional wrestling is built on unforgettable characters, and Turnbuckle Hearts is no exception. Step into a world filled with larger-than-life rivals, mentors, allies, and showmen who each leave their mark on CJ's path to greatness.

Features

• A story-rich visual novel set in the world of professional wrestling

• Forge friendships and rivalries with an unforgettable cast of characters

• Build relationships with female wrestlers and possibly find romance

• Make choices that shape relationships and key moments throughout the story

• Experience a blend of comedy, heartfelt drama, and larger-than-life wrestling personalities

• Fully voiced characters

store_data.about_the_game:
The World Master is your simulated tabletop game master. They will build you a unique world, play as long as you like, will never tire of your antics, and will let you pursue any challenge you wish to take on. However, the World Master will not shelter you from the consequences of your actions or ill-preparedness.

The first step of generation produces random tectonic plates. From that moment forward the system is deterministic. Mountains form along faults, sunlight increases temperature, pressure drives the wind, rain flows into rivers and lakes and out to the oceans. Not dice rolls, physical laws. 

Manage your resources wisely. Food, water, sleep, and equipment. It's relatively safe within a days walk of town, but out in the wilds, fresh water is scarce, food spoils quickly, and torches only keep small creatures at bay.

Humans settle across the world, but they aren't the only living creatures shaped by it. Monsters lurk wherever spears and armor don't reach, and sometimes even where it does. 

These fantasy worlds are filled with monsters, and when you run into them, you will resolve your differences in turn based tactical combat. Spend your initiative to move and attack, but be careful, you need it to defend yourself as well.


Skills grow as you use them. Any time you use a skill to do something difficult, you gain experience points for the relevant skills and attributes. Adjacent skills are revealed, but nothing is stopping you from training skills you can't see on the web yet.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Controls】 　The controls are the same as classic Minesweeper — left-click to reveal a cell. However, since the goal of this game is to detonate all mines, some functions have been changed. Right-click to place a bomb; click again to remove it. Left-clicking a placed bomb will detonate it immediately, with the same effect as a mine. The advanced technique of pressing both mouse buttons simultaneously also works here, but only on revealed number cells — instead of the usual effect, it reveals all adjacent number cells while leaving mines in place, and consumes the corresponding number of steps.

　The yellow face works the same as in classic Minesweeper to reset the stage. After clearing a stage, clicking it will return you to the stage select screen, where you can choose newly unlocked stages.

【Strategy】

  • Try to minimize wasted steps. A cell showing 0 guarantees that none of the surrounding 9 cells contain a mine, so revealing cells around a 0 is a waste of steps.

  • When you are running low on steps, use right-click to place a bomb and then left-click to manually detonate it — this does not consume any steps.

  • Pressing both mouse buttons on a number cell consumes a large number of steps, but it helps you pinpoint mine locations precisely. Combined with bombs, this can trigger chain explosions.

store_data.about_the_game:
A scandal you have to settle.

Open Interest is an adult romance visual novel set inside Bellwether Markets, a breakout prediction exchange where elections, storms, and ceasefires all become tradable contracts. You play as Lennox Carver, Bellwether's Chief Markets Officer, and the man under federal subpoena for the most infamous market in company history: a mortality contract on missing aid worker Edith "Edie" Dunmore, found dead three weeks ago. The market is still pending. Your decision will either pay out those who bet she'd die, or void the trade and claw it back.

Over one charged day, three women converge on Lennox as three incompatible truths of the same catastrophe. The most material nonpublic information in the building isn't on a screen. It's whichever room you walk into first.

Meet the Cast




Maxine Reyes — The Whale
Maxine is the biggest counterparty on Bellwether's book: a fund founder, a ruthless reader of rooms, and the holder of the enormous NO position the probe can't stop circling. She and Lennox came up together in the pits — briefly, combustibly in love — and broke over the same question now hanging between them. Maxine's emotions don't wear market language; they move like fencing: distance, invitation, the touch you give away on purpose to learn how someone fights.



Cleo Dunmore — The Sister
Cleo is Edie Dunmore's older sister, a working ceramicist who walked into Bellwether's glass tower with nothing but grief, fury, and a demand: void the bet on her sister's life. She refuses the building's euphemisms and makes Lennox say the real words — died, bet, profit. Cleo's truth is tactile and unsoftened, and when emotion overwhelms language she turns to clay: centering, cracking, firing.



Kit Aldana — The Quant
Kit is Bellwether's head of market design: the razor-bright architect of the questions people trade, and the woman whose resolution logic is now the most subpoenaed page in the building. Lennox pulled her up from a junior seat years ago — mentor, shield, and ceiling — and now the scandal threatens to pin the blame on her while he holds the override that started it. When the math cracks and she reaches for something human, Kit speaks in birds and migration.

Key Features

  • One decisive choice, three intimate routes: choose whose room you walk into first — Maxine, Cleo, or Kit — and commit to a single, high-stakes romance.
  • A corporate thriller wrapped around a love story: subpoenas, resolution deadlines, and insider-trading pressure collide with private need.
  • Distinct emotional "languages" for each romance: fencing distance and touch, clay and kiln-heat, birds and migration.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes for mature audiences (18+).
  • A world that keeps moving after the confession — even when you choose love (or integrity), the exchange keeps listing the next contract.

store_data.about_the_game:
A glowing ball of light bounces through the dark. Your job is to guide it home.

Chromafall is a neon physics puzzle game where you place mirrors and obstacles to redirect a bouncing ball of light toward glowing receptors. Simple to learn, endlessly satisfying to master.

Drop obstacles onto the play field, watch the ball ricochet off your carefully chosen placement, and feel the rush when every receptor lights up simultaneously. The more you play the deeper the strategy becomes — angles that seemed obvious become complex, and solutions that felt impossible suddenly click into place.

Place. Bounce. Solve.

store_data.about_the_game:
'Don't Sleep With The Fishes' is a point-and-click survival horror game focused on rapid salvaging, resource management, and surviving day by day at sea featuring:

  • Randomized scavenging and events.

  • 3 Different shipmates to take with you and talk to.

  • A cozy and creepy atmosphere that alternates between day and night. (This game contains Jumpscares!

How To Play:

You’re the captain of a ship on a covert delivery mission with a small crew. Without warning, something strikes the vessel, causing severe damage. You wait for the emergency horns. When they sound, you know you need to evacuate immediately.

Time is running out! Gather whatever you can and toss it into your lifeboat, before the ship sinks. Every item counts! Escape by staying near the boat at the end! However, it can only carry one more person besides you.

Use the daytime to spend your energy on fishing, eating, doing small tasks, or chatting to your shipmate (if you brought one). When you run out of energy, end the day and try to sleep hoping nothing disrupts your rest.

If your night does get interrupted, use an item you brought to handle the situation. If you have no answer, you can try going back to sleep. Sometimes, that’s your only option.

Your adventure could end in many ways. In some, you will survive. In most, you won't.

store_data.about_the_game:
Purrfect Slide is a charming and cozy take on the classic match-3 puzzle genre. Whether you want to relax after a long day or chase massive high scores, these adorable bubbly felines are here to help you unwind!

Key Features:

  • Cute & Bubbly Match-3 Gameplay: Match 3 or more adorable cats to pop them and score points! Features 7 colorful kitty types including Pink, Green, Yellow, Blue, Purple, Orange, and the rare Calico.

  • Special Cats & Combos: Match 4 cats to create a powerful Line Cat that clears an entire row or column. Match 5 cats in a T or L shape to spawn a Bomb Cat for an explosive area-of-effect clear!

  • Fever Mode: Build up your combo multiplier and enter Fever Mode! The screen pulses, the music distorts, and your score skyrockets as you pop cats in a frenzy.

  • Procedural Cozy Music: Enjoy an endless, procedurally generated cozy soundtrack that perfectly matches the relaxing puzzle vibes.

  • Achievement Hunter Friendly: Over 60 fully integrated Steam Achievements to unlock, ranging from score milestones to popping hundreds of your favorite colored cats!

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the medieval world of art and alchemy—where every cat hides a secret.

《Find Cats 7: Art & Alchemy》is a colorful hidden object game set in medieval art studios and alchemy chambers. Across three hand-drawn levels—from the flickering alchemy room, to the sunlit painter's attic, to the flower-filled Gothic garden—every cat perches in a carefully arranged scene, waiting to be discovered.

## Game Features

🐾 **180 Cats Across 3 Levels**

60 × 3 = 180 uniquely drawn, vibrantly colored cats scattered across every corner of art and alchemy. Each one is independently illustrated and one of a kind.

🎨 **Art & Alchemy Theme**

From the alchemy room hung with flasks and crucibles, to the painter's attic packed with gold-framed oil paintings, to the flower-laden Gothic garden—every scene drips with medieval art and alchemy atmosphere.

🔊 **27 Cat Calls + 4 Brand-New BGM Tracks**

27 real-sampled cat calls—each cat has its own voice. 4 newly composed background tracks shift with the scene, drawing you deeper into the search.

💡 **A Hint for Every Cat**

Can't find one? No problem—every cat has its own hint. Just tap for a clue. But the real joy is spotting them with your own eyes.

👀 **Visible, Yet Deeply Hidden**

Every cat is on the canvas, but their hiding spots are tricky—behind flower petals, in the shadow of jars, curled in painting corners, nestled among alchemy tools. Only the truly observant will find them all.

## Who Is It For?

- Fans of cat-finding, hidden object, and casual puzzle games

- Players who love the "I found it!" moment

- Anyone wanting to relax their eyes and sharpen their observation in busy times

- Cat lovers and art enthusiasts

- Players who enjoy medieval art and alchemy fantasy atmosphere

## Why Find Cats 7?

- **Substantial content**: 180 carefully drawn and placed cats—no padding

- **Immersive atmosphere**: Colorful art + medieval art and alchemy, visual and audio delight

- **Friendly difficulty**: Hints available, no stuck moments—but still requires care, or you'll miss them

- **Easy to pick up**: Click to find, no complex controls, suitable for all ages

Step into the medieval world of art and alchemy, and start your cat-finding journey!

"Humble Abode & Strays" is a heartwarming idle game.

On a stormy night, you find yourself in a shabby old room, where you encounter a group of stray cats.

You can do nothing at all — just listen to the rain, rest to the sound of their purrs, and take it easy. Or you can pick up a brush and gently groom their fur. The fur balls you brush off are the cats' way of saying thank you. Use them to make this humble room a little warmer, one step at a time.

Every cat in the game is based on a real stray. Some were lucky enough to be adopted by kind people. Others never got that chance. I drew their stories one by one, crying as I painted. I hope their stories can touch your heart, just a little.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Pixel Hold'em is a pixel-style Texas Hold'em game built around online multiplayer matches. Create your own room or join a public or password-protected table, then take on friends and other players in tense rounds of Texas Hold'em.

From pre-flop to river, every call, raise, fold, and all-in can change the outcome of a hand. Read your hole cards, react to the community cards, watch the pot, and respond to your opponents' actions to decide when to push and when to hold back.

The game uses authoritative server-side settlement and includes a verifiable dealing system. Commitment data is locked before a hand begins, and verification materials are revealed after the hand ends, allowing players to review the result for greater transparency.

Features

- Online multiplayer room-based matches with public and password-protected tables

- Classic Texas Hold'em gameplay with blinds, betting rounds, community cards, showdown, and hand comparison

- Practice with AI bots while waiting for suitable live rooms

- Friend and invite systems that make it easy to add friends, track status, and send room invites

- In-match chat for table interaction and a more social multiplayer experience

- Customization options including avatars, avatar frames, card backs, and background themes

- Verifiable match data to help players review fairness after each hand

Content

The game includes online multiplayer, bot practice, friend interaction, invitations, chat features, and collectible cosmetic content.

All chips and related in-game values are for entertainment purposes only and cannot be exchanged for real-world currency.

Whether you're a fan of automation games or simply enjoy solving complex systems, you'll find endless opportunities to improve, expand, and perfect your production network.

store_data.about_the_game:
Reshape the battlefield. Then blow it up.

Stickplosion is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art PvP brawler where every wall, floor, and platform is fair game. Carve a tunnel, drop the ground out from under an enemy, or wall yourself in to reload — the terrain is fully destructible, and the smartest fighter bends the arena to their

will.

FEATURES

• Fully destructible terrain — blast it, build it, bury your rivals in it. No two matches play the same.

• Steam multiplayer — invite friends and play up to 8 players over Steam P2P. No IP addresses, no port-forwarding.

• Roguelite ability drafts — pick a fresh power-up between every round and stack a build on the fly.

• Modes for every mood — Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch, Tower, and melee-only mayhem.

• Bots anytime — fill a lobby or sharpen your aim solo against tunable AI.

• Hazards & pickups — sentries, landmines, explosive barrels, teleporters, and spike traps, plus HP, reload, and damage boosts.

• Build your own arenas — a full in-game map editor and a browser-based Map Creator; design it, share it, fight in it.

• Play your way — custom characters, in-game chat, gamepad or mouse & keyboard, and 31 languages.

Drop in. Blow it up. Do it again.

Quick matches, instant chaos, and a battlefield that never looks the same twice.

store_data.about_the_game:
This game is a unique blend of football and card-based strategy, where two players compete against each other in real time.

The goal is simple: score 5 goals before your opponent. But the path to victory is anything but.

During the match, you use cards to build tactics, strengthen your players, and gain the upper hand on the field. Every decision counts—if you run out of cards or your players become exhausted and ineffective, you can quickly lose control of the match.

Each team consists of 6 players on the field:
5 outfield players and 1 goalkeeper.
That’s a total of 12 players competing at the same time.

The gameplay is enhanced by special magic cards that:

  • temporarily or permanently boost player stats

  • grant unique abilities

  • provide tactical advantages in critical moments

The right strategy, timing, and smart card usage will determine who scores the 5th goal—and wins the match.

Features

  • ⚽ Real-time 1v1 matches

  • 🃏 Strategic card-based gameplay

  • 🧠 Deep tactical decision-making

  • 💥 Magic cards with unique effects

  • 👥 6v6 player setup on the field

  • 🎯 Fast-paced matches – first to 5 goals wins

Inherit the hotel. Inherit the phone.

Aiden Kurosawa, 28, comes home to the Crimson Resort & Spa to bury his father and take over a hotel he never wanted. On his second day he unlocks his father's phone and finds Manager Mode — an app that reads every staff member's inner state and lets him Amplify, Reduce, or Transfer any emotion he points it at.
Four women he was meant to manage start managing him back. And every one of them already belongs to someone else.
Disclosures: this game contains uncensored adult content, AI-generated art, and AI-synthesized (TTS) voice, with NTR (cuckolding) themes in two of its four routes. Full details at the bottom of this page — please read before purchasing.
★ 4 heroines · 8 routes · 9 endings · 70+ event CGs · 40+ animated H-scenes · Japanese full voice · 5–7 hours ★

Four women. Each one already taken.

  • Evelyn, 29 — front-desk supervisor. Her husband visits on weekends. You have her the other five days.
  • Aoi, 27 — housekeeping lead, engaged two years to the head chef in the next wing. He still hasn't set a date. You will.
  • Rei, 23 — seasonal part-timer, half-into something with a junior cook, committed to nothing — until the app shows you what she actually wants.
  • Haruka, 38 — general manager, your father's right hand for twenty years. She thinks it was unrequited love. The photographs in his desk say otherwise.

The choice IS the corruption.

Every heroine forks into a Pure route (refuse the app at the decisive moment) or a Dark route (open it). The branching isn't a menu — it's the theme. Each Dark choice makes you tap "Open Manager Mode." By the time a Dark route ends, you've re-enacted the pattern three times, knowing exactly what you were doing — and what you refuse to do is the only thing that defines you.

Features

  • 4 dedicated heroines, each with a full Pure/Dark arc across three visits
  • 8 routes, 9 endings — your pattern of choices is the route you earn

The rules of the casino have changed. High Roller: Dicey Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelite / bullet heaven game with tactical card synergies where you turn your luck into a deadly force. Dive into thousands of creatures, blast slot machines, and build your own bullet heaven to become the ultimate winner of the table!
Key Features

  • Drag-and-Drop Weapon Modification: Your weapons don't just fire; they are shaped by the rules you write. Connect projectile types, explosive or homing augments, and slot utilities using a unique card system. Design crazy bullet combinations that split mid-air, spiral, or trigger chain explosions on hit.

  • Push Your Luck, Grab the Reward (Slot Machines): You don't just collect experience points on the battlefield; you gamble with slot machines that appear on the map at specific kill milestones. Spin the wheel, grab rare cards based on the combinations, and take your build to the next level.

  • Challenging Boss Fights: Roll your dice against powerful bosses ruling the area. Fight for survival against bosses with cleverly designed attack patterns, including unique opponents that multiply damage based on poker hands.
