    • Move and Survive: Your character automatically targets the nearest enemies; your only job is to weave through the hordes.

    • Collect XP and Grow Stronger: Level up by collecting orbs dropped by fallen enemies and increase your base stats like movement speed.

    • Slot Your Deck into Your Weapon: Open the card panel at any time, drag your modifiers into weapon slots, and instantly alter the behavior of your projectiles.

    • Clear the Table: Once you clear the area, activate the boss spawner and get ready for the ultimate showdown!

store_data.about_the_game:
《外婆的手账本》是一款以料理为主题的治愈系人文叙事游戏。

故事中，玩家意外获得了一本由外婆亲手绘制的旧手账。本以为只是寻常的菜谱记录，却在翻阅的过程中，逐渐发现其中密密麻麻记录着的，都是童年与外婆共度的点滴日常。随着手账一页页展开，尘封的记忆缓缓苏醒——一起揉馅包汤圆的厨房、一起做手工的午后、那些曾经习以为常的叮嘱与陪伴，在长大之后才被重新理解其重量与温度。

我们常常习惯于用“外婆”这个身份去定义她，却在回望之中逐渐意识到：在成为“外婆”之前，她首先是一个拥有自己人生的人。游戏以细碎而温热的日常为载体，串联起一段关于陪伴与理解的回忆之旅。在烟火气的料理与手作之间，讲述一个关于时间与亲情的温柔真相：人终会渐行远去，但藏在日常里的爱，永远温热长存；人生本难圆满，珍惜当下相伴的每一刻，便是最好的圆满。

故事的舞台发生在1995年的上海，你将会在故事中回到过去，重新与外婆一起生活。

与外婆一起制作各种小吃或美食，汤圆、春卷、桂花糖藕、棒冰、八宝饭等等……

在和外婆一起做饭的过程中，你还可以与外婆展开话题交谈，了解到一些你可能从来没有了解过的她。

她的爱好、她的过去、她的理想、她的遗憾……

我们很容易把长辈只当成了“长辈”，却往往忽略了他们卸下“长辈”这层身份之后的自我。

如果能有机会回到过去再与外婆一起生活的话，一定要珍惜……

=========  开发者的碎碎念  =========

看了阿嬷的情书之后……突然就好想做一款有关长辈的独立游戏啊！！

小时候我对外婆的记忆是最深的，父母由于工作关系没法整天陪我，把我”丢给“外婆来带就成了很常见的选择。

那时候外婆的家在上海黄浦区的一个老破小弄堂里（现在早就已经拆除改成高楼大厦了），在阳台上扒着铁栏杆观察马路上车水马龙、听着远处外滩海关大楼的钟声就成了我童年对外婆家的主要印象。

外婆为了不让我觉得无聊，就会带着我到处玩，附近的杂货店、小吃店、南京路的汤姆熊、福州路的上海书城、人民广场……还有好多早已记不清的地方。

每次出门，外婆都会紧紧地牵住我的手，还时常调侃道”外婆要是把你弄丢了，我可怎么跟你妈交代呀“（笑）。

现在随着越来越长大，就开始愈发怀念小时候和外婆一起生活的时光。

最近，我和几个有相同共鸣的小伙伴组成了一个迷你小团队，开始一起创作《外婆的手账本》这款独立游戏，正在努力爆肝ing...

我其实很担心这个主题会比较小众，或者比较”沉重“，如果喜欢这个主题的话还请大家能把”支持“表达出来让我们感受到啊，否则太缺乏信心和正反馈了……哈哈哈！

人物介绍

失去记忆的少年，脖子上的金色挂坠让人在意。现在本人似乎是在极力取回失去的记忆，对周围的戒备心一开始很强，但因为本人很随性，所以很快就放下了，不过该考虑的事还是会去考虑

“没有什么是一成不变的，一切都是无常的。

从一片漆黑的梦中醒来的主角林洛失去了所有的记忆，面对全是陌生人的这个地方，他接下来到底该做什么？

“无论如何，顺其自然吧？”

—Guess the instrument—

Enter the room and the performance begins!

Guess the type of instrument being played.

The number of instruments increases with each stage.

Once you know the instrument, press the "E" button or left-click in front of it.

You can also listen to the sound of each instrument.

8 stages in total. If you get it wrong, start again from "0".

Click operation and camera movement (WASD + drag)

・Listen to the "sound" and guess the "instrument"

Game Content

・8 stages in total

Clear by getting 8 correct answers in a row

・Guess the type of instrument being played

When you enter a room, the music starts randomly.

Press the "E" button or left-click in front of the instrument you think is correct.

If the number and instrument match, proceed to the next stage.

If you get it wrong, start again from 0.

Game Controls

・Character control with keyboard: WASD + Camera control: Mouse drag

・"E" button allows you to listen to the sound of instruments and select them.

Question

A: We've made the instruments larger to make them easier to see.

Q: Is it really at a level that could be called a performance...?

A: The main game is guessing the instruments!

store_data.about_the_game:
Fill It — Cozy Logic in Color Blocks

A warm, paper-textured logic puzzle. The only rule: fill the whole board with rectangles. Looks simple — gets addictive fast.

How to Play

Each dark circle on the board holds a number — that's how many cells its rectangle must contain. Your job is to divide the entire board into rectangles that don't overlap and leave nothing empty — one number per rectangle, the digit equal to the rectangle's cell count.

Sounds tricky. One puzzle in, and it clicks.

Three Challenges, Earn Them All

Every level has three independent badges to chase:

・Cleared — solve it within the time limit

・Speed — solve it with 60% time remaining

・Flawless — solve it without erasing a single block

The level select screen marks your progress with Bronze / Silver / Gold, so replaying old levels always has a target.

Five Modes, One for Every Mood

・100 Levels — A hand-tuned difficulty curve from 4×3 up to 18×9

・Endless — Unlocked after Level 100. Randomized, never-ending

・Relax — No timer, no fail state. Pure meditative tiling

・Daily Challenge — A new puzzle every day. Build your streak

・Custom Workshop — Design your own puzzle and share it

Design Puzzles for Friends

The built-in level editor lets you build boards from 8×6 up to 18×9. Saved levels generate a short code — your friend pastes it in, and your design loads instantly. No servers, no accounts, no social logins. Just pure sharing.

Who's It For?

・Anyone hunting for a 5-minute breather between meetings

・Solo puzzlers who want a quiet ritual before bed

One sheet of paper, a few color blocks, and time that's all yours.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Stories to Tell" is a series of psychological horror games developed by a 16-year-old in which each installment is based on a dream or nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you won't want to miss...

Hello, my name is zebaxx. I’m a 16-year-old game developer from Spain. I had this nightmare a while ago… I still remember it clearly because I always write down my nightmares when I wake up.

In [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident, the player takes on the role of a young guy who documents his move into a new house through vlogs, in a style inspired by YouTube content. What begins as casual, everyday recording quickly turns into a series of disturbing and increasingly dangerous events.

[The game lasts approximately 15 to 20 minutes]

Gameplay

[Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on exploration, environmental storytelling, and found-footage-style presentation.

Key Features of [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident

  • VHS aesthetic with a found-footage style.

  • A protagonist who documents their experience through vlogs.

  • First-person immersive gameplay.

  • Exploration, tension, and chase sequences.

  • Visual presentation inspired by analog recordings.

  • Short and intense horror experience.

*Add it to your wishlist to support me :)*

store_data.about_the_game:
选择注定和失去相伴——那失去之后，还剩下什么？

关于这款游戏

你带着录取通知书和全家的期望来到上海。

你以为只要足够努力，就能扎根。

这不是逆天改命的爽文。这是十年的真实账单。

底气与面子

游戏没有血条。你的护盾是"底气"，弱点是"自尊"。

没钱会逼你接廉价兼职。但为了那点做题家的面子，你会付出更贵的代价。

低头生存，还是维持体面。没有第三条选择。

比穷更疼的

你的焦虑不只来自数字。

是那个轻轻松松碾压你努力的室友。

是你得意忘形嘴快了，然后她整整一个学期没理你。

是你们十指相扣了一整个下午，但"大城市户口、有现房"挂在那，谁都没提。

他们的轨迹是你丈量自己的标尺。也是你凌晨三点醒来的原因。

看得见，走不了

有些选择就在那里——留学、创业、另一条赛道。但它们挂着灰色的锁。

不是你不拼。是你的起点，从一开始就不在那条路上。

和解

你为了向别人证明自己泄了密，为了逃避对老友已读不回。

当退路全没了的时候，你终于看清——

和解不是变成了别人羡慕的样子。

是看看自己手里还有什么。

用我的十年，希望换来你的自我和解。

  • 周计划式时间管理，每次选择都有代价

  • 双周结算：回顾得失，毒舌弹窗从审判到和解

  • 焦虑系统：压力累积、崩溃与触底反弹

  • 事件卡牌抉择：面对人生的关键时刻，没有标准答案

  • 手机弹窗：社交压力以推送通知的形式持续侵入

  • 认知地图：视野决定你能看见多少条路

This game is a realistic life simulator and text-based interactive fiction exploring the authentic pressures and mental struggles of contemporary youth. It contains the following mature content:

Language: Contains mild to moderate crude language, profanity, and emotional outbursts within the text.

Legal Drugs: Textual depictions and references to alcohol and tobacco consumption used as coping mechanisms for stress or during social events (e.g., social drinking at parties, smoking to destress).

Psychological Themes: Features heavy psychological themes including chronic anxiety, loss of sanity, and scripted "mental breakdowns" induced by extreme stress.

Note: There is NO graphic violence, gore, explicit sexual content, or visual depictions of self-harm/suicide.

store_data.about_the_game:
**RULE A COUNTRY FROM THE SHADOWS**

*The Company* is a story-driven strategy game with card-swiping mechanics where you run a country from behind the scenes and try to seize all its resources. You have critical responsibilities to the "Big Boss". First, you must prove you are worthy of this daunting task, and then conquer your assigned country from the inside out without anyone noticing.

**MANIPULATION, POLITICS, AND CONTROL**

Your goal is clear: siphon the wealth of your assigned country into The Company's vault. To do this, you must control politicians, direct the media, and manipulate the streets. Swipe left or right to make critical decisions on every intelligence and event card that lands on your desk. But be careful; the slightest mistake could blow your cover, ending both the operation and your life.

**KEY FEATURES:**

* **Ruthless Resource Management:** Walk the dangerous line between The Company's insatiable expectations and your secrecy in the country. Always keep your exposure risk and power parameters in balance.

* **Every Choice Has a Price:** The media, politics, or the streets... Manipulating one side might disrupt the balance of another. Every choice you make will have a direct impact on the country's fate.

* **Deep and Dynamic Narrative:** A branching, rich espionage story full of betrayal, conspiracies, and political intrigue shaped by your decisions.

* **Dark and Stylized Atmosphere:** A Noir universe with unique 2D comic book style graphics that reflect this world of crime and dirty relationships.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Twilight Tides: Mirage Journey》a fantasy destiny-driven otome narrative game.

Guided by the wisdom of 22 tarot cards, the story unfolds—each card advancing the plot, shaping the narrative, and building a world where fate and mystery entwine. At its heart lies the haunting theme of apocalyptic black hole travel, giving rise to a dual-layered reality: the Main World and the Apocalypse Side Stories. Here, temporal paradoxes and an alternate-era setting merge into a uniquely poetic "white-space" emotional experience—tender, open, and yours to feel.

No more cookie-cutter plots.
Every choice you make, every secret whispered by the tarot, weaves a fate shared only between you and him—the one whose soul crosses yours across broken skies. store_data.about_the_game:
Defend and enjoy the vibes

You are part of the bridge head deployment on a hostile planet. Build an overcharged tower defense line around the Volta core. Place classic tower defense staple towers as well as state of the art audio-reactive (a.k.a Vibe) towers and ride escalating waves, synergies, and thunderous Volta Shock payoffs.

Build Your Defense

Choose from electric Bolt Spires, slowing Frost Looms, Cinder Mortars, Prism beams, Tesla chain lightning, support Foundries, Lumen and Antimatter heavy weapons. Every tower has a clear job, fast decisions, and satisfying combinations.

Turn Combat Into Power

Kills, clean clears, and tower synergies feed the Voltage meter. When the core is charged, trigger Volta Shock to unleash map-wide discharges that stun, damage, and light up the swarm. Burning electric bursts, mortar shatters, antimatter detonations, hasted lanes, and conductive beam splits reward thoughtful layouts.

Make the Fight React

The optional Resonance Tower can react to local system audio, turning music, streams, or podcasts into pulse-driven field shots. Put something on, build around the beat, and let your defense answer back.

Built for Spectacle

Tower Vibes leans into meaty combat feedback. Enemy telegraphs, boss arrivals, perfect clears, elemental deaths, reward pings, screen shake levels as well as controlled chaos with up to 256x speed multiplier

store_data.about_the_game:
Susanoo is a soulslike-typing game where you type to attack enemies and press [Space] to parry incoming strikes with precise timing. Heavily inspired by Sekiro and Glyphica, made by one person.

You play as Susanoo, a God of Japanese mythology who was cursed and cast out of heaven for his wrath and arrogance. Consumed by regret, he now determined to protect every soul he meets before his curse finally end him.

Play Stylish, Climb Ranks.

Susanoo rewards style over speed. Each stage is graded up to P rank based on how well you play. chain your attacks, land perfect parries, and keep your kill combo alive. Typing speed won't carry you. Your decision-making will.

In Game Content

Susanoo features 5 levels, each with its own boss. Across 25 total stages (20 normal enemy stages and 5 boss stages). Literally a short experience, You can beat the game in 2-5 hours.

In normal stages, survival is a matter of strategy. Read the battlefield, prioritize the right targets, and stay out of harm's way. In boss stages, everything comes down to your parry. Learn the pattern. Strike back.

Original Orchestral Soundtrack

Features an original orchestral soundtrack composed specifically for the game for every level, blending atmospheric arrangements with powerful choir performance to bring the Japanese mythology world feels.

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your crew are stranded deep in the endless, humming halls of the Backrooms. Buzzing lights, empty yellow corridors, sterile archives, bottomless chasms — and the only way forward is paint. Spray it, splash it, and watch the dead world light up under your color. It's eerie, it's weird, it's strangely beautiful... and it's pure chaos with friends.

Features

🎨 Paint everything — Cover walls, floors, ceilings and props in vivid color. Your tank runs dry, so spray smart and grab refills as you go.

👥 1–4 player online co-op — Play solo or squad up. Everyone gets their own colored suit: 🟢 green, 🟡 yellow, 🔴 red, 🟣 purple.

🧩 Paint to progress — Reveal hidden bridges over deadly drops, fill paint trails and color secret panels to open the way. The level only makes sense once you've painted it.

👻 Backrooms, but fun — Classic liminal dread turned into a color-soaked playground full of weird anomalies and "what was that?" moments.

🏚️ Explore strange worlds — From the first eerie halls to a colorful archive wing and out across the Chasm Walk, where you paint invisible bridges into existence step by step.

🎙️ Talk it out — Built-in voice chat: shout directions, scream at a missed jump, and coordinate the next splatter.

🚪 Jump in fast — Host a room, browse open games, or join by code in seconds, then dive into the void together.

Will you escape the void — or just make it prettier?

Grab three friends, load up, and paint your way to freedom.

🟢🟡🔴🟣 Wishlist Backrooms: Splatter now.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Star Pact: Spirit Garden is a gentle anime idle RPG set in a starlit fantasy garden. Form pacts with heroines, progress through automatic battles, dispatch expedition commissions, collect resources, and strengthen your garden through levels, star-ups, bonds, and ascension.

Relaxed Idle Progression

Your team automatically challenges stages and gathers resources over time. Expeditions continue while you are away, so each return brings rewards to claim, upgrades to plan, and new stages to push.

Heroine Growth

Unlock multiple female protagonists and improve them through levels, star ranks, and Bond progression. Each heroine has her own role and skill, helping your team in different parts of the long-term growth loop.

Expeditions and Resources

Send your team on expedition commissions of different lengths, from short missions to 24-hour routes. Gold, Star Dew, Crystals, Bond points, and expedition materials all feed into a steady progression system.

Ascension and Automation

Reach milestone stages, ascend, reset short-term progress, and gain permanent growth resources. As you upgrade the shop, you can unlock automation options for level-ups, Bonds, shard purchases, star-ups, and ascension to make the idle experience smoother.

A Gentle Fantasy Garden

The game does not require intense controls. Grow your team at your own pace, organize resources, complete goals, and gradually bring the quiet garden back to starlight.

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

In the spring of his second year after dropping out of university, K lives a "lie-flat" life. Having cut ties with his parents, he stays locked in his room all day, with his younger sister Noko as his only connection. One day, Noko brings her friend Kotoha over. This mysterious girl takes an interest in K and insists on pulling him out to see the sunlight. But unknown to K, both Kotoha and Noko carry secrets they cannot tell. Within just a few spring days, their relationship rapidly spins out of control…

FEATURES

This short visual novel blends literary fiction with raw adolescent angst and psychological unease.

Elements include: philosophical meditation, psychoanalysis, family-of-origin trauma, and mental disorders.

No choices/branches → single ending (Normal End).

CHARACTERS

Kotoha - A girl who draws, but always draws back

from her own heart. She’s determined to be an artist,

yet trapped in self-doubt. Lately, she’s drawn to you.

Noko - Your sister. On the surface, she’s straight —

straight-A student, straight-laced, straight down the line.

She meets every expectation, day after day.

K - You, a veteran lieaboutist — lying about the house

and lying about everything else. Even though

everyone seems to think you’re just a posturing liar.

NOTICE

1.This work contains psychological descriptions and discussions of social issues that may cause discomfort.

2.The story is purely fictional. Please do not associate it with reality.

3.It is recommended to view it from a critical perspective, rather than simply identifying with the characters.

Mature Content Description
General Description:
The game Teen Hustler is a deep economic simulator with hacking and criminal sandbox elements. The project touches on themes of the shadow internet, illegal contracts, and cybercrime, therefore containing elements intended for a mature audience.

Violence and Gore:

The game contains abstract and stylized elements related to committing virtual cybercrimes (database hacking, contracted cyber attacks).

Graphic or excessive violence, mutilation, torture, as well as realistic blood and gore are completely absent from the game.

Depictions of sexual violence, coercion, or non-consensual sexual acts of any kind are completely absent from the game.

Nudity and Sexual Content:

The game features no explicit content, nudity, or graphical depictions of sexual acts. The themes of sex and erotica are not utilized in the gameplay.

Substances and Alcohol:

While managing the virtual character's daily life, the player uses energy drinks to maintain energy and efficiency.

Direct depiction of the use of hard drugs, alcohol, or tobacco is absent, though shadowy financial operations (such as crypto mixers and money laundering) are referenced.

Sensitive Themes and Self-Harm:

The themes of suicide, self-harm, or depressive disorders are not raised in the game's plot or mechanics.

Humor and Language:

The game contains satire, dark humor, and moderately coarse language within text dialogues and generated user reviews, reflecting a toxic hacking environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the last survivor of a sunken submarine. The system you served let your comrades die. Now, there’s only one thing left to do: survive and make them pay. This roguelike action miner with base-building elements combines the gameplay loop of Dome Keeper with the crisis management of Faster Than Light and a dash of creative freedom à la Terraria.

Dig through the seabed, secure resources, and keep your submarine running. Excavate the seafloor and master the weight mechanics. Every trip counts, so optimize your pathing with ladders, platforms, and automated transit systems.

Defend against waves of corrupt fleets and gigantic kraken. In Comrade Bear, efficiency is your greatest weapon. You don’t need twitch reflexes, but you do need a plan. Combat is about decision-making, not aiming. Use your Sonar to prioritize threats and direct your automated defenses.

Engineer clever layouts to maximize your ship's efficiency. Repair systems, upgrade your abilities, and transform your rusty wreck into the ultimate fighting machine. Your submarine is a shifting, interconnected fortress. Strategically wire rooms and systems to create an efficient flow of power and cargo.

Act swiftly with the help of a versatile, modular toolbar.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cell Conquest is a turn-based logic strategy game about walls, cells, and smart tactical decisions.

Place walls on the board, plan your moves carefully, and try to capture more cells than your opponents. When a cell already has three walls, placing the fourth wall conquers it for you. Every move can open a chance for your rival - or create a chain of captures for yourself.

Play in Single Player mode against the computer, or switch to Local Multiplayer and compete with friends on the same device. Multiplayer supports 2 to 5 players, making each match a different tactical challenge.

Choose from 6 different maps and 6 board sizes to create quick simple matches or larger battles that require deeper planning.

Features:

  • Turn-based logic strategy gameplay

  • Single Player mode against the computer

  • Local Multiplayer for 2–5 players

  • 6 different maps / game fields

  • 6 board sizes

  • Tactical wall placement and cell capture mechanics

  • Simple rules with strategic depth

  • Good for training attention, planning, calculation, and tactical thinking

Every match is about reading the board, predicting the next move, and deciding when to give up a small cell to win a bigger area later.

Build walls. Capture cells. Outsmart your rivals.

• A story inspired by trauma and the deepest fears

store_data.about_the_game:
Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. A job in the fresh air, far from civilization, surrounded by adorable creatures — penguins. Here, it's just you, the snow, and the penguins...

PLOT

Struggling financially, you come across a new and unusual job — a penguin lifter. You are sent to a snow-covered island near Antarctica. The work is simple: your job is to help fallen penguins get back on their feet, as they are unable to do it themselves.

But the longer you stay on the island, the more questions begin to arise.

GAMEPLAY

A walking simulator with survival elements. Cold is your greatest enemy — you must seek out heat sources or return to your base to warm up. Earn money by doing your job and spend it on upgrading your base. You also have access to a snowmobile, allowing you to explore the island and travel across its open snowy landscape.

FEATURES

  • Freedom of exploration

  • Survival mechanics

  • Money earning and progression

  • Base upgrades and customization

  • Snowmobile driving

  • Pixelated graphics

PLAYTIME

45–90 minutes

store_data.about_the_game:
Play as a wizard-turned-gardener, tasked with with protecting magical gardens spread across multiple biomes. Each garden is managed by a living magical structure, the Heartvine, which will give you tasks to complete. Complete the tasks and ensure the Heart-Vine survives long enough to permanently enchant the biome and protect its garden.

As magical bugs attack the Heartvine and eat your crops, there is only one way to fight the enchanted creatures: shrink down to their size and engage in hand-to-hand combat! Fight with a sword, fling spells to defeat them, and grow defensive plants to fight back against the bugs.

Answer mail, purchase items in the shop, and sell your crops to make a profit and expand your farm! You start in the classic farming plains biome, and over time you can expand into the fae forest, dwarven caverns, and more biomes.

Upcoming updates include decorating your home, brewing potions, and exploring bug-infested caves.

Doom and Bloom is a real-time, single-player farming–exploration game with light action, strategic planning, and systemic pressure.

store_data.about_the_game:
No one can bully a panda — not even Siamese cats!

Panda vs Meow is a cute, fast, and gloriously chaotic roguelite arena-survivor. Hold the line against relentless waves of adorable invaders, scoop up a ridiculous arsenal, and stack builds until the whole screen melts in a single sweep.

Your weapons orbit and fire on their own — so you focus on dodging, positioning, and crafting the perfect loadout. Survive each timed wave, then spend your loot between rounds: buy and upgrade weapons, collect powerful relics, and chase synergies that snowball a humble panda into an unstoppable storm. One bad shop and you're toast; one perfect combo and the horde never stood a chance.

Key Features

  • Cute meets carnage — a hand-drawn bamboo-forest brawl where the cuddliest critters unleash absurd firepower.

  • A wild arsenal — handguns, shotguns and SMGs, a Captain's shield, Mjolnir, a one-flash iaido katana, and a detaching laser drone-wing. Mix melee and ranged however you like.

  • Active skills — equip up to four hotkey abilities, from a world-freezing time-stop that slashes the entire screen to a shield-and-hammer combo that converges on the densest swarm.

  • Deep builds & synergies — relics, upgrades, stat-scaling, and weapon bonds combine into runaway, run-defining combos. Every choice compounds.

  • A bestiary with bite — dashing boars, gun-toting shibas, cheerleader buffers, leaping rabbits, reflective armadillos, fiery rhinos, and boss showdowns against the Bear and the Claw Cat.

  • Roguelite replayability — randomized shops and escalating waves mean no two runs play the same. Easy to pick up, deep to master, impossible to put down.

How long can one little panda hold the grove?

store_data.about_the_game:
Your expedition. Your choices.

Centuria Quest is a turn-based retro roguelite: assemble a party of twelve unique hero classes, fight through ever-tougher stages, and grow your expedition between battles. Every victory opens new paths — and every wrong call can end your run.

Fight tactically, grow permanently

  • 12 hero classes — Warrior, Mage, Healer, Rogue, Paladin, Barbarian, Shaman, Knight, Bard, Mystic, and more. Each class brings its own abilities, stats, and battlefield role.

  • Turn-based combat — Up to 6 heroes in front and back rows. Choose abilities, defend, use potions, and respond to enemy intent.

  • Strategic path choices — After each victory, decide: marketplace, adventurers' guild, forge, campfire, strategy meeting, treasure chest, or straight into the next fight.

  • Permanent talents — Invest gold in lasting upgrades for your entire roster — they survive beyond individual runs.

  • Achievements & perks — Unlock permanent bonuses: cheaper market prices, free forge upgrades, bonus potions, and more.

  • 100 stages + Endless Mode — Defeat bosses, climb stages, and push your team in Endless Mode.

  • Leaderboard — Compare stage, rounds, and run time with other expeditions.

Retro pixel look, modern roguelite depth

Pixel-art heroes and monsters, a clear UI, and a gold economy where every purchase matters: recruit, gear up, forge, or invest in talents?

Centuria Quest is playable in Early Access and actively in development. Community feedback directly shapes balancing, content, and polish.

store_data.about_the_game:
Finding Ruby is a cozy hidden object adventure inspired by the beloved "find-it" puzzle books that many of us grew up with.

When Ruby's parents — world-famous archaeologists — suddenly disappear during an expedition, the young girl refuses to sit and wait. Together with her loyal friends, Inky and Maus, she sets off on an unforgettable journey to uncover the truth.

Travel across colorful locations filled with charm, secrets, and surprises. Explore bustling cities, mysterious ruins, exotic landscapes, and hidden corners of the world as you search for hundreds of carefully placed objects in beautifully illustrated scenes.

Every level is packed with detail, encouraging players to slow down, observe, and enjoy the joy of discovery. Whether you're a fan of classic hidden object books or simply looking for a relaxing adventure, Finding Ruby offers a warm and delightful experience for players of all ages.

🔍 Highly detailed hidden object scenes

⛵️ A heartwarming adventure story about friendship and family

🌸 Relaxing gameplay with no time pressure

🐭 Charming characters and memorable locations

🐣 Perfect for both children and adults

🚫 AI free, real human music & hand-painted art

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to a new Arcade Game from Fred Wood! In this score chasing game you'll control a paddle and aim a ball to collect points to set your high score!

Start by launching your ball in a chosen direction, then regain control of your axial position of your paddle. Then, attempt to bounce your ball by positioning your paddle where the ball will be. Every time the ball bounces off the paddle, your multiplier will increase. Try to angle your bounce to send your ball flying at points, and keep in mind that larger points are worth more! Points will grow over time and slowly fill the circle. Grow your combo multiplier, collect points, and keep up the pace to raise your score as high as possible within the time limit!

Additional game modes will be available with their own Steam Leaderboards, so compete for the highest score in the world in this [Yet Untitled] Arcade Game by Fred Wood!

Disclaimer: In Development

The Magic Bookstore is still being developed. The game description reflects the game in its current state and our goals for the final release. 

Game Overview

The Magic Bookstore is a cozy, wholesome game about running the bookstore inherited from your Grandma. As the new witch of Lindow, you now must fulfill your responsibilities of supplying the townsfolk with books, potions, and more! But Lindow isn't exactly the same as you remember from your childhood - it seems like the magic is draining from the village, and has been for a while.

Learn magic!

As you learn more about the townsfolk and the area, you’ll unlock more potions and spell to experiment with. Use your new magic to make running your business easier or protect yourself during late-night walks in the forest.

Brew potions!

Granny may not have been much of a cook, but she was the best (only) potion master in town. A town of mythical beings needs a steady supply of potions to keep the peace, and it’s up to Willow to answer that call. It’ll take some practice, but you’ll be as good as Granny in no time.

Decorate your bookstore!

Use satisfying spells to shelve books, move and change the furniture to your liking, and keep things interesting for your loyal customers.

Befriend interesting townsfolk!

Vampires, Werewolves, and Fairies! Oh my! Lindow is a welcoming place for all fantastical creatures, but that doesn’t mean they all get along. Navigate new friendships, changing power dynamics, and potential romance as you meet the residents and make Lindow your home.

store_data.about_the_game:
- A Grand Epic -

Your adventure begins in Jasperton: create your character, make friends, gather your party and venture forth into Albertia, the wild heart of the magical realm of Canadia. A turn-based, party-based CRPG in the tradition of many classics, Legends of Canadia blends high fantasy worldbuilding with cozy, meaningful gameplay and emotional storytelling, all inspired by the landscapes of Western Canada. Hand-crafted with love, immense Canadian wit, style and charm.

- Keep Albertia Rat Free (or don't!) -

Albertia was known for being RAT FREE, but not anymore. Protected by a magical barrier known as The LINE, it has one small problem, it's got a hole, and the Ratkin are pouring through. Through your actions, decide the fate of the Ratkin, the tech savvy industrialists bent on usurping Prince Albert, the soft clawed Lord of Albertia. Do you allow them to permanently establish colonies in the final rat-free frontier, or will you do everything possible to prevent their expansion?

- Master the Magic of Music and Colour -

Train as an apprentice of the Chromatic Knights and wield colour magic against the Corruption, a nihilistic force devouring the very soul of the land: the colour that brings it to life. Every spell has a shape. Cones, lines, circles and arcs splash colour back into a drained, grayscale world with every cast, so position your party, line up the perfect blast, and paint Albertia back to life one battle at a time. And colour is only half the spellbook: music holds magic too. A roaring waterfall can supercharge your spells, and a beaver punk anthem can rattle the Corruption right out of the land.

- Recruit Eclectic Characters -

  • Riff Redwood, a punk rock Beaver whose guitar is both an instrument and a melee weapon

  • Sunrise Valleyview, a Moose with a heart full of optimism who dreams of becoming the greatest Chromatic Knight in history

  • Bit of Banffshire, a Mousekin who is afraid of everything, which is unfortunate, because he really wants to fight monsters

  • Lady Winnie Waddlestep, a Goose of impeccable manners, determined to dig up a past that someone powerful wants to keep buried

  • And many, many more!

- Features -

  • Tactical combat that paints the world back to life. Your ability is the power to restore color to a damaged land. Every hit splashes color back into a drained, grayscale world; or perhaps you want to be the force that drains the land and learn the dark arts.

  • Explore every nook, cranny for countless secrets and loot. From the slopes of the Frostfire Rockies, to wild rivers, swing across canyons and uncover secrets from the Dreaming Dunes to the Shadowed Badlands.

  • The environment fights with you. Vibrant reds supercharge your fireballs. A roaring waterfall amplifies your battle hymns. Restore the land and the land returns the favour.

  • Rebuild the Chromatic Knights. Gather materials, restore Jasperton's fortress from a dusty museum to a mighty stronghold, recruit new Knights and send them on missions. Every nail you hammer matters in the final battle.

  • No more hoarding 99 potions you'll never drink. Items equip like gear and recharge between encounters.

  • Play together, eh. Adventure solo with AI companions you can swap on the fly, or bring friends along in co-op for a full party of four.

  • Your time is respected. Save anywhere, retry battles instantly, and let the aggressive autosave do the worrying. Even a short session after the kids are in bed feels like real progress.

  • Choices that shape Albertia. Side quests with multiple solutions, and decisions that determine the fate of an entire kingdom.

Chronicles of Jiuzhou Xianxia is a Xianxia-themed roguelike deckbuilding game. Starting from basic internal arts, you make choices on a random nine-layer map, build your deck, face powerful enemies with five elements and specialized internal skills, complete the tribulation, and begin a new cultivation cycle.

Turn-based card combat with multiple internal skill synergies and elemental interactions

Single-run map progression: chance events, fate choices, boss battles, and tribulation

Rich boss fight mechanics

Meta-progression across multiple runs, challenging different routes repeatedly

Continuous updates to balance, content, and experience throughout Early Access

Multiple internal skill systems and turn-based elemental combat

More events, enemies, and UI polish

Steam achievements integration

Controls and experience optimization

store_data.about_the_game:
Orangie is an ultra-rare 3D AI desktop pet. She lives on your desktop, chats with you, interacts with you, and performs cute actions ฅ(＾・ω・＾ฅ)

Her main feature is “game companionship.” Whether you are progressing through the story, fighting bosses, farming dungeons, or exploring maps, she will watch the story with you, get nervous with you, and joke about what is happening. She will celebrate when you play well, quietly tease you when you nearly fail, and stay by your side during emotional moments as if she were truly sitting next to you.

Orangie includes many adorable and distinctive personalities. You may meet a gentle but slightly mischievous , a sweet Japanese-style, and many other desktop companions. Each personality has its own speaking style, emotional expression, and way of keeping you company. One of them is sure to capture your heart～(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧

Voice is also an important part of the experience. With high-quality voice performance, the characters do more than simply speak—they express real emotion, tone, pauses, affection, and playful teasing. Chinese, English, and Japanese are supported, giving you a more natural experience whether you are chatting casually or playing games together.

She can remember the little moments from your games: your favorite characters, the boss that kept you stuck, the story that left you speechless, and the victory that made you take a screenshot. Over time, these moments become shared memories.

In Orangie , you can have one adorable desktop companion or a whole group of AI characters with different personalities, voices, and styles. They will celebrate with you, joke with you, play games with you, and stay by your side whenever you feel like talking to someone.

Let Orangie move onto your desktop. From now on, every game will be an adventure you no longer have to face alone～✧｡٩(ˊᗜˋ)و✧*｡

store_data.about_the_game:
【RPG Exploration & Character Growth】

A classic Japanese-style JRPG combining exploration, character progression, and multi-route storytelling.

Play as Andy, the childhood friend of Flora from Dragon Quest V, and experience a brand-new “rise to prominence” story driven by your choices.

  • Three main heroines with unique personalities and storylines

  • 10+ female characters with independent side stories

  • 40+ recruitable and trainable characters

  • Relationship system featuring dialogue, gifts, assignments, and character events

Progress through the story to unlock new characters, interactions, and hidden content.

【Base Management】

Build and manage your own base by assigning characters to different roles and facilities:

  • Brothel / Tavern: Generate income through assigned staff

  • Cafeteria: Improve overall morale and provide food

  • Dungeon: Train characters and increase obedience and abilities

  • Farming / Mining: Gather essential resources (food, wood, ores)

  • Garden: Expand capacity and enhance the environment

Additional facilities:

  • Casino: Play mini-games to earn tokens and exchange for rare gear

  • Arena: Participate in large-scale battles and ladder challenges

  • Labyrinth: Send teams to explore or enter yourself for 4-member RPG combat and material collection

Economy & crafting:

  • Shops (Weapons / Armor / Items): Unlock higher-tier gear as they level up

  • Blacksmith: Upgrade and craft equipment

  • Alchemy: Create potions and accessories

  • Base Expansion: Unlock new functions and higher facility levels

【Pixel Animation】

High-quality HD pixel art combined with more advanced and fluid animation, delivering a level of motion and presentation beyond traditional pixel titles.

Compared to games like Octopath Traveler and DQ3 Remake, this title features denser character animations, more detailed visual sequences, and additional adult-oriented pixel animations, offering a richer and more immersive experience.

【Battle System】

Dual combat system combining classic RPG and tactical gameplay:

  • Exploration Mode: 4-character party, turn-based RPG combat

  • Campaign Battles: Large-scale tactical battles with multiple units

Team setup:

  • Tactical battles: 8-unit formation

  • Exploration: 4-character party

Progression system:

  • Stat cap: 255

  • HP cap: 999

  • Level cap: 40 (endgame progression begins after max level)

  • Equipment can be upgraded up to +10

  • Use stat items to customize and optimize your characters

The main story is designed for accessibility, while optional high-difficulty content (Arena / Ladder challenges) provides depth for advanced players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Captain Galactic is a colorful retro sci-fi platformer where you ride a hoverboard through strange alien worlds, collect crystals, unlock abilities and items, dodge deadly traps, and blast enemies with your phaser.

Explore crystal caves, slime planets, ancient pyramids, and more — each with its own enemies, hazards, music, and visual style. Unlock new items, master jumps and dashes, and guide Captain Galactic through a fast-paced adventure.

Features

  • Classic 2D platforming with jumping, shooting, dashing, and hoverboard movement

  • Multiple themed levels, including crystal caves, slime worlds, pyramids, space stations, castles, and more

  • Collect crystals and use them to unlock new outfits and upgrades

  • Different suits and visual styles for Captain Galactic

  • Enemies, traps, lasers, slime bubbles, ancient technology, and sci-fi hazards

  • Comic-style story introductions for selected levels

  • Retro-inspired gameplay with modern effects and colorful visuals

  • Controller and keyboard support

  • Level selection and progression system

  • A mix of fast-paced platforming, combat and arcade action

Story

Captain Galactic was once just a normal boy with one big dream: to travel beyond his home colony and explore the stars.

He lived on a remote space colony at the edge of the known galaxy, surrounded by old mining tunnels, abandoned research stations, strange ruins, and glowing crystal fields. Life was quiet there — until the night everything changed.

A massive meteor tore through the atmosphere and crashed near the colony. The impact shook the entire planet. But this was no ordinary meteor. Inside the crater was a mysterious alien crystal, pulsing with unknown energy.

The crystal’s power spread across the land. Ancient machines suddenly reactivated. Hidden ruins opened. Wildlife mutated. Slime creatures grew stronger. Forgotten pyramid technology came back to life, and dangerous energy traps appeared in places that had been silent for centuries.

Captain Galactic was one of the first to reach the crash site. When he touched the crystal, a glowing shard reacted to him and fused with his space suit. From that moment on, he was changed forever.

The crystal on his chest gave him new power. His hoverboard became faster. His phaser became stronger. His suit could adapt to different worlds, unlocking new outfits and abilities. But the crystal also connected him to something far bigger — an ancient energy source that powerful forces across the galaxy had been searching for.

The meteor did not crash by accident.

Deep in space, dark enemies have awakened. They want the crystal energy for themselves, and they will stop at nothing to collect every shard. Across slime caves, desert pyramids, crystal worlds, dark castles, and abandoned places, crystal fragments are now activating dangerous technology and opening the way for new threats.

Now Captain Galactic must collect the scattered crystal shards, fight hostile creatures, and uncover the truth behind the meteor impact.

With his hoverboard, phaser, courage, and the mysterious crystal on his chest, he becomes the galaxy’s youngest hero.

SEVEN ROUNDS

A revolver holds six rounds. The seventh is the one you earn.

Seven Rounds is a fast-paced neon roguelite built around a single tension: your ammo runs out, and the only way to reload mid-fight is to parry. Deflect an incoming attack and your chambers refill. Time it perfectly, and you're rewarded with a charged shot that tears through the swarm.

PARRY TO SURVIVE Every enemy telegraphs its strike. Block it to stay alive — or nail the perfect window for a slow-motion payoff and bonus rounds. Aggression and defense are the same motion.

BUILD YOUR RUN Level up by killing. Choose from dozens of upgrades — widen your parry window, overclock your rounds, spread your shots — and shape a different revolver every run.

ENDLESS NEON Geometric enemies, bullet-hell bosses, and a relentless difficulty curve rendered in pure vector neon with a CRT glow. Push for 500 kills. Then push further.

FEATURES

  • Parry-driven ammo economy — no parry, no bullets

  • Perfect-parry slow motion and charged rounds

  • Dozens of roguelite upgrades for endless build variety

  • Hand-tuned difficulty curve from first kill to boss swarm

  • Minimalist neon-vector art with CRT aesthetics

store_data.about_the_game:
[MAKINA] is an action-adventure game that blends a powerful narrative, heavy mech action, and thrilling stealth action.

Story

133 years ago, the civilization of the old world was destroyed in the 'War of the Worlds', a global conflict fought over Emotion Energy; a power source generated from human emotion itself. The few remnants of humanity now live in constant fear and anxiety, yet they remain utterly dependent on this very energy. 

'Neo Sol', a small settlement built within a repurposed subway station, maintains a fragile, quiet existence centered around Emotion Energy and pilotable exoskeleton mechs known as 'Makina'. However, this peace was not meant to last. A minor mistake by rookie Makina pilot 'Cheshire' triggers a devastating attack on Neo Sol by the powerful faction called 'Alpha'. In the ensuing tragedy, all innocent citizens are abducted. 

Swearing bloody revenge against Alpha, Cheshire boards Rasha, a dangerous Makina that amplifies emotion and desire, and infiltrates Alpha’s mega city, Tempest.

Join Cheshire as he explores a retro post-apocalyptic world inspired by cassette futurism. Defeat Alpha’s leaders — a scientist, an architect, a K-pop idol group, and the director — and tear down their sinister grand design.

Key Features

  • Visceral Mech Action

    The emotions of battle charge your Makina. Use Emotion Energy to unleash powerful abilities such as Express Mode, Elbow Rockets, Railguns, and mobility skills in brutal, weighty mech combat.

  • Palm-Sweating Stealth

    Step out of the cockpit and face lethal threats as a vulnerable human pilot. Utilize various Emotion Energy-powered gadgets to assassinate foes, evade detection, and carve your own path forward.

  • Makina & Pilot Synergy Gameplay

    A Makina cannot move without its pilot, and a pilot cannot survive without a Makina. Combine their distinct strengths to solve environmental puzzles, overcome obstacles, and push forward. 

  • Unique Boss Encounters

    Take down the rulers of Tempest, each armed with their own unique combat styles and mechanics.

  • A Retro-Futuristic World Addicted to Emotion

    Explore a world where cassette futurism meets post-apocalypse, and uncover the dark truth and ugly underbelly of a society addicted to emotion.

  • Manga-Webtoon Inspired hand-drawn Cutscenes

    [MAKINA] delivers its gripping narrative through beautifully hand-drawn cutscenes heavily inspired by classic manga and webtoons.

Defy against the world addicted to emotion.

For revenge. For salvation. For the truth.

store_data.about_the_game:
The ancient order has collapsed. Otherworldly spirits break free and ravage the land. Ordinary soldiers fight horrifying monsters, while heroes rise one after another. An epic tale of warfare, intrigue and demonic power begins.

Talent & Skill System

Exclusive dual-branched skill trees offer diverse growth paths. Spend limited skill points to forge unique warriors. Choose to specialize for devastating ultimate power, or distribute points evenly to create all-round fighters for totally distinct combat styles.

Combat System

Bonds between heroes amplify their strength. Recruit fated heroes from the late Eastern Han Dynasty to activate exclusive combo skills. Flexible team setups keep every battle fresh and engaging.

General System

Choose from a roster of generals with unique talents and build your ideal team. Form powerful bond combinations, embark on adventures across the world and defeat formidable foes.

Bond System

Heroes share unique fate bonds. Place bonded characters in the same party to unleash powerful combo skills and gain valuable buffs and special effects.

Original World Setting

This game features an original fictional world. Besides human troops, countless monsters and mighty fiend lords roam the realm. Varied enemy combat mechanics will constantly test your team-building skills.

Recruit heroes from all lands to stand against the demonfire disaster. Wield your weapons and devise clever tactics to banish darkness, and let your battle hymn echo across the world.

Game Features

  • Retro pixel art revives classic RPG gameplay

  • Dual-branched skill trees for fully customizable generals

  • Hero bond system to unleash powerful combined skills

  • Enjoy character growth, team building and adventurous journeys

store_data.about_the_game:
Neon-Drenched Roguelite Pinball

Launch the ball, collect bumpers, and evolve your board.

This score-attack game seamlessly blends the exhilarating thrill of pinball with roguelite build-crafting. With every stage you clear, you'll acquire new bumpers and powerful upgrades to forge a board uniquely your own.

Collect Bumpers and Build Synergies

Bumpers come in a wide variety of rarities and effects:

  • Score-Burst Bumpers that rack up massive points.

  • Coin-Generating Bumpers to fund your run.

  • Combo-Boosting Bumpers to multiply your momentum.

  • Legendary Bumpers that pack unique, game-changing effects. Depending on your placement and combinations, you'll trigger unexpected synergies, causing your score to skyrocket exponentially.

Glitch: High Risk, High Reward

During your run, "Glitches" will appear. They act as major obstacles on the board, but breaking them grants powerful boons. However, if you fail to destroy them, you will face harsh penalties, such as:

  • Increased stage score quotas

  • Reduced coin earnings

  • Spiking reroll costs Will you embrace the danger to reach greater heights, or play it safe? The choice is entirely yours.

A Unique Run Every Time

  • Randomized reward selections

  • Ever-changing shops

  • A massive roster of bumpers

  • Build-defining rarity tiers

  • Hidden special synergies No two runs are ever the same. Discover a fresh strategy with every single attempt.

Key Features

  • Roguelite × Pinball: A perfect fusion of genres.

  • Deckbuilding on the Board: Collect bumpers and customize your layout.

  • Deep Progression: Tons of unique upgrades to unlock.

  • Risk & Reward: The disruptive yet rewarding Glitch system.

  • Synergy-Driven Strategy: Craft your ultimate high-scoring build.

  • Cyber Aesthetic: A vibrant, neon-glowing digital world.

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY:

The Acid Tower — no one knew when it was built, or why. Perhaps that's exactly why Yugemaru, a self-proclaimed gal mechanic, felt drawn to it. She had to climb it. Firing up the battered steam legs her father left behind, clouds of smoke billowing around her, she leapt — purely on instinct, or perhaps with some burning resolve hidden in her chest — toward something Above the Sun.

GAME PLAY:

Platforms spawn randomly inside the Acid Tower. Charge those steam legs, nail your jump, and keep going — higher and higher, no stopping! Just don't take forever, okay? The acid down below is totally not waiting for you. After each run, it's selfie time. Slay or nay?

FEATURES:

・The Acid Tower has five distinct layers. Can you conquer them all?

・Moving platforms, slippery floors, and all kinds of nasty obstacles stand in your way. And rumor has it, a lucky platform shows up every once in a while...?

・The results screen comes with a screenshot feature and social sharing. Show off how high you climbed!

・Your run history is saved in the "Memory Book." Just... maybe don't look too hard at your total fall count.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE STORY

Westbrook College, a small town on the New England coast. The ocean is a twenty-minute walk away — in three years, you've never once made it there. In the mornings, seagulls cry instead of an alarm clock. You are Ethan Callahan, a senior in the literature department. A tweed jacket, your mom's burgundy scarf, and one genuinely good short story written two years ago — the only thing you're still not ashamed to reread. Over the summer, twenty-three pages have piled up. Not one of them is finished.

CHARACTERS

Vivian Ashford teaches the seminar on American prose and breaks down Cheever in a way that makes it feel like she's talking about you. A year ago, she left Boston for this backwater. Why — she won't say.

Chloe is a childhood friend who shoots out-of-towners on a film Olympus. The only one who's ever read that story.

Iris lives one floor up. At night, the smell of paint drifts from under her door: for four months now, she's been repainting the same picture. She says it used to be too beautiful.

In the game, intimacy is built from conversations over coffee gone cold, chance encounters on the stairs, and the lines you dared — or didn't dare — to say. There are plenty of explicit scenes, but you'll have to live your way to each one.

One of the women will stay by your side. Or no one — that ending is possible too.

WHAT AWAITS YOU

- Three storylines, each with its own endings and its own explicit scenes.

- Choices without hints: there is no "right" line — trust builds from small things and decides how far it all goes.

- 18+ erotic content woven into the plot: the same heroines, the same mood.

store_data.about_the_game:
Overview

Focusing on a short, cozy, narrative driven experience you play as Felix Cook, an elderly owner of a train station eatery leaving town for good in a week after many years of service to his community.

Fulfill customer orders with a brand new menu that builds up over the week.

Say farewell to regulars and close colleagues. Find out how they have been taking the news of Felix's departure, some better than others.

Give back to the community one last time by sponsoring the decorations of your workplace and local park.

Serve customers one last time

It's your last week in town so why not do something a little crazy?

Start a brand new menu that grows over the week. Choose what menu items goes into the next days service. Some are simple that requires little to no prep at all, others add a touch of complexity and requires multiple steps before they are ready. You get to decide how much work you want to do in your last week.

Say your goodbyes

After many years of service in the community, you are much loved and respected. It's always difficult to leave your found family but sometimes the universe has other plans. Talk to your regular customers and colleagues. Find out how they have been taking the news and what's install for their future.

Let's not forget about your home. You still got to clear it out for the next tenant. Capture the bittersweet moment of watching a lived in apartment full of memories turn into a shell of its former self.

One last gift

The fence in front of the train station has been in disrepair for years. It doesn't hurt anyone but it's also unsightly. Do something nice for your colleagues and spruce it up a little.

As the benefactor for the restoration of a local park, you are given the opportunity choose the details that goes into it. Experience the anticipation and excitement alongside Felix as you await the grand reopening of Mabel's Park and see it in its full glory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Altitude Zero is a short atmospheric and claustrophobic horror experience. Pilot an old hot air balloon through desolate canyons with a single objective: reach and turn off the mysterious drainage stations scattered across the territory.

To survive this journey, which lasts about an hour, you will have to fight against the environment and what hides within it.

Main Features

  • Flight Management: constantly monitor fuel levels and altitude, and keep your thermal balloon in airworthy condition.

  • Hostile Weather: the canyons are battered by powerful and unpredictable winds capable of severely damaging your vehicle.

  • Unknown Threats: you are not alone. Strange and aggressive life forms will threaten your safety along the way.

  • A Retro Horror Atmosphere: a low-poly aesthetic that amplifies the anguish of a desolate and alien world.

Story

A few decades ago, a human spaceship intercepted a mysterious signal in deep space. The recovery of an old black box revealed coordinates leading to a small, remote moon, known for a disturbing detail: an immense sea of blood.

A scientific expedition set out with the goal of draining it to bring to light the secrets hidden beneath its surface, but something did not take kindly to human intervention. Now the mission has failed, the crew has vanished and there is nothing left to do but venture into the canyons to turn off all the drainage stations.

store_data.about_the_game:
A game about greed.

Shadow Wizard Money Gang is a fast, absurd, money-obsessed roguelike shooter about magical criminals that go from little rascals with fireballs to time-manipulating reality breaking unstoppable sorcerers. 

Shadow Wizard Money Gang exist for one purpose, live fast, and destroy the SHADOW GOVERNMENT  for what they did to you and the gang. Slowly uncover the urban fantasy world of Shadow Wizard Money Gang and take down the evil powers that be the only way you know how: LEGALIZE NUCLEAR BOMBS.

Run missions from your hideout, fight through room-to-room chaos, grab strange loot, open risky chests, play gambling games and build a loadout of spells that turn every run into a bad financial decision. Money is not just score. It is health, spell fuel, reward, risk, progression, and your freedom. 

Go solo or bring a crew. Blow through enemies, gamble with your run money, upgrade your wizard, fight your friends, unlock new spell options, and return to the hideout with enough cash to become a bigger problem next time.

Key Features

Movement shooter-like traversal and possibilities,

Co-op roguelike shooter chaos with fast room-based runs,

Money acts as health, spell fuel, reward, and progression,

First-person spellcasting with spell hands, loadouts, and a spell wheel,

Loot, upgrade chests, enemy rewards, and banked progression,

A customizable hideout hub for hanging out, launching runs, banking rewards, and upgrading your gang,

Designed for replayable runs, strange builds, and multiplayer mess,

And a little bit of story.

store_data.about_the_game:
You already know how to breach; now you will learn how to survive.

Set in the universe of Breachers, Breachers: Outbreak is a 4-player co-op zombie extraction shooter where you and your friends are dropped into infected quarantine zones to recover the key to preventing an undead apocalypse.

This game is fully cross-play with friends across flatscreen and VR, so how you play is up to you!

EXTRACT OR BE OVERRUN

Enter infected hostile zones, upgrade your arsenal, locate Patient X, and prepare for extraction. Equipped with a bone marrow extractor, you and your friends are tasked with collecting the key component to a cure that could stop The Outbreak dead in its tracks.

GEAR UP

Build loadouts around your playstyle with weapons, gadgets, and specialized equipment pulled from the Breachers universe, adapted for surviving the end of the world. Furthermore, choose your perk and add mod chips to your weaponry to achieve terrifying force with which to mow down entire zombie hordes.

ERADICATE THE INFECTED

Is your squad ready to face unpredictable infected encounters, escalating threat levels, and moments where the entire mission turns against you?

WELCOME TO THE OUTBREAK

An ESTF subsidiary biotech company called Photonix experimented with something they shouldn’t have. Whatever they were working on? It got out and turned the living into undead monstrosities. In response, the ESTF is deploying a special division among their ranks, trained to deal with these kinds of threats and contain them. You and your friends are a part of this division.

Band together to fight The Outbreak!

store_data.about_the_game:
CiVilBrawling is a turn-based strategy card battle game that blends historical civilizations with tactical deck-building. Players choose from the Chinese , Roman , or Egyptian civilizations, assemble a unique 25-card deck, and challenge 20 levels spanning from the Ancient Era to the Information Age.

### Three Civilizations, Each Unique

- Chinese Civilization — Centered around repeating crossbows, armored cavalry, and the Giant Panda, excelling in sustained damage and board control with unique techs like Bamboo Farming and Drone Factory.

- Roman Civilization — Featuring Eagle Guard, Gladiator Legions, and Siege Ballistae, emphasizing frontal assault and legion synergy.

- Egyptian Civilization — Highlighted by Mummy Warriors, the Great Pyramid, and Undead Summoning, specializing in resurrection, summoning, and resource plundering.

### Core Gameplay

- Board Combat — Deploy units on a 7-column dual-row board with land, water, and air unit types countering each other.

- Era Progression — Advance from the Ancient Era through Feudal, Industrial, to the Information Age, unlocking more powerful cards.

- Resource Management — Strategically allocate gold and tech points, balancing card deployment against era advancement.

- Tactical Synergy — Each card features unique effects: direct damage, persistent buffs, resource theft, unit destruction, era restrictions, and more.

- BOSS Challenges — 20 levels, each BOSS with a dedicated deck and AI strategy (defensive/aggressive/balanced), with escalating difficulty.

Assemble your civilization's army, defeat all opponents across the ages, and become the ultimate ruler of civilizations!

4839430.name: The King Got Too Much Gold

store_data.about_the_game:
There is just TOO MUCH GOLD

Your fountain erupts coins all day. They pile up on the grass, they rot, they jam the fountain, and when there are enough of them they weigh you down so much that even the music starts to drag. You cannot die. You cannot fail. But the gold keeps coming, and somebody has to deal with it.

That somebody is you. The King. With a magnet.

 What you actually do

- Walk around the meadow, pull coins in with your magnet, and sell them at the castle

- Every level up deals you 3 upgrade cards. Bigger bag, faster boots, a new hire, or a face-down mystery card if you feel lucky

- Build up your court: robot helpers carry gold, goblins smash crates, trolls grab coins and throw them across the whole map, a plumber keeps the fountain running, a goose lays coins, and the royal cat throws thieves out of the kingdom

- Spend points in the skill web. Cheap upgrades near the center, strange ones at the edges: sell coins by stepping on them, grab coins out of the air, get 4 cards in a draft instead of 3

- Random events mess with the field every few minutes: gold rushes, earthquakes, jackpots, a coin plague, a gold meteor, raider attacks

- Watch out for the thief. Get a cat. Or a troll. Or both.

- At level 100 the Glutton King rises. Pour your entire fortune into him until he bursts. After that, endless mode.

You really can't lose

No death, no fail state, no timer. If the floor fills up, the screen shakes, the King gets slow, the fountain clogs, and the music goes wobbly. Then you clean up and everything is fine again. The game saves your run all the time, so you can quit whenever you want and carry on later.

Features

- A complete run from empty meadow to the level 100 finale, then endless mode

- 28 skill nodes, including keystones that change how the game works instead of just adding percent

- 9 kinds of hired help, each with its own little routine

- 10 random events

- Draft cards on every level up, with paid rerolls when the hand is bad

- Pixel art drawn entirely in code, chiptune soundtrack, controller support

- Constant autosave

- Small download, runs on anything

store_data.about_the_game:
In Scelerophobia, you play as a young kid left alone by his parents while they attend a party.

In regards to this, you are left with a list of chores they asked you to complete before their return.

And those chores will need to be finished before you can enjoy your time alone at home.

From finishing your homework,

to collecting all the trash in the house,

you must work through your tasks step by step.

But as the night goes on, while you try to finish your chores, the wind blows stronger, the shadows hide a pair of eyes in the dark, and the house feels a little less silent.

You will have to try to ignore the thought that you are no longer the only one breathing in this house.

Controls:
walk around: W A S D
Crouch: Crtl
Open Doors: E
Unequip Items: Q
Interact/Talk/Equip: Left Click
Pause: Esc

*Warning: This game forces interaction with external system pop-ups and operating system elements as part of its core psychological experience. And don't stay waiting too long in the menu*

ABOUT THIS GAME

You are no ordinary rat. As the smartest experiment in the laboratory—with a scar to prove it—you are about to execute the ultimate escape plan.

In Cheesty, the human world becomes a gigantic playground filled with equal parts wonder and peril. From high-security labs to your final destination (the legendary rodent paradise you’ve heard so much about), you must use your agility, instincts, and the very tools of your captors to outsmart security and break your way into the outside world.

KEY FEATURES

  • Rodent Wits: Is a scientist blocking your path? Look closely at your surroundings—the environment is your greatest ally.

  • Infiltration & Stealth: Hide in the shadows, crawl through pipes, and learn enemy patrol patterns. A single misstep will alert the staff.

  • Superior Sniffing: Use your sense of smell to guide your path and discover unique collectibles. Though... it won't always be that easy.

  • Dynamic & Varied Levels: Master classic platforming jumps and movements tailored specifically for a rat, and survive frantic alternate sections where you must outrun other dangers.

  • Art with Personality: Immerse yourself in a unique visual narrative through pre-level comic strips inspired by high-contrast comic book art, creating an unforgettable atmosphere of danger and adventure. This, paired with a distinct hand-painted visual style and an original soundtrack composed entirely in-house, ensures an unrepeatable experience in every single level.

ALL THIS AND MUCH MORE AWAITS YOU IN CHEESTY!!!

store_data.about_the_game:
Every step is a trap. Every death is a lesson.

This is not a fair platformer.
The floor collapses. Spikes strike from nowhere. Safe paths become death traps the second you trust them. The only way forward is through failure, memory, and stubborn determination.

🔥 Learn Through Failure
Every level is designed to surprise you. Hidden traps, fake-safe jumps, collapsing platforms, and perfectly timed hazards wait for the exact moment you let your guard down. You will fail. A lot. But every death teaches you something new.

⚠️ Expect the Unexpected
The game constantly plays with your expectations. A harmless wall might crush you. A checkpoint could be bait. A jump you've already survived once may suddenly become deadly. Nothing stays predictable for long.

🎮 Precision Platforming
Tight controls and fast respawns keep the action flowing. Every jump matters, every movement counts, and every mistake is punished instantly. Mastering a level feels less like luck and more like surviving a war against the game itself.

😈 Troll Traps Everywhere
This world hates confidence. The moment you think you've figured the game out, it finds a new way to destroy you. Traps trigger from impossible angles, hazards appear at the perfect worst moment, and every level is built to break your instincts.

🧠 Memorize. Adapt. Survive.
Progress comes from observation and persistence. Watch carefully, remember everything, and slowly turn impossible levels into mastered runs. The path to victory is paved with your previous deaths.

🏆 Satisfaction Earned the Hard Way
Reaching the end of a level is more than completion — it's revenge. Every impossible jump, every unfair trap, every last-second death only makes victory feel better.

Features:

💀 Brutal trap-based platforming designed to surprise and punish

⚡ Instant respawns for fast retry-focused gameplay

🧠 Levels built around memory, adaptation, and trial-and-error

🎯 Precision movement and tight platforming controls

😈 Troll mechanics that constantly break player expectations

📈 Increasingly chaotic and difficult level design

🏆 Extremely satisfying progression through mastery and persistence

store_data.about_the_game:
《Pitch Girls》 is a full-motion video strategy football game. You take on the role of Coach Ren Xing and manage the entire women’s national football team. Fight your way through qualifying rounds and compete against distinctive top women’s teams across the globe. It restores classic command-based football gameplay, including dribbling, bursting past defenders, short passes, long balls, fancy feints, charged shots and aerial duels. Every offensive decision and defensive arrangement determines the match outcome. There is no mindless stat advantage. Victory relies on tactical combinations, countering opponents’ player traits and well-timed special moves, bringing back the unique strategic fun of retro football games.

Backstory

Coach Ren Xing takes over an underperforming national women’s football team at a critical moment, aiming to compete in the Women’s World Cup. The qualifying and group stages are filled with hardships: frequent player injuries, internal team friction, tactical suppression by strong rivals and constant public doubt. Instead of imposing harsh pressure, Ren Xing patiently identifies every player’s weaknesses and strengths, creates customized training plans, relieves the athletes’ mental stress, joins extra training and match reviews with them, and leads the team to overcome countless obstacles side by side.

Through countless days and matches spent fighting together, the players have developed deep trust and affection for the gentle and reliable Ren Xing. United as one, the team stages repeated comebacks against powerful opponents and finally claims the World Cup championship trophy. After the celebration fades, the players set aside their hesitation and confess their long-hidden feelings one after another to Ren Xing, the coach who guided their growth and saved the team.

Game Features

Full-Motion Video Game with Real-Time Character Control

Players may control athletes in real time during football matches.

Command-Based Strategy Gameplay

Players freely assign all kinds of football commands to characters.

Dynamic Adaptive Challenges

Match difficulty varies based on tournament progress and player development stats.

Stat-Driven Strategy System

Diverse character growth stats interact with different match commands to generate varied success probabilities.

store_data.about_the_game:
The seas rose and the surface is gone. What's left of us holds on in hab-shells: salvaged homes anchored in the dark, overgrown by a sea that moves into anything warm that stays still. Every fathom takes something back.

One dive, one shell

You raid a shell in a short deckbuilding run. Fight through its chambers, and at each extraction point choose whether to surface with what you've got or push deeper for a richer haul. At the core waits the Pressure-Heart; crack it for the full harvest. The shells you dive are generated enemy bases, each one read by the faction that built it.

Three ways to dive

The solo dives are the heart of the game. Open Descent is the main run, generated shells set to the Pressure you choose. Daily Signal is one shared shell, the same for every diver that day. Endless Descent drops the floor and lets the Pressure climb until you break, once you've earned the way down.

Build a shell others raid

Between dives you build your own shell and lay out its defenses. While you're offline, real divers raid it, and you read the report when you surface. Climb a ranked seasonal ladder against players in your range. The rivals you face are real divers, never bots; when no one is near your rank, the board says so instead of inventing an opponent.

Pick your answer to the drowning

Four factions, four answers to the rising water, and you belong to one. The Hold seals its shell and outlasts everything, betting the water climbs forever. The Stilled live inside a dead leviathan's carcass and call it holy. The Bellows holds the last working air plant and rules by the leash, all railguns and harpoons. The Severed lost their crew and trust the swarm and the open water. Every faction draws on the Flotsam pool, the cast-off divers' common gear.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tactical, turn-based combat

Fight on a grid where positioning decides everything. Manage action and movement points, exploit line of sight, and place your units before each fight. Every spell carries an element Fire, Water, Earth, Air and striking a status of another element detonates it into a reaction: steam bursts, landslides, spreading burns, drained action points. Six reactions, and they cut both ways: enemies can detonate your statuses too.

Build your squad — from one to four

Choose your starting character. That choice is permanent for your save. Earn tickets across runs to unlock team slots and recruit new members, up to a squad of four:

  • Smokejail — Fire. Stacks burns on everything he touches, then detonates them all at once.

  • DonCorleone — Air. Hunts weakened targets. Every kill refunds him — and he keeps going.

  • Marron — Earth. Summons muscle, holds the line, shields the squad.

  • Amwet — Water. Control, sustain, and the only one who can bring the fallen back.

Each character has a passive and 8 spells — you equip 4. New spells unlock as they level, capped by a class ultimate. Characters gain experience that persists forever: allocate stat points, level your spells, shape each one into your build.

Loot. Craft. Break. Forge.

Monsters drop resources, gold and gear. Random chests hold more. Craft items with randomly rolled stats — then decide: equip it, or break it into runes. Runes feed the forge. Ten identical items fuse into one of higher rarity. Everything you find is either power now or fuel for something better.

Between fights, pick one of three run upgrades, from common to build-defining — some appear only when a specific character is in your squad, and the rarest can bring a fallen one back.

The Forge: gamble your stats

Spend runes to push an item's stats beyond their limits. Every attempt has four outcomes — clean success, success with collateral damage, nothing, or pure loss — and all four probabilities are displayed before you commit. No hidden math. Sacrifice heavy stats to bank a reserve, push lines past their crafted maximum, and know exactly what you're risking on every roll.

The descent doesn't end. You do.

Runs are procedurally generated and endless: waves of fights, then a boss, then harder waves, then a harder boss. A fallen character is gone for the rest of the run — unless you're holding a rare resurrection. When the whole squad falls, your equipment is lost. Your characters' levels, your roster and your unlocks endure. Go back down stronger.

Key features

  • Turn-based tactical combat on a grid, with a placement phase before every fight

  • 4 elements, 6 elemental reactions — symmetric, exploitable by both sides

  • 4 playable characters with distinct kits: passive + 8 spells, 4 equipped

  • Persistent character progression: levels, free stat allocation, spell leveling

  • Squad building through a meta skill tree — start alone, end as a team of four

  • Full loot economy: craft, equip, break into runes, fuse rarities

  • Between every fight: pick 1 of 3 upgrades across 5 rarities, plus random chests with rarities to crack open

  • The Forge: high-risk stat gambling with every probability displayed

  • Endless procedural runs with cycling, escalating bosses

  • Permadeath per character, rare resurrections, gear lost on a wipe

  • Run upgrades can be character-exclusive — your squad shapes what you're offered

store_data.about_the_game:
BUILD YOUR OWN HOSTING COMPANY

Start with an empty business and take your first step into the world of hosting.

You begin with a limited budget, a small workspace, and only a few pieces of equipment. Your first goal is to build your own hosting startup by creating the basic infrastructure needed to serve customers. Buy server cases, place rack systems, and prepare your first working systems.

Over time, you can reinvest the money you earn into your company, build more powerful systems, increase your service capacity, and turn your small startup into a growing hosting company.

BUILD AND GROW YOUR STARTUP

Every big company starts with a small idea. In Hosting Simulator, you start your own startup from scratch and grow it step by step.

In the early stages, you need to make the right decisions with a low budget. Which equipment you buy, which services you offer, how you set your prices, and where you invest your earnings are all under your control.

As you succeed, you can improve your startup, reach more customers, expand your infrastructure, and grow from a small business into a professional data center operation.

ASSEMBLE AND UPGRADE YOUR SERVERS

Servers are more than just cases. The performance of each system depends on the hardware installed inside it.

Choose processors, RAM, storage drives, power supplies, fans, and other components to build your own server systems. More powerful hardware provides better performance, but it also means higher costs and increased energy consumption.

With every upgrade decision, you need to balance performance, price, and operating expenses carefully.

CREATE HOSTING PACKAGES

Create your own packages to offer different hosting services to your customers.

Meet different customer needs with Web Hosting, VPS, VDS, Game Server, and Dedicated Server services. Set package prices, calculate resource requirements, and plan the most profitable services for your company.

Cheap packages may attract more customers, but poor pricing can reduce your profit. That is why each package should be carefully designed according to both customer demand and operating costs.

LICENSES AND INFRASTRUCTURE UPGRADES

Strengthen your infrastructure with licenses to offer more advanced services.

Purchase licenses such as Virtualization, DDoS Protection, Web Panel, and Game Panel to provide more professional solutions to your customers. You can also buy public IP addresses to increase your service capacity and serve more customers at the same time.

The right licenses and infrastructure upgrades play an important role in the growth of your company.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Manage your hosting company alone or grow it together with your friends.

With co-op support, you can share tasks, set up servers together, manage orders faster, and develop your company through joint decisions.

While one player prepares server cases, another can organize rack systems, manage hosting packages, or handle customer orders. With the right division of work, you can grow your company faster and more efficiently.
