store_data.about_the_game:
In search of adventure, you and your friends set out to explore an abandoned mine. After a sudden collapse, you become separated from the group and, while searching for a way back to the surface, discover something that should never have existed.

Deep beneath the earth lies a secret Soviet research complex whose existence was never officially acknowledged. Decades ago, the facility was completely isolated from the outside world, and all information about the experiments conducted there vanished without a trace.Explore abandoned laboratories and tunnels as you uncover the history of the complex. Project Collie was created to grant a living creature intelligence and freedom from death.

The deeper you descend underground, the more questions arise. Why was the complex sealed off? What happened to its personnel? And is everything buried beneath the mountain truly dead?

Buried Life is an atmospheric first-person adventure featuring exploration, puzzles, and psychological horror elements.

Features

• An abandoned Soviet research complex hidden from the outside world for decades.

• The secrets of Project Collie and Project Newtonia, buried deep underground.

• Exploration of laboratories, mines, and technical tunnels.

• Documents, tapes, and recordings that reveal the fate of the complex.

• Interactive environments and hidden secrets.

• Choices that influence the outcome of the story.

• An atmospheric adventure with psychological horror elements.

store_data.about_the_game:
A relentless, momentum-driven, narrative-first shooter, where you pilot J-L, half-human, half-robot protagonist, in a futuristic earth where humanity has lost its place as rulers of the world, and something far less forgiving has taken the throne.

STORY

To J-L, a Droid, it doesn't matter. All he has to do is complete the missions given to him by his Boss, then head back to the recharge station. Labor work, assassination, one-man-army he's done it all. But now, with a new danger around the corner, the Boss interrupts his charging hours, sending J-L into the most dangerous and brutal mission he has ever received,

Dive deep into this world, running across factories, cyberpunk cities, dream worlds, and many other futuristic and intriguing locations. Slashing, shooting and exploding hundreds of robots that stand in your way, speeding through levels designed to keep your momentum going, with many different and unique weapons, dashing and slowing time, sliding and climbing walls, running across buildings, kill those that stand in your way and complete your mission. And maybe... just maybe, one day you will be set free.

store_data.about_the_game:
History is not lost—it waits to be restored.

Step into the role of a relic restorer and breathe new life into treasures from ancient civilizations. Carefully assemble scattered fragments, reveal the complete form of forgotten artifacts, and uncover the stories they carry through time.

Each restored piece enriches your museum collection, allowing visitors to rediscover the beauty, craftsmanship, and legacy of the past. From delicate jade ornaments and elegant ceramics to mysterious bronzes and ancient paintings, every artifact offers a new puzzle to solve and a new chapter of history to revisit.

Take your time, enjoy the soothing atmosphere, and experience the quiet satisfaction of preserving what history left behind.

Features:

• Relaxing yet engaging fragment-based puzzle gameplay
• Restore a wide variety of artifacts inspired by ancient civilizations
• Explore themed museums and expand your collection
• Hand-painted storybook visuals with a cozy atmosphere
• Learn the stories behind each relic as history gradually unfolds
• Designed for players who enjoy thoughtful, stress-free experiences

store_data.about_the_game:
VOIDRAVE is an arcade bullet hell shoot 'em up wrapped in a Lovecraftian nightmare. What begins as a routine purge mission becomes a descent into the body of a sleeping god - and the deeper you go, the more the void notices you.

▶ FIGHT THE ORGANS OF A GOD

100 waves. 20 unique hand-crafted pixel bosses, each with its own attack patterns: lasers, gravity wells, homing swarms, time distortion, and a mirror that throws your own bullets back at you. They are not an invading species. They are something's anatomy.

▶ MUTATE OR DIE

  • Choose 1 of 3 Mutations every 10 waves - ricochet bullets, vampiric kills, glass cannon builds and more. Every run plays differently.

  • 4 playable ships with unique special abilities: EMP Burst, Phase Shift, Shield Wall, Overcharge.

  • Upgrade shop with drones, crits and the limitless VOID OVERCHARGE for late-game power.

  • Unstable wave mutators keep every sector unpredictable.

▶ PURE ARCADE DNA

  • Combo and graze scoring with a global online leaderboard.

  • Overdrive meter, screen-clearing bombs, dash with invincibility frames.

  • Beat wave 100 and unlock ENDLESS MODE - the void never ends.

  • BOSS RUSH: defeat bosses in campaign to unlock a gauntlet mode - fight them all back-to-back with mutations and shops between rounds.

  • Authentic CRT visuals: scanlines, bloom and chromatic aberration (all toggleable).

  • Synthwave-flavored FM soundtrack. Full keyboard rebinding. Xbox controller support.

▶ THE VOID IS LISTENING

The transmissions degrade. Your commander's voice begins answering questions you haven't asked. And something at the bottom of sector 50 has been waiting - not for humanity. For you.

Stop the heart. Outfly the god. End the dream.

store_data.about_the_game:
After a long absence, Silas Reed returns to Dry Creek… but something feels wrong.

The silence is too heavy, the streets too empty. And no explanation awaits him upon his return.

In this isolated town of the Old West, everything feels frozen in time. Landmarks seem to vanish, places are deserted, and a growing sense of unease slowly sets in.

Very quickly, what was meant to be a simple return home turns into a disturbing mystery, where every moment deepens doubt and uncertainty.

store_data.about_the_game:
A mission gone awry. A world pushed to the brink.

Crash-landing on a strange planet was just the beginning of Lyra’s nightmare. Stranded deep within uncharted territory, she discovers the Taurids—a brutal, hostile alien race aggressively harvesting the planet's core resources.

Outnumbered and outgunned, Lyra's survival depends on her agility and wits. Navigate a beautiful but deadly alien ecosystem by scaling cliffs, leaping across chasms, and using fluid parkour movement to stay out of sight. Outmaneuver the high-tech Taurid patrols, study their patterns, and use the verticality of the terrain to engineer your escape.

Key Features:

  • Fluid Parkour & Verticality: Run, jump, climb, and vault your way through treacherous environments. Use momentum and agility to cross dangerous terrain and escape tight situations.

  • Tense Evasion Gameplay: Stay one step ahead of the ruthless Taurids. Utilize the vertical landscape to break line-of-sight and slip past deadly patrol units lurking below.

  • True Alien Perspective: Experience a sci-fi survival story from the eyes of Lyra, an alien explorer navigating a universe where she is the outsider.

  • A Beautifully Hostile World: Explore an uncharted planet filled with unique ecosystems, dangerous heights, and the atmospheric tension of a hostile occupation.

From The Developers: Our Debut & Passion for Godot

A Note From Our Small Team: Dayless Games is a small, independent team, and this is our very first commercial game! Driven by a passion for open-source tech, we chose to build this entire 3D world—including its fluid parkour and movement mechanics—inside the Godot Engine.

While Godot is traditionally famous for 2D, we wanted to push the boundaries of its 3D capabilities to prove what a dedicated indie team can achieve with the engine. By wishlisting and playing our debut title, you are directly supporting independent, open-source game development. Thank you for taking this journey with Lyra!

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up behind the counter of a pawnshop. The door is locked. A debt hangs over your head.

The Collector is watching.

You have five days to turn a profit. Or you die.

Every day, items come through. Your job is to observe them, analyze them, spot what's wrong. Some carry subtle markings — symbols, signs that only a careful eye will catch. Accept a cursed item by mistake, and the rules shift. Take in stolen goods, and karma turns against you. Inflation. Fines. Invisible consequences that stack in silence.

The terminal is your only ally. Every morning it reports the news — stolen goods in circulation, categories under watch, fluctuating values. Read it. Remember it. Ignore it at your own risk.

There is no UI. No HUD. No tutorial holding your hand. Everything you need to know is in the room. Everything you need to see is in front of you. The rest belongs to The Collector.

Five days. One chance. Be profitable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Prepare to cross the threshold into a ruined world, where ancient magic and ancestral chaos clash in battles to the death. Gatebound: Chronicles of Valor is a Fantasy Arena Action RPG, step into battle, annihilate legions of darkness, collect invaluable loot, and rise as the ultimate hero.

Classes: Find Your Combat Style

Begin your journey exploring 3 powerful base classes, then evolve by mastering one of their 9 lethal Specializations:

Warrior: Relentless and lethal in close quarters, crushing enemies and defending the group with sheer brute force.

  • Paladin: A divine protector. Sacrifices mobility for sacred defenses to punish heretics with holy light.

  • Berserker: The embodiment of unbridled fury. Foregoes caution to inflict colossal damage, turning the pain of battle into unstoppable rage.

  • Death Knight: A dark sovereign who dominates shadow arts to weaken, terrify, and drain the life essence from enemies, thriving amidst the chaos.

Mage: A master of arcane arts who rends enemy defenses by conjuring devastating spells.

  • Pyromancer: A fire mage who summons infernos of blazing ashes, causing immense area-of-effect damage over time.

  • Cryomaner: A frost mage and brilliant tactician who slows, blocks, and paralyzes enemy hordes to control the battlefield.

  • Electromancer: Bends the energy of storms to unleash lightning-fast electrical magic and devastating chain-lightning for high bursts of damage per second.

Rogue: An indomitable specialist relying on agility to survive, with high mobility to execute targets and quickly fade away.

  • Hunter: Master of archery and primal abilities. Prefers keeping distance, controlling the flow of battle.

  • Shadow Trickster: Embraces paranormal shades. Manifests the power of darkness, while brutally draining the soul of those who dare approach.

  • Storm Ranger: A hybrid wanderer who weaves stormy ice, and lightning, combining extreme mobility with the lethal.

Deep Loot & Equipment

Your progression is defined by what you can tear from the corpses of your adversaries. A deep progression system will keep you constantly hunting for perfection:

  • Endless Loot: Collect weapons, helmets, and armor of every rarity (from Common to Legendary).

  • Mythic Weapons: Seek out Mythic weapons, extremely rare cosmic relics of catastrophic power. Tools like the Shadow Fang or the Greatsword of the Eclipse grant potent Innate Abilities capable of healing critical damage, devouring souls, or unleashing lightning storms on your enemies!

Boss Fights, Immersive Arenas & Dungeons

  • Survive haunted dungeons or delve into the corrupted depths of the universe to fight unwavering undeads, colossal monsters, and ravenous entities.

  • Face fearsome bosses, fight on the mountaintops to challenge majestic and deadly ancient dragons, or face its general in the bowels of hell.

A Devastating Endgame: No Rest for the Strong

Have you reached the maximum level? The real challenge has just begun. Push past mortal limits with Endgame challenges designed for the most devoted warriors:

Trial of the Gods: A lethal wave-based arena, with no pauses and no checkpoints. Face the arena itself turning hostile against you through powerful Divine Modifiers. Fight suspended in the Celestial Pinnacle, survive the deadly Emerald Sanctuary, or dominate the Resonating Crystal Forest. Prove your valor and take on increasingly higher level challenges.

Are you ready? Sharpen your blade, prepare your spells. The end of the world awaits its new hero.

store_data.about_the_game:
"Tragic Illusion: Dancer Clara Dead After On-Stage Stabbing During Live Performance. The head magician, Albert, remains hospitalized with severe head trauma. Witnesses report the prop knife had been swapped for a real blade..."


You are Albert. You don't remember who that is. You don't remember the woman in the photograph, even though someone has scratched out her eyes with a pin. You don't remember the circus, the stage, or why your hands won't stop shaking. But when you close your eyes, you see a knife and you feel something worse than guilt. You feel relief.

Wander through corridors that stretch and loop the moment you look away. The rooms behind you are not the rooms you left. Pick up old photographs, torn letters, and ruined props turn them over in your hands, inspect every angle, every scribbled note. The answer to what happened during "The Final Show" is here, buried in the debris of a mind that doesn't want to remember. Or can't. Or won't.

You are not alone. Someone is watching from the rafters. He saw what you did, and he hasn't forgiven you.

Walk softly. The floor is littered with traps, step on the wrong thing and every sound you make becomes a beacon. Breathe quietly. Run too long and your gasps will betray you before your footsteps do. Don't look up. When the sandbag falls, you won't hear it coming.

A first-person psychological horror experience. Approximately 1 hour of gameplay. An original ambient soundtrack with reactive audio.

THE SHOW NEVER ENDED

store_data.about_the_game:
THE INDUCTED

They do not want you to die.
They want to see what you become under pressure.

The Inducted is a third person cooperative arena survival game about surviving staged combat trials inside a rebuilt ancient colosseum.

The Arena was once a place of ritual combat, punishment, and spectacle. It was abandoned for centuries, buried in dust and silence.

Then someone found it.

An advanced faction rebuilt the Arena into a controlled combat machine. Gates seal behind you. Spawn systems wake beneath the floor. Observation tiers fill with people you never see clearly. Every fight is recorded. Every choice is measured.

You are one of The Inducted.

Some were taken without warning. Some chose this for reward, freedom, or someone waiting at home. The Arena does not care why you came. It only cares what you can survive.

FIGHT AS A HERO WITH A PURPOSE

Each hero brings a distinct combat role to the trial.

The Crusader holds the front line with shield, sword, and explosive close range power. The Engineer turns the Arena against itself by placing turrets, locking down choke points, and building defenses before the next wave begins.

More heroes are coming, each designed to change how your team survives.

SURVIVE CONTROLLED TRIALS

The waves are not random. They are staged experiments.

Every gate that opens brings a new test. More enemies. Tighter pressure. Less room for mistakes. The faction is studying how long you last, how quickly you adapt, and what happens when the plan falls apart.

Between trials, use the prep phase to recover, build, reposition, and prepare for the next escalation.

USE THE ARENA AGAINST THEM

The Arena gives you tools, but not mercy.

Activate turret pylons. Place defensive panels. Create choke points. Protect weak angles. Buy your team enough time to survive the next wave.

The faction installed these systems because longer fights create better data.

Use them anyway.

STAND TOGETHER OR BREAK ALONE

Play solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

The Arena rewards coordination. A shield in the right place can save a teammate. A turret placed before the gates open can turn a collapse into a hold. A bad call can leave everyone surrounded.

The gates do not close.

The trials do not stop.

Someone is always watching.

The Inducted is currently in development. Wishlist now to follow progress.

A mystery-focused otome game that blends narrative investigation with crime simulation mechanics.

Featuring four romanceable male characters, the game offers nine major endings, including romantic endings with each love interest, two independent endings in which the protagonist solves the final case alone, and numerous bad endings.

Unlike many traditional otome games, you are not required to reshape your personality or choices to win someone's affection. Relationships grow naturally through the story, with affection developing through both the main narrative and optional character events.

Most importantly, the way you pursue the truth is entirely up to you. Decide how to investigate, whom to trust, and how to execute the murders that drive the story forward. Every choice brings you closer to a different ending.

store_data.about_the_game:
A great magical catastrophe has shattered the peace of the Rhu Archipelago. Its inhabitants are displaced as corruption and toxic magic rain down from the sky. Become an enchanter for Enchanted Oceans Inc., equipped with the tools and magical talents to save the day. Cleanse the corruption from the land and beneath the waves and bring life back to this once thriving oceanic community! Learn to harness the magical energy corrupting the land and use it to help breath life back into the archipelago once again.

Sail the Archipelago

Take control of your own enchanted ship, fully equipped to handle every challenge. Navigate treacherous seas with a dynamic weather and wave system, transport cargo and supplies between islands, or use your crane to lift wreckage off the sea floor. Your fully upgradable magical ship is your lifeline and best tool to help restore the environment. Be sure to manage your hull integrity or you may find yourself on the bottom of the ocean yourself.

Explore the Ocean Depths

Dive beneath the waves with a realistic SCUBA diving system. Manage both your air supply and the nitrogen building in your blood to survive and avoid the getting the bends. Explore the wonders of the ocean and find hidden treasures deep below the surface. Be careful as things get darker and more dangerous the deeper you go! Use your bottom time wisely as you'll need to remove corruption, gather resources, and search for rare artifacts

Restore a Living World

Purge the corruption spreading across the land, twisting everything it touches into decay and death. Your magical enchantments keep you safe and allow you to survive the corruption where others would perish. Beneath this toxic magic is lush world waiting to thrive again. Watch the world come alive and life return to the oceans as you cleanse them. Once restored, cast your fishing rod to try your luck catching the big one.

Enchanted Oceans Inc. is a solo developer project created by marine biologist, commercial diver, and tired dad. Thanks for taking the time to check it out!

store_data.about_the_game:
Barrels are never where they should be!

2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved.

Features

• Classic sokoban puzzle gameplay

• Beer-powered gate breaking mechanic

• Handcrafted puzzles

• Unlimited undo

• No timers or move limits

• Hand-drawn pixel art

• 8-bit soundtrack

Gameplay

You push barrels across a grid, one tile at a time. Barrels can only be pushed, never pulled. Back one into a corner or against a wall and it's stuck, so every move is worth thinking through.

Your main obstacle is the gates blocking the way. To break a gate, the dwarf drinks a mug of beer. But it's strictly one mug at a time: drink, break one gate, drink again, break the next. And there's usually less beer on a level than there are gates, so part of the puzzle is deciding which gates to break, and in what order.

There are no clocks and no move counters, so there's never any rush. And if you slip up, any action can be undone, which means you'll never have to restart a whole level over a single misplaced barrel.

Graphics and sound

Hand-drawn pixel art in the spirit of old consoles, with a handful of 8-bit tracks for the right retro mood.

The horror in ESKINITA doesn’t rely on constant threats, but on the slow realization that your routine is no longer safe, and your journey home is no longer predictable.

Each night pushes you further into uncertainty, where something unseen seems to observe your movement through the alleys.

Story

You operate and close the lugawan the same way every night. Serve customers. Wash the bowls. Wipe the tables. Close the stall. Walk home. The alleyways are always dark, narrow, and quiet at this hour — but lately, something feels wrong.

Customers whisper about strange people roaming at night. The late-night news keeps reporting incidents nearby. At first, its only little things, then one night… they start following you.

Features

  • Immersive Filipino urban horror atmosphere

  • Realistic “eskinita” neighborhood setting

  • Narrative-driven suspense and psychological tension

  • Simple immersive tasks and closing shift gameplay

  • Two possible endings

  • 20 to 30 minute playthrough

Can you make it home safely before closing time becomes your last routine?

store_data.about_the_game:
Let Her Stay on Your Desktop

Luo Ci Jian is an AI character companion app for Windows desktops.

The character appears on your desktop as an animated presence, keeping you company while you study, work, draw, or play other games. There is no need to open a traditional chat webpage — you can start a conversation at any time.

More Than Just a Chat Window

Interact with the character through text and experience responses shaped by her own personality and way of expression.

The character generates replies based on her character settings, the current conversation, and parts of her interaction memory, making conversations feel more coherent and allowing different characters to show distinct personalities.

Lively Character Expression

The character can respond to interactions through animated models, motions, and facial expressions.

You can freely adjust the character’s position, size, and display status, placing her in the area of your desktop that best suits your own usage.

Import Your Own Characters

With the local Mod import feature, you can add compatible character content and configure character settings and related resources.

Whether you want to enjoy the built-in character or create your own collection of desktop companions, you can choose freely according to your personal preferences.

Please Note Before Use

AI conversation features require an internet connection. AI conversation, screen-context responses, code or technical text generation, and other AI-assisted features consume in-app Memory Points. Users receive initial bonus points and monthly bonus points. Additional Memory Points can be purchased in the application through Steam Wallet if needed. AI response quality, response speed, and service availability may vary depending on network conditions, server status, and model availability.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bound to Rot is a dark fantasy action RPG built around one ruthless question: how long do you dare to stay and explore further?

Drop into a procedurally generated instance, cut through waves of escalating enemies, and fill your inventory with rare gear, but the longer you push your luck, the more dangerous it gets.

Die, and your character is gone. Everything. Gone.

An Anima That Wants You Dead

Explore the Anima, a sprawling, ever-deepening anima driven by a pulse that waits for no one. The pulse lights your way and keeps the darkness at bay, but you choose where it goes next. Every node cleared is a moment of truth: take what you have and walk away, or pick the next path and gamble it all. There is no exit to find. There is only the choice you make before the darkness moves in.

Itemization That Actually Matters

Six damage types. Hundreds of affixes. A spatial grid inventory that forces real decisions about what you carry out.

Items roll on drop and never change, what you find is what you get. Common scrap or a Legendary with a unique red-text mod that rewrites how your build works.

Dark, Deterministic Combat

Hit resolution runs through an Entropy System — no pure RNG streaks, no invisible dice rolls. Accuracy, evasion, and per-entity entropy values produce combat that feels fair even when it kills you.

Seasonal Ladders

Every season wipes the slate. Climb the competitive ladder, race to depth, and carve your name into the rankings before the reset erases everything and the cycle begins again.

Features

  • Permadeath! lose your character, not just your loot

  • Extract between nodes or risk it all pushing deeper

  • PoE-style Delve with branching node choices and enemy level previews

  • Diablo II-inspired itemization: five rarity tiers, prefix/suffix affixes, spatial inventory

  • Six damage types with distinct mechanics (Burning, Chain Lightning, Freeze, Rot)

  • Deterministic hit system, no streaky RNG

  • Seasonal resets with competitive ladders

  • Dark fantasy gothic aesthetic

store_data.about_the_game:
A gateway to Hell has opened beneath the churchyard, and the only thing standing between mankind and eternal damnation is a squad of heavily armed nuns with no intention of going quietly.

Nuns With Guns is a dark gothic top-down action roguelite where you command four battle-ready sisters defending their church from waves of demons. Position your nuns, survive the assault, upgrade their weapons, strengthen their abilities, and prepare between waves before Hell sends something bigger, uglier, and significantly less polite.

Demons pour in from below. The church stands above. Everything in between becomes a firing range.

Defend the Church

Your church is the last line between the living world and the demonic filth crawling out of the pit.

Keep the chapel standing while waves of enemies push upward from the hellhole. Your nuns can fight, fall, revive, upgrade, and reposition, but if the church falls, the parish is finished.

No pressure. Just eternal damnation and a repair bill.

Command Four Armed Sisters

Each nun has her own colour, role, weapon setup, health, and upgrade path.

Sister Mercy — aggressive, direct, and fond of solving theology with bullets.

Sister Agnes— mystical, strange, and dangerously comfortable around forbidden relics.

Sister Joan — precise, controlled, and very good at making demons regret having legs.

Sister Ruth — heavy support, tough defence, and holy firepower with bad intentions.

Switch between sisters, keep them alive, upgrade their weapons, and build your squad into a proper little holy problem for Hell.

Build Between Waves

After each wave, enter the build phase and prepare before the next demonic assault.

Spend gold to:

  • Buy and equip weapons

  • Upgrade damage, range, fire rate, health, speed, and armour

  • Heal wounded nuns

  • Revive fallen sisters

  • Prepare your defence before the next wave begins

This is where you decide whether the next wave is a heroic stand or a short funeral with reload animations.

Run-Only Blessings

Level up during a run and choose from blessing cards that change how your squad fights.

Blessings can improve weapons, strengthen the church, protect your nuns, boost your economy, or grant cursed advantages with ugly consequences.

Examples include:

  • Bullets that apply holy burn

  • Faster reloads

  • Squad-wide health boosts

  • Emergency revives

  • Church damage reduction

  • Cursed blessings that make you stronger while making the next waves nastier

Every run gives you different choices. Some are holy. Some are stupid. Most are both.

Fight Hell’s Worst

As the assault escalates, Hell sends more than ordinary demons.

Face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins, the Four Horsemen, and worse, each bringing unique attacks, pressure, and punishment. Survive long enough and the fight stops being about crowd control and starts being about whether your squad can kill a walking theological problem before it tears the church apart.

Features

  • Gothic top-down bullet-heaven combat

  • Four playable / commandable armed nuns

  • Wave-based church defence

  • Demons attacking from the bottom of the map

  • Church and squad health management

  • Build phase between waves

  • Weapon buying and equipping

  • Stat upgrades for each nun

  • Run-only blessing cards

  • Boss fights inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins, the Four Horsemen, and worse

  • Dark cathedral, cemetery, and hell-zone battlegrounds

  • Score, kills, souls, and survival progression

  • Singleplayer action with replayable runs

Gameplay Loop

Defend the church from a wave of demons.

Earn gold, souls, XP, and upgrades.

Level up and choose a blessing.

Enter the build phase.

Heal, revive, upgrade, and prepare.

Start the next wave.

Repeat until Hell runs out of demons or you run out of nuns.

Spoiler: Hell has a lot of demons.

Hacklash is a typing horror game where you type against the clock while a hostile AI has a turret aimed at your spine. Survive as long as you can, beat your best scores, and climb the global leaderboards across multiple modes and modifiers.

SUMMARY

You break into a surveillance corporation called ORCA (Omni Research & Control Authority) to access their data. You go to log in to a computer, but then you get a nasty surprise.

The computer is alive, and it wants to have some fun with you before shredding your lungs.

Race against the turret timer countdown, typing randomized codes from a list of 1300+ words and trying to get through as many as you can.

You earn big points for completing words quick, but less for taking time or mistyping.

As the game progresses, ORCA will impose RESTRICTIONS on you, such as words where you can't type vowels or numbers.

The timer will shorten. You will feel cold dread and your heart rate fasten more than your fingers as you tire and

At the end of your life, you see your high score. Try to beat your best score, or those on the global leaderboards.

Hacklash offers:

  • Four Modes

  • Daily Challenges

  • 11 Achievements

  • Multiple difficulty settings and configuration options for adding more ease or challenge to the ORCA experience

  • Different Phosphor Colors

Good luck hacker.

ORCA has calculated your arrival. ORCA is ready for you to play.

WARPED is a polished arcade space shooter built around fast movement, satisfying combat, and classic sci-fi action. Pilot your ship through dangerous sectors of the solar system, survive waves of hostile UFOs, dodge asteroid fields, collect power-ups, and push deeper into space to find the source of the signal.

Choose from multiple ship classes, each with its own strengths, weaknesses, and playstyle. Whether you prefer balanced firepower, heavy defense, fast movement, or hard-hitting shots, every ship changes how you survive the chaos.

Fight through a campaign that takes you from Earth’s orbit to the outer edges of the solar system and far beyond, or jump straight into Endless Arcade mode for quick, high-score chasing action.

Features

  • Fast twin-stick space combat

  • Campaign and Endless Arcade modes

  • Multiple playable ship classes

  • Local co-op support

  • Power-ups, upgrades, and chaotic enemy waves

  • Asteroids, UFOs, bosses, and space hazards

  • Retro arcade style with vibrant sci-fi visuals

  • Controller-friendly gameplay

  • Local high scores and replayable score-chasing action

Built with the spirit of classic arcade shooters, WARPED is easy to pick up, exciting to master, and packed with colorful space action. The signal is calling, Pilot. Will you answer?

Choose from multiple ship classes, each with its own strengths, weaknesses, and playstyle. Whether you prefer balanced firepower, heavy defense, fast movement, or hard-hitting shots, every ship changes how you survive the chaos.

Fight through a campaign that takes you from Earth’s orbit to the outer edges of the solar system and far beyond, or jump straight into Endless Arcade mode for quick, high-score chasing action.

Features

  • Fast twin-stick space combat

  • Campaign and Endless Arcade modes

  • Multiple playable ship classes

  • Local co-op support

  • Power-ups, upgrades, and chaotic enemy waves

  • Asteroids, UFOs, bosses, and space hazards

  • Retro arcade style with vibrant sci-fi visuals

  • Controller-friendly gameplay

  • Local high scores and replayable score-chasing action

Built with the spirit of classic arcade shooters, WARPED is easy to pick up, exciting to master, and packed with colorful space action. The signal is calling, Pilot. Will you answer?
store_data.short_description: WARPED is a fast, retro-inspired twin-stick space shooter where you blast UFOs, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship, and fight across the solar system with your robot companion Zippy to uncover the source of a mysterious signal.

store_data.about_the_game:
Curse of Baghdad

The city of Baghdad has fallen under the grip of an ancient and mysterious curse.

When Canadian special operations officer Captain Ryan Jones finds himself trapped within the city alongside journalist Bridgette Baker and Iraqi Army officer Captain Ali Salim, the trio must fight their way through chaos, uncover the origins of the curse, and survive a nightmare that threatens to consume everything in its path.

What began as a routine mission quickly spirals into a desperate struggle for survival as ordinary civilians are transformed into monstrous husks stripped of their humanity. As the curse spreads across the city, Ryan, Ali, and Bridgette must confront both the horrors before them and the secrets buried deep beneath Baghdad's ancient past.

Tactical Top-Down Military Combat

Fight your way through a variety of dangerous environments using an arsenal of military weapons and equipment.

Battle through palm groves, abandoned facilities, horror underground basements, rooftops, 

  • Ancient locations touched by the curse

Every encounter brings new challenges as you push deeper into the heart of the outbreak.

A Story-Driven Cinematic Experience

Experience a narrative-driven adventure told through fully voiced cinematic cutscenes. Follow Ryan, Ali, and Bridgette as they uncover the truth behind the curse while witnessing the human cost of conflict, loss, and survival. Featuring a cast of dedicated voice actors, Curse of Baghdad combines military action with a character-focused story that explores friendship, sacrifice, and resilience in the face of overwhelming odds.

Face the Symbols of the Curse

Ancient forces have awakened.

Throughout your journey, you will confront powerful bosses inspired by Mesopotamian mythology. Each entity represents a different aspect of the curse that has taken hold of Baghdad.

Fight through unique arenas, survive deadly attack patterns, and overcome powerful enemies as you break the chains binding the city to its dark fate.

Built by a Family Team

Curse of Baghdad was created by a small team of three brothers working alongside family members, friends, volunteers, artists, voice actors, and supporters who believed in the project.

Every purchase directly supports our studio and helps us continue creating independent games driven by passion, storytelling, and creativity.

This project is deeply personal to us. It reflects our family's journey through immigration, hardship, and the real stories of survival that shaped our lives.

From Our Family To Yours

Thank you for taking the time to experience Curse of Baghdad.

We hope the characters, story, music, and world stay with you long after the credits roll.

See you in Baghdad.

Features :

Weapons fire automatically by default with the option to aim manually

Quick matches (under 30 minutes)

Characters available to customize your matches

Dozen of weapons assigned randomly during gameplay

Collect materials to gain experience, build and protect your base

store_data.about_the_game:
A SURGERY, BUT THE MEDIEVAL WAY!

Sure, being a doctor is hard and all. But it's the medieval times! We can just try bullshit!

Face the Doctor in his game of Organ Failure, and show him and the rest of the Murder why you deserve to have and manage your own hospital!

GAMBLE WITH SOMEONE ELSE'S LIFE

A ton of patients. Vital and Non-Vital Organs. One of them, the Sick Organ.

Extract one organ per turn, and follow the clues to the Sickness.

Don't kill the patients!... Alright, you can kill some of the patients.

Find 3 Sick Organs before your opponent to win, and crown yourself the best doctor in the Murder!

IT'S THE MEDIEVAL TIMES! MAGIC IS REAL!

Yes, extracting the heart will kill your patient, but that's where the items are!

There's a LOT of items with unique effects, inspired by both medieval fantasy, and actual medicine from the middle ages (those guys did really weird stuff!).

Find the Sick Organ, Sabotage your opponent, Steal and Copy items; Replace, Shuffle, Imbue, Rematerialize, Revitalize, Remove, Block and Alter each and every organ in the body, and the body itself! Gamble with your resources, and see how the Doctor does the same! What a rapscallion!

MANAGE YOUR HOSPITAL AND MEET WEIRD PEOPLE

Your town has been getting more popular lately. Was it the Plague? Maybe your hospital? Doubt that.

A Witch, a dungeon Skeleton, a powerful Wizard, and the King himself are just some of the characters you'll meet, and each of them add modifiers and requirements to a game that was already sufficiently hard on its own!

Taxes? Shopping lists? Exploding organs? A crow with a very cute pink bow? Things couldn't possibly get any crazier... right?

store_data.about_the_game:
Civilization is an experiment built atop older experiments.

Every generation inherits a world it does not understand.

The purpose of the rituals has been forgotten.

The gods are conducting tests.

The archives are incomplete.

The dead continue to influence the living.

Every solution leaves a scar for those who follow.

Inspired by forgotten kingdoms, impossible saints, emergent systems, and the things that survive them.

About This Game

Way of the Wind is a terminal-born feudal Japan strategy roguelike about building a clan, raising heirs, surviving ogres, and watching a living world grind forward whether you are ready or not.

You begin small: a wandering household, a fragile camp, a few names worth protecting. From there, the world opens into a strange ASCII Japan of roads, cities, markets, castles, rival factions, family lines, secret systems, and consequences that do not politely wait for the player.

This is not a clean tactics board. It is a living machine.

Cities grow, decay, trade, starve, arm themselves, send caravans, produce heirs, remember harm, and fall under pressure. Roads matter. Buildings matter. People matter. Your family matters. Every year pushes the simulation forward.

Build a Clan

Ogre Shader is the base human unit of action. Heirs are cheat resources.

Your heirs are not disposable menu icons. They are your future.

Raise a bloodline, assign roles, send family members into danger, build up cities, defend what you own, and decide how much of your dynasty you are willing to risk for power. The world can be survived, conquered, inherited, or lost.

Children become successors. Successors become commanders. Commanders become legends, failures, ghosts, or liabilities.

The clan is the save file.

Rule a Living Japan

Move across a stylized terminal map of Japan and interact with cities, roads, markets, castles, shrines, villages, and hostile infrastructure.

Each city has its own pressure state: food, money, morale, defense, labor, attention, corruption, and stability. Buildings are not decoration. A castle, market, shrine, barracks, farm, spy network, or dojo can change what a city produces, how it defends itself, and what kind of future it creates.

The world is readable, inspectable, and mechanical — but never fully safe.

Fight, Fail, Adapt

Combat is fast, strange, and consequential. Units have roles, abilities, momentum, and matchups. Some fights are clean battles. Some are desperate interruptions. Some are bad ideas you walked into because the map looked quiet.

Victory can open routes, protect people, create heirs, or secure territory.

Failure can wound the entire run.

Ogres Are Not Just Enemies

Ogres are a faction, a threat, a ritual system, and a pressure source. They raid, capture, distort, bargain, and change the world around them. Their presence bleeds into the economy, the map, the family system, and the hidden machinery underneath the game.

Sometimes they are a battle.

Sometimes they are a disaster.

Sometimes they are the interface.

Bratbox

Buried inside Way of the Wind is Bratbox: a strange voiced terminal system built from recorded lines, personality fragments, unlocks, and reactive ritual logic.

It is part character system, part performance layer, part secret reward structure, and part haunted machine.

You do not need to understand it immediately.

You will know when you find it.

A Terminal Artifact

Way of the Wind is intentionally built like a cursed strategy artifact: dense, sharp-edged, funny, ugly-beautiful, and alive with systems. It uses text, ASCII art, menus, simulation readouts, voiced fragments, and sudden dramatic overlays to create a game that feels less like a clean modern UI and more like operating a war machine someone should not have left running.

It is a game about Japan.

It is a game about ogres.

It is a game about family.

It is a game about what happens when every system has a memory.

The Gods Are Conducting Tests. The Ogres Adapt.

This is a fast, strange feudal strategy roguelike about turning fragile human actions into a surviving civilization.

Begin with stories, rumors, and small acts of human leverage. Stories become intel. Intel enables sabotage. Sabotage funds repairs, roads, buildings, rescues, and expansion. Every city you take becomes another part of the state machine — another place to defend, exploit, repair, or lose.

As rival city-states weaken and ordinary opportunities dry up, survival pushes you toward darker bargains. Ogre tribes, caravans, barges, raids, roads, heirs, warbands, and ruined buildings all feed into the same living pressure system.

You are not just moving units across Japan.

You are running a cockpit civilization where every year matters, every shortcut has a cost, and every solution creates the next problem.

Features

  • Explore a stylized terminal map of feudal Japan

  • Build and manage cities, roads, markets, shrines, farms, barracks, and castles

  • Raise heirs and continue your dynasty across years of simulation

  • Command units in tactical battles

  • Watch AI cities grow, trade, pressure each other, and produce their own heirs

  • Encounter ogre raids, barges, hostile settlements, and dark consequence systems

  • Manage resources, buildings, people, queues, morale, defenses, and city stability

  • Discover hidden routes, strange overlays, Bratbox systems, and secret debug-like rituals

  • Experience a deliberately weird terminal aesthetic with ASCII art, voice fragments, and simulation-heavy menus

Ogres are a faction, a threat, a ritual system, and a pressure source. They raid, capture, distort, bargain, and change the world around them. Their presence bleeds into the economy, the map, the family system, and the hidden machinery underneath the game.

Sometimes they are a battle.

Sometimes they are a disaster.

Sometimes they are the interface.

Bratbox

Buried inside Way of the Wind is Bratbox: a strange voiced terminal system built from recorded lines, personality fragments, unlocks, and reactive ritual logic.

It is part character system, part performance layer, part secret reward structure, and part haunted machine.

You do not need to understand it immediately.

You will know when you find it.

A Terminal Artifact

Way of the Wind is intentionally built like a cursed strategy artifact: dense, sharp-edged, funny, ugly-beautiful, and alive with systems. It uses text, ASCII art, menus, simulation readouts, voiced fragments, and sudden dramatic overlays to create a game that feels less like a clean modern UI and more like operating a war machine someone should not have left running.

It is a game about Japan.

It is a game about ogres.

It is a game about family.

It is a game about what happens when every system has a memory.

The Gods Are Conducting Tests. The Ogres Adapt.

This is a fast, strange feudal strategy roguelike about turning fragile human actions into a surviving civilization.

Begin with stories, rumors, and small acts of human leverage. Stories become intel. Intel enables sabotage. Sabotage funds repairs, roads, buildings, rescues, and expansion. Every city you take becomes another part of the state machine — another place to defend, exploit, repair, or lose.

As rival city-states weaken and ordinary opportunities dry up, survival pushes you toward darker bargains. Ogre tribes, caravans, barges, raids, roads, heirs, warbands, and ruined buildings all feed into the same living pressure system.

You are not just moving units across Japan.

You are running a cockpit civilization where every year matters, every shortcut has a cost, and every solution creates the next problem.

Features

  • Explore a stylized terminal map of feudal Japan

  • Build and manage cities, roads, markets, shrines, farms, barracks, and castles

  • Raise heirs and continue your dynasty across years of simulation

  • Command units in tactical battles

  • Watch AI cities grow, trade, pressure each other, and produce their own heirs

  • Encounter ogre raids, barges, hostile settlements, and dark consequence systems

  • Manage resources, buildings, people, queues, morale, defenses, and city stability

  • Discover hidden routes, strange overlays, Bratbox systems, and secret debug-like rituals

  • Experience a deliberately weird terminal aesthetic with ASCII art, voice fragments, and simulation-heavy menus
store_data.short_description: Way of the Wind is a grand-strategy monster terrarium: a living feudal map where cities, ogres, heirs, shrines, rot, snow, and rescued characters all visibly grow into long-term consequences — with the immediacy of a toybox instead of the friction of a spreadsheet.

store_data.about_the_game:
Prepare your run before entering the dungeon

Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every attempt begins before the first fight. Choose your hero, set up your preparation, equip artifacts, and enter the run with a clear direction for your build.

Each choice changes how you approach the next battles: which cards to prioritize, which effects to combine, and how to turn rewards into a strategy that can survive until the end of the map.

Build your deck during the run

Your deck does not start finished. Throughout the run, you choose rewards, adapt your strategy, and decide which cards deserve a place in your build.

Different cards open different paths: direct damage, effect buildup, resource control, setup for bigger plays, and combinations that become stronger once your deck starts to click.

Turn small choices into an engine

Items and artifacts are not just loose bonuses. They help define the rhythm of the run, reinforce synergies, and can change how your plays resolve.

Finding the right combination between cards, items, artifacts, and hero is at the heart of Dungebra: a strong run is not about one powerful card, but about several pieces working together.

Choose artifacts that change your strategy

Before and during progression, artifacts help give your build an identity. Some support a more aggressive playstyle, while others favor preparation, survival, or effects that grow over time.

The best choice is not always the obvious one: it depends on your hero, your deck, and the direction you are trying to build in that run.

Play with different heroes

Each hero brings a different way to start and plan a run. Your character choice influences your priorities, your risks, and the type of build that makes sense to pursue.

Try different combinations and discover which heroes best match your playstyle.

Unlock, discover, and try again

Dungebra is built around short runs, constant decisions, and that feeling of wanting one more attempt. Even when a run goes wrong, you learn the cards better, understand new combinations, and come back with another build idea.

Choose your destination, face enemies in sequence, improve your strategy between fights, and carry your engine to the final challenge.

Key features

  • Dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

  • Deck built during the run through rewards and choices.

  • Heroes with different preparation styles.

  • Artifacts, items, and cards creating build synergies.

  • Short runs focused on adaptation, strategy, and replayability.

  • Progression through unlocks and new preparation options.

store_data.about_the_game:
Nanma walks between villages like a gentle shadow. She observes more than she speaks. She carries a crow mask — both a protection and a warning. Her journey is a silent quest for a place where she can exist without hiding.

Nanma: A Tecelã das Sombras (Note: If you want to translate the subtitle, you can use: Nanma: The Shadow Weaver) is a Brazilian dark high-fantasy Visual Novel focused on a dense narrative where player agency is absolute. You assume the role of Nanma, a young weaver whose abilities are considered a curse, on a journey of self-discovery and mystery in a world filled with magic and monsters.

Explore multiple paths, meet captivating characters, and discover: what price will you pay to alter what has already been woven?

Key Features:

  • Choices with Real Consequences: There are no right or wrong paths, only intertwining threads. Your decisions pull at the strings that shape Nanma's character and the fate of those around her.

  • Branching Narrative: Explore multiple endings and hidden paths. Each new playthrough reveals a different perspective on the secrets of Mesacna.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: An experience focused on introspection, featuring an original soundtrack and unique, custom artwork that evokes the mystery of dark fantasy.

store_data.about_the_game:
The old order did not end in fire. It ended in treaties no one honored, debts no one could pay, and borders drawn by whoever still had soldiers at the table.

Concert of Power is a grand strategy game about ruling a nation in the fractured remains of North America. Kingdoms, duchies, confederacies, and ambitious city-states compete across a continent where no power is strong enough to rule alone, and no promise is stable enough to trust forever.

You are not simply trying to conquer.

You are trying to make sure no one else can.

Preserve the Balance, or Break It

Every nation is watching the board. A rising power attracts rivals. A weakened neighbor invites demands. A guarantee can hold the peace, provoke a crisis, or become the excuse for war.

Diplomacy is not separate from strategy. It is how strategy begins.

Shape the balance of power through pressure, promises, threats, markets, and carefully chosen restraint. Keep your enemies divided. Keep your allies dependent. Keep the continent convinced that your ambitions are necessary, reasonable, or at least too costly to oppose.

Build the State Behind the Threat

Power begins at home. Feed your people, keep factories supplied, build ports, forts, offices, and industry, and turn grain, fish, timber, coal, iron, steel, weapons, and civilian goods into leverage.

A rich country can afford patience. A hungry country bargains with its hands tied.

Every building is part of the diplomatic machine. Mines feed factories. Factories arm soldiers. Ports open markets. Chanceries create the diplomatic reach needed to justify claims, court allies, and keep pressure alive.

Every Nation Wants Something

No state exists only to fill space on the map.

Some powers want restoration. Some want security. Some want markets, coal, ports, prestige, revenge, or a quiet border. A peacekeeper may tolerate one concession to prevent a larger war. An opportunist may sell neutrality today and betray it tomorrow. A trader may hate you and still need your grain.

Read the continent carefully. Nations remember who threatened them, who fed them, who abandoned them, and who kept a promise when breaking it would have been profitable.

Make Demands

Claims and ultimatums are tests of the international order.

A demand forces every interested power to choose a position: support, oppose, stay silent, bargain, warn, or seek arbitration. Your target may yield, stall for time, seek backers, buy you off, or dare you to escalate.

The demand itself is only the first move. The real contest is over who can make their side look stronger before the crisis closes.

Isolate Rising Powers

A strong rival is dangerous. A strong rival accepted by the world is worse.

Use diplomacy to turn fear into policy. Paint your enemy as a threat to regional stability. Pull away their friends, weaken their guarantees, court their neighbors, and build a quiet consensus that something must be done.

The best wars begin with your enemy already alone.

Buy Support, Silence, or Betrayal

Not every nation needs to admire you. Some only need a reason to stand aside.

Offer guarantees, concessions, favors, money, trade access, diplomatic cover, or future promises to shape how others respond when the balance begins to shift. A small nation may want protection. A great power may want compensation. A rival's ally may simply want to survive the next crisis.

Everyone has principles. Most also have conditions.

Guarantees and Great-Power Pressure

Guarantees are the scaffolding of the post-collapse order. They protect weak states, restrain ambitious ones, and give powerful nations a reason to interfere.

Use them to secure clients, deter attacks, or trap rivals into defending liabilities. Pressure other nations to abandon guarantees that no longer serve them. Turn a promise of protection into a bargaining chip, a warning, or a liability.

A guarantee is peace written in pencil.

Trade Is Leverage

Once the diplomatic field is set, markets become another way to move it.

Trade with rivals you are not ready to fight. Support friendly states that keep your enemies occupied. Build economic relationships that create influence, dependency, and quiet obligations.

A trade partner is not always a friend. Sometimes they are a future hostage.

Embargo and Strangle

When pressure is not enough, deny your enemies room to breathe.

Embargo hostile powers, cut off key resources, and force other nations to choose between profit and alignment. An isolated rival may still have armies, but armies need food, money, weapons, trade routes, and political patience.

A nation does not need to be invaded to start weakening.

Crisis and Escalation

A border dispute can become a diplomatic crisis. A crisis can become a continental test of prestige.

Escalate carefully to force concessions, or hold back while your rivals overcommit. Back down when the price is wrong. Push forward when the room is divided. In a balance-of-power system, restraint can be as ruthless as aggression.

Every crisis asks the same question: who is willing to risk the order, and who is only pretending?

False Flags and Manufactured Causes

Sometimes the balance needs a shove.

Stage provocations, shape blame, manufacture evidence, and create the justification your nation needs to act. A war with the right story is easier to sell at home, harder to oppose abroad, and more dangerous for rivals to ignore.

But lies are instruments, not miracles. A weak story needs preparation. A careless operation can damage stability, expose your methods, stain your reliability, and turn cautious powers into enemies.

Power is strongest when it looks like necessity.

Fight Limited Wars

Not every war must become total war. Limited wars let nations punish rivals, enforce demands, seize disputed territory, break guarantees, or rebalance a region without openly seeking destruction.

But limited wars remain limited only while everyone believes the balance can still be restored.

Win quickly and the continent may tolerate the outcome. Drag the war out and even friendly states begin to wonder what you are becoming.

A Continent of Uneasy Powers

The map is familiar, but the world is not. North America has fractured into successor states with old claims, new titles, unstable borders, and dangerous ambitions.

Some powers want restoration.

Some want security.

Some want revenge.

Some simply want more.

The road to power is still open.

So is the road against you.

store_data.about_the_game:
LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation about the life you build, the pressure you carry, and the consequences you live with.

Start a new life and make the decisions that shape who you become. Manage money, debt, energy, mental load, relationships, health, family, career, stability, self-respect, job security and your future while everyday choices slowly turn into a life story.

This is not about finding the perfect path. It is about discovering what kind of person you become when every decision pushes your life in a different direction.

Live Through Everyday Decisions That Add Up

Answer messages, handle bills, request annual leave, book holidays, build relationships, start a family, protect your health, manage illness, chase promotions, deal with tax, follow World News, react to changing weather, and make choices that can come back days, months or years later.

• Some choices help you today and cost you later
• Some choices feel small until they start changing everything
• Some choices are hard now, but protect the life you are trying to build

Build The Life You Want — Or The Life You End Up With

Focus on success, money, love, comfort, ambition, friendship, stability, family, recovery, or risk. Chase a better future. Keep life small. Put others first. Start again after things go wrong.

LIVORA is built around the tension between who you wanted to be and what your choices actually created.

Your Life Remembers

Ignored messages, delayed decisions, missed chances, financial pressure, health strain, relationship tension, unfinished business, career choices and family responsibilities can follow you.

Your choices shape not just your stats, but the pattern of the life you are living.

A World That Keeps Moving

Life in LIVORA does not pause around you. Seasons change, weather affects daily life, fictional sports results appear in World News, future technology can reshape society, and major events can create pressure, opportunity or disruption.

The world moves forward — and your life has to move with it.

Start another life with a different mindset. Take a different job route, handle money differently, prioritise relationships, protect your wellbeing, chase ambition, start a business, build a family, or make choices you avoided before.

store_data.detailed_description:
LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation about the life you build, the pressure you carry, and the consequences you live with.

Start a new life and make the decisions that shape who you become. Manage money, debt, energy, mental load, relationships, health, family, career, stability, self-respect, job security and your future while everyday choices slowly turn into a life story.

This is not about finding the perfect path. It is about discovering what kind of person you become when every decision pushes your life in a different direction.

Live Through Everyday Decisions That Add Up

Answer messages, handle bills, request annual leave, book holidays, build relationships, start a family, protect your health, manage illness, chase promotions, deal with tax, follow World News, react to changing weather, and make choices that can come back days, months or years later.

• Some choices help you today and cost you later
• Some choices feel small until they start changing everything
• Some choices are hard now, but protect the life you are trying to build

Build The Life You Want — Or The Life You End Up With

Focus on success, money, love, comfort, ambition, friendship, stability, family, recovery, or risk. Chase a better future. Keep life small. Put others first. Start again after things go wrong.

LIVORA is built around the tension between who you wanted to be and what your choices actually created.

Your Life Remembers

Ignored messages, delayed decisions, missed chances, financial pressure, health strain, relationship tension, unfinished business, career choices and family responsibilities can follow you.

Your choices shape not just your stats, but the pattern of the life you are living.

A World That Keeps Moving

Life in LIVORA does not pause around you. Seasons change, weather affects daily life, fictional sports results appear in World News, future technology can reshape society, and major events can create pressure, opportunity or disruption.

The world moves forward — and your life has to move with it.

store_data.about_the_game: In Hephaestus Protocol, players pick one of over 50 playable heroes, and try to survive escalating waves of enemies while traversing an infinite, procedurally generated, map. The world draws on mythological pantheons, traditional fantasy, and historical elements. The core loop is pure Bullet Heaven adrenaline: move, dodge, and let players auto-firing arsenal do the work while they level up, accumulate catalysts, and decide which weapons to evolve. The primary innovation is the weapon combo system; items can be combined together into hybrid armaments that merge their stats, elemental affinities, attack patterns, and sprites, giving each run a distinct, build-defining identity.

store_data.about_the_game:
CLAIM WHAT'S LEFT.

The Frontier doesn't reset, and it doesn't care if you make it home. Drop into a persistent, post-collapse wasteland with whatever you can carry. Scavenge it for everything it's worth, fight the raiders and AI who want it more than you do, and reach extraction before the storm — or a stranger's rifle — ends your run. Get out and the haul is yours for good. Go down and your kit stays on your corpse for the next raider to strip.

DEADCLAIM is a hardcore, third-person (FPS-toggle) extraction survival shooter. One life per raid. Everything you carry is on the line.

ONE LIFE, EVERYTHING ON THE LINE

You get a single life per raid — no respawns. Every weapon on your back and every scrap you claw out of the dirt rides on reaching the extract. Bank it and it's locked in. Bleed out and it drops where you fell, free for the taking. Push for one more crate, or break for the exit while you still can? That decision is the whole game, and it's never free.

YOUR PROGRESSION IS SAFE — YOUR LOADOUT IS THE WAGER

This isn't about losing everything. Your rank, your skills, your banked credits, your stash and your outpost are always yours — they only grow. What you risk is the kit you bring and the loot you find. Insure your gear to get it back, fall back on a respawn kit when a run goes bad, and decide for yourself how much to gamble on the next drop.

A PERSISTENT, LIVING FRONTIER

There's no lobby and no menu raid. Servers ARE the wasteland — a continuous, populated Frontier you drop straight into. Discover walk-in outpost camps, field hospitals, supply depots and convoy wrecks scattered across an island-wide map, each one defended and worth dying over. Day bleeds to dusk, weather rolls in, and the high ground changes hands.

BUILD YOUR OUTPOST

Bank your hauls between raids and turn scavenged scrap into a war machine. Craft gear, stock your stash, and fortify a home base that compounds with every successful extraction. Progress you fought for, kept safe behind the lines.

A LIVING WAR ECONOMY

Outfit your next run from four specialist vendors — the Gunsmith, Medic, Chef, and Quartermaster — each a one-stop shop for its trade, with loyalty discounts and a gear-tier climb that rewards the bold. Build a weapon from parts at the Gunsmith's bench, then take it back into the fight. Zero pay-to-win — everything is earned.

HOST YOUR OWN WASTELAND

Download the dedicated server for free and run the Frontier your way — private squads, custom rules, total control. No middleman, no subscription, no one renting you your own game.

KEY FEATURES

  • High-stakes extraction: Loot, survive, and get out — or it drops on your body for someone else.

  • Gear-on-death stakes: Weighty gunplay with real consequences — risk the loadout, keep the progression. Insurance and respawn kits soften the fall.

  • Persistent open Frontier: A hand-built, atmospheric island of ruined towns and apocalyptic outposts to master.

  • Third-person with an FPS toggle: Read the world over your shoulder, or drop into the sights.

  • Drive the wasteland: Commandeer vehicles to haul loot, run extracts, and cover ground fast.

  • Four specialist vendors + crafting: Build guns, brew meds, cook supplies, fabricate gear.

  • Run your own server: Free dedicated server.exe — your rules, your wasteland.

  • No pay-to-win, ever: Every advantage is scavenged, crafted, or earned.

THE FRONTIER IS OPEN

Claim the wasteland. Hold what's yours. The rest is up for grabs.

Wishlist DEADCLAIM now, and join the operators on Discord.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to The Art Keeper, a cozy life simulation and home-building experience where creativity is your greatest tool.

Start with a simple house and transform it into a unique living space filled with furniture, decorations, collectibles, music, artwork, and interactive objects. Every choice shapes the atmosphere of your home.

But decorating is only the beginning.

Take on the role of an art gallery curator and complete painting placement contracts to earn money, unlock new items, and expand your collection.

Create Your Perfect Home

Turn an empty house into a place that truly feels yours.

  • Purchase and place over 100 unique items

  • Decorate every room however you like

  • Move, rotate, and arrange furniture freely

  • Create cozy corners, artistic displays, or organized living spaces

  • Design without restrictions and express your personal style

A World Full of Interactive Objects

Your home is more than decoration.

Many objects can be interacted with in meaningful ways:

  • Turn lamps and lights on or off

  • Play board games and tabletop activities

  • Listen to music through purchased audio items

  • Discover unique interactions throughout the house

  • Experience personality and charm in every object

Every Item Has a Story

Items are not just decorations.

Each object contains its own unique dialogue, flavor text, or observations, encouraging players to explore and learn more about the world around them.

Gallery Curation Jobs

Become a professional art keeper.

Accept gallery contracts and carefully place paintings in their correct locations.

  • Complete 15 unique gallery rounds

  • Organize and display up to 29 paintings per round

  • Match artworks with their designated exhibition spaces

  • Test your memory, observation, and efficiency

Beat the Clock

Some gallery exhibitions are timed challenges.

  • Finish exhibitions before time runs out

  • Earn larger rewards for faster completion

  • Improve your performance and efficiency

  • Use your earnings to purchase new decorations and collectibles

Inspiration System

Creativity leads to progress.

Gain inspiration as you interact with your home, discover objects, and complete tasks. Use your growing collection and imagination to create spaces that reflect your artistic vision.

Relax, Decorate, and Explore

Whether you're carefully organizing an art exhibition, collecting new furniture, discovering item interactions, or simply enjoying the atmosphere of your home, The Art Keeper offers a relaxing and rewarding creative experience.

Build your dream home.
Curate beautiful galleries.
Become the keeper of art.

Can a drop of mortality poison an ocean of godhood?

The machine planets once filled the heavens, raising up life in peace and prosperity. Now this one is among the very last of their kind. Child of the first students, defend this planet and learn its lessons. Learn also its secrets, the fates of the rest of its kind, and the fate of the colder universe to come.

Gameplay

Malevolent Star is a retro-style FPS game with gameplay heavily inspired by classic Halo. Face a wide roster of enemies and unique encounters with simple, satisfying gameplay mechanics and a tight sandbox of weapons with complementary strengths.

Features

  • Linear campaign progressing through four unique environments and increasingly chaotic encounters

  • A variety of enemies among multiple factions

  • A diverse sandbox of weapons

  • Simple, engaging combat

store_data.about_the_game:
The Isometric Farm is a cozy, hand-crafted farming simulator where you turn a small patch of grass into a thriving, beautiful farm. Till the soil, plant your seeds, water your crops, and harvest them for profit — then reinvest everything to grow bigger, unlock rare plants, and meet a colorful cast of vendors.

Plant, Grow & Harvest

Work your land tile by tile with a simple, satisfying toolset — **Hoe, Plant, Water, and Harvest**. Watch every crop grow through multiple stages, and keep them watered to speed up their growth. From humble violet flowers to exotic blooms, every harvest brings you closer to your dream farm.

Expand Your Farm

Start small and grow big. Spend your hard-earned coins to **expand your land across multiple levels** — each expansion opens up more space to cultivate and unlocks brand-new vendors to trade with.

Meet the Vendors

A cast of characters lives on your farm, each with something to offer:

- The Seed Seller — your go-to for everyday seeds.

- The Farmer — helps you expand your land.

- The Herbalist — sells powerful tools like the Harvesting Pliers and the Auto-Waterer.

- The Nursery — unlocks rare plants: Red Valerian, Blue Agapanthus, Lavender, and Flowering Cactus.

- The Botanist — offers truly special species, including the Venus Flytrap and the Magic Mushroom.

Hidden Riches

Your land hides more than dirt. Clear rocks and dig up rare diamonds scattered across the ground — a lucky find that can pay off big.

Tools & Upgrades

Make farming faster and easier with smart upgrades. Level up your Harvesting Pliers for more efficient harvests, and let the Auto-Waterer keep your crops hydrated while you focus on growing your empire.

Play Your Way

- Multiple save slots so you can manage several farms.

- Full settings menu — audio, controls, gameplay, and accessibility options.

- A relaxing pace with no pressure — just you, your land, and time to grow.

Grab your hoe. Your farm is waiting. A game by Fanteh Studios.

store_data.about_the_game:
7743 is a puzzle heavy psychological horror game where you play as Simon Kimana who has grown up in a well known family who have built their wealth from selling kimonos. Situated in 1980s Japan, Simon's family is brutally murdered in front of his own eyes, as he watches in horror, hidden away in his parent's closet.

From there on out, Simon's mind has snapped to the point where he places blame upon himself for only watching and not acting and is unable to break from the event of that day, as he relives it, piece by piece.

Throughout Simon's mental state, he must unlock his mind and look beyond what he has set out to believe and accept the truth of what has happened on that horrible day. 

The focus on 7743 is to provide the player with many options and avenue's of replayability, as such 7743 offers:

  • Difficulty selections, allowing the player to select Normal Puzzles or Hard Puzzles mode, each offering unique puzzle experiences and additional experiences.

  • 3 endings, each of which offers a different angle of the story.

  • Many achievements to challenge the player to explore every avenue of the game.

  • Checkpoint functionality to allow the player to explore multiple endings without having to complete the game from the start.

Additional Disclosures:

  • 7743 is puzzle heavy, offering the player problem solving opportunities ranging from simple to very difficult.

  • 7743 is estimated to be completed within approximately 45 minutes for one ending.

After nearly 2 years since my last release (Night at the Office), here we are with 7743! With school and work taking up a huge piece of my time these last couple of years, I am super happy to have the ability to jump back into game dev and pump out this new terror.

Over the years, I've spent a great deal looking into new horror releases and trying to expand further beyond my typical release (Even visited Japan for inspiration :D ). Now, the focus is to provide players with not only a terrifying experience, but also a difficult one, whereby you must focus on the story and your surroundings in order to solve puzzles and experience all the game has to offer.

One thing you will notice with this game is a large increase in puzzles and interactions, alongside an option to choose between Normal or Hard puzzles, each of which offering different experiences and interactions. Increasing the degree of variability has definitely increased the complications of this game and has made it take a bit longer to build than expected, but nonetheless, I believe the game turned out well, and will provide you with an experience far different than what you have seen when compared to my previous releases.

I truly hope that you enjoy what the game has to offer, and I would love to hear your feedback to help progress future games! :) 

cheers and happy gaming!

Stan. T

store_data.about_the_game:
Limited health and resources, a journal to document what you find and see, an unknown monstrosity hunting you around every corner, in a seemingly endless labyrinth. How long will you survive for? And if you do, can you find the exit?

  • Procedurally generated areas

  • Collectables for health, hunger, and thirst

  • Co-op so you can have your friends get devoured while you run

  • Completely different layout on every playthrough

  • Chance to find inscriptions on the walls that clue you into them

  • A zoom feature to see things in better detail

  • A flashlight, necessary for some areas

  • Each death slowly corrupts you until you become one of them

  • Late 90's style camera as your eyes

  • The floors and walls are not always as they seem. It can be to your own detriment or benefit

  • There is a chance you can fall into a less than desired area

This is the first game we have made and we would like for it to not be our last. That being said, we are still honing our skills so please let us know if there is any pointers you have that would benefit the game! We will be releasing more levels as time goes on so look forward to more refined levels as they are developed. Your input will help them!

P.S. please buy our friendslop so we can continue to afford our hard liquor addiction - T4NK, Market Director

store_data.about_the_game:
The library closes at nine. A librarian always stays behind.

Ashwood Library has stood since 1889. Its night librarians rarely last a week. You are the new one.

For five nights you keep the desk alone. Books arrive that were never catalogued. Notes appear in the request tray, left by a patron whose name is in no register. The reading room at the end of the east corridor stays locked after nine, and you have been told not to ask why. Do the work. Shelve the returns. Answer the requests. And, night by night, learn what the library is really asking of you.

What you'll do:

Shelve and sort returns by genre, author, date, and call number, reading each book carefully before you decide.

Answer patron requests by finding the one book that matches every clue in a handwritten note.

Reassemble torn letters and hidden documents, piece by piece.

Deduce the truth from redacted records and the case files that fill the gaps.

A quiet, bookish mystery

Five chapters, twenty-two handcrafted puzzles, one very old secret.

A written, atmospheric story you uncover at your own pace, by candlelight and rain.

Gentle on-ramp and optional hints, so you are never truly stuck.

Chapter select and a keeper's record to revisit the nights you've kept.

Honest about what it is

The Night Librarian is a short, complete experience, roughly one to two hours for a first playthrough. It is meant to be read and savored in an evening or two, not stretched out. If you like cozy puzzles, dark academia, and a mystery that trusts you to pay attention, this was made for you.

Ashwood Library has stood since 1889. Thank you for continuing the legacy.

store_data.about_the_game:
CROPS HORDES & BOSSES

Original plant-based enemies attack in waves, featuring unique movement and behavior patterns. Each map offers a tiered challenge, featuring Mini-Boss Commanders, standard Bosses, and brutal Hard-Bosses to test your build.

GAMBLE UPGRADES: SLOTMACHINE LEVELING UP

Discard the genre’s tired "pick one of three" upgrade system for a high-stakes, gambling-driven progression loop. Instead of static choices, players earn roll points to spin a slot machine where every outcome matters—featuring a volatile mix of powerful upgrades, risky downgrades, and over 80 unique Joker cards that trigger game-altering special effects.

ELEMENTAL SURFACES & STATUS EFFECTS

7 status effects (burn, freeze, poison, etc.) affect both heroes and mobs. Surfaces react dynamically with elemental attacks (e.g. electricity + toxic puddle = explosion; electricity + iced puddle = electric iced puddle).

SKILLS, COMBOS & ULTIMATES

Each hero features a signature skill that can be evolved into a devastating combo attack. Beyond standard progression, players can unleash powerful Ultimates to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of combat.

FREE KICK MINI-GAME

We have integrated a unique "Free Kick Shot" meta-game that doubles as a skill-shot mechanic for evolving standard attacks into Combos. This mini-game features its own dedicated progression system – complete specific challenges to unlock a roster of new specialist kickers with signature types of kicks.

HIDDEN SECRETS

Scour expansive maps to reveal hidden pathways, challenge secret Commanders, and unlock the game’s most powerful hidden heroes.

MASSIVE ENTITY VARIETY

A deep pool of content including base attacks, combos, Ultimates, standard items, boosts, merchant-exclusive gear, and strategic drops.

QUEST COMPLETION

Complete a vast array of quests to unlock new entities and earn currency for permanent growth. Invest in persistent stat boosts to ensure you return stronger and more resilient for every new run.

DYNAMIC DIFFICULTY SCALING

Take control of your challenge in real-time. Activate specific in-game objects to buff enemies and increase the stakes—the only way to draw out and defeat each map’s brutal Hard-Bosses.
