7 status effects (burn, freeze, poison, etc.) affect both heroes and mobs. Surfaces react dynamically with elemental attacks (e.g. electricity + toxic puddle = explosion; electricity + iced puddle = electric iced puddle).

SKILLS, COMBOS & ULTIMATES

Each hero features a signature skill that can be evolved into a devastating combo attack. Beyond standard progression, players can unleash powerful Ultimates to dominate the battlefield and turn the tide of combat.

FREE KICK MINI-GAME

We have integrated a unique "Free Kick Shot" meta-game that doubles as a skill-shot mechanic for evolving standard attacks into Combos. This mini-game features its own dedicated progression system – complete specific challenges to unlock a roster of new specialist kickers with signature types of kicks.

HIDDEN SECRETS

Scour expansive maps to reveal hidden pathways, challenge secret Commanders, and unlock the game’s most powerful hidden heroes.

MASSIVE ENTITY VARIETY

A deep pool of content including base attacks, combos, Ultimates, standard items, boosts, merchant-exclusive gear, and strategic drops.

QUEST COMPLETION

Complete a vast array of quests to unlock new entities and earn currency for permanent growth. Invest in persistent stat boosts to ensure you return stronger and more resilient for every new run.

DYNAMIC DIFFICULTY SCALING

Take control of your challenge in real-time. Activate specific in-game objects to buff enemies and increase the stakes—the only way to draw out and defeat each map’s brutal Hard-Bosses.
store_data.short_description: Vampire Survivors meets Clover Pit. Spin the slot machine to level up your abilities, unlock new heroes, and unleash crazy combo/ultimate attacks. A chaotic action-roguelite bullet heaven built for genre fans, by genre fans.

store_data.about_the_game:
A 3D voxel virtual tabletop.

Building is fast. Left-click to paint, drag to fill a wall or a variety of shapes like ramps, pyramids, hills and more. Copy any chunk of  your scene and paste it elsewhere or share it as a text string in your notes (inspired by Talespire "slabs").

Fog of war is fully 3D. Areas your party has visited can stay visible behind partial fog. Visibility is team based, so your players can share vision, have individual vision, or you could run PvP wargames with fog of war tracking multiple teams.

Lighting is raytraced through the voxel grid: sunlight, ambient occlusion, colored lighting, emissive blocks, and more.

Tokens are built as "standees" from any imported image, and can be scaled to any size. You can convert sections of the level into "props" that can be moved and rotated like tokens.

Current features:

  • Build voxels with a variety of 3D shape tools like rectangles, cylinders, ramps, pyramids, etc.

  • Fog of war / line of sight

  • Shared or private vision - each team has its own vision and exploration

  • Players can be granted permission to get vision from and/or move tokens

  • Players can be assigned to any combination of teams

  • Build voxels in any color, make them transparent, emit light, and/or non-solid

  • Copy & paste sections of blocks and save them to a prefab library - pastes can be rotated, flipped, and scaled

  • Import Magicavoxel files

  • Import images with optional heightmaps and place them into scenes for reference, or convert them directly into voxels

  • Import any image as a custom standee tokens. Standees can be any size, can emit light, and be toggled as flying

  • Alternate camera modes like isometric and top-down

  • Custom units for rulers

  • Voxel-based lighting from a directional sun, ambient sky, basic ambient light, and light-emitting blocks

  • Convert selections of blocks into "props" that can be moved around and rotated like tokens - use for doors, furniture, vehicles, etc.

store_data.about_the_game:
Old Time Hockey is an arcade hockey game that crosses the simplicity of the 16-bit classics with the over-the-top speed and bone-crunching hits of late-'90s arcade rinks. It's built to be understood in seconds and hard to put down: a new player can score inside a minute, but mastering the one-timer takes a lot longer.

You watch the whole rink from a clean, broadcast-style 2.5D camera while real 3D players battle below.
Tap to snap a wrist shot or hold to wind up a slapper. Thread a one-timer off a tape-to-tape pass. Dangle past a defender with a toe drag or a spin-o-rama, then turn around and flatten the puck carrier to spring a breakaway. String together goals and hits to catch fore, and when tempers boil over, drop the gloves in a quick arcade fight with a winner and a loser.

Pick from six not-so-original teams each with its own city, colors, sweaters, and named barn — and play a full game with three periods, a game clock, faceoffs, penalties and power plays, goalies, overtime, and a shootout to settle ties. Play a quick Exhibition, grind a Season, sharpen up in Training Camp drills, or take it head-to-head in local and online two-player matches. Every goal lights the lamp and blasts the horn, the jumbotron erupts, and the booth cuts to an instant replay.

Fictional teams, players, and leagues only. No real names or logos, just old time hockey the way it's supposed to feel.

store_data.about_the_game:
✏️ Draw your strategy in a single continuous stroke.

One-Stroke Hunter is a strategy puzzle roguelite where you defeat monsters by drawing a single continuous line. In battle, you connect squares on the board with a single line, and the path you take triggers a chain reaction of effects such as attack, defense, magic, poison, and barriers. Which squares to connect, in what order, and how to connect them—all of this determines victory or defeat.

🗺️ An adventure to reach the depths of the field.

Starting from the left edge of the map, you'll make your way to the back of the field. Along the way, you'll encounter monsters and enter into battles. You'll be faced with choices as you progress, such as shopping at item shops, searching for treasure chests, and healing at inns. The further you go, the stronger the enemies become. How far can you go?

🧙️Unique characters

Four unique characters: Warrior, Mage, Thief, and Berserker.

Each character has a different type of square that appears, requiring completely different strategies.

🧩️"Puzzle Mode" to solve in one turn

Can you decipher the layout of the squares and defeat the enemy in just one turn?

Clear 50+ stages.

🏅️Growth and dedication

- Rewards earned through "Fame" gained by defeating enemies

- Character unlocks

- High-difficulty field unlocks

- Enemy character encyclopedia

store_data.about_the_game:
True Happiness is out there somewhere…

… And we lost it.

… But then we found it again!

And one needn’t worry about why it was lost to begin with.

…Unless one is a disquisitive urchin who can’t leave well enough alone.

 

…Like you!

Legumi Lagoon is a time and resource management survival game like none other. 

  • Harvest beans to stay alive.

  • Gamble with explosives to scare monsters away.

  • Explore a mysterious lagoon made up of hand-crafted areas arranged in randomized mazes.

  • Uncover Echo Vessels, seashell-like objects which contain voices of the past reading ancient legends and histories. You can listen to them while you play!

STORY

Legumi are unusual little bean-eating creatures. They live in small, insular colonies found around the world, and since time immemorial have endeavoured on individual Quests for True Happiness. 

But one day long ago, for one reason or another, they simply stopped. Now, the tradition has been recovered, and all is well. 

You play as Delve, an investigative historian who is haunted by the question of why these quests ever stopped, and what’s preventing them from stopping again. You’ve made the journey to the Great Galoona Archive, which once housed the greatest collection of works of all Legumi-kind. Generations ago, the proprietor dumped the entire collection into the nearby Galoona Lagoon. Your hope is that, summoning your courage and wits, you’re able to recover enough of the collection to answer your questions. 

It won’t be easy; the lagoon is cursed. Paths tangle and shuffle and lead to different places day to day. It’s also full of monsters, ruins, caves, traps, and all manner of other horrific things. 

GAMEPLAY

You have sixty seconds to live, but it’s not as scary as it sounds. Eat a bean, get ten more seconds back. There are beans to harvest everywhere, and sixty seconds after they harvest, they grow back. As long as you know where two vines are, you’ll never starve.

Sometimes, you’ll encounter monsters. They’re after your beans. You can give them to them, or you can use pips to frighten them away.

Pips are harmless little explosives. You get two whenever you eat a bean. They pop at a random value between 0 and 3, and each monster has a bravery number you have to hit by throwing as many pips as you think you need to. Simple! You can also offer monsters certain items which will make them your companions for a time. 

Each level of the lagoon is a randomly laid-out patchwork maze of hand-crafted worlds. Within each world, a series of exits, some randomly distributed bean vines and monsters, and with any luck, an Echo Vessel.

Sometimes, you’ll encounter monsters. They’re after your beans. You can give them to them, or you can use pips to frighten them away.

Pips are harmless little explosives. You get two whenever you eat a bean. They pop at a random value between 0 and 3, and each monster has a bravery number you have to hit by throwing as many pips as you think you need to. Simple! You can also offer monsters certain items which will make them your companions for a time. 

Each level of the lagoon is a randomly laid-out patchwork maze of hand-crafted worlds. Within each world, a series of exits, some randomly distributed bean vines and monsters, and with any luck, an Echo Vessel.

store_data.about_the_game:
The year is 929. More than two decades have passed since the fall of Nanzhao;
power has changed hands again and again, and no new dynasty yet holds.

Below Jizu Mountain, the road splits three ways. Whether they travel for trade or flee for their lives,
those crossing the mountains stop here for the night.

At the fork stands a nameless inn. You are its keeper.

You boil the water, lay out the food, light the lamps, and receive your guests. You do not question them—
there is no need, and no place for it.

You only watch, and listen, in the spaces between pouring tea and
banking the fire.
Everyone who steps through the door carries a past. Some will tell it; most will not.

And yet, on one night or another, you come to see who they truly are.

store_data.about_the_game:
The call awaits. The adventure is crafted. Luman is ready. Are you?

Luman Lars: Dichotomy is a 2D pixel-art open-world narrative action-adventure built around a single idea: two worlds, and one blade between them. Step into The Realm as Luman Lars — a lone figure cutting his way toward the truth — and into the World as The Kid, where the ordinary hides something extraordinary. Imagination is the frontier between them, and the destiny that looks forged is yours to question. Every pixel, every line of dialogue, every sound was made by hand to be worth your time.

Combat that learns how you play

Forget grinding for levels. Dichotomy runs on the Playstyle Tree — a hybrid combat system that buffs and nerfs your abilities based entirely on how you fight. Lean into chaos with Berserker and your speed and melee power climb to tear through crowds. Slip into the shadows with Hunter and your noise drops, your weapon range stretches, and your aim sharpens. No menus, no manual leveling — just a build that grows out of your instincts.

Wield the DG-22, a gun powered by the oxygen pressure of Luman's suit — a resource tied directly to your playstyle.

Close the distance for brutal stealth take-downs and DG-22 melee finishers.

Frame-perfect, brutal, readable.

Two truths, one ending you choose

Follow Luman on a mysterious quest through The Realm, facing factions with conflicting interests and confronting the moral weight of everyone who walks beside him. The dichotomy between realms lets you move between Luman and The Kid, and your decisions ripple outward — reshaping quests, characters, and the way the story resolves. Every playthrough is its own truth.

A soundtrack that plays back

The original handmade score by VChord was written through a "dual inspiration" technique: the composer plays the game and answers it with music, while the designer listens and reshapes the game around the sound. The result is dynamic, interactive music — the direction you walk, the choices you make, and your combat style all bend the track in real time. Head toward a main quest and the melody lifts; turn toward danger and it sharpens into aggressive synth. Open a door onto treasure and the note rings major; open it onto a trap and it falls minor. The music isn't background — it's part of how you read the world.

A world you can touch

The Realm is always shifting, and almost everything in it responds to you. Buildings are open to explore, and the environment is yours to bend: shoot out a fence to clear a path, vanish into tall grass, or drop a lamp onto an enemy's head. Objects scattered through the world tweak your Playstyle Tree stats and feed your combat. Wrapped around it all is curated pixel art — rain, rust, and neon decay — where every color is chosen to carry the narrative weight of the moment, and every space tells a story.

Brew your edge

And then there's the coffee. The grounds Luman collects can be ground and brewed with different methods, and every recipe pours a different stat modifier into the cup. Your perfect build might just come down to how you take it.

Choose your side when the rain comes

Wishlist Luman Lars: Dichotomy now and be there when two worlds collide.

A game by Zelfac Studios · Coming 2026

■物语概要

为了筹集妹妹高昂的生活费，

守财奴男主新海幸意外踏入了名为「人才租赁」的奇妙行当。

在扮演代理熟人、倾听者乃至专属搭档的虚假契约掩护下，

女性们不为人知的内心秘密与真实心声悄然绽放。

以金钱维系的脆弱羁绊终将遭遇现实的考验，

当层层伪装剥落时，究竟会是财尽缘散，还是假戏真做？

一场充满谎言与心跳的喜剧就此上演。

■故事简介

「请和我合作吧！」

「别，别随随便便碰我啊！会晕过去的好吧！？」

「因为我的喜好和姐姐不一样」

「希望你成为我的“专属搭档”」

「给，这是朋友费」

「为什么会变成这样……」

主人公新海幸非常疼爱自己的妹妹。

他因为家庭情况特殊，只相信“钱可以让妹妹幸福”，

每天拼命打工到深夜。

他本想尽快步入社会找一份稳定的全职工作，

但某天妹妹却告知，如果他不好好为自己的未来做长远规划，她也要放弃梦想去打工。

幸绝不能让妹妹吃那样的苦。

为了紧急筹措生活与事业起步所需的一大笔钱，

幸在“人才租赁派遣”平台上进行了注册。

虽然这份工作极其可疑，

但迫于生计，他还是干了起来。

从收下钱的那一刻开始，

与她们之间这段虚假关系的结局，究竟会如何！

■核心玩法

打工赚薪酬 青梅竹马掩心扉 拌嘴见情真

结伴游街巷 奇思妙想探未知 笑语满晴空

双姝常相随 前辈指引解忧愁 携手渡难关

派遣为生计 谁知相处遇知音 契约化情深

类型：ADV・视觉小说・美少女游戏

store_data.about_the_game:
FruitSnoot is the snake roguelike where every run is a frantic hunt for fruit, upgrades, and one more chance to grow your ridiculous little tail. Slither across bright ocean islands, gobble up fruit, dodge danger, and build a growing chain of captured fruit behind you. The longer you last, the more chaotic things get: enemies crowd the island, rare finds appear, and your once-tidy little fruit trail becomes a beautiful disaster waiting to happen.

Capture, Grow, Survive

Collect fruit to grow your tail and rack up points, but watch your movement carefully. A good run can turn messy fast when the island fills with enemies, hazards, and your own winding body.

Choose Your Upgrades

Between the chaos, pick from upgrades that change how each run plays. Improve your chances, chase rare power-ups, and build toward a stronger, stranger run.

Unlock Weird Little Friends

Play as a growing cast of quirky characters, from cute critters to stranger visitors from beyond the stars. Each character brings their own personality to the fruit-chasing chaos.

Features

  • Fast, colorful action roguelike gameplay inspired by classic snake-style movement

  • Gobble fruit, grow your tail, and chase high scores across floating ocean islands

  • Pick upgrades and power-ups that shape each run

  • Unlock quirky characters and equipment

  • Cute, chaotic top-down action with cartoony 3D visuals

  • Single-player arcade runs built for quick retries and “one more run” energy

store_data.about_the_game:
Become the Samurai Space Cowboy — a ronin gunslinger cutting through a dying galaxy with an energy katana in one hand and a six-shooter in the other.

Every system is collapsing into supernova. You deploy from your ship to a doomed planet, fight across it as the blast wave closes in, and race for the extraction portal before the star swallows everything. A boss waits at the exit, but it only guards the portal, it doesn't lock it. Staying for the kill is your call. Run for the door or earn the reward.

Three tools, one flow

Energy katana — lightning-fast melee that builds your Power meter. Late-game upgrades can stretch the blade into an absurd long-reach arc.

Six-shooter — tap to fire, hold to charge an explosive area blast that can detonate incoming rockets mid-air. An auto-lock identify system tags threats and weak points, and boss rewards rebuild the gun itself: spread shots, penetration, ricochet, multi-lock.

Cloak — dodge, reposition, and chain jumps and dashes through the air until you're practically flying.

Progression that spirals out of control

A roguelite built to make you feel ridiculous. Stack augment lines and upgrades into combinations that break the game in your favor, freezing, hijacking, and detonating whole swarms while damage numbers climb into the billions. The deeper the skill tree you assemble, the more absurd the synergies get. "I didn't know I could do that" is the entire point.

Every run is a new problem

Enemies are assembled by a generative system: silhouettes, weapons, armor, and behavior modifiers recombine into near-endless threats, so you're always reading something new. Bullet-resistant bruisers force your blade. Kiters force your gun. Telegraphing giants force your timing. Every planet, every swarm, every boss asks a different question.

Built for the long haul

Endless scaling — runs push from thousands of damage into the trillions as you climb deeper.

Optional honor duels against rival gunslingers for players chasing a win streak.

Branching boss rewards and in-run respec stations to rewrite your build on the fly.

Persistent and hardcore paths that change how much you keep and how much you risk.

The vibe

Cyberpunk tech-noir meets the lone-gunslinger western — the neon dread of Ghost in the Shell and Blade Runner crossed with a spaghetti-western showdown. Fast, stylish, and built to feel broken in the best way.
store_data.detailed_description:
Become the Samurai Space Cowboy — a ronin gunslinger cutting through a dying galaxy with an energy katana in one hand and a six-shooter in the other.

Every system is collapsing into supernova. You deploy from your ship to a doomed planet, fight across it as the blast wave closes in, and race for the extraction portal before the star swallows everything. A boss waits at the exit, but it only guards the portal, it doesn't lock it. Staying for the kill is your call. Run for the door or earn the reward.

Three tools, one flow

Energy katana — lightning-fast melee that builds your Power meter. Late-game upgrades can stretch the blade into an absurd long-reach arc.

Six-shooter — tap to fire, hold to charge an explosive area blast that can detonate incoming rockets mid-air. An auto-lock identify system tags threats and weak points, and boss rewards rebuild the gun itself: spread shots, penetration, ricochet, multi-lock.

Cloak — dodge, reposition, and chain jumps and dashes through the air until you're practically flying.

Progression that spirals out of control

A roguelite built to make you feel ridiculous. Stack augment lines and upgrades into combinations that break the game in your favor, freezing, hijacking, and detonating whole swarms while damage numbers climb into the billions. The deeper the skill tree you assemble, the more absurd the synergies get. "I didn't know I could do that" is the entire point.

Every run is a new problem

Enemies are assembled by a generative system: silhouettes, weapons, armor, and behavior modifiers recombine into near-endless threats, so you're always reading something new. Bullet-resistant bruisers force your blade. Kiters force your gun. Telegraphing giants force your timing. Every planet, every swarm, every boss asks a different question.

Built for the long haul

Endless scaling — runs push from thousands of damage into the trillions as you climb deeper.

Optional honor duels against rival gunslingers for players chasing a win streak.

Branching boss rewards and in-run respec stations to rewrite your build on the fly.

Persistent and hardcore paths that change how much you keep and how much you risk.

The vibe

Cyberpunk tech-noir meets the lone-gunslinger western — the neon dread of Ghost in the Shell and Blade Runner crossed with a spaghetti-western showdown. Fast, stylish, and built to feel broken in the best way.
store_data.short_description: A cyberpunk samurai gunslinger action roguelite. Carve through endless robot hordes with an energy katana and a six-shooter, dash through the chaos, chain upgrades into builds that snowball out of control, and see how far one run can take you.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are about to enter Dracoulous' Castle. And for what? A hefty price on his head! Countless minions, bosses and traps stand between you and him.. 

As a Shadow Dancer, you will have to coordinate with your duo, the shade. Use it to your advantage:

### Combine your Dash and your Swip/Swap to overcome Bosses!

Use your Dash to position yourself strategically or escape danger, then activate your Swip/Swap ability to instantly trade places with your shade. Timing these mechanical movements perfectly is key to outsmarting and defeating the castle's powerful bosses.

### Avoid enemies' attacks:

Enemies will strike relentlessly. Watch their animations, learn their attack patterns, and use your mobility to dodge their ground attacks and projectiles before they can overwhelm you.

### Deal Big AoE damage to slay your foes!

When you execute a Swip/Swap, it triggers a powerful area-of-effect blast at your new location. Group your enemies together, swap at the perfect moment, and clear the room with massive damage! (Your Shadow will do the same but for ethereal creatures only)

Will it be enough to claim Dracoulous' reward?

In this linear game, you will explore every room of Dracoulous’ castle, fighting waves of enemies and a unique boss in each room! Dracoulous has also set deadly traps between rooms for you to avoid!

You will be able to choose 3 out of 6 talents and change them at any time (just not in combat—Dracoulous is not that generous), allowing you to create 4 different builds to swap between during your exploration!

Master the art of dancing with your shadow to defeat them all!

store_data.about_the_game:
Hold My Hand (Or Let Go) is a linear Visual Novel about unrequited love, envy, friendship and forgiveness. Experience the story of Charlie, a completely normal Swedish college student that’s graduating next week. But before he does that, he has to say goodbye to all the friends that he made during his three years in town.

That’s easier said than done though, since he’s still unhappily in love with his best friend Elvira. In order to keep their friendship from spiraling into chaos they decided to establish three different ground rules. But will they manage to keep all the rules and keep their feelings under control during the last night together with each other?

Charlie also has a Japanese friend called Toshihiro, who owns a bar in the town. Maybe there’s a chance for Charlie to take Elvira to this bar and introduce her to Toshihiro. But how did Toshihiro end up in Sweden? And why has he been so quiet about his past?

The last friend that Charlie has to say goodbye to is Benjamin, who he’s known all the way back since he moved to the town to study. Will their common interest in movies be enough when their friendship is put at risk? Or do they need something deeper? Find out about this, and much more, in Hold My Hand (Or Let Go).

WARNING
This game contains bright flashes of light and flashing images that may trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy or similar conditions. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
Enter a manor where every portrait hides a secret.

In Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love, you step into a decaying family estate haunted not by monsters, but by silence. The Ashrose family has preserved its legacy in oil, wood, and dust — yet one name has been scratched away, one portrait has vanished, and one forbidden love was never meant to be remembered.

As Evelyn, you arrive at Ashrose Manor and begin piecing together the truth hidden within its halls. Examine portraits, read forgotten journal entries, investigate old guest books, and uncover the story of Julian Vale, a restorer whose presence in the manor was deliberately erased.

Investigate. Collect clues. Rebuild the past.

Explore atmospheric rooms such as the entrance hall and the artist’s studio, where the manor’s most important secret waits to be uncovered. Every object can become a clue: an overpainted nameplate, a missing frame, a guest book entry from 1954, or a torn fragment of a painting.

Your journal acts as both your memory and your investigation board. Important discoveries are automatically recorded, allowing you to connect clues and unlock new conclusions as the story unfolds. This matches the intended journal-based clue system, where evidence such as Julian Vale, the overpainted nameplate, and the missing portrait lead to a larger realization.

Restore the portrait. Reveal the forbidden love.

At the heart of the prototype is a focused mystery loop: explore the manor, find fragments, restore a painting, and uncover what the Ashrose family tried to hide. The planned mini-prototype centers on a main menu, an intro, the entrance hall, the atelier, one central puzzle, a journal, a memory scene, and a final teaser ending.

The deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: Julian Vale was not just a visitor. His connection to the family was dangerous enough to be erased from every wall, every record, and every memory.

Run an American football league from the ground up. As commissioner, every decision is yours: ticket prices, merchandise, sponsorships, broadcasting deals, salaries, and team management all shape whether your league thrives or goes bankrupt.

Build a brand new league with customizable teams, stadiums, and markets, then guide it through season after season of growth (or decline). Simulate weekly matchups, watch attendance and TV ratings respond to your pricing decisions, and react to a constantly evolving league powered by fan enthusiasm and team performance.

KEY FEATURES

  • Full League Management: Set ticket prices, concession costs, merchandise, and player/staff salaries for every team in your league.

  • Dynamic Simulation: Each game is simulated based on player quality, fan enthusiasm, ticket pricing, and stadium atmosphere, with results that ripple into attendance, revenue, and fan growth.

  • Marketing & Sponsorships: Run advertising campaigns, sign league and team sponsors, and negotiate broadcasting deals to grow your fan base and revenue streams.

store_data.about_the_game:
Most wizards die in towers. You get to choose how.

You are an Apprentice Wizard, inexperienced, curious, slightly out of your depth and newly assigned to a Tower full of rooms and secrets. Perhaps you seek arcane mastery and Apotheosis. Perhaps you just want to afford your rent.

Apprentice Ascending is a single-player, real-time card game played on a virtual tabletop. Every part of your life is a card: your health, your mood, your money, your problems. Drag cards to interact, combine them to act, and watch the timers tick down. Outcomes resolve. The table gets slowly, interestingly worse.

Balance ambition with survival

The Chapel pays you to pray for the townsfolk (though sometimes they ask for more than prayer). Meanwhile, the Clocktower ticks in real time, eats your Silver, and changes the weather. It is never on your side. There is no pause between bad decisions; there is only the next card, and the shrinking space on the table.

Unravel arcane mysteries through discovery

Meditate on books and reagents in the Study to learn spells across six schools of magic. Recipes, rituals, and hidden combos are found by experiment, and by the marks they leave behind.

Ascend the Tower

The Stairwell goes up, which is the direction problems come from. Explore floor by floor to uncover loot, traps, escalating encounters, bosses, and things best left undescribed. Perform rituals in the Chamber to craft, transmute, and rank yourself up from Apprentice to something the markets point at.

Outwit the Hunters

Cards age. Hunger grows. And somewhere below, someone has started asking questions about you, specifically. The Gate appears when the Hunters catch your scent. Three clues and they find you. They always find you.

Transcend your inevitable demise

Every ending is earned, and most are regrettable. Your runs will end when you:

  • Be slain

  • Go broke

  • Get hunted

  • Lose your mind

  • Drown in gold

  • Or climb all six floors and earn the Apotheosis your school deserves

But death is not a game-over. Each run records your knowledge in a permanent Journal, unlocking new starting backgrounds, bonuses, and curses for the apprentices to come.

Dare to try?

store_data.about_the_game:
An HD-remaster of a comedy-horror visual novel from 2009, mixing classical Russian literature with the walking dead.

Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead is an enhanced and updated version of a visual novel game that was considered quite controversial upon its release due to an unorthodox approach to the source material. The source material in question is Alexander Pushkin's Eugene Onegin, which is considered one of the defining works of Russian literature.

The game is available in English, Chinese and Japanese for the first time ever. If you're not familiar with 19th century Russian literature, then Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead is a colorful and at times quite bonkers dark comedy set in the early 1800s. If you're familiar with the source material, then it is a bizarre glam rock pandemonium.

The original Eugene Onegin game was one of the milestones for the visual novel genre in Russia. In fact, it was the third game in this genre ever produced in the country. The first two were developed by the same team , which is important because the very first Russian visual novel, a short game called Book of the Dead: The Lost Souls, is unlockable here in Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead, also in the remastered form and, once again, for the first time in a language other than Russian. So you actually get two games instead of one.

Features

  • Visual novel with multiple endings

  • HD 1080p remastered graphics

  • Updated and revised script

  • Bonus game Book of the Dead: The Lost Souls

  • Glam rock soundtrack

store_data.about_the_game:
The city doesn't sleep. It sweats. Rain hammers the docks, smoke curls out of underground clubs, and somewhere beneath a busted streetlight, a deal is being cut that has nothing to do with money. Noir Vice is where the law ends and everything filthy begins — corrupt badges, back-alley arrangements, underground gambling dens packed with bodies and bad intentions. The women here aren't victims. They're the ones running the operation. Detectives who interrogate with their thighs. Crime bosses who seal contracts on their knees. Dock workers, gamblers, informants, and the kind of woman who gets handcuffed not because she lost — but because she asked nicely. The saxophone wails. The rain doesn't stop. Step into the city and find out exactly how dirty it gets. 🎷🖤

🧩 Six Puzzle Modes. One Corrupt City.

Work six distinct puzzle modes — Swapping, Rotating, Swapping & Rotating combo, Sliding, Mirror, and Shifting — each one peeling back another layer of the city's filth. Randomize across all six for unpredictable, relentless challenges that keep the pressure on. Crack the puzzle, collect your evidence: rope marks on wrists, rain-soaked bodies pressed against brick, explicit scenes shot through interrogation room glass and dock warehouse shadows. Every solved case reveals exactly how these women operate after dark. 🔥🎯

📸 Gallery, Favorites System & Character Profiles

Build your personal case file of the city's most explicit criminal encounters. Every puzzle cracked unlocks hardcore scenes straight from the underbelly — bound informants on warehouse floors, soaking wet bodies against alley brick, corrupt officers using their authority in very unofficial ways, and back-room transactions that never make the report. Heart the scenes and women that hit hardest and build a personalized gallery of your most wanted. The profiles go deeper than the scenes: each woman has a full dossier — her angle, her kinks, her skills, and exactly what it takes to make her crack. Browse your collection one-handed, anytime, and review every case at your own pace. 🎥📝🖤

🎷 New-Noir Jazz Soundtrack

The score is as dirty as the city. Saxophones bleed through static, upright bass throbs under dim club lighting, and smoky jazz melodies keep the tension wound tight while you work. The draggable music player gives you full control — skip tracks, loop your favorite cuts, or let the playlist run like a stakeout that never ends. Every note is soaked in rain and bad decisions. 🎧🖤

🕹️ Multiplayer & Co-op

Bring in backup. Supports 4 Player Local and Online Co-op via Steam Remote Play, so you and up to three others can work the case together and unlock the city's most explicit evidence side by side. Gamepads, mouse, or any combination — run your crew however you want. Also fully playable on Phone, Tablet, and TV via Steam Link and Steam Remote Play. 🎮👥
⚠️ Local co-op requires a gamepad per player.⚠️

♿ Accessibility Features

Adjustable background animations, resizable text, and separate color controls for text and titles keep things sharp without distraction. Dyslexia-friendly, ADHD-optimized, and clear readability font options available so nothing pulls your focus from the scene. Full mouse-only controls supported, plus ambidextrous one-handed controls for keyboard, gamepad, and Steam Deck ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) — your other hand has its own investigation to run. Quick Quit/Minimize and customizable window names keep your case files strictly off the record. 🕶️🔐

💻 Technical Features

Every rain-slicked body, every rope mark, every dripping detail rendered clean with full Ultrawide and Super Ultrawide support. Native gamepad support — plug in and start the interrogation immediately. Full Steam Deck support with optional native touchscreen gameplay so the city travels with you. Also supports Steam Input, Steam Cloud, and Steam Achievements to chase down. Interface available in all 103 languages Steam supports — because corruption is a universal language. 🎬🖥️🌍
⚠️ Character profiles, lore, and custom fonts are English only⚠️



The rain hasn't let up in three days. Down at the docks, someone's on their knees on wet concrete and it has nothing to do with an arrest. The underground clubs are still running, the gambling tables are still dirty, and every woman in this city has something she's not telling you — until you earn it. Noir Vice doesn't hand you anything. You work for every scene, every profile, every explicit moment hidden in the city's rot. The saxophone keeps playing. The question is how deep you're willing to go. 🎷🖤

All characters depicted are adults (21+).

store_data.about_the_game:
Conquer the Scorched Lands. Build Your Dominion.

Scorched Dominion is a turn-based strategy game in which two factions compete for territory and assets across a tactical board.

Victory is not achieved simply by defeating your enemies. Push the front line forward with your warriors, expand your territory, and use farmers and merchants to generate assets. Your controlled territory and the assets held by your units combine to form your Power. The first faction to reach the target Power wins.

Three Units Per Turn

You can command up to three units each turn. Every unit moves first, then performs one of its unique actions.

Will you use a warrior to drive the enemy back? Return a farmer to the safety of your territory to produce assets? Or send a merchant to the front line to buy territory?

How you spend your limited actions can decisively change the course of battle.

Units with Distinct Abilities

Command a diverse roster of units, including warriors, archers, barbarians, farmers, hunters, wizards, merchants, spies, rogues, nobles, and dragons.

Claim territory, produce assets, attack from range, bind enemy units, rob opponents, buy territory, and break through the front line. Combine each unit's abilities to forge your own path to victory.

Five Factions

Each playable faction features a different unit composition and style of play.

Mellonil: A well-balanced faction with strong offense, production, and mobility.

Gilfan: A faction focused on generating assets through its farmers.

Parther: A faction that controls the battlefield through magic and disruption.

Lotherym: A powerful faction built around its dragon.

Harasal: A faction specializing in rapid assaults and breaking through the front line.

Study your opponent's composition, make the most of your faction's strengths, and exploit their weaknesses.

A Battlefield That Evolves

The opening is a struggle for control of the scorched lands at the center of the board. In the midgame, large units clash as both sides fight to advance the front line. In the endgame, the battle becomes a race to accumulate enough territory and assets to reach the target Power.

Will you take an immediate advantage or invest in production several turns ahead? Stop your opponent from winning while planning the sequence of moves that will bring your faction to its goal.

Key Features

  • A unique Power system in which victory is determined by your combined territory and assets

  • Turn-based battles where you command up to three units per turn

  • Five factions with distinct compositions and strategies

  • Eleven unique unit types

  • Five AI difficulty levels, ranging from Easy to KING

  • Local two-player matches on a single PC

  • Randomized and fixed starting positions

  • Three selectable victory targets

  • A beginner-friendly tutorial and in-game help

  • Match history and replay features

  • English and Japanese language support

store_data.about_the_game:
An ‘Ace Detective.’ A rookie who’s way too energetic. And somewhere out there... someone who sells perfect murders for a fee.

Aaron Drake has a near-perfect clearance rate, a title he didn't ask for, and as of today — a new partner/mentee.

Robin Watson passed the detective exam with the top score and has decided that means she's ready for anything.

…She is NOT ready for anything.

But the cases are coming whether either of them are ready or not.

How It Works

Investigate the Scene

Explore each location and gather evidence. Every room tells a story — if you know what to look for.

Interrogate the Suspects

Everyone present had opportunity. Everyone has something to hide. Some of them don't even realize what they're giving away.

Probe & Refute/Suggest

Break each statement apart claim by claim. Probe for more detail. Refute with hard evidence. One wrong word is all it takes.

Deduction Duel

When the contradictions are mapped and the evidence is airtight, face the killer directly. Make your case. Close it.

Key Features

Statement-by-Statement Interrogation — Statements aren't monologues, they're puzzles. Every individual claim can be pressed, challenged, or contradicted. Witnesses revise. Deflect. Crack.

Evidence-Driven Deduction — No detective vision. No highlighted clues. No guesswork. Build your case from physical evidence, autopsy reports, security cam logs, and the gaps between what people choose to say.

A Growing Partnership — Aaron is dry, precise, and carrying an unspeakable past. Robin is loud, warm, and sharper than she looks… probably. Watching them figure each other out is half the game.

A Shadow Behind Every Case — Someone out there sells perfect murders to anyone who can afford one. The cases that follow get harder to explain. The crime scenes get cleaner. Aaron starts to notice the pattern — and the pattern starts to notice him back.

Three Cases. One Mastermind.

Case 1: Murder Café The owner of Cafe Noir is found dead during his afternoon break. Four suspects. One crime scene. Everyone had opportunity. Only one had motive… and last-minute help.

*The demo contains the FULL 'Case 1: Murder Café.'*

Case 2: Murder Mountain A park ranger at the base of a cliff. Every staff member on site has a seemingly perfect alibi. An accident? Appears so… except for the victim’s last text message: “IF I DIE TONIGHT, THEN I’M MURDERED.”

Case 3: Murder Manor A manor. A locked room. A wealthy old matriarch… dead. Five suspects, five motives, and an ‘expensive’ trick to make the death look like suicide… but isn’t.

Is This Game For You?

Great fit if you enjoy:

— Ace Attorney-style interrogation and deduction gameplay

— Picking apart witness testimony statement by statement

— Sharp writing and a character duo worth rooting for

— Mysteries that reward careful reading over quick reflexes

Probably not for you if you:

— Expect action sequences or reflex-based gameplay

— Prefer games that highlight what to click next

— Dislike dialogue-heavy, character-driven experiences

Corner Dungeon

Corner Dungeon is a lightweight desktop idle RPG that lives in the corner of your screen. Keep it running tucked away in any desktop corner, and your heroes will continuously farm loot, collect gear, and grow stronger completely on their own.

Delve into mysterious dungeons, acquire powerful equipment, and build your ultimate adventure party!

True Idle, Zero Effort

Run the game minimized in any corner of your desktop. No constant clicking, no mandatory grinding—occasional quick interactions will reward you with mountains of loot and resources. Minimal internet required for smooth, lag-free gear drops.

Build Your Dream Party

Choose from dozens of unique heroes to form your perfect team. Mix and match equipment freely to create your own powerful playstyles and unbeatable builds.

Vast Dungeon Worlds

Explore dozens of handcrafted dungeon levels, each filled with diverse monsters and unique challenges. Endless hours of progression and exploration await.

Steam Market Trading

All rare and valuable in-game items can be bought and sold freely on the official Steam Market. Our robust anti-cheat system ensures a level playing field and a stable, fair trading ecosystem for all players.

store_data.about_the_game:
You don't pilot the ship—you run it.

Trenite Engineer is a first-person spaceship management game.

Instead of flying from the cockpit, you walk through your ship, maintaining the systems that keeps it alive. Generate power, manage fuel, keep oxygen flowing, repair damages, and make decisions about which systems deserve your attention first.

Explore the solar system, gather materials, craft components and expand your ship's capabilities while surviving the dangers of deep space.

Features

  • Operate your ship entirely from the inside through interactive control panels.

  • Balance power production, fuel consumption and resource usage.

  • Maintain life support, gravity, directional shields and other critical systems.

  • Physically transport, install and replace ship components.

  • Recycle equipment into materials and craft new components.

  • Explore a solar system filled with points of interest and hostile encounters.

  • Fight ship-to-ship battles where success depends on preparation and decision making.

  • Experience a simulation built around deep interconnected systems.

Early Access

This game is in active development by a solo developer.

The current version focuses on the core engineering simulation. Further development is planned throughout Early Access based on player feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
Beneath the crimson moon, countless adventurers have descended into the abyss. Few have ever returned.

Crimson Crawl is a dark fantasy pixel-art roguelike RPG that combines dungeon exploration, deckbuilding, turn-based combat, and strategic progression. Play as a Crimson Crawler, a wanderer corrupted by ancient blood magic, and venture deep into ever-changing labyrinths filled with monsters, treasures, and forgotten secrets.

Explore procedurally generated dungeons, uncover powerful relics, and collect blood-infused cards to create devastating synergies. Every encounter becomes a tactical challenge as swarms of enemies close in from all directions. Build your deck carefully, unleash destructive area attacks, and chain together powerful combinations to survive overwhelming odds.

Death is not the end. Each run unlocks new cards, relics, abilities, and opportunities for future adventures. Adapt your strategy, refine your build, and push deeper into the darkness with every attempt.

The abyss is calling.

And blood will guide your path.

Features

■ Explore Ever-Changing Dungeons

Procedurally generated maps, events, enemies, and rewards ensure every run feels unique.

■ Build Your Crimson Deck

Collect and combine powerful blood-themed cards to create devastating builds and playstyles.

■ Strategic Turn-Based Horde Battles

Face massive enemy swarms and overcome them with careful planning, powerful combos, and explosive area attacks.

■ Deep Roguelike Progression

Unlock new cards, relics, classes, and permanent upgrades across multiple runs.

■ Dark Pixel Fantasy World

Discover a cursed realm filled with blood magic, ancient ruins, terrifying creatures, and hidden mysteries.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shootrix: Shoot, Match, and Pop! A New Era of Block Puzzles!
Thought this was just another ordinary block puzzle? Think again! Shootrix isn't just about "placing" blocks—it’s a strategic, projectile-based puzzle where you aim, shoot, and strategically blast your way to victory. Experience a rhythmic flow and an explosive satisfaction that goes far beyond your imagination!

Why Shootrix?

The Thrill of the Shot: The strategy starts the moment you "fire" a block. It’s not just about placement; your success depends on the angle and timing of every shot.

2x2 Explosive Mechanics: Match same-colored blocks into a 2x2 square, and watch every connected block of that color vanish instantly! Feel the rush of infinite chain-reaction combos.

Game-Changing ‘Color Swap’ Blocks: Special rotating blocks allow you to change colors on the fly. Decide whether to pop them now or build up for a massive combo later. This small choice is the essence of "smart puzzling."

  • Easy to Learn, Deep to Master: Enjoy a relaxed, turn-based experience on an optimized 7x20 stage. The controls are simple, but the tactical depth will keep your brain sharp.

Two Modes, Double the Fun!

  • Shootrix (Single Player: Challenge Your Records) Immerse yourself in strategic gameplay and break your personal bests. Focus, build your skills, and become a true puzzle master.

  • Shootrix Arena (Real-Time Competitive Mode) Psychological Warfare: Every time you clear blocks, you send "blockers" to disrupt your opponent! Offense vs. Defense: Who can clear faster and survive longer? Climb the tiers and claim your spot at the top of the global rankings.

Shootrix Highlights:

  • Intuitive Controls: A clean interface that lets you jump straight into the action without a tutorial.

  • Combo & Chain System: The more you clear and the longer your chains, the higher your score and the greater the thrill!

  • Global Rankings & Tiers: Compete with players worldwide and become a hero for your country!

  • Optimized Performance: Smooth gameplay on all devices with short but intense sessions.

Tips for Puzzle Masters:

  • Plan Ahead: Check the color of your next projectile and pre-build your 2x2 structures.

  • Aim for Chain Clears: If one shot triggers multiple explosions, your bonus points will skyrocket.

  • Timing is Key in the Arena: Wait for your opponent to be in trouble, then hit them with a massive combo to secure the win!

Download Shootrix Now!
Test your wits, sharpen your strategy, and dive into the explosive satisfaction at your fingertips. The ultimate strategic block puzzle is here. How high can you climb?

store_data.about_the_game:
You have moved into this Condo called ChouChou, and you discover that the entire building is actually filled with princes who are deeply in love with you! ChouChou Condo is a super-sweet otome game for women. It is an AI-driven online game that requires an internet connection to play, and belongs to the 1000 Princes series. The visual style is AI photorealistic. In the game, you can browse and unlock daily posts from different princes, experience light visual novel interactions and online mini-games, chat privately with individual princes, and also make posts in the group to receive responses from the princes! All 1000 princes only follow you, only dote on you, only care about you, and only protect you!

Part 1 Discovering ChouChou Condo

You are an architecture student. After graduation, you finally managed to find an internship at a small architecture firm, though everything has been full of setbacks. You are making a Condo architectural model of your own design, while also looking for an inexpensive room to rent. One day, you discover a magical condo that you have never seen before in this neighborhood. Its exterior is exactly the same as the architectural model you are currently designing. It turns out to be what your own model will look like when it is built in the future, and it is called ChouChou Condo. The Condo manager is a little pink pig.

You view the room. It is clean, tidy, and well-lit. Since the rent is cheap, you decide to rent it. Yet every household in this Condo is actually occupied by a handsome and gentle prince, and they all love only you. This Condo is therefore filled with 1000 princes who are deeply in love with you!

The manager, the little pink pig, explains that the developer of this Condo comes from the Time-Space Administration Bureau and is caught in a land dispute. In addition, the property management company of this Condo has already gone bankrupt, so the residents must maintain every aspect of the building’s daily management by themselves. For example, the sanitation of the entire Condo, garbage disposal and security, electrical and plumbing repairs, and wall repainting all need to be handled by the residents. After moving in, you, as an architecture student, actively participate in maintaining and managing the building, and also begin a sweet romance with the princes……

Part 2 Introduction to ChouChou Condo

Private rooms: Each prince and you live in your own separate rooms. All rooms have almost exactly the same area and layout, but the style and décor of each room differ according to the historical era from which each prince originally comes.

Shared facilities: shared living room, swimming pool, chatroom, shared workspace, shared kitchen, garden, library, mini classroom, movie room, music room, shared restaurant, mini-game room, pet playground, gym……

This is a modern Condo with a French-style architectural exterior, while some shared areas such as the shared restaurant feature styles like Neo-Chinese design. The interior is a magical architecture that blends many different world styles!

You recall that when you once studied architecture abroad in Cat Country, your professor said in French, “When we design a Condo, we must keep in our hearts that it is being designed and built for our most precious, most beloved person!” This teaching became deeply engraved in your heart. You chose ChouChou, a French word meaning “darling,” “sweetheart,” or “beloved person,” as the name of this Condo. And for all 1000 princes, only you are their most beloved Chouchou!

Part 3 Condo Layouts, Facilities, and Rent

Visiting and browsing the entire condo is free, but unlocking Condo posts and increasing AI usage requires paying rent. After the monthly rent is paid, you can enjoy all Condo facilities. Monthly rent can only be paid through the STEAM Wallet.

Resident posts: Each prince resident posts updates about his daily life. Unlockable content includes images, music, voices, videos, interactions, and more.

Swimming pool: Daily discussions where the princes gather together. You can reply, and you can also make posts. The princes will all respond to you.

Chatroom: Chat privately with different princes.

Garden: Unlock more light romance visual novel stories.

Laundry room: Use the drum washing machine for gacha pulls and draw stories of the prince you love.

Mini classroom: This is an international Condo, where princes from various countries teach languages.

Music room: Listen to the princes sing or perform music.

Mini-game room: Various fun mini-games.

Library: Read online e-books.

Part4: Manager’s Room

The little pink pig was once a pet pig of the Time-Space Administration Bureau. After the property management company of ChouChou Condo went bankrupt, it struggled to organize the residents for self-management. Although the rent is cheap, this building is extremely strange, and the time-space in which it is located is unstable. Taking the stairs can lead you to different residents, but taking the elevator sends you to each resident’s different time-space.

You and all the princes, as residents, must live here, explore, and unravel the mystery of time-space.

The little pink pig is responsible for collecting monthly rent. If server downtime or other failures occur during operation, residents will receive corresponding extensions.

Part5 Resident List

The list of prince residents is still continuously growing, and this strange Condo from a higher-dimensional space will also automatically add more floors and become taller. On the game’s main interface, when users scroll down the building, they will see the Condo’s floors continue to increase in the future.

The princes who have already moved in are:

◆Bang（Primitive Man） Coming from the Stone Age, he is tall, powerful, and carries a unique purity that has never been polluted by modern industrial society. He has loved you deeply since prehistoric times.

◆Yucheng（Programmer） Free-spirited in style and skilled at aggressive code, he speaks directly. When the brakes of your electric car failed, he hacked into the traffic system as a hacker, turned all traffic lights green, and saved you.

◆Haowei（Warlord of Bear Country） Nicknamed Brown Bear, he is a young warlord commander. He acts with force, dignity, and coldness, but he leaves all his gentleness for you. He cannot bear to let you suffer even the slightest grievance.

◆Lingtian（Prince of Fang Country） He is a student at an Asian military academy, handsome and gentle, devoted and faithful in love. The royal family of Fang Country holds a “Search for Love” event for Prince Lingtian to find his princess consort, using it to divert public attention and ease social conflict. Yet he completely ignores the other girls. He only cares about you, only follows you, and only loves you.

◆Citan（Baike Alien） He is a mixed-race Baike alien and Earthling. Baike Star has extraordinarily advanced technology, and its people believe in strict logical rationality while removing emotions. Yet as an alien, because he loves you deeply, he insists on preserving his emotions.

◆Congwei（Electricity CEO） He runs Quark Electric Power Company, and he deeply loves and protects you. In his timeline, the two of you are exposed to electric radiation. You turn into a power bank, and he needs your body to charge in order to survive……

◆Momo（Detective of Bear Country） Nicknamed Black Bear, he is a detective who is decisive, calm, and meticulous. In his timeline, he always encounters you at murder scenes. Because he often questions you as an eyewitness, he comes to understand you and falls in love with you.

◆YuuJin（Prince of Fish Country） Intelligent, diligent, low-key, and humble, he is a mechanical engineer. In his timeline, you are his secretary and translator.

◆Yongmi（Water General of Ji Country） An ancient Water General of Ji Country, he is skilled in water arts and can freely switch water between its three states: liquid water, steam, and ice. In ancient times, he often used water to create rainbows for you, making you happy.

◆Shenjun（Fire General of Ji Country） An ancient Fire General of Ji Country, he is skilled in fire arts and can control fire. In ancient times, he always used fire to create fireworks for you, encouraging and comforting you.

◆Mingzun（Judge） He was originally a judge from the Underworld. Because he loved you deeply, he reincarnated into the mortal world and became a court judge in the human realm.

◆Zexian（Pearl Prince） Zexian says to you, “When I found you, it was like discovering the most precious, most translucent pearl in the world. I only want to place you inside my hard pearl clam shell and protect you well!”

◆Weilong（Crown Prince of Dragon Country）Weilong was born with naturally curly hair, and the people of Dragon Country have nicknamed him “Instant Noodle Hair,” “Steel Wool Ball,” or “Fried Enoki Mushroom.” Weilong says to you, “Even if I deliberately straighten my curls, my hair will still curl back again. It is just like my love for you. Even if I deliberately try not to think of you, I still naturally start missing you again, loving you deeply. My curls are innate, and my love for you is also innate.”

Part 6 The 1000 Princes Series

“1000 Princes” is a gorgeous and romantic otome game series for women. It is entirely driven by AI, including AI photorealistic images and videos, AI voices, AI translation, and AI code. The storylines are originally created by the developer Ginyan.

The 1000 Princes game series is divided into three categories:

1.《1000 Princes: ChouChou Condo》. This is the only online game in the series that requires an internet connection to play. After the server opens, prince posts will be updated daily. You will feel a sense of daily companionship and a strong feeling of being loved, while the storyline is fragmented. By calling AI models, the princes’ responses to you are exclusive to you and dynamic.

2.《1000 Princes: Born to Love You》 and others. These are premium single-player games in the series with a one-time purchase model. They feature complete group romance storylines, with fixed content, telling the romance between all the princes and you.

3.《Lingtian 1》 and others. These are premium single-player games in the series with a one-time purchase model. They feature complete individual romance storylines, with fixed content, telling the romance between one specific prince and you.

Part 7: About the Developer

I am Ginyan, and I am passionate about learning computers and foreign languages. Over the past ten years, I have self-published dozens of romance novels and foreign-language learning e-books that I wrote myself. I have also taught online, run websites, created videos, and more.

I adapted my own novels into game scripts. At first, I learned iClone and CC, combined them with various AI tools, and used Unity and Naninovel to independently create offline single-player games.

Now, through deep collaboration with AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and others, I am trying to create an online otome game. In addition to the fixed storyline, I have integrated DeepSeek’s AI model so that princess players can create interactions that are uniquely their own.

As the solo developer and human customer support representative of 1000 PRINCES, I am always looking forward to hearing players’ feedback. Please feel free to contact me at any time.

Garden: Unlock more light romance visual novel stories.

Laundry room: Use the drum washing machine for gacha pulls and draw stories of the prince you love.

Mini classroom: This is an international Condo, where princes from various countries teach languages.

Music room: Listen to the princes sing or perform music.

Mini-game room: Various fun mini-games.

Library: Read online e-books.

Part4: Manager’s Room

The little pink pig was once a pet pig of the Time-Space Administration Bureau. After the property management company of ChouChou Condo went bankrupt, it struggled to organize the residents for self-management. Although the rent is cheap, this building is extremely strange, and the time-space in which it is located is unstable. Taking the stairs can lead you to different residents, but taking the elevator sends you to each resident’s different time-space.

You and all the princes, as residents, must live here, explore, and unravel the mystery of time-space.

The little pink pig is responsible for collecting monthly rent. If server downtime or other failures occur during operation, residents will receive corresponding extensions.

Part5 Resident List

The list of prince residents is still continuously growing, and this strange Condo from a higher-dimensional space will also automatically add more floors and become taller. On the game’s main interface, when users scroll down the building, they will see the Condo’s floors continue to increase in the future.

The princes who have already moved in are:

◆Bang（Primitive Man） Coming from the Stone Age, he is tall, powerful, and carries a unique purity that has never been polluted by modern industrial society. He has loved you deeply since prehistoric times.

◆Yucheng（Programmer） Free-spirited in style and skilled at aggressive code, he speaks directly. When the brakes of your electric car failed, he hacked into the traffic system as a hacker, turned all traffic lights green, and saved you.

◆Haowei（Warlord of Bear Country） Nicknamed Brown Bear, he is a young warlord commander. He acts with force, dignity, and coldness, but he leaves all his gentleness for you. He cannot bear to let you suffer even the slightest grievance.

◆Lingtian（Prince of Fang Country） He is a student at an Asian military academy, handsome and gentle, devoted and faithful in love. The royal family of Fang Country holds a “Search for Love” event for Prince Lingtian to find his princess consort, using it to divert public attention and ease social conflict. Yet he completely ignores the other girls. He only cares about you, only follows you, and only loves you.

◆Citan（Baike Alien） He is a mixed-race Baike alien and Earthling. Baike Star has extraordinarily advanced technology, and its people believe in strict logical rationality while removing emotions. Yet as an alien, because he loves you deeply, he insists on preserving his emotions.

◆Congwei（Electricity CEO） He runs Quark Electric Power Company, and he deeply loves and protects you. In his timeline, the two of you are exposed to electric radiation. You turn into a power bank, and he needs your body to charge in order to survive……

◆Momo（Detective of Bear Country） Nicknamed Black Bear, he is a detective who is decisive, calm, and meticulous. In his timeline, he always encounters you at murder scenes. Because he often questions you as an eyewitness, he comes to understand you and falls in love with you.

◆YuuJin（Prince of Fish Country） Intelligent, diligent, low-key, and humble, he is a mechanical engineer. In his timeline, you are his secretary and translator.

◆Yongmi（Water General of Ji Country） An ancient Water General of Ji Country, he is skilled in water arts and can freely switch water between its three states: liquid water, steam, and ice. In ancient times, he often used water to create rainbows for you, making you happy.

◆Shenjun（Fire General of Ji Country） An ancient Fire General of Ji Country, he is skilled in fire arts and can control fire. In ancient times, he always used fire to create fireworks for you, encouraging and comforting you.

◆Mingzun（Judge） He was originally a judge from the Underworld. Because he loved you deeply, he reincarnated into the mortal world and became a court judge in the human realm.

◆Zexian（Pearl Prince） Zexian says to you, “When I found you, it was like discovering the most precious, most translucent pearl in the world. I only want to place you inside my hard pearl clam shell and protect you well!”

◆Weilong（Crown Prince of Dragon Country）Weilong was born with naturally curly hair, and the people of Dragon Country have nicknamed him “Instant Noodle Hair,” “Steel Wool Ball,” or “Fried Enoki Mushroom.” Weilong says to you, “Even if I deliberately straighten my curls, my hair will still curl back again. It is just like my love for you. Even if I deliberately try not to think of you, I still naturally start missing you again, loving you deeply. My curls are innate, and my love for you is also innate.”

Part 6 The 1000 Princes Series

“1000 Princes” is a gorgeous and romantic otome game series for women. It is entirely driven by AI, including AI photorealistic images and videos, AI voices, AI translation, and AI code. The storylines are originally created by the developer Ginyan.

The 1000 Princes game series is divided into three categories:

1.《1000 Princes: ChouChou Condo》. This is the only online game in the series that requires an internet connection to play. After the server opens, prince posts will be updated daily. You will feel a sense of daily companionship and a strong feeling of being loved, while the storyline is fragmented. By calling AI models, the princes’ responses to you are exclusive to you and dynamic.

2.《1000 Princes: Born to Love You》 and others. These are premium single-player games in the series with a one-time purchase model. They feature complete group romance storylines, with fixed content, telling the romance between all the princes and you.

3.《Lingtian 1》 and others. These are premium single-player games in the series with a one-time purchase model. They feature complete individual romance storylines, with fixed content, telling the romance between one specific prince and you.

Part 7: About the Developer

I am Ginyan, and I am passionate about learning computers and foreign languages. Over the past ten years, I have self-published dozens of romance novels and foreign-language learning e-books that I wrote myself. I have also taught online, run websites, created videos, and more.

I adapted my own novels into game scripts. At first, I learned iClone and CC, combined them with various AI tools, and used Unity and Naninovel to independently create offline single-player games.

Now, through deep collaboration with AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and others, I am trying to create an online otome game. In addition to the fixed storyline, I have integrated DeepSeek’s AI model so that princess players can create interactions that are uniquely their own.

As the solo developer and human customer support representative of 1000 PRINCES, I am always looking forward to hearing players’ feedback. Please feel free to contact me at any time.

Unlock daily posts, mini-games, and light visual novel stories. Chat with the princes or post in the group to receive their sweet responses.

store_data.about_the_game:
Vonkelveld (Afrikaans: "spark field") is a god-sim of tending and witnessing, where every light scattered across the dark veld is a simulated life — and you can fall all the way into any one of them.

Tend, don't command. You are a force, not a king. Raise land and sink it, call the rain, warm the air, bless the ground — then spend your limited divine power and let time run. The people decide for themselves where to settle, when to flee, who to follow. You shape the world they live in; you never give an order. And the world pushes back on its own terms — the stakes always win in the end.

Fall from a god's eye to a single life. Pull back and watch hearth-lights bloom into villages, villages into cities with real streets and landmarks. Then dive — past the clouds, past the rooftops — and follow one person through their whole life. Their family and friendships light up around them; their private story unfolds in their own words; and you can reach in with a god's touch to change one fate among thousands. Every spark is a life, and every life is yours to find.

Ask why — and get the truth. The Chronicle narrates your world's history as it happens. Click any place, any moment, and ask why — and the game answers with the actual causal chain that produced it, traced back through the years. Not flavour text. The real reasons your world became what it is. No other god-game does this.

Survival is the score. The cold — or the fire, the flood, each scenario's own slow doom — always comes. Skill is how long and how brightly your world burns: soul-years lived, peak souls, years endured.

Deterministic to the byte. A world is nothing but a seed plus your choices. Send a friend your seed code and they play the identical world — so the gap between your scores is pure skill. Same seed, same world, every single time.

Drawn from nothing but math. The living map, the drifting weather, the turn of day and night, every sound — all procedurally generated at runtime from simple primitive recipes. No stock art. No AI-generated images. A world that looks and sounds like only itself.

Choose your catastrophe. Hand-authored scenarios that each play completely differently — the Long Winter, a drowning world, an age of fire and volcanism, a fragile eden on the brink — plus open-ended seeded free-play for endless worlds.

Standout features

  • Tend, don't command — shape land, weather and fortune, but the people live by their own will

  • Seamless scale — zoom from continents and centuries down to one person's life, with no loading or seams

  • Follow a single soul — track individuals and watch their families and relationships emerge, kin lighting up around them

  • Ask "why" about anything — get the true, traced causal chain behind any place or event, not canned text

  • A living Chronicle — your world narrates its own real, emergent history as it happens

  • Power at every scale — bless a continent or reach into one person's fate

  • Survival as a high score — soul-years, peak souls, years endured

  • Byte-perfect determinism — share a seed code and compete on the exact same world; the score gap is pure skill

  • Hand-crafted procedural world — art and sound generated from primitives at runtime; zero stock assets, zero AI imagery

  • Distinct authored scenarios + infinite free-play — every map plays its own way

store_data.about_the_game:
PROPHAUNT

Hide. Hunt. Survive.

Welcome to Creepwood Carnival — a decaying funfair where the rides still turn and something is hunting in the dark. Survivors must power the carnival back up and escape before The Butcher catches them. Their secret? Transform into any prop in the world — a barrel, a pumpkin, a teddy bear — and pray nobody looks twice.

THE HUNT

PropHaunt is a 1v4 asymmetric multiplayer horror game where every match is a tense game of cat and mouse. Survivors blend into the carnival as everyday objects while racing to repair generators and open the exit portals. The Butcher hunts on instinct, axe in hand, listening for the wrong creak of floorboards.

FEATURES

• Become Any Prop — Click an object to morph instantly. Choose your hiding spot wisely; The Butcher is watching.

• Two Sides, Two Playstyles — Survivors rely on stealth and teamwork. The Butcher wields raw power, bear traps, and a sixth sense for prey.

• Skills That Matter — Heal, sprint, vanish, drop smoke, leave decoys, sense the killer. Every cooldown counts.

• Down But Not Out — Run out of health and you're downed, not dead — crawl away and let a teammate revive you before you bleed out.

• Head-Bump Stuns — Drop on The Butcher from above in prop form to stun him cold.

• Steam Lobbies & Friends Only — Public matchmaking or private rooms. No port forwarding, no lag spikes.

• Creepwood Carnival — A hand-built, decaying funfair full of shadows, rides, and a thousand places to hide.

EVERY MATCH IS A STORY

Will the survivors slip away under cover of fog, hidden in plain sight as a discarded popcorn cart? Will The Butcher's axe find them first? In PropHaunt, every prop could save you — or expose you.

Hide well. Hunt smart. Survive the night.

store_data.about_the_game:
Heart Light: Knight of the Gnomes is a hand-drawn first-person dungeon crawler set in a world where humans once lived.  Put on your trusty toolbelt, dust off your cap, and become the first of your kind to uncover the secrets left behind by the ancient builders.

Play as a gnomish knight venturing into a forgotten labyrinth beneath the surface.  Explore handcrafted dungeon floors, battle a variety of strange creatures, gather ingredients, discover secret rooms, and return to the safety of the  surface before the darkness overtakes your Heart Light.

The World Above is where you prepare. Brew potions, buy and sell gear, dig for buried treasure, socialize with other players in the shared hub, and study your Rune Tablet to unlock Ley Magic.

The World Below is where gnomish knights are made!

The game combines classic dungeon-crawling tension with a colorful fantasy world of gnomes, mushrooms, and crystals.


Features

• Experience a cozy-dark fantasy adventure with an old-school dungeon-crawler heart and handcrafted charm.

• Explore first-person dungeons filled with monsters, secrets, alternate routes, and treasure.

• Battle strange creatures including imps, undead, cultists, redcaps, and more.

• Unlock magical abilities through the Rune Tablet. Enhance your spell loadout by linking spells together.

• Brew potions and experiment with alchemy using roots, seeds, herbs, and stranger ingredients.

• Meet other players in the shared hub, chat, share hints, and compare discoveries.  The dungeon itself remains a solo adventure.

• Discover hidden rewards, secret walls, and unique tools that open new ways to explore.
