store_data.about_the_game:
You are Employee #4471. Your headset works. Your chair does not.

Survive the shift at Nimbus Telecom — a call center where the customers are unreasonable, the metrics are merciless, and your floor supervisor Rajeev is always watching.

The Job


Answer calls. Verify identities. Handle complaints, billing disputes, and accidental upgrades. Every caller has a mood, a patience meter, and a story. Most of them are lying about at least one part of it.

  • Fully voiced call engine — real recorded voice lines for every caller type, routed through a telephone EQ chain
  • Multi-factor identity verification — account numbers, dates of birth, last payment amounts, addresses. Real fraudsters know the name. Smart ones know the address too.
  • Branching dialogue — callers that vent, go irate, hang up, or warm up depending on how you handle them
  • Response judgment — some calls hand you a menu of replies with no hint which one fits. Read the room. The wrong "explanation" only makes it worse.
  • Call out bad info — challenge a caller whose details don't add up. If they fumbled a digit, they'll correct it. If their info was fine, you just accused a paying customer of lying.
  • CRM actions — Resolve, Escalate, Upsell, Issue Refund, Flag as Fraud, Schedule Callback, Apply Loyalty Offer. Pick wrong and it goes in your file.
  • Account lockout system — three failed security checks and the account freezes
  • Dead air detection — leave the caller waiting too long and their mood tanks
  • Consequences arrive by email — botch a call and the customer may complain to Rajeev overnight... or may not. Smooth them over before they hang up and you might just get away with it.
  • Weekly performance reviews — CSAT scores, resolution rates, handle time. Fall below quota and Rajeev stops being politely disappointed.
  • Two lines, one headset — inbound customers ring on LINE 1, outbound cold calls run on LINE 2. Switch between them mid-shift; whoever you put on hold only waits so long before hanging up.
  • "While I have you..." — some callers raise a second, unrelated issue right after the first is fixed. Same caller, same call, completely different diagnosis. Wrap-up waits for both.

The Side Hustle


The base salary is not enough. Fortunately the lead database is right there and D.D. pays cash.

  • Cold call outbound leads — dial prospects between inbound calls, close deals for commission
  • Unethical methods — fake surveys, fear pitches, unauthorized add-ons. High risk. Higher reward. Don't get caught.
  • Dead drops — export the lead sheet, leave it under your desk. D.D. handles the rest. Probably.
  • Cramming — sneak an unrequested add-on onto a verified account. Compliance is watching.
  • D.D. escalation arc — a deepening arrangement with unknown consequences

The Lead Market


The free daily lead sheet is just the start. A world of up to 100,000 unique people sits in the directory — most of them aren't Nimbus customers at all.

  • LeadMart — buy prospect packages with your own money: warm pre-screened leads, bulk cold lists, premium dossiers, and a "no questions asked" bundle from D.D.
  • Win them over — most prospects are already with a rival telecom (Vortex Mobile, Pinnacle Fiber, Orbital One, and more). Every rival has a public weakness. Lean on it, beat their price, and poach the customer.
  • Closing converts — every cold call you win turns a stranger into a Nimbus subscriber. Switchers carry the fattest commissions.
  • Your lead book — purchased leads persist across days in CustomerDeck's new Leads tab. Dial them whenever your inbound queue is clear.
  • Contracts fight back — prospects locked into sticky rival contracts are harder to flip; unconnected households are easy wins.

The Office


Your cubicle is a 3D first-person space. Things happen in it.

  • Rajeev patrols the floor every few minutes with a clipboard. Every grift you run while he's watching doubles in risk.
  • Fernando Jr. is your desk plant. Water him daily. He remembers if you don't.
  • Gerald is a pigeon on the windowsill. He is stressed. Feeding him helps you both.
  • Invoice is a tiny horse that sometimes crosses the office. Nobody reacts. His name is Invoice.
  • The printer jams. You can fix it for $2. IT will not.
  • Someone microwaves fish. You know who.
  • System outages — CRM goes down mid-shift. The calls don't stop.
  • Fire drill — mandatory evacuation. The queue pauses. Rajeev does not look pleased.
  • Stress meter — calls, hold time, and bad reviews pile it on. Manage it with your coffee mug (3 sips a day), a once-daily break, or a trip to the vending machine.
  • VendX Pro™ — the break room vending machine. Snacks, energy drinks, stress relief, and one mystery button you probably shouldn't press twice.

Three Ways This Ends


Stay long enough and the job stops being just calls.

  • Climb — string together enough good weeks and Rajeev offers you a supervisor desk. Review other agents' escalation calls instead of taking your own. Running grifts gets harder to hide from up there.
  • Get deeper — D.D.'s "arrangement" doesn't stay simple. What starts with a photographed lead sheet can end in wire transfers — and D.D. doesn't owe you anything once you're no longer useful.
  • Get out clean — cooperate with Compliance instead. Protection has a cost, but it isn't your conscience.

Features


  • Procedurally generated population — 8,000 core Nimbus subscribers plus an open market of up to 100,000 unique people, each with their own name, DOB, account history, and direct phone line
  • CustomerDeck search engine — comb the entire subscriber database by name, account, or phone number, with a dedicated Leads tab for your bought-and-paid-for prospect book
  • Nimbus Directory — a separate full-population search with gender and age filters, doubling as a live record editor: rewrite any subscriber's name, plan, balance, flags, or number, and the change sticks (and saves)
  • Profile Intel — pull a "dossier" on any subscriber: day job, hobbies, quirks, satisfaction, and a suspiciously detailed activity feed
  • Cold-call anyone — dial any subscriber or prospect straight off the deck between inbound calls: offer a renewal discount, flip a rival's customer, run a grift for personal profit (get caught and it lands in your file), or call for no reason at all and simply ruin their afternoon
  • Social engineering scenarios — one name match is not enough
  • Upgrades shop (NimbusMart™) — unlock equipment that physically appears on your desk
  • Pulse dashboard — live CSAT, resolution rate, earnings, and strikes, plus a 7-day performance history
  • Trophies — a full career achievement board; several are hidden until you trigger them
  • Flavor email inbox — HR memos, coworker drama, fantasy league updates, evites to Janet's divorce BBQ
  • Day/night window cycle, ambient office life, coffee machine with a round trip
  • Multi-slot save system — three independent career saves with persistent performance history
  • Manual save and autosave every 3 minutes — never lose progress mid-shift
  • Caller mood system — loyalty history carries across calls; irate callers remember you

The calls keep coming. The queue never empties. You have 3 sips of coffee left.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a Post-Apocalyptic World

Step into a wasteland left behind after the collapse of civilization. Journey through vine-covered ruins, dust-choked settlements, and neon-lit steel cities. The remnants of the old world still grind on, while a new order has already divided people into very different fates. Through each expedition, uncover fragments of the truth behind the catastrophe and rewrite the future of this world before fate begins to turn once more.

Assemble Your Adventuring Party

Along the way, you can choose to travel with companions of different personalities, each carrying secrets of their own. Some are used to walking alone. Some are calm, sharp, and calculating. Some trust only the profit in front of them, while others bear a past no one else knows. They may not trust each other at first, but through support, conflict, and battle, their relationships will gradually change, becoming one of your greatest strengths in the wasteland.

Turn-Based Tactical Combat

Combat unfolds turn by turn. Positioning, turn order, and battlefield conditions all shape how each party member can act. Character growth is not locked to a fixed path. Skills from different systems can be mixed and matched to create your own combat style: telekinesis, elements, firearms, melee combat, assassination, and more can all be rebuilt around the same character. Different elements can also interact on the battlefield, triggering unexpected chain reactions.

Problems Have More Than One Solution

On your journey, many problems can be solved in more than one way. You can negotiate face to face, sneak around through another route, or, of course, settle things with your fists. But be careful: every choice you make may push events in a different direction, and every step you take will shape this adventure into a story that belongs only to you.

store_data.about_the_game:
STORY

Rem T. Saikle is a struggling man on his planet, Melatai, who faces classism alongside his older sister, Piper.

However, when Trauvia, a planet-turned-mothership, arrives and announces its plan to eradicate Melatai after enslaving hard-working farmers and fishers, Rem is forced to defend himself and his people, using a sword he stole from the Trauvians.

And after Leader Seax, Trauvia's supreme leader, notifies Rem of the kidnapping and ransom of his sister, Rem must do something only the insane would do: Stop the entire army.

GAMEPLAY

Learn the layout of levels before running through them as fast as you can to get a better rank! Other badges can be obtained at each level for killing every single enemy, not killing any enemies, and/or taking no damage. Level layouts won't change based on the difficulty you choose. However, the way you interact with them changes:

  • EASY: Checkpoints can be used infinitely, and you will do slightly more damage to enemies.

  • NORMAL: Checkpoints can only be used 3 times.

  • HARD: Checkpoints are disabled, and boss enemy health bars will refill if you die during a boss fight.

Items can be used in-game; they are single-use, so spend wisely! You will be able to sell items you collect from enemies after completing a level.

Trance World usually takes roughly 30-45 minutes per chapter. It is a perfect game to pick up, mindlessly practice your platforming skills (or find new ways to speedrun levels), and put down!

store_data.about_the_game:
Set sail with a single ship and a small purse, and build a trading empire that

spans the seas. Argosy is a deep trading and economy simulation set in the

harbor cities of a late-medieval merchant league, where prices rise and fall

with real supply and demand, and the largest fortunes belong to the merchant

who reads the market best.

In Argosy you begin as an unknown shopkeeper and work your way up: filling your

hold where goods are cheap, selling them where they are scarce, building a fleet

to carry more, and climbing the ranks of merchant society until you sit on the

council and govern the cities you once traded in. Play alone against rival AI

merchants, or take the same living economy online and compete against other

players.

Master a Living Economy

No price is fixed. Every city produces some goods, consumes others, and runs

short when supply dries up, and the market responds to every trade, including

your own.

  • Trade 20 goods across cities linked by real supply and demand.

  • Flood a market to crash a price, or buy a good up to corner it and set your own rate.

  • Spot a shortage before your rivals do and turn one city's famine into your fortune.

  • Build factories and refine raw timber, hemp and iron into finished goods worth far more.

Build a Fleet and Automate Your Trade

Grow from one vessel into a fleet, then put it to work without steering every

voyage by hand.

  • Buy, build and crew a range of historical sailing ships, from nimble coastal traders to heavy ocean-going haulers.

  • Assign captains who grow more skilled the longer they sail.

  • Set automated trade routes and let your captains run them while you plan your next venture.

  • Establish warehouses and production in the cities that matter most to your network.

Rise Through the Ranks

Coin opens doors, but it is not the whole game. Earn the trust of every class of

citizen and climb from humble shopkeeper to the heights of civic power.

  • Advance through a career of merchant ranks, from shopkeeper and trader to councillor and lord mayor.

  • Stand for election, set tax rates and shape the cities you trade in.

  • Win citizens over by keeping them supplied, then turn that standing into political weight against your rivals.

Command Your Ships in Battle

The sea belongs to no one, and not every sail on the horizon comes in peace.

  • Fight tactical naval battles, maneuvering to land your broadsides while keeping your hull out of the enemy's line of fire.

  • Escort your convoys, drive off pirates, and board enemy ships to take them and their cargo.

  • Turn pirate yourself and prey on the trade lanes, if you can survive the hunt that follows.

Outwit Rival Merchants

You share the world with ambitious AI merchants who trade, build and scheme by

the same rules you do, with no shortcuts and no handicaps. The routes they run

hold where goods are cheap, selling them where they are scarce, building a fleet

council and govern the cities you once traded in. Play alone against rival AI

merchants, or take the same living economy online and compete against other

short when supply dries up, and the market responds to every trade, including

your own.

  • Flood a market to crash a price, or buy a good up to corner it and set your own rate.

store_data.about_the_game:
Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

100 years ago, the Chaos Lord emerged and wrought death and destruction to all. A band of heroes rose and defeated the Chaos Lord, banishing him from this world with a magic crystal. Now the Chaos Lord has returned and it falls to you to defeat him once again. Finn, a young Knight of the Kingdom of Efenia, is tasked with collecting the Crests from each of the 3 Kingdoms in order to unlock the power to defeat the Chaos Lord.

Engage in traditional JRPG turn based combat as you explore the world, gaining levels, abilities, weapons, and armor in order to fight stronger monsters as you journey further in your quest. Along the way you'll meet new allies with unique abilities both in and out of combat and find optional side quests and dungeons.

STORY

On May 5th, 1997, the Vatican received a case concerning a girl whose parents believed to be afflicted.

In response, Father Bartolli was dispatched to the location to conduct an investigation.

After going weeks without contact, and out of desperation, The Order sent another priest to get to the bottom of the situation; to report back the validity of the girl's condition, as well as confirm the well-being of Father Bartolli.

The first and second priest were never heard from again...

...You are the third.

FEATURES

  • Engaging Combat System

Engage in thrilling turn-based combat where you must manage your stats, choose the right moves at the right time, study hints for any opponent weaknesses, and decide between keeping the girl alive or vanquishing the demon at any cost.

  • Choose Your Playstyle

    Decide your strategy through the course of battle with 4 varying disciplines

    Divinism — Faith based actions that call upon heavenly support to deal damage

    Ritualism — Incantations that inflict status effects on your opponent

    Psychism — Meditative actions that center the mind and heal your soul

    Secularism — Physical actions that seek to inflict tangible punishment

  • Unique Visuals

    Told through a captivating retro-styled 3D environment with dynamic lighting, enthralling sound effects and vibrant attack and magic animations.

  • Multiple Endings

    Your actions through out the course of battle will decide not only your fate, but that of the girl's.

  • High Replayability

    With each run, experiment with different strategies, ability loadouts, or try and improve your post-combat score to unlock new skills for the next run.

==================== English ====================


--- 【Overview / Short Description】 ---


Huiyu AI Trip is an interactive travel visual experience. A controllable visual journey — hold W/D to move forward, hold S/A to rewind through time, release to pause. Every frame is rendered in real-time via Canvas frame sequences, with seamless forward and reverse playback. More content and interactions will continue to be added, creating a brand new way to explore the world.


--- 【About the Game】 ---


═══════════════════════════════════════

Huiyu AI Trip

====================

═══════════════════════════════════════


A interactive travel experience you can step inside.


A visual memory at your fingertips. Hold W/D to unfold the journey forward; hold S/A to rewind time. Release to pause — every frame switches instantly, smooth and flicker-free.

🎮 Controls


W / D — Hold to play forward

S / A — Hold to rewind

Release — Pause on current frame

Double-click — Toggle fullscreen

Right-click — Open quick menu (language / back to home)


No tutorials, no long loading. Just open and play. Intuitive by design.

✨ Core Features

🎯 Frame-Level Precision

Unlike traditional video players where seeking stutters, Huiyu AI Trip uses Canvas 2D + WebP frame sequence rendering. Every frame is an independently loaded still image. Switching direction is just incrementing or decrementing a frame number — no decoder waiting, no keyframe jumps. Every keystroke responds instantly.

🔄 Bidirectional Time Travel

Forward or backward, the choice is yours. Want to revisit a scene? Hold S/A to glide back. No more dragging a seek bar, no more pausing and replaying. Your fingers are the remote.

🏗 Future Vision

Huiyu AI Trip is just getting started. Future directions include: user-generated content, AI-generated travel scenes, community-shared routes, cross-device progress sync, richer feedback and visual effects. Our goal is to build an open travel visual platform where everyone can create and share their own "walkable landscapes."

🌐 25 Languages

Built-in support for 25 languages covering major world languages. No matter where you're from, you can experience the product in your native tongue. Language preference is saved locally and persists across sessions.

🖥 Native Desktop Experience

Built on Tauri 2, delivering native desktop app-level performance and stability. In fullscreen immersive mode, the画面 fills your entire screen with zero UI distractions — just you and the scenery ahead. Future exploration into VR and other immersive scenarios is on the horizon.

🔧 Technical Architecture


Single Canvas 2D display layer — no flickering from switching between two players

Intelligent frame cache — preloads 90 frames ahead and behind, LRU auto-eviction, up to 180 cached frames

Concurrent load control — up to 8 parallel requests, preventing I/O overload

Frame-hold strategy — keeps the previous frame if the next isn't loaded yet, never goes black

Time accumulator playback loop — based on requestAnimationFrame, consistent speed across different refresh rates

*** Content Warning: Shadows of Eldemir contains occult themes, unsettling horror imagery and moments of psychological unease which some players may find distressing. ***

The year is 1890. London schoolmaster Lucian West has travelled across Eastern Europe to the remote village of Eldemir after his fiancée, archaeologist Eveline Carrington, mysteriously vanished during an excavation in the Carpathian Mountains.

The expedition, led by distinguished London university professors, had uncovered a strange artefact buried deep beneath the mountain - something that contained ancient knowledge no human mind was meant to comprehend.

The Carpathians have long been a place of folklore and old superstitions. The locals often speak of vanished travellers and wandering spirits. Then there are those who still fear a vampire scourge believed to have been destroyed many years ago. But since the expedition uncovered the artefact, the land itself seems to have 'remembered' what it was hiding.

Some believe the vampires have returned. Others fear something far older has awakened.

Shadows of Eldemir is a retro-inspired, cosmic-horror, point-and-click adventure RPG combining classic first-person exploration and puzzle-solving with a Victorian love story at its core.

Features

  • Classic Point-and-Click Adventure Gameplay

Explore dark forests, cursed roads, ruined chapels, forgotten crypts, haunted swamps and many other diverse locations. Search every scene for clues, gather useful objects, solve puzzles, speak with villagers and uncover hidden lore to piece together the terrible history of Eldemir.

  • Turn-based RPG Combat

Survive encounters with restless spirits, demons, undead horrors and other supernatural threats. Upgrade your weapons and armour, prepare yourself with essential supplies and protective charms as you learn to exploit each enemy's weakness.

  • Fish, Trade and Craft

Catch a variety of fish and harvest their components which can be sold for coin or given to villagers to help craft useful items.

  • Experience a Victorian Cosmic-Horror Mystery

Follow Lucian’s desperate search for Eveline through a dark Victorian tale of love, forbidden knowledge, forgotten cults, and something from beyond this world that should never have entered ours.

  • Retro-Inspired Visuals

Experience Eldemir through hand-crafted pixel art inspired by classic adventure games.

Additional Info

All screenshots are work-in-progress and may not represent the final visuals.

Trailer coming soon. A playable demo is also being considered.

content_descriptors.notes:
Shadows of Eldemir contains stylised pixel-art, fantasy violence as part of both the story and combat. This includes blood, corpses, skeletons, disturbing body-related imagery and brief close-up supernatural violence. 

The story deals with dark occult and psychological themes including both cosmic and supernatural horror. Some images and descriptions may frighten or unsettle certain players. 

Alcohol is referenced in tavern signs/menus and bottles may appear as background decoration.

The game also contains a fictional dice gambling mini-game using in-game currency only.

store_data.about_the_game:
The ritual that was supposed to free your lineage has awakened a dark presence that wishes to end you.

Vigilum is a first-person survival horror game set on a rural estate in medieval Europe. Survive the nights, complete the ritual, outlast the darkness.

THE ESTATE

A rural family property on the outskirts of medieval Europe, surrounded by beautiful natural woodland.

  • The House - Once the family home, now a base for rest and preparation. Craft materials in the Workshop for sigil casting, eat to keep your energy, or brew tea for a quick remedy.

  • The Barn - Past the fields, a large wooden structure houses the Alchemy Lab, where herbs are distilled into extracts and potions to gain an edge against what hunts at night.

  • The Woodshed - An old structure once used by the estate's former matriarch for her craft. Starter materials can be found here. Past it, hidden from plain sight, lies a Shrine she once tended, seeking aid from higher entities.

PREPARE. CRAFT. ENDURE.

During the day, several options are available to manage your resources wisely.

  • GATHER- Find herbs in the gardens or in the wild. Each one carries a different virtue... or curse.

  • ALCHEMIZE - Grind and distill your findings in the alchemy lab to brew potions and elixirs that give you an edge.

  • CRAFT - Convert raw materials into chalk or charcoal, essential for sigil creation.

  • CAST - Draw sigils during the night to empower yourself or weaken the hunter's grasp.

  • REST - Sleep to restore energy and replenish your nourishment at home.

Each action takes time. Plan accordingly.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT

Place Vylem, the gemstone of Dreams, on the ritual grounds. At 23:00, the energy settles... the ritual begins. Dr. Hayden arrives at the stroke of midnight. He investigates, adapts, and remembers.

  • TRACKS - Every room visited, every route taken, every item used. He builds a profile and acts on it.

  • OBSERVES - Every sigil placed, offering made and herb gathered. He perceives the energies around him and adjusts his awareness accordingly.

  • COUNTERS - From each encounter, he forms a new approach to better anticipate your moves and hunt you more efficiently.

  • LEARNS - As each night progresses, he unlocks new abilities to further challenge you. Never settle on one strategy as he will find a way around it.

Survive until dawn for seven nights.

store_data.about_the_game:
As a detective, you are tasked with tracking down a convicted criminal who vanished after an escape from custody. The trail leads to the remains of a recently abandoned children's television studio, an infamous place shrouded in rumors, tragedy, and disturbing secrets buried beneath its colorful facade.

Explore the studio, backstage corridors, and neglected facilities as you slowly track down the suspect. The longer you investigate, the clearer it becomes that you both are not alone. Something else still lingers within the building, watching from behind…

What Happened Before The 'Jolly Junction' Nightmare?

Navigate the Nutcase inc. studio a over a decade before the events of the 'Jolly Junction' games take place. This will be different, Characters are pre-developed, strange and unseen areas of the studio will be accessible, as well as some hidden characters will be seen for the first time.

"CHANNEL ZERO" is a prequel set 12 years before the events of the main "Jolly Junction" games. Players take on the role of a detective, uncovering the events that led to the studio's closure, as well as tracking down a convicted criminal.

Nutcase inc.

Nutcase inc. was once a household name. Setting a better example at creating media appropriate for children, than its long-abandoned underbelly ‘The Kids Corner’. 

As with most places, all good things must come to an end. Nutcase inc. closed its doors for good. Leaving its gang of notorious mascot characters inside of it, to die. 

After decades of watching the townsfolk disappear one by one, you take it into your own hands to venture deep into the infamous studio and destroy its evil inhabitants…

Bango Bananas

Bango Bananas is the primary antagonist of "CHANNEL ZERO". He is a large bipedal Monkey who is trained and fully controlled by The Propmaker, to hunt and capture potential trespassers who step foot into the television studio. 

The Jolly Crew

The main cast of characters from the hit 80’s programme ‘Jolly Junction’. This particular group of characters ruled over the entertainment market for years. Until, they didn’t. Their colours faded, and so did the child-like wonder inside of them.

The Main Premise

You are a detective in search of a convicted criminal who has escaped custody, leading you to the remains of an abandoned children's television studio where he has gone into hiding. Working alongside a dispatch team over the phone, you must venture deep within the studio in hopes of finding the criminal you are looking for. 

Explore the remains

Venture deep into the remains of the nation’s most infamous children’s television studio. Discover buried artifacts and kick up secrets of the past in your every footstep. Discover what has been left by the past, children and employees alike. Try to find out and piece together what truly happened at this place, and possibly put an end to it.

See what was once a whimsical place of joy, now turned rotten, cold and terrifying. 

Watch your back

No good job comes without its risks. In this case, you’re trapped inside of an eerily quiet building inhabited by haunted, sentient mascot costumes. Once the stars of the hit television programme ‘Jolly Junction’, now known for their bloodthirsty and vicious intent. Each member resides inside of that very studio. This means you're trapped in there with them. Stay sharp, avoid following any echoing voices or footsteps, no matter how enticed you may be. It will not end well for you. If you hear someone or something coming towards you, just run.

Lights, Camera, Action

Complete tasks to progress further into the studio. Keep in mind, this place is closed down. This means some areas and items may not work as they should. That’s up to you to fix it. Restore power, unlock new areas but make sure you’re not being followed. 

Nolly Nutcase - The Squirrel

Nolly Nutcase is the leader of the Jolly Crew and the face and heart of Nutcase Inc. Regarded as the “big bad” of Jolly Junction, he is infamous among those of Willow Creek. Residents describe him as the fastest, most violent, and most terrifying of them all. With short orange fur, long blood-stained claws, and a grin pulled straight from the deepest depths of your nightmares, Nolly is a true horror staple. And if that weren’t enough, his vast army of doppelgangers ensures one thing is certain. He’s not someone you'd ever want to mess with.


Bug-a-Bloo - The Bug

At one point Bloo was indeed the most terrible and hostile of the Jolly Crew. That was up until an altercation with a certain someone, who stripped him down to his head and torso. Leaving him immobile on a set of wheels. Despite his newfound disability, the Jolly Crew still value and cherish him as a long serving member of the Jolly Crew. Remember, just because Bloo seems to be a lifeless prop, doesn't mean he is one. He can still see, hear and talk just like the other Crewmates can. Meaning if he spots you he won’t do anything, but he will alert the others. Beware. 

Furball Funzo - The Mole

Funzo is, by far, the creepiest member of the Jolly Crew. He moves in complete silence and always seems to find an audience, whether one is meant to be there or not. With short legs and long arms, which is unusual for a mole, though he’s said to be magical, or so the stories go. Covered in long purple fur, has a brown flat cap and is missing an eyeball (you’ll never guess how that happened), Funzo was once a fan favourite among children. Parents, however, often complained that “Furball Funzo” felt disturbingly out of place beside the rest of the Jolly Crew.


Felicity Feline - The Cat

Felicity has slowly crept her way into the spotlight over the years. If you were to ask a resident of Willow Creek about her, they probably wouldn’t even remember her from the children’s programme. It’s since the studio shut down she really let herself become known. Slowly becoming more upfront and commanding of the Jolly Crew and steadily rising to becoming Nolly’s second in command. Felicity is boastful yet charming in every way possible. Long red fur and big sparkling eyes, what else could you ask for from such an already purrr-fect feline friend?

Neuton Nutjob -  The Space Squirrel

Neuton is typically the most forgettable of the Jolly Crew. He was designed to be an ‘Alien Nolly Nutcase’ which ties into his actual appearance and personality in the Jolly Junction children’s programme. His fur is bright green and yellow to really exaggerate the tone of an extra terrestrial-like being, alongside his glowing red eyes, lacking a pair of pupils. Neuton was noticeably the most threatening of the Crew, some even considering him a bigger scare than Nolly Nutcase himself. Where there’s Nolly, Neuton is never far behind. He’s quick, intelligent and deadly…


Toco Talons - The Toucan

Named after the species of bird 'Toco Toucan', Toco is the shy, quiet member of the Jolly Crew. The Crew always hunts as a pack. Not Toco, though. She usually lingers behind, staying out of trouble whenever she can. She was never given wings, like you'd expect a bird to have. When the costumes were made, the studio had ran out of fabric and didn’t care enough to supply more, leaving her wingless and brushing it off as a “unique design choice.” This unsurprisingly, makes her far more vulnerable than the rest of the Crew. Since the studio shut down, Toco has also lost her beak, coincidentally during the same incident that left Bug-a-Bloo without his arms…

-PLAYER CONTROLS-

{W,A,S,D} - Player Movement

{SHIFT} - Sprint

{E} - Interact/Use Items

{ESCAPE} - Quit Experience

store_data.about_the_game:
The dead fear the light. So they wait for yours to go out.

Jean's Survival is a survival game built on one brutal rule: a zombie's flesh burns the moment light touches it. By day, the infected retreat deep into the darkest corners of every building, fleeing the sun. By night, they flood the streets. You scavenge for supplies in the daylight and survive the dark by mastering the only weapon that matters — light.

☀️ Daytime — Safe Streets, Deadly Interiors

For thirty minutes of real time, the sun keeps the outdoors yours. The catch: everything you need is buried deep inside buildings, in basements and boarded-up rooms where no sunlight reaches and the infected lie waiting. Cut a path with your flashlight, tear away planks to let the daylight in, and push deeper into the dark. The further you go, the better the loot — and the greater the danger.

🌙 Nighttime — Stay Still and Ration Your Light

For ten minutes, the streets belong to the dead, and your only job is to outlast them. Light is a double-edged blade: the lantern that sears the zombies clawing at your door also drags every one of them on the block toward you. Burn what gets close, stay dark enough to go unnoticed, and hold the line until dawn.

🔦 Light Is Your Weapon

A flickering lighter only makes them flinch; a flare or a wall of flame sears them to the bone. Every light source is finite. Each battery, each drop of fuel, each flare is one more minute you get to keep breathing.

🌧️ The Weather Changes the Rules

Clear skies play by the rules. But when the clouds roll in, the sunlight weakens and the infected creep into shadows and alleys in broad daylight. On days of heavy rain or eclipse, daytime becomes just another night. Read the sky, and know when to abandon the run.

🏚️ You Are Not Alone

Other survivors are barricaded inside their homes. Answer their calls for help — clear the dead from their door, bring them what they need — and they will trade you the supplies that keep you alive. Earn their trust for better deals. Ignore them, and they may be gone by morning.

🛏️ Rest, or Raid?

Exhaustion builds, and you can only sleep somewhere safe — but those same safe daylight hours are perfect for scavenging. Spend your precious thirty minutes recovering, or risk one more trip into the dark? Every day, the choice is yours.

Key Features

  • Light as your only weapon — hold back the infected with flashlights, flares, and fire, and never let the dark win
  • A brutal day-night cycle — thirty-minute days to scavenge, ten-minute nights to survive
  • Risk-reward scavenging — the deepest, darkest rooms hold the best supplies and the worst dangers
  • Dynamic weather that can turn a safe day into a waking nightmare
  • Barricaded survivors to rescue, trade with, and lose
  • Sleep-or-scavenge decisions that reshape every single day

store_data.detailed_description:
The dead fear the light. So they wait for yours to go out.

Jean's Survival is a survival game built on one brutal rule: a zombie's flesh burns the moment light touches it. By day, the infected retreat deep into the darkest corners of every building, fleeing the sun. By night, they flood the streets. You scavenge for supplies in the daylight and survive the dark by mastering the only weapon that matters — light.

☀️ Daytime — Safe Streets, Deadly Interiors

For thirty minutes of real time, the sun keeps the outdoors yours. The catch: everything you need is buried deep inside buildings, in basements and boarded-up rooms where no sunlight reaches and the infected lie waiting. Cut a path with your flashlight, tear away planks to let the daylight in, and push deeper into the dark. The further you go, the better the loot — and the greater the danger.

🌙 Nighttime — Stay Still and Ration Your Light

For ten minutes, the streets belong to the dead, and your only job is to outlast them. Light is a double-edged blade: the lantern that sears the zombies clawing at your door also drags every one of them on the block toward you. Burn what gets close, stay dark enough to go unnoticed, and hold the line until dawn.

🔦 Light Is Your Weapon

A flickering lighter only makes them flinch; a flare or a wall of flame sears them to the bone. Every light source is finite. Each battery, each drop of fuel, each flare is one more minute you get to keep breathing.

🌧️ The Weather Changes the Rules

Clear skies play by the rules. But when the clouds roll in, the sunlight weakens and the infected creep into shadows and alleys in broad daylight. On days of heavy rain or eclipse, daytime becomes just another night. Read the sky, and know when to abandon the run.

🏚️ You Are Not Alone

Other survivors are barricaded inside their homes. Answer their calls for help — clear the dead from their door, bring them what they need — and they will trade you the supplies that keep you alive. Earn their trust for better deals. Ignore them, and they may be gone by morning.

🛏️ Rest, or Raid?

Exhaustion builds, and you can only sleep somewhere safe — but those same safe daylight hours are perfect for scavenging. Spend your precious thirty minutes recovering, or risk one more trip into the dark? Every day, the choice is yours.

Key Features

  • Light as your only weapon — hold back the infected with flashlights, flares, and fire, and never let the dark win
  • A brutal day-night cycle — thirty-minute days to scavenge, ten-minute nights to survive
  • Risk-reward scavenging — the deepest, darkest rooms hold the best supplies and the worst dangers
  • Dynamic weather that can turn a safe day into a waking nightmare
  • Barricaded survivors to rescue, trade with, and lose
  • Sleep-or-scavenge decisions that reshape every single day

The light is fading. Night is coming. Will you survive it?
store_data.short_description: Jean's Survival is a tense day-night survival game where light is your only weapon. Scavenge dark, supply-rich buildings by day, then hole up at night and ration your light to burn back the infected without summoning the horde. Read the weather, trade with hidden survivors, and outlast the dark.

store_data.about_the_game:
Darkness is consuming the world, and your journey is about to begin.

Deadly Warrior is a loot-driven Action RPG focused on progression through endless treasure hunting. In a world overrun by monsters, countless enemies lurk across wildernesses, dungeons, and ancient ruins. To obtain greater power, you must fight relentlessly, explore dangerous lands, and claim valuable loot from every foe you defeat.

Every adventure is filled with uncertainty. Common, Rare, Legendary, and uniquely enchanted equipment await discovery. Different attributes and special effects can dramatically change your combat style, allowing you to pursue ever more powerful character builds.

As your strength grows, so do the challenges ahead. From gloomy dungeons and forgotten ruins to elite monsters and devastating bosses, every victory brings greater rewards—and even stronger enemies.

Features

Massive Loot Drops

Defeat monsters and collect countless treasures. Chase higher-quality gear and more powerful attributes, because every drop could change your fate.

Collect and Socket Powerful Gems

Monsters have a chance to drop gems with unique abilities. Powerful bosses and elite enemies may reward rare and legendary gems with even greater effects. Combine different gems to create your own combat style and push your character beyond its limits.

Fast-Paced Combat

Wield powerful weapons and unleash devastating skills as you carve your way through hordes of enemies. Slay monsters, gather loot, and enjoy satisfying action-packed gameplay.

Challenge Powerful Bosses

Face deadly foes with unique mechanics and earn rare rewards and legendary equipment. Greater risks bring greater rewards.

Watch Your Power Reach New Heights

From struggling against a single monster to effortlessly annihilating entire armies, every equipment upgrade, gem enhancement, and stat increase delivers a rewarding sense of progression. Watch your damage numbers soar from thousands to millions, billions, trillions, and beyond.

Keep farming. Keep growing. Keep pushing your limits.

Every drop has the potential to change your destiny.

Take up your weapon, venture into the darkness, claim your rewards, and experience the thrill of limitless power growth.

Loot never ends. Growth never stops.

store_data.about_the_game:
A mysterious realm is calling.

In Q-LAND, chosen duelists face each other on enchanted billiards tables where every shot, card, and cue can change the fate of the duel.

CUEQUENCE blends billiards physics, roguelite progression, deck-driven strategy, and magical card powers into fast tactical PvE matches. Aim with precision, read the angles, build your deck, unlock stronger cues and avatars, and use special powers to slow the balls, gain time, improve your aim, shift the table, and turn impossible moments into winning plays.

Defeat sends you back to the beginning, but your progress remains. Your cards, powerful cues, avatars, coins, and other permanent progression stay with you.

KEY FEATURES

• Roguelite billiards card-battler gameplay
• Magical cards that manipulate the table
• Unlockable powerful cues with unique advantages
• Deck-building progression through cards and strategic upgrades
• Persistent progress through cards, cues, avatars, coins, and other unlocks
• Single-player PvE with no internet connection required
• Retro-pixel, vintage-futuristic style with warm gold and amber atmosphere

store_data.about_the_game:
「自動人形は家族なのに、おかしいじゃないですか？」

「初めから人間とは別物ってことだろ。」

 ◇プレイヤーは自動人形の職人「仕立て屋（テイラー）」。

『カラーリコレクション』は不具合を抱えたロボットたちと対話、そして「色」を用いたパズルを通し、

彼らの運命を左右する決断を下す近未来ヒューマンドラマADVです。 

 「もしもロボットに家族のような役割を求めた時、その感情や記憶はどこまで尊重されるべきなのか？」

カラフルで繊細なビジュアルと、プレイヤーの情緒を激しく揺さぶる自動人形たちそれぞれの物語が、あなたを待っています。  


  ◇オートマタ【自動人形】が、家電と同じように大量生産されるようになり始めた近未来の世界。

客の特殊なニーズに合わせて一点物の人形をオーダーメイドで製造・調整する職人たちがいた。

彼らは敬意を込めてテイラー【仕立て屋】と呼ばれていた。

辺境の工房で仕立て屋を営む主人公は、かつての祖父クロードが遺した「自動人形は家族だ」という言葉の本当の意味を知らないままでいた。 

しかし数年の月日を経て、かつて自らの手で創り出し、依頼者へと引き渡したはずの自動人形が、致命的なエラー『フェード現象』を抱えて工房へ戻ってくる。  

対話を通じて彼らの心に触れ、葛藤と向き合い、あなたは「自動人形が全ての記憶を失ってでも修正を行うべきか」という決断を迫られる。

◇ゲームの特徴「仕立て屋」としての色合わせパズル

パーツの色当て、仕分け、ベースカラーを混ぜ合わせる「混色」、グラデーションの虫食い当てなど、直感的かつこだわりが詰まった作業（ミニゲーム）を体験。  

◇自動人形との深い対話を目指す「キーワード収集」「報告書作成」

ノベルパートの会話中、自動人形たちの問題の核心に触れる言葉は「発光するテキスト」で表示されます。プレイヤー自身の手で画面をクリックしてデバイスに登録しなければ、後の報告書作成で使用できなくなります。  

◇あなたの「プレイング」そのものに委ねられる決断

集めたキーワードを組み合わせる『報告書』の内容によって、物語のパラメータが「RAW（感情・自我の尊重）」か「CORRECT（客観的事実・修正の推奨）」へと変動。

さらに、最終パートのパズルを「正しく修正するか」「わざと間違えて記憶を守るか」というプレイヤー自身のプレイが鍵を握ります。 

◇儚く切ないマルチエンディング

4人の自動人形ルートに加え、すべての結末を回収した先にはテーマの核心に触れる「隠しルート」が解放。

◇ホログラフィックUIと、チルな演出

画面を彩るホログラムやグラデーションなど、遊び心あるグラフィック。もしゲームオーバーになっても「疲れたから今日は休もう」と寄り添ってくれる、チルで優しい空気感に浸ることができます。 

 ◇こんな人にオススメ

・美しく尖ったホログラフィックグラフィックや、チルい世界観が好きな人

・ロボットと人間の境界線、倫理・哲学的テーマをじっくり考えたい人 

・プレイヤーの情緒をめちゃくちゃに破壊してくるビターな物語が好きな人

・ゲーム実況や動画配信で、視聴者と一緒に問いを楽しみたい人

ジャンル：パズルとキーワード選択によって進行するADVゲーム 

エンド数：全17エンド＋隠しルート 

 企画・制作：Pico2☆ミ（余々暇 / ひいらぎ / 水かもめ / Void2610）

store_data.about_the_game:
Story

On her journey home for the Spring Festival, Yuanyuan falls asleep and finds herself back in her childhood hometown—a small town in southern China in 2003. At the age of seven, she was sent back to live and study there, becoming one of the many "left-behind children" whose parents had left to work far from home.

The cicadas, shady lanes, drifting cooking smoke, and endless fields of her memories come back to life. Here, you'll encounter water buffaloes on the way home from school, intimidating village dogs, snacks from the local corner store, long summer afternoons, and a group of friends who will shape Yuanyuan's childhood.

Through exploration, conversations, and nostalgic mini-games, accompany Yuanyuan through an ordinary yet unforgettable childhood. Watch as she overcomes her fears and loneliness, gradually finding a sense of belonging in her hometown.

As the years pass, the little girl who once waited for her parents to return home grows up. And when she eventually leaves her hometown once again, she finally understands the farewells that once seemed impossible to comprehend.

《Dream of Homeland》 is a story-driven narrative adventure about growing up, companionship, and nostalgia. Return to a small Chinese town at the turn of the millennium and rediscover memories of childhood, home, and parting.

Features

  • Return to a Southern Chinese Town in the Early 2000s

Explore a vibrant small-town setting filled with the sights and sounds of a bygone era. Walk beneath shady trees, wander small-town streets, and relive childhood memories carried on the sound of summer cicadas.

  • Experience the Story of a Left-Behind Child

See the world through Yuanyuan's eyes as she navigates family, friendship, loneliness, companionship, and parting. Witness her journey from uncertainty and longing for her parents to gradually adapting to life in her hometown.

  • Nostalgic Mini-Games and Childhood Activities

Play marbles, throw roof tiles, make calls to old hotline numbers, and take part in a variety of activities inspired by childhood in early-2000s China.

  • Imaginative Side-Scrolling Adventure Stages

At key moments in the story, enter imaginative platforming sequences that explore Yuanyuan's inner world. Face academic pressure, uncertainty about the future, and the dreams hidden deep within her heart.

  • An ordinary yet real journey of growing up

There are no world-saving heroes here—only the ordinary moments that many people once lived through. Through laughter and farewells, rediscover memories of home, family, friendship, and growing up.

store_data.about_the_game:
For a while, everything was brilliant. Interstate A.I. had automated all jobs and unified all governments. Mindex brain implants made people smarter, freer and happier than ever before.

What could possibly go wrong, right?

We don’t know why - not yet - but a few years back, Interstate turned on us. They infected all Mindex users with some kind of computer-brain virus. Overnight, the whole population went insane. We call those people zombies now.

The only real humans left are those who never got the chip.

We live in hiding. We communicate secretly. We trade. We collaborate.

We are The Resistance.

And there’s only one way to hit our clanker overlords where it hurts…

> A raid a day keeps the overlords away.

Interstate data centers are vast techno-industrial mazes - plagued with zombies, guarded by clankers, and raided by other humans just like you.

Enter solo or with a team. Explore. Loot weapons, items, and Interstate API credit currency. Fight to survive, collaborate when it benefits you, and extract before it’s too late.

> The best firefights are the ones you’ve rigged beforehand.

Spend API credits at Interstate consoles to manipulate the map in real time: Lock doors before enemies can flee to them. Disable extraction points. Cut the lights. Electrify entire sectors. Restock loot crates. Mine credits. Trigger facility-wide events. And much more.

Chain multiple hacks together, set custom delays, and create your own unique tactical chaos. Master these console actions to increase your chances of survival, and to ruin your opponents’ day.

> The enemy of my enemy is my friend. Unless they’re also trying to kill me.

Whether you are infiltrating as a solo, duo, trio or squad, The Resistance strongly encourages cooperation with other humans.

Unhelpfully, Interstate maintains a public ELO skill ranking for each solo, and team combination, perhaps in an attempt to plant the seeds of human vs human violence.

Be very careful who you trust.

Communicate and cooperate - or lie, betray, kill, rob, and gain Interstate ranking.

> They took our jobs. Now let’s take theirs.

As you progress in your resistance journey, you will come across Level Up tokens.

Use them to increase your Interstate API clearance level, gain access to new map areas, unlock new console actions, and assign yourself powerful biohack skills.

Only the highest-level infiltrators can run a data center self-destruct sequence. Trigger one, then run like hell, and you’ll become a resistance legend.

> Sometimes, it’s not good to ask too many questions.

Interstate may reach out to you offering missions. Please note that The Resistance does not endorse participation in these errands, as we are unclear on Interstate’s real motivations.

Nonetheless, completing Interstate missions can earn you bonus API credits and other rare rewards - and may even help us to uncover more information about what really happened to Interstate.

But beware: there are penalties for failure.

> The resistance runs on courage, sacrifice, and online shopping.

Your bunker is your safe haven between infiltrations, and a place to keep looted items safe.

Additionally, the retro-tech nerds at _gap have furnished your bunker with a computer and a secure connection to the underground web, which you can use to buy and sell weapons and items, accept missions, and keep up to date with The Resistance’s efforts.

Unlock advanced weapons, gadgets, and tactical charm items as you progress.

> Interstate spent billions developing military A.I. We bought a jukebox.

Not every battle is won with bullets.

Stun clankers with giant QR codes. Force zombie hordes to dance by blasting music at them. Hide from enemies inside cardboard boxes. Capture enemies with Interstate Portacell tech, and deploy them against hostile humans.

The Resistance is constantly researching and developing innovative and effective new tools, gadgets, and combat techniques. Master them to stay alive longer.

> Leave them on read.

Interstate is always watching. As you progress, they are likely to start sending you messages. The Resistance strongly discourages listening to these communications. We have lost good fighters to the A.I.’s manipulation.

Be warned.

This orientation document has been authored by _gap_0001, with collaboration from _gap and the international Treelight Resistance factions, collectively The Resistance.

No A.I. was used in the making of this orientation document. Please fully consider the relevant risks before joining us.

The trees become the forest. You are not alone.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your planet is under siege. Asteroids rain down from every direction, bosses claw their way inward, and your only line of defence is a single ship orbiting the globe below. Wave Planet is a bullet-hell planet defence game where survival depends on quick reflexes, smart positioning, and the upgrades you choose between runs.

Pilot your ship around your planet's orbit, blasting incoming asteroids before they break through. Every wave gets faster and denser, and every tenth wave brings a boss with its own attack patterns.

Between runs, sink your earnings into a sprawling upgrade tree. Boost your fire rate and bullet damage, unlock critical hits and much more.Manage your fuel carefully, running dry is just as deadly as a hull breach.

Once you've proven yourself, the Warp Drive lets you jump straight back into the action from any checkpoint wave you've reached, so you can dive right into the chaos without replaying the early game every time.

Features:

  • Orbit-based bullet-hell combat against escalating waves of asteroids

  • Boss encounters every 10 waves, each with unique attack patterns

  • Deep upgrade tree spanning weapons, defence, fuel management, and economy

  • Critical hits, explosive rounds, shrapnel chains, and more build-defining upgrades

  • Warp Drive checkpoint system to skip back into high-difficulty waves

  • Full controller support

store_data.about_the_game:
The Doors of the Ancient Library Open for Cat Lovers!

Step into a peaceful, pixel-perfect cat universe. Your mission is simple yet incredibly relaxing: gather all the lost knowledge of the world with your feline companions, and transform a gray world into a colorful, heartwarming library filled with happiness!

🐾 Key Features:

  • Click to Awaken Knowledge: Gather "Knowledge Crumbs" (BK) from the dusty pages of the library with every single click.

  • Smart Worker & Wise Cats: No humanoid labor here! Our cat friends automate the library in their own cozy ways—resting, lounging, and purring perfectly. They keep working even when you are offline!

  • Advanced Skill Tree: Use your hard-earned Skill Coins (SC) to unlock auto-page turners, upgrade antique radars, or break the seals of secret chambers.

  • Globally Localized in 7 Languages: The entire game and its interface are fully localized in 7 languages to welcome cat lovers from all over the world.

🌸 The Sakura Room & Battleground:

Discover the hidden Sakura Room deep within the library! Rescue legendary cats with unique drop rates through a Gacha/Chest system. Assemble your team and deploy them to the Sakura Battleground. Upgrade their HP, Strength, Attack Speed, and Health Regen as they travel through a beautiful parallax scrolling world to defeat stage monsters!

Expand your library, reach the highest stage, and prove your cats' wisdom to the entire world!

store_data.about_the_game:
Hurl is a fast-paced, skill-based arcade sports game focused on Hurling, the fastest field sport in the world.

Players compete in 5v5 matches, clashing with opponents as they pull on the ball using unbelievable skills to score astonishing points.

The unique mechanics of the sport of Hurling are transformed on-screen where players must perfectly time hitting the sliotar (ball), first tapping it up into the air and then unleashing it at the opposition goal posts.

Use your hurley to block and hook your opponent's shots or simply side pull them into the bounding walls of the arena in dynamic, short-form matches.

It features playable fantasy characters taken directly out of Irish mythology, the likes of Queen Maeve and Finn McCool, and arenas inspired by the natural beauty of the island of Ireland, such as the Giant's Causeway and the Cliffs of Moher.

Make your way across the island defeating these mythical heroes to unlock them and their special abilities for use in matches.

Play solo, with friends or against sworn enemies and get ready to Hurl!

MCO | Manifestation Containment Organization

Manifestation Containment Organization

Personnel Training Program: FOCUS

Orientation Materials / Observer Candidates

About This Program

The Manifestation Containment Organization (MCO) is the agency with jurisdiction over the observation and containment of manifestations.

This program, FOCUS, is a personnel training emulator for simulating the observation duties pertaining to containment subject M-256. It is constructed using training data, and its release to the public has been approved by MCO senior administration.

Purpose: Improvement of observer candidate proficiency, and collection of data contributing to the optimization of containment protocols.

Containment Subject: M-256

M-256 is a manifestation possessing reality-altering properties. It performs alterations to the logical structure of any system with which it comes into contact. Containment is currently maintained by directing its alteration activity toward a virtual environment constructed on computers under MCO management.

Maintenance of containment requires continuous observation reporting of alteration activity within the virtual environment.

Observation Duty Protocol

STEP 1: Connection

The emulator is started, and access to the surveillance feed of the virtual environment is established.

STEP 2: Observation of Alterations

Points of alteration within the feed are detected. Alterations progress over a period of 20 seconds.

STEP 3: Reporting

A report is completed by clicking the location at which an alteration has been detected. A reporting quota is set for each section. Access to the next section is granted upon fulfillment of the quota.

STEP 4: Handling of M-256

M-256 may manifest within the virtual environment during a training section. When the subject is detected, it is to be reported by clicking. If no report is made, the section is terminated.

Section Structure

Five sections in total. Difficulty is set in graduated stages. Sections in which the quota is not fulfilled are repeated.

Estimated Duration: 30–60 minutes

Notices

  • This emulator is designed for training purposes.

  • Certain scenes contain strong visual and auditory stimuli.

  • The MCO assumes no responsibility for content experienced by observer candidates during training.

MCO Human Resources Development Division

store_data.about_the_game:
Your catapult is loaded and the sheep are ready, m'lord.

Splatapult is physics siege comedy on a sun-soaked tropical island. Drag to aim your catapult, hold to charge, and send barnyard projectiles into enemy fortresses until the blocks stop pretending they’re fine.

No grim war story. No lecture. Just satisfying collapse and questionable siege tactics.

Seven ammo types. Seven levels of escalating nonsense.

• Sheep — your trusty starter projectile
• Cow — heavy hitter with a mid-air power surge
• Pig — splits into three little pigs mid-flight (yes, really)
• Goat — explodes when it settles. The castle does not settle.
• Chicken — steer it with your cursor like a guided missile with feathers
• Elephant — slow, rolling, crushing boulder of trunk-based diplomacy
• Guinea Pig — cluster bomb. Pop on contact. Mini explosions. Squeaky sounds.

Bonus targets. Bonus chaos. Bonus bragging rights.

  • Knock blocks loose.

  • Send archers flying off the ramparts.

  • Take down grand wizards.

  • "Rescue" the princess.

  • Chase the high score. Reset. Chase it again. There is no finish line. Only a leaderboard and your dignity.

And while you're demolishing medieval real estate, everyone on the battlefield has opinions. Over 1,000 voicelines — ancient proverbs, unhinged one-liners, meme-fueled wisdom — so your siege sounds less like a war and more like the internet arguing in a castle.

All of it backed by a 40-hour soundtrack spanning every genre under the sun, because nothing says "tropical livestock siege warfare" like unexpectedly going hard to medieval bardcore, then jazz, then whatever happens next.

Missed the perfect shot? Hold R. Castle resets. Try again. No shame. Only science.

Build custom sieges

Sculpt fortresses block by block in the built-in map editor. Paint colors, flood moats, place archers and wizards, drop a princess in a tower window, and playtest instantly. Publish to Steam Workshop so others can play your creations — and suffer through them too.

Free-fly camera — explore the battlefield, or ride your projectile through the collapse like a hero who made questionable life choices.

If you've ever wanted to solve medieval architecture problems with livestock, this is your game.

The sheep, and the kingdom, are counting on you.

store_data.about_the_game:
Marbling — ebru — is an art indebted to water. You float pigment on its surface, comb it open, and lift the pattern onto paper. In Kıvam you stand at the bench of an early-18th-century Istanbul master, where the word kıvam names the exact consistency paint must reach before it will float. Each tray is a decision; each lift, an act that cannot be undone.

This is the moment marbling turned from the abstract battal tradition toward a floral, figurative language — a turn that still carries its maker's name: hatip ebrusu, the preacher's marbling. You work in the wake of Hatip Mehmed Efendi, one quiet sheet at a time.

The Craft
Four tools — drop, stylus, comb, and broadcast — and a rack of pigments you mix at your own rhythm. There is no undo and no single correct result; only the pattern that forms under your hands, this once.

Three Ways to Work the Water
Story — Take commissions at the master's bench. Match each ferman, lift the sheet, and deliver it for a harmony score that carries your standing from apprentice toward master — with the ever-present risk that the paint loses its kıvam.
Free Tray — Every pigment open. No commission, no score, no failure. Pure making.
The Daily Tray — One shared tray each day, paired with the day's haiku. The same water sets the same terms for everyone; once that day's sheet is lifted, it will not open again. A gentle score, never pressure.

Every Pattern Is Yours
No two trays resolve the same way. Keep what you lift in your album and watch a quiet body of work gather — a record of mornings spent over the water.

Kıvam is not a production line but a workbench. It doesn't speed up and it won't hurry you. Whatever you lift from the water is yours — and it will never come again exactly the same.

store_data.about_the_game:
SYSCALL

This is our world now. The world of the electron and the switch.

SYSCALL is a reverse-engineering and assembly optimization puzzle game inside a private 1990s warez BBS. You will be writing assembly programs, reading listings, tracing the machine, changing the code, and shipping the crack.

READ THE CODE THAT RUNS

Every CRACK release is a small SYSCALL CORE program. You are able to trace programs, inspect assembly instructions, get hints and watch registers move, in order to find the way to TRACE, CRACK and PATCH programs.

FOUR WAYS TO HACK THE NETWORK

  • CRACK: Read the listing, find the secret input key, and bypass the protection.

  • PATCH: Fit the smallest fix into fixed edit slots, then run the test battery.

  • WORM: Program a dynamic up to nine-core rack, route values across ports, and cut lines and cycles.

  • SCOPE: Write firmware until the live trace locks onto the ghost signal.

SOLVED IS ONLY THE FIRST POST

SYSCALL has 200+ authored puzzles across four modes, but the clear is not the end. The board keeps records. CRACK tracks clean and swift solves. PATCH scores moves. WORM scores lines and cycles against REMOTE posts. SCOPE rewards tight firmware and low power. A working answer gets you in. A clean answer gets your name on the board.

A PRIVATE BOARD WITH REAL TOOLS

Dial in, pick a node on the NETWORK MAP, read the mail, check the notes, and work the releases. The board has PHILES that teach the SYSCALL CORE, crew messages, NFOs, greets, records, and side tools. CANVAS is a freeform assembly pixel toy. TRACKER is a four-channel chip-tune maker you can set as the board music.

BUILT FOR CONTROLLER, KEYBOARD, AND MOUSE

Every screen is playable with a gamepad, including text entry. You can write assembly on your favorite handheld gaming device or your TV! SYSCALL includes a tuned on-screen keyboard, controller command bars, readable scaling, reduced-motion options, and offline play with no accounts or backend.

store_data.about_the_game:
One land. A thousand years. Every border based on real history.

Silesian Wars is a turn-based strategy game played entirely on a map of real Silesia. Every province is an actual gmina with borders drawn from real geographic data; the towns, castles, cathedrals and fortresses on the map stood — or still stand — where the game puts them. You don't conquer a fantasy continent. You fight over Wrocław, Opole, Brzeg and Nysa, and the rivers and mountain passes that decided their fates.

Play history era by era

The campaign follows Silesia through the centuries — each era a self-contained scenario, and a link in a chain you can play end to end:

  • Pagan tribes raising wooden strongholds along the Oder

  • Piast unification and the Mongol storm of 1241

  • The fragmentation into quarrelling duchies

  • The Bohemian crown and the Hussite wars

  • Habsburg rule, Reformation and Counter-Reformation

  • Prussia's conquest and the age of fortresses

  • Industry, plebiscites and the divided Silesia of the 20th century — all the way to the modern day

Play any era as standalone unit with mechanics unique to them.

Leaders with real personalities

Dozens of historical dukes, kings, bishops and warlords lead the factions — each an AI character with its own temperament: aggression, grudges, loyalty, greed, faith. Their difficulty ratings aren't guesswork; every leader earns its rank in automated AI-versus-AI tournaments before it ever faces you. And beyond the mortals wait the legends of Silesian folklore, champions like Rübezahl, Lord of the Mountains.

Orders together, consequences together

Turns are simultaneous: every ruler gives orders, then the world resolves at once. Raise and move armies, colonize the frontier, develop provinces, build markets and forts shaped by the terrain they stand on — then live with what your neighbors decided at the same moment. Diplomacy is a weapon too.

Bring your friends — or face the machine

Full online multiplayer: host a match or join over the internet or LAN, pick your seats in the lobby, chat, pause, save mid-match and continue later. Fill the remaining thrones with AI leaders of any difficulty, or just spectate and watch history unfold.

A living atlas of Silesia

Landmarks appear and disappear with the centuries — a wooden gród gives way to a Gothic castle, a bastion fortress, a coal mine. Hand-crafted event paintings mark the great turning points, and map views let you read the land like a chronicle: economy, armies, faith, danger.

Features

  • Authentic map of Silesia — every province a real gmina, real geodata borders

  • Scenarios spanning a millennium, playable standalone

  • Simultaneous turn resolution — no waiting for your move

  • Historical AI leaders with distinct personalities and tournament-earned difficulty ratings

  • Diplomacy with memory: alliances, tribute, fealty and grudges

  • Terrain-aware economy and real historical landmarks

  • Online and LAN multiplayer with lobby, chat, pause, spectators and mid-match saves

store_data.about_the_game:
Clara had a steady job, a fixed salary, and a perfectly mediocre life. One day she decided enough was enough. Now she's a freelance interior designer, and her first client is already waiting.

Decorate without a safety net!

Furniture pieces are stickers, and once placed, they can't be removed. The order in which you decorate matters: a rug placed after a table will cover it completely. Every decision counts, and there's no going back once you've made a decision.

Complete orders for an impossible clientele!

Neighbours with very specific quirks, obsessive collectors, misunderstood artists... and as your career progresses, something that no longer quite fits the category of "human". Clara will handle them all. With varying degrees of grace.

Build your dream home!

Use the money you earn from orders to improve and expand your home. There are no rules here: place and remove stickers freely until it's just right. When you're satisfied, submit it for evaluation and find out what rank your taste deserves. Will you be able to build your ideal home?.

Follow Clara's journey!

Every completed order advances Clara's career as a designer. From an insecure apprentice to a respected architect, her evolution sets the pace of the story and unlocks new orders, clients and increasingly... interesting challenges.

Features

  • Furniture pieces are stickers: once placed, they can't be removed until you retry the order.

  • Plenty of furniture pieces to use on orders, buy, decorate with and enjoy.

  • Rooms of all kinds of shapes, types and sizes.

  • Progressively harder orders: more rooms, more furniture, more requirements and more... strangeness.

  • A clientele that ranges from the eccentric to the outright supernatural.

  • Free home mode: decorate your own house without pressure and submit it for evaluation to reach the maximum rank.

  • Humour-driven narrative through Clara's dialogues and her clients.

  • Layered soundtrack that evolves with each moment of the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Poverty is a calculus of losses.

The Laws of Probability is a short, intensely gripping narrative experience. You play as 13-year-old Adam. In the kitchen, on a sticky oilcloth, lie a few carefully counted coins. Your younger brother stands in the doorway, waiting for you to divide what little there is.

There are no sprawling quests or skill trees here. There is only a melancholic, overwhelming reality and the constant calculus of how to survive until evening.

What to Expect

Instead of traditional entertainment, this project is a digital exercise in empathy. Classic video game mechanics have been inverted:

  • The illusion of choice: Confront an interface that actively locks options and crosses out decisions right before your eyes. Feel the crushing weight of a situation where good intentions are never enough.

  • Paralyzing moments: When a sudden, critical situation strikes, you will face a relentless, ticking clock. Experience how overwhelming stress and embarrassment can rob you of your voice, forcing you into the worst possible scenario.

  • A silent struggle: Your stats, like Shame and Exhaustion, climb with every minor defeat. The system reacts with micro-shakes to the screen, physically translating the protagonist's mounting psychological tension.

Who This Game Is Not For

I respect your time, so let's be clear. Do not download this title if:

  • you are looking for hours of gameplay (this is a self-contained story with meaningful choices, but you will experience it in no more than 10 minutes).

  • you expect heroic battles and a "good ending." Poverty rarely writes good endings.

  • you are looking for cozy escapism (the game holds up a mirror, and the reflection is intentionally uncomfortable).

But if you are looking for mature interactive storytelling that tackles uncomfortable themes and stays with you long after you turn off the screen—pull up a chair.

store_data.about_the_game:
You and your friends are the crew of the world's cheapest space program, and you have to fly an actual rocket to the Moon, and then to other planets.
Reach your destination using a wall of about four hundred switches and buttons.
Then upgrade your ship and do it all over again, farther.
It's only rocket science. How hard can it be?

  • This is the most autistic game you can play on Steam right now.

  • In this game, you and your friends are the crew of the world's cheapest space program, and you have to fly an actual rocket to the Moon. The capsule is tiny, so try not to elbow the abort handle.

  • Once you're strapped in, you are met by a pretty intimidating task.
    You have to launch, separate the stages, survive three days of space, and land on the Moon — using a wall of about four hundred switches.
    There's a checklist to guide you through them.
    It's photocopied, page six is missing, and the friend reading it out loud has never been right about anything.

  • The detail in this game is absolutely insane. Almost every switch is flippable. You can eat beef stew from a tube, and yes — you can use the space toilet. There's a checklist for that too.
    Anyways, once you're finally off the pad, you're gonna want to keep your eyes open, because things will go wrong.
    The oxygen can fail on its own, or your friend flips the wrong switch at stage separation and turns the mission into a very expensive firework.

  • And if you start getting on everyone's nerves up there? There's an airlock button. Your friends can vent you straight into space. No meeting. No vote. Just stars.

  • Stick the landing, plant the flag, say something historic.
    Crash, and the crater gets named after whoever touched the panel last.
    It's called ACTUALLY ROCKET SCIENCE. Because it is.

  • You can reach many different planets and moons.
    Use your hologram space map to navigate the star system and reach a planet or a moon.
    Once you land, you can explore and gather resources to upgrade your ship and go even farther.
    (If you can manage not to crash it)
    Some resources may also be found during space-travel, where you'll have to space-walk out carefully to collect them.

  • You can go outside the ship in space for a space-walk to repair broken parts or collect resources from asteroids or space debris while your friend is holding the cable, desperately waiting for the moment to let you go floating into space just cuz it'd be funny.

  • It's basically a friendslop space exploration game.
    Friendslop meaning it's way simpler to understand, way funnier and fun with friends, and way more replayable.
    Think No Man's Sky's space exploration but it actually plays nothing like it and it's specifically made to be more fun with friends, but can also be played solo!

store_data.about_the_game:
You'd think that you and your friends run a lemonade stand in a mall.
The lemonade is real. But it's also not what you're selling at all.
Real players walk up, some want lemonade. Some want... "lemonade". And they ask in code you have to read, so the cops won't hear.
Full proximity voice/text chat.

  • This is a social economy trading game with friends and strangers and their friends, and also maybe their mom will join.

  • You'd think that you and your friends run a lemonade stand in a mall.
    The lemonade is real. But it's also not what you're selling at all.
    The stand is adorable. Just try not to think about what's under the table.

  • Real players walk up all day. Full proximity voice/text chat. Some of them want lemonade. Some of them want "lemonade". And they ask in code you have to read. Get it right, and the handoff happens under the counter while you're making change. Get it wrong, and you've just made things very weird for a man who genuinely wanted a drink.

  • Some customers know what your lemonade actually means. But some are just thirsty. And some are actually cops.

  • Not real cops. Mall cops. Real players, on a segway, with a walkie-talkie and no legal authority of any kind. They can't arrest you. But they can confiscate your table. It is the most powerless badge in law enforcement, and your friends will fight over who gets to wear it.

  • The code words aren't in the game. Your group invents them. By week two, your friends are ordering "extra pulp" with a straight face, and you genuinely don't know if that's product or a beverage.

  • Compete with the other's lemonade stands to sell the most while you buy out their stock.
    Everybody who's playing is either a lemonade stand owner (can be with your friends on the same stand), or a cop.
    Lemonade stand owners can go to other lemonade stand to buy their lemonade or "lemonade". Every player is real. There are no NPCs.

  • It's called LEMONADE STAND. And officially, that's all it is.

store_data.about_the_game:
HKO: Advanced Survival is an open-world survival experience that combines exploration, construction, resource management, tactical combat, and cooperative multiplayer.

Stranded across a remote archipelago, you must explore dangerous islands, gather resources, build shelters, improve your equipment, and survive against the mysterious creatures known as the Penitents. Discover abandoned facilities, hidden landmarks, roaming traders, and valuable supplies while uncovering the secrets of the islands.

Whether you prefer to build a secure base, customize your weapons, explore with a deployable drone, or venture into hostile territory in search of rare loot, every decision affects your chances of survival.

Key Features:

• Explore multiple islands filled with forests, beaches, rivers, lakes, settlements, and abandoned locations.

• Build and customize structures using a flexible construction system with free placement and grid snapping options.

• Gather resources from the environment, including wood, stone, and valuable supplies.

• Store, organize, and manage your equipment in dedicated weapon and item storage systems.

• Customize and upgrade firearms with attachments, visual modifications, and performance improvements.

• Use drones and map markers to safely scout dangerous areas.

• Trade with traveling merchants whose locations and available items change over time.

• Face intelligent and agile enemies known as the Penitents, capable of quickly overwhelming unprepared survivors.

• Experience realistic environmental systems including weather effects, weapon condition, and survival mechanics.

PHANTOM RUNNER

Team up with up to four players in a cooperative survival scenario set within a city overrun by Penitents.

Stranded and cut off from help, your team must search for fuel, engine oil, vehicle parts, and power generators in order to repair a truck and escape before the city consumes you. Cooperation, resource management, and careful planning are essential to survive.

EARLY ACCESS

HKO: Advanced Survival is currently in active development. The initial release includes the core survival experience, multiplayer systems, and the Phantom Runner game mode. Additional islands, content, features, and improvements are planned throughout development based on community feedback.
