store_data.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO SKOOT CITY 

Your keyboard is no longer just a controller.

It is the road.

In Skoot: Keyboard Brawl, nearly every key becomes a place your car can drive. Tap a key and your Skoot turns toward it, carving a path across the whole keyboard as quickly, or recklessly as your fingers can plan one.

Cut from one side of the board to the other. Fake out an opponent. Thread between hazards. Swing around and catch somebody at the exact angle needed to break their armor.

With every key press, you are choosing where to go next.

DRIVE WITH THE WHOLE KEYBOARD

Skoot’s keyboard-control system turns driving into a rapid conversation between your hands and the arena. Nearby keys create tight corrections. Distant keys create bold charges across the board. Chaining them together lets you curve through traffic, snap into evasive turns, or commit to one precise full-speed ram.

It feels immediate, strange, and surprisingly natural once your fingers start thinking like a car. The keyboard becomes your way of escaping very bad traffic.

Every collision is judged by positioning and angle. T-bone another Skoot to destroy it, while protecting your own sides from the same fate. Meet head-on and both drivers might regret it.

THE CITY THAT NEVER SKOOTS

Skoot City is full of mind-controlled, self driving vehicles, you are one of the remaining conscious Skoot. Explore shifting environments, sudden hazards, strange machines, and cars that seem determined to solve every disagreement by accelerating into it.

The atmosphere can change from a clean competitive brawl to complete mechanical chaos in seconds. Armor breaks scatter across the keys. Power-ups appear in dangerous places. Engines rise and dip as cars weave around one another.

BRAWL YOUR WAY

Jump into quick arena battles against AI or other players. Break through rival armor, survive sudden-death hazards, collect unpredictable power-ups, and score by being the last Skoot still driving.

Matches are easy to understand, but the keyboard gives you room to develop your own movement style and tactics. Experienced players carefully trace routes around the arena.

WORLDS OF SKOOT

The story mode brings the keyboard-controlled excitement to unique challenges.

store_data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO SKOOT CITY 

Your keyboard is no longer just a controller.

It is the road.

In Skoot: Keyboard Brawl, nearly every key becomes a place your car can drive. Tap a key and your Skoot turns toward it, carving a path across the whole keyboard as quickly, or recklessly as your fingers can plan one.

Cut from one side of the board to the other. Fake out an opponent. Thread between hazards. Swing around and catch somebody at the exact angle needed to break their armor.

With every key press, you are choosing where to go next.

DRIVE WITH THE WHOLE KEYBOARD

Skoot’s keyboard-control system turns driving into a rapid conversation between your hands and the arena. Nearby keys create tight corrections. Distant keys create bold charges across the board. Chaining them together lets you curve through traffic, snap into evasive turns, or commit to one precise full-speed ram.

It feels immediate, strange, and surprisingly natural once your fingers start thinking like a car. The keyboard becomes your way of escaping very bad traffic.

Every collision is judged by positioning and angle. T-bone another Skoot to destroy it, while protecting your own sides from the same fate. Meet head-on and both drivers might regret it.

THE CITY THAT NEVER SKOOTS

Skoot City is full of mind-controlled, self driving vehicles, you are one of the remaining conscious Skoot. Explore shifting environments, sudden hazards, strange machines, and cars that seem determined to solve every disagreement by accelerating into it.

The atmosphere can change from a clean competitive brawl to complete mechanical chaos in seconds. Armor breaks scatter across the keys. Power-ups appear in dangerous places. Engines rise and dip as cars weave around one another.

BRAWL YOUR WAY

Jump into quick arena battles against AI or other players. Break through rival armor, survive sudden-death hazards, collect unpredictable power-ups, and score by being the last Skoot still driving.

Matches are easy to understand, but the keyboard gives you room to develop your own movement style and tactics. Experienced players carefully trace routes around the arena.

store_data.about_the_game:
DiceVenture Dungeon is a roguelike dice-building dungeon crawler.

Descend as an adventurer into procedurally generated dungeons. Plan your route across a node map—encounter battles, resupply, growth, and random events. Every step shapes your resources, risk, and rewards for the run.

Combat revolves around dice. Roll, reroll, and assign faces; combine Blade, Heart, Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Star elements to meet skill thresholds and unleash class abilities. After each fight, pick from rewards—new dice, relics, engraved traits, and skill upgrades—to build a unique dice bag and skill board every run.

Exploration is dice-driven too. Some branching options are gated behind dice challenges—roll the required combination or pip total to unlock better rewards.

Key Features

  • Dice building — Manage your bag, upgrade faces, fuse engraved traits; amplify your archetype with traits and relics

  • Tactical combat — Skill slots, bonus sockets, Focus, and class resources (e.g. Warrior Morale / Battle Intent) drive deep turn-by-turn decisions

  • Procedural dungeons — Main paths and branches with elites, resupply, growth, danger nodes, and pre-boss tuning rooms

  • Branching events — Exploration events and choice nodes where dice tests meet risk vs. reward

  • Roguelike runs — Random encounters, random rewards, run saves—every descent plays differently

store_data.about_the_game:
Gameplay

Explore a surreal world haunted by the number 13 as you guide Lune through a series of challenging obstacles, mysterious locations, and disturbing memories.

  • Navigate fast-paced crossing challenges inspired by classic road-crossing games, where timing and precision are essential for survival.

  • Master parkour mechanics to jump across dangerous gaps, avoid deadly hazards, and reach hidden areas.

  • Solve environmental puzzles that reveal fragments of Lune's past and uncover clues about his mother's disappearance.

  • Survive increasingly twisted levels where reality bends around the curse of the number 13.

  • Discover secrets hidden throughout the world and piece together the truth behind the voice that called out, "Little Bunny."

Every challenge brings Lune closer to the answers he seeks—but some truths may be better left forgotten.

RATED 18+

This game contains themes of psychological horror, distressing imagery, loud sounds, flashing visuals, and depictions designed to provoke fear and anxiety.

Player discretion is strongly advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
FitBlocks is a relaxing wooden block puzzle game about fitting every piece perfectly into the tray.

Drag wooden pieces onto the board, rotate them, and find a way to fill the entire shape. There are no timers, scores, or penalties. Take your time, think through each arrangement, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of making every piece fall into place.

Each stage is handcrafted around a pixel-art inspired silhouette, from simple shapes to more challenging layouts. Early stages are easy to understand, while later puzzles introduce more pieces, unusual shapes, and trickier spaces to solve.

Features:

- Handcrafted block-fitting puzzles

- Relaxing wooden puzzle theme

- Simple mouse controls

- Rotate and place pieces at your own pace

- No timers, scores, or pressure

- Stage select and progressive unlocks

- Challenge stages for players who want harder puzzles

- Calm background music and cozy sound effects

store_data.about_the_game:
The Chronicle of 20"67"

Rav A'ScarraCrow JustUse'Godot: Get freed from the "Rav A'ScarraCrow" thinking. They believe they found a real clue, but in fact, you must prove you are not incapable of thinking for yourself.

Protect the Jets Entity:

Jets is a beautiful entity that probably smiles and smells great. You need to protect Jets from the evil Jolly Wo'Angar.

Defeat the Evil Jolly Wo'Angar:

The evil Jolly Wo'Angar thinks he looks like an Australian version of Cruise. He thinks he’s right because he was allowed by his own genetics to say gross things, like "hackor smallest in the world."

The Weight of the World:

The way you see Crelly rounding herself up every day and changing reminds you of the times you will never be able to achieve because of the things that keep dragging you down. It brings the fear of wondering what the reason for living is. It makes you feel like you would want to have a bit of the LimesDancey in yourself, too.

The Burnout:

Feeling emotional burnout because you keep trying to do the stuff you feel you are only allowed to do. But passing through the Squ tree each day makes you realize she keeps spreading her branches every day, because for her, her branches are her "tools"—while you feel punished by the evil Wo'Angar.

The Villain’s Mockery:

Jolly Wo'Angar would call you a dumbass and mock you, thinking he "looks handsome because he deserves it" like the worst cartoonish villain. Yet, if you want your own "third place," you always need to fight, because they judge your intentions by your look.

The Powerhouse of the Cell:

When you feel almost defeated and like giving up on your own life, you are reminded of Layna. She felt mocking to you when she said, "Issues are the powerhouse of the cell." But unlike her, you don't have a "third place" that can carry you when you are at your best or at your worst. You can't just say, "That's right, that's where I quit," and move on.

But unlike her, they're never gonna put you in a game as a 'sexy nurse' in some average, bottom-barrel horror shovelware videogame where everyone is happy, or even paste your almost-balding head on a snorshe, because in fact, who are you? You aren't some marketable looking Jets, aren't you?

What You Actually Do In This Game: Behind all the emotional burnout and Wo'Angar's mockery, this is a puzzle game about figuring things out for yourself.

Spawn Mechanics: Summon objects and tools into the world to overcome obstacles.

No Hand-Holding: Just like dealing with the weight of the world, you have to figure out how to get to the flag on your own.

A fairly short experience that is meant to be "enjoyed like a box of cherry cordials" (like what even does it have to do with game???)

store_data.about_the_game:
STATO is a procedural grand strategy sandbox about building a nation in a world that does not wait for you.

Every campaign begins with a generated strategic map shaped by geography, resources, borders, coastlines, population, and rival powers. From there, you create a state, define its identity, and guide it through an unstable world where industry, diplomacy, logistics, and war all shape the course of history.

Expand your economy, secure vital resources, strengthen your infrastructure, and prepare your armed forces for conflicts that can emerge from ambition, rivalry, scarcity, or fear. Every province matters: cities drive power, frontiers create tension, ports open trade, and weak supply can break even the strongest offensive.

STATO is built around emergent campaigns. Nations rise, compete, fracture, and collide across a living strategic map. There is no single scripted path to victory. Your country may become an industrial power, a cautious regional actor, an expansionist empire, or a fragile state struggling to survive between stronger neighbors.

Build a State

Create and customize your nation, shape its political identity, and lead it through a procedurally generated world. Your choices define how your country grows, how others perceive it, and how far it can push before instability catches up.

Rule an Economy

Population, industry, infrastructure, resources, trade, and supply form the foundation of national power. Growth requires planning, and military ambition needs an economy strong enough to sustain it.

Redraw the Balance of Power

The world is shaped by competing ambitions. Build alliances, isolate rivals, secure strategic resources, and exploit international crises. Every decision influences the balance of power and can change the course of history.

Command War at Scale

Mobilize forces, hold frontlines, protect supply, and fight across land, sea, and air. Wars are not only won by numbers: logistics, preparation, production, geography, and timing can decide the outcome.

Create and Replay

Use procedural generation, scenario support, and map editor tools to build new worlds and tell different strategic stories. Each campaign offers a new political landscape, new risks, and new opportunities.

Key Features

- Procedural grand strategy campaigns

- Nation creation and customization

- Province-based economy, population, resources, and infrastructure

- Diplomacy, rivalries, alliances, crises, and war

- Land, naval, and air warfare systems

- Supply, mobilization, frontlines, and strategic pressure

- Scenario support and map editing tools

- Multiple visual themes and strategic map modes

store_data.about_the_game:
Synopsis

My mother, who worked at a facility managing the belongings of those who met a gruesome end—the Kihin—has died. It was written off as a tragic accident... But was it really? Was it just an accident? I have to find out... what really happened on that day. Can a son chasing the truth ever uncover the reality? Your choices and actions will dictate the end.

Game Features

  • Uncover the Truth: Control the protagonist and solve the mystery behind the facility where your mother passed away.

  • Branching Narrative: Your choices and actions will split the story, leading to 5 unique endings +α.

  • Touch the Memories: Interact with each Kihin (the cursed belongings) to touch their memories and piece together what happened.

Estimated Playtime

  • 10–15 minutes per playthrough to reach an ending. (A short, fast-paced story designed for high replayability.)

Recommended for players who

  • Love games where choices branch the story and change the outcome.

  • Enjoy short, bite-sized games that can be played quickly.

  • Love collecting multiple endings and uncovering every secret.

System & Specifications

  • Controls: Keyboard and Mouse only.

  • Audio/Visual: Fully voiced in Japanese with custom face motions.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your desktop just got a little wetter.

Pocket Pond is a cozy idle fishing companion that lives right on your desktop. A pixel-art angler drifts in his boat along the bottom of your screen - casting, waiting, and reeling in fish entirely on his own - through a transparent, borderless window that floats over everything else. No tab to keep open, no clicking to do. Just glance over now and then to see what's on the line.

🎣 Cast once, relax forever

  • Truly AFK - the angler fishes by himself while you work, browse, or play something else.

  • Always there - a frameless overlay that sits on your desktop and stays out of the way; click straight through to whatever's behind it.

  • Make it yours - drag it anywhere, scale it up or down, lock it in place, launch it at startup, and keep it always-on-top.

🐟 A whole pond to discover

  • 130 species of fish, from everyday commons to shimmering legendaries.

  • Five rarities to chase - every catch is a little hit of "what did I get?"

  • Fill your codex - log every species you've caught, its size and weight ranges, and your personal best.

🌊 Explore new waters

Travel between biomes - the calm Blue Lagoon, a vivid Coral Reef, a swaying Kelp Forest, a tangled Mangrove Delta, and steaming Volcanic Springs - each with its own backdrop and roster of fish. Work your way up through fishing levels to reach rarer, more valuable catches.

💰 Catch, sell, upgrade

  • Sell your haul for coins - space is limited, so decide what to keep and what to cash in.

  • Gear up in the shop: rods, reels, lines, hooks, and baits, each with effects that quicken bites, hook slippery fish, tip the odds toward rares, double your catch, and more.

  • Grow your stash by buying extra inventory slots as your collection expands.

✨ The calm little ritual in the corner of your screen

Hand-crafted pixel art, a gentle soundtrack, and dozens of achievements to chip away at. Pocket Pond is the perfect companion for focus, study, or winding down — a quiet pond that's always just a glance away.

store_data.about_the_game:
Cleaning Has Never Been This Relaxing

Last night, you hosted a huge party. The music was great, the mood was lively, and your guests had an unforgettable evening.

But the next morning, you are left with complete chaos.

Bottles, cans, packaging, and all kinds of trash are scattered everywhere. Your guests are long gone, and they have left the entire mess behind. Now it is your task to restore your home and the surrounding areas, turning them back into clean and cozy places.

In Cozy Cleanup, you collect trash, earn money, unlock new tools, and gain access to new areas. There is no time pressure and no need to rush. You decide how quickly you want to progress.

Clean at Your Own Pace

Take as much time as you need. Explore calm and lovingly designed environments, pick up the trash, and watch messy places slowly transform into clean and comfortable spaces.

There is no timer forcing you to hurry. There are no enemies and no dangerous situations. It is just you, your tools, and an environment waiting to be cleaned.

Upgrade Your Equipment

At the beginning, you will need to pick up every piece of trash by hand. By delivering collected waste, you earn money that can be used to purchase better equipment.

Buy larger trash bags to carry more items at once, or unlock a powerful trash vacuum that can clean up large amounts of waste within seconds.

The better your equipment becomes, the faster and more satisfying the cleanup process will feel.

Customize Your Tools

Change the colors of your tools whenever you like and create equipment that matches your personal style. Even your trash vacuum can become a unique companion during your relaxing cleanup journey.

Unlock New Areas

Earn money by collecting and delivering trash. Use your income to unlock better tools, upgrades, and additional locations.

Each new area offers a different atmosphere, new surroundings, and small details waiting to be discovered.

Find Hidden Rubber Ducks

Special rubber ducks are hidden throughout the game world. Keep your eyes open while cleaning, discover them, and add them to your personal collection.

Some ducks are easy to find, while others are hidden in places that reward careful exploration.

Features

• Relaxing trash collection without time pressure
• Calm and cozy gameplay
• Different tools and useful upgrades
• Larger trash bags with increased capacity
• A powerful trash vacuum for faster cleaning
• Customizable tool colors
• New areas to unlock
• Hidden rubber ducks to collect
• Peaceful and varied environments
• No violence, no enemies, and no stress

Cozy Cleanup is a relaxing game for players who enjoy creating order, collecting items, and transforming messy environments into clean and beautiful places.

No violence. No stress. Just you and the environment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Proud Boss Turns Into Obedient Loyal Maid - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Core Plot Introduction
Underground in Manhattan, New York, worker Ilya encountered an explosion during tunnel work and merged his consciousness with Liu Zihua to gain superpowers. He disguises himself as a low - level employee in an insect food research laboratory during the day and follows the clues of the consciousness insects to investigate the conspiracy of the FX Group at night. Meanwhile, the relationship between him and his proud boss, Natalie, is also undergoing subtle changes.

Worldview Atmosphere
The story constructs a world full of science - fiction elements. The FX Group has built an "Ancient Erosion Energy Field Core" underground, and what it has cultivated is slowly permeating the whole world. Mysterious consciousness insects, strange superpowers, and hidden conspiracies make the whole world full of unknowns and dangers.

Highlights of Female Character Interaction
Natalie, the proud boss, goes from resenting Ilya to gradually submitting to him. The interaction between the two is full of tension. Ilya uses his superpowers to protect Natalie, and Natalie signs an obedience contract with Ilya at her most vulnerable moment. This transformation is full of drama and appeal.

Tension in Character Relationships
Ilya's consciousness is merged with Liu Zihua's. He has his own self - awareness but is also influenced by Liu Zihua. The old grudges and new feelings between him and Natalie are intertwined. There is also the mysterious Sister Li who gives guidance. These complex character relationships add rich tension to the story.

Scene Features
From the damp tunnels underground in Manhattan, New York, to the insect food research laboratory, and then to the cheap rental house in Brooklyn, each scene has its own characteristics, creating different atmospheres and making players seem to be in a real science - fiction world.

Immersive Experience
Players will follow Ilya's perspective, feel his transformation from a low - level worker to a superpowered person, experience the complex emotional entanglement with Natalie, and delve into this mysterious and dangerous world, with a strong sense of immersion.

High - definition Visual Performance
The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the details of the scenes and the expressions of the characters, allowing players to more intuitively feel every moment in the story.

Functional Gameplay Features
It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots. The auto - play function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function allows players to quickly locate the chapters they are interested in. High - definition CGs bring visual enjoyment to players, ensuring a smooth reading experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Faced with a planet depleted of resources, humanity turned to a desperate final measure: hyper-accelerating time to force Earth into a rapid state of regeneration. The reckless project failed, plunging the world into a state of 'zero entropy' where all energy decays into absolute nothingness.

You play as Gren, a state-of-the-art emergency protocol android built by humanity's finest minds for this exact apocalyptic scenario. Journey through dark facilities to wind back time, and forge a path to the genesis of the disaster to rewrite the future.

Gameplay & Key Features

  • Puzzle-Platforming: Navigate a atmospheric 2D pixel art world where reflexes and logic collide. To progress, you must master the flow of time itself.

  • Record and Replay Your Actions: Collaborate with your past self to overcome seemingly impossible obstacles. Record your movements and replay them to activate complex machinery in real-time. Let a past clone hold down a heavy switch, or time your jumps perfectly with a platform moved by your previous attempt.

  • Intricate Interactive Hazards: Puzzle your way through high-tech facilities filled with moving elevators, pressure plates, toggle-buttons, teleportation portals, and spatial rifts that shift direction.

store_data.about_the_game:
Royal Flush is a turn-based dueling card game built on a simple idea with deep consequences: one card, one turn, one chance to make it count. Every move is a calculated gamble. Play the right card at the right moment to unleash powerful effects, drain your opponent's health, and turn the tide of the duel before your own life runs out.

There are no sprawling hands to hide behind here. Each turn comes down to a single decision — and the player who reads the table best walks away the winner.

Play One Card. Change Everything.

Forget juggling a fistful of cards. In Royal Flush, you commit to a single play each turn. That focus turns every choice into a high-stakes read: do you strike now, set up your next move, or bait your opponent into overextending? Suits and ranks each carry their own weight, and knowing when to spend your best card is the difference between victory and defeat.

Outsmart a Cunning AI

The single-player opponent doesn't just play cards — it plays you. The AI adapts to your strategy, punishes greedy moves, and forces you to think several turns ahead. Sharpen your tactics in solo duels before you take your skills online.

Duel Players Online

When you're ready for a real challenge, take the table against other players in online multiplayer. Networked, real-time duels put your decision-making to the test against opponents who can bluff, adapt, and surprise you in ways no AI can.

Beat the Clock

A turn timer keeps every match tense and fast-paced. Hesitate too long and you'll forfeit your moment — every second at the table counts.

Key Features

  • One-card-at-a-time combat — every turn is a single, decisive choice with no filler.

  • Health & effects system — chip away at your rival's health and trigger powerful status effects.

  • Strategic AI opponent — face an adaptive solo opponent that learns to counter your style.

  • Online multiplayer duels — challenge real players in head-to-head networked matches.

  • Turn timer pressure — fast, tense rounds where hesitation costs you.

  • Slick visuals — fluid card animations and particle effects bring every play to life.

Read your opponent. Time your move. Deal the perfect card.

This is Royal Flush.

store_data.about_the_game:
MegaCorp has 42 floors, one understaffed help desk, and a brand-new AI that is absolutely, definitely not after your job.

You are Analyst #15. Your monitor is your world: a ticket queue that never stops, an inbox full of escalating passive aggression, and a corporate news ticker that knows too much. Welcome to SERVICE DESK SIM — a retro-terminal IT helpdesk simulator about triage, time pressure, and the slow realisation that the machines are learning your job faster than you are.

TRIAGE OR DIE (PROFESSIONALLY)


  • Work the queue against SLA timers — accept, prioritise, resolve, and try not to apply the printer fix to the VPN outage.

  • 10,000+ hand-written tickets across 13 themed sectors, from the Basement helpdesk to the Quantum Lab to places IT support was never meant to go.

  • Multi-step complex tickets, VIP escalations, boss-level malware incidents, and department policies that change how every shift plays.

CRISES, CHOICES, AND CONSEQUENCES


  • Mid-shift Crisis Events freeze the clock and demand a decision with real, deterministic tradeoffs — no dice rolls behind the buttons.

  • Every choice feeds a hidden Human ↔ AI alignment meter. Side with your users, or keep accepting Synergy-AI's increasingly generous offers.

  • Four endings at the top of the tower — three of them gated by who you became on the way up.

BUILD YOUR ANALYST


  • 50 unlockable workflow skills — passive automations and active abilities, unlocked differently across three difficulty levels.

  • A live USER TRUST meter that rewards genuinely good support and punishes the rotting queue.

  • Combo chains, shift grades, leaderboards, and an Endless 24/7 mode for analysts who never log off.

PLAYABLE IN 8 LANGUAGES


English, English (UK), Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano — and full native-script हिन्दी (Hindi) and right-to-left اردو (Urdu), all the way down to the ticket pool and the requesters' names.

A LOVING SHRINE TO CORPORATE DREAD


CRT glow, terminal boot sequences, sticky notes with mandatory smiling policies, and a soundtrack of 13 sector ambiences. Runs on very modest hardware — if your machine can open a ticket, it can probably run the game about closing them.

MegaCorp reminds you that smiling is mandatory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Code City has stopped working.
An AI promised to take coding off everyone's hands – and the city forgot how its own code ever worked. Streets sit silent, lights are out, whole districts are frozen. The code is still there. It's just broken.

Your job: get it running again.
You don't write programs from scratch. You repair them. A wrong operator here, a missing condition there, a gap to close – small, real edits to real code. And with every line that runs again, a piece of the city wakes up: lights flicker on, fountains start, color comes back.

Coding that doesn't feel like homework.
Code Rescue is peaceful. No timers, no fail states, no high-score grind. Just you, a puzzle you can actually read, and a city that's visibly grateful you understood it. Friendly enough for your very first line of code – honest enough that you'll really learn something.

Because no one can understand it for you.
Code City collapsed because everyone trusted the AI to handle it. That's not a coincidence – it's the whole point: AI is a tool, not a substitute for understanding how something actually works.

Features:

  • Real code, gently dosed – you work with real code, but in bite-sized pieces: spot the bug, fill the gap, get the condition right.

  • A city that blooms with you – every fix visibly turns the world from grey and silent to alive and colorful.

  • Cozy, not punishing – no stress, no failure. Learn at your own pace.

  • A stance, not hype – a quiet counterpoint to the "let AI do it all for you" promise.

Congratulations! You are the newest custodian at Upton-Tree Middle School, assigned to the evening shift. Armed with a checklist and a ready-to-work attitude, your job seems simple: clean classrooms, take out trash, and finish the night's duties before heading home.

Each evening begins with a cheerful recorded message from Principal Tulley, whose warm instructions guide you through your responsibilities. Yet the more nights you spend in the empty halls, the more you begin to notice that something isn't right.

Strange sounds echo through dark corridors. Lights flicker when no one is around. And as midnight draws closer, you find yourself replaying the principal's final instruction over and over:

Be finished and out of the building before midnight.

The Evening Custodian is a first-person horror game where players must complete nightly cleaning tasks while avoiding a mysterious presence that stalks the school after hours. Manage your duties, stay alert, and uncover the unsettling truth hidden within Upton-Tree Middle School.

Just make sure you're gone before midnight.

store_data.about_the_game:
Sweat Equity

Lucenti is a storied Milanese maison built on heritage, craft, and a promise stitched into every label: Made in Italy. Three weeks ago, a 22-year-old finisher named Mei Lu collapsed and died in a locked, off-the-books subcontracted workshop—one whose existence the cost targets demanded and the audits never recorded.

CEO Sandro Vianello set those targets. Now a prosecutor’s probe, a labor suit, a make-or-break runway show, and a conglomerate recapitalization are all closing in at once. And three women, each holding a piece of the truth Lucenti wants sealed away, pull him into three charged, incompatible romances. Desire becomes dangerous. Intimacy becomes leverage. Every choice asks the same question: when the next collection is already in production, what—if anything—is still worth more than the close?

Meet the Cast


Yara Esposito — The Protégé

A brilliant Neapolitan designer Sandro discovered and championed, now positioned as Lucenti’s “reformed” future. But Mei Lu hand-finished the very capsule collection meant to crown her—turning her dream into a debt she can’t stomach. Her route burns with gratitude against autonomy: did Sandro lift her up, or buy her silence with a throne?

Selene Roux — The Face

Lucenti’s exclusive campaign icon, locked to the brand by the contract Sandro signed—and the morality clause the relaunch depends on. She met Mei once at a fitting, and now the image she’s paid to perform feels like an alibi she can’t live inside. A forbidden attraction where every tender moment risks detonating careers, contracts, and the entire comeback.

Jia Wu — The Witness

Second-generation Chinese-Italian, a former workshop stitcher turned organizer, Jia carries the real ledger, the real hours, and the dead girl’s real name into Lucenti’s immaculate halls. She stitched beside Mei in the locked room where it happened, and she refuses to let the house settle the truth into a sealed number. The sharpest collision of all—outsider against steward, record against reputation.

Key Features

  • Three full romance routes. Choose whose door you walk through, then follow a complete story where love and consequence stay tightly entwined.
  • A luxury-thriller workplace drama with teeth. Prosecutors, unions, investigative press, and corporate containment collide with runway deadlines and brand survival.
  • Three distinct emotional registers. Sea-cold freedom, kitchen-warm truth, and the fragile ethics of an open cage—each heroine feels her way through a world that monetizes everything.
  • Moral pressure that doesn’t flinch. The story pushes past scandal into complicity, accountability, and what it means to put a price on a person.
  • Bittersweet, earned endings. Even after the reckoning, the machine wants to roll on—unless someone makes it stop.

store_data.detailed_description:
Sweat Equity

Lucenti is a storied Milanese maison built on heritage, craft, and a promise stitched into every label: Made in Italy. Three weeks ago, a 22-year-old finisher named Mei Lu collapsed and died in a locked, off-the-books subcontracted workshop—one whose existence the cost targets demanded and the audits never recorded.

CEO Sandro Vianello set those targets. Now a prosecutor’s probe, a labor suit, a make-or-break runway show, and a conglomerate recapitalization are all closing in at once. And three women, each holding a piece of the truth Lucenti wants sealed away, pull him into three charged, incompatible romances. Desire becomes dangerous. Intimacy becomes leverage. Every choice asks the same question: when the next collection is already in production, what—if anything—is still worth more than the close?

Meet the Cast


Yara Esposito — The Protégé

A brilliant Neapolitan designer Sandro discovered and championed, now positioned as Lucenti’s “reformed” future. But Mei Lu hand-finished the very capsule collection meant to crown her—turning her dream into a debt she can’t stomach. Her route burns with gratitude against autonomy: did Sandro lift her up, or buy her silence with a throne?

Selene Roux — The Face

Lucenti’s exclusive campaign icon, locked to the brand by the contract Sandro signed—and the morality clause the relaunch depends on. She met Mei once at a fitting, and now the image she’s paid to perform feels like an alibi she can’t live inside. A forbidden attraction where every tender moment risks detonating careers, contracts, and the entire comeback.

Jia Wu — The Witness

Second-generation Chinese-Italian, a former workshop stitcher turned organizer, Jia carries the real ledger, the real hours, and the dead girl’s real name into Lucenti’s immaculate halls. She stitched beside Mei in the locked room where it happened, and she refuses to let the house settle the truth into a sealed number. The sharpest collision of all—outsider against steward, record against reputation.

Key Features

  • Three full romance routes. Choose whose door you walk through, then follow a complete story where love and consequence stay tightly entwined.
  • A luxury-thriller workplace drama with teeth. Prosecutors, unions, investigative press, and corporate containment collide with runway deadlines and brand survival.
  • Three distinct emotional registers. Sea-cold freedom, kitchen-warm truth, and the fragile ethics of an open cage—each heroine feels her way through a world that monetizes everything.
  • Moral pressure that doesn’t flinch. The story pushes past scandal into complicity, accountability, and what it means to put a price on a person.
  • Bittersweet, earned endings. Even after the reckoning, the machine wants to roll on—unless someone makes it stop.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the UFO. The whole world is below you — and all of it wants you gone.


The Confidential Disclosure is an action sandbox where you pilot an alien craft over an infinite voxel world that curves like a tiny planet in space.
Explore, abduct, destroy and uncover what humanity has been hiding — while the army, the police and the men in black do everything to capture you.

What awaits you

  • 🛸 5 unique craft — each with its own weapons, shield, cloak and special weapon: a black hole, a hunting swarm, an EMP, the 80,000-foot drop...
  • 🌍 A fully destructible world — dig through terrain, topple buildings, blast craters. It's all voxels, and it all breaks.
  • 👽 Abduct anything that moves — 85 animal species, pedestrians, ejected pilots: pull them into your ship in the tractor beam.
  • 🌎 A living world that fights back — cities, farms, an ocean you can dive into, traffic, day and night, storms and tornadoes. 30 enemy types
    across 5 factions — from armed rednecks to the Majestic discs that don't kill you: they capture you.
  • 🔺 Secrets found by navigation — Area 51, the pyramids of Giza, an island metropolis you can SINK. Each one is found by following the exact
    compass heading.
  • ⏳ Death is only the beginning — when you go down, time dilates and you rewind the last seconds to escape your end.

The truth

The aliens came to help. They were betrayed. Now it's time for disclosure.

It's a sunny afternoon in the park. The benches are full, the picnics are unguarded, and your pigeons are absolute professionals.

Pidgeon Pocket is a kawaii, chill heist incremental. Aim your flock at the crowd, snatch a pocketful of coins, and fly back. Spend the loot on a tree of upgrades, breed a better flock, and go again. Steal, upgrade, repeat.

Aim and let fly

Point your pigeons at the crowd, release, and watch the coins drop. Chain your steals together for bigger and bigger hauls.

Upgrade your flock

Pour your loot into a branching upgrade tree, and pick talents that change how your pigeons steal.

Breed better pigeons

Climb through pigeon tiers, from a scruffy Street Pigeon to a glorious Imperial one. Every tier raises the whole flock for good.

Dodge the law

The more you steal, the more the park notices. Grab what you can, slip away, and keep your flock out of the net.

Mouse only. 30 in-game languages.

store_data.about_the_game:
A wartime investigator handed a criminal case from the past — one night to solve it, a city crumbling around him. This isn't just a job. If the case isn't closed by morning, none of the team survive to see the next day.

Two Abilities. One Night:-

  • Psychometric Vision — The asylum's past left traces on everything it touched. Hold what they held to see what they saw.

  • Echo Memory — Some moments don't just leave marks but they leave sounds. Live what they lived and close your eyes to be able to hear what they heard.

Your Notebook Is Your Canvas:-

Open it. Write on it. Sketch on it. Your notebook is a real investigator's tool — paint your theories, map your findings, mark what matters. Everything you discover, captured in your own hand.

A Full Investigator's Toolkit:-

Lockpicks, hammer, ropes, spanner, wires, pistol, notebook, mobile phone and more. Every tool has a purpose. Every room has a secret.

Explore Every Corner:-

Climb, rappel, crawl, push, pull — this asylum was built to keep people in, and it will do the same to you.

Puzzles Buried in the Walls:-

Restore power, find passwords — the asylum's secrets are locked behind layers, and you need to peel every one of them back.

The Asylum Has Records:-

Security footage, patient files, criminal case documents — long before the war started, something happened here. The files know what it was.

Every Cassette Tells a Story:-

Scattered through the corridors, each one a fragment of a life that ended inside these walls — each one bringing you closer to the truth, or deeper into the dark.

Outside, the war rages on — bombs, sirens, smoke. Inside the asylum, a different kind of darkness has been waiting.
Solve it tonight. All of your lives depend on it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Run a shop no one admits they use

Blackwater Exchange is a 2D black market pawn shop management sim set in a gritty 1990s city.

You run a legal-looking exchange upstairs while the real business happens below: stolen watches, forged documents, suspicious electronics, cursed relics, desperate sellers, and cash changing hands before anyone asks too many questions.

Every item is a gamble

A customer comes down the stairs, drops something on the counter.

Maybe the item is real. Maybe it is fake. Maybe it is damaged, stolen, traceable, underpriced, or worse. Inspect visible clues, use tools, read the seller, and decide what the risk is worth.

Negotiate under pressure

Sellers have moods, patience, lies, and limits.

Push too hard and they may walk. Push the wrong person and they may report you. Pay too much and the day eats your profit. Every offer is a choice between margin, speed, and exposure.

Move goods before they become evidence

Buying the item is only half the job.

Store what you can, stash what you must, and sell through contacts with their own prices, risks, and availability. The right buyer can turn a dirty object into clean profit. The wrong one can leave you holding the problem.

Profit gets attention

Hot goods pay better, but they also raise heat.

Bills, raids, fines, confiscation, suspicious customers, rival pressure, and corrupt enforcement keep success from becoming safe. Legal deals keep the lights on. Dirty deals build the business. Every shortcut leaves a mark.

Features

  • 2D shopkeeper management built around appraisal, negotiation, and resale

  • Questionable goods with value, condition, authenticity, and risk uncertainty

  • Customer moods, lies, scams, walkouts, and report risk

  • Limited inventory, stash decisions, tools, upgrades, and shady contacts

  • Heat system with raids, fines, confiscation, and corrupt enforcement pressure

  • Gritty 1990s crime atmosphere

store_data.about_the_game:
Experience virtual spring gobbler hunting at it's finest! Whether you are a turkey hunter that needs off season action or a game enthusiast that enjoys playing true to life hunting simulations 'Pro Turkey Hunting' is the fix you need. Game play centers around the four wild turkey sub-species residing in North America; easterns, osceolas, rios and merriams. Harvesting each sub-species is referred to as the 'Grand Slam' of turkey hunting. Get close to that gobbler and use your calls and decoy to lure him in. But be careful not to move too abruptly, these old gobblers have incredible eyesight! Challenge yourself and see if you have what it takes to earn the coveted 'Grand Slam'!

* High definition environmental graphics.

* Four expansive hunting areas dispersed in different geographic areas in North America.

* Sim parameters for hunting- gobbler population/difficulty, gobbling activity, hen influence, sub-species to hunt.

* Turkey gear options- shotgun, turkey calls, locator calls, decoy, camouflage.

* Turkey Hunting Realism- strutting gobblers, hens, realistic calling interaction.

* Four different sub-species available to hunt.

  • Trophy room for top gobbler harvests.

store_data.about_the_game:
Surf the dark. Smash the stars.

You are loose in a vast neon void, and the only way through it is speed. Build momentum, ram everything to dust, charge your core to OVERLOAD, and tear a path toward the guardians waiting at the edge of the dark.

Momentum is the weapon

There is no trigger to hold. You surf. You dash. You smash asteroids, towers, and hunters apart by hitting them hard enough, then ride the wreckage straight into the next kill. Chain a dash-nova through a crowd and watch it come apart.

Every run is a different void

Each zone reshuffles into a new shape: open void, asteroid belts, pylon corridors, fence mazes, dense cluster fields. Then the anomalies bend the rules.

  • SWARM - the void teems with far more hunters.

  • GOLD RUSH - salvage doubled, and well defended.

  • VOLATILE GEOMETRY - the debris detonates, so smash at speed or bleed.

  • MAGNETIC STORM - rogue currents drag your ship off course.

  • OVERCHARGE - your energy charges faster, and so do your enemies.

  • HUNTED - apex predators stalk you from the first second.

store_data.about_the_game:
Following the death of his mother, Aozora Haru, an art student who is a member of a highly prestigious and selective art program in his school, feels lost. Although fortunate enough to pursue his passion and dreams, the listlessness of his daily life leaves him in a constant state of longing. Besides a group of extremely close friends that he holds dear to him, Haru finds it difficult to attach significant meaning to anything at all, instead seeking solace in the never-ending chambers of his thoughts and dreams. However, unbeknownst to anybody at all, Haru and his friends are bound together in a cruel and twisted, yet beautiful lattice of fate. Through his perspective, unravel the story of a young man staring down the barrel of what it means to be himself. 


- Featuring over 10 hours of visual novel/kinetic novel gameplay, a fully unique OST, FHD backgrounds and sprites.

- Multiple endings and bonus content upon completion.

store_data.about_the_game:
When the apocalypse came nearly  everyone died... But you regenerated.

Idle Regenerator is a deep, systems-rich idle RPG where your hero fights on automatically but every decision you make shapes how they fight. Unlock powers, forge equipment, build a roster of sidekicks, and watch a cascade of interlocking systems carry your character from a lone fighter to a force that reshapes reality itself.

A living idle game, not just a number that goes up

While you're away, your hero keeps fighting. When you return, offline progress fills your pockets with rewards earned while you slept. But Idle Regenerator rewards engagement just as much as patience. The deeper you push, the more complex and satisfying the systems become.

Key Features

  • 99+ unique powers — each with distinct effects, proc rates, and scaling. Choose which powers define your build at key level milestones, then amplify one to Signature status.

  • Five major game modes — unlock Adventure, the World Dungeon, the Heaven Spire, the System Labyrinth, and Rebuilding as you reach deeper chapters. Each mode is a fully realized system, not just a reskinned arena.

  • Deep character progression — primary stats (Strength, Vitality, Agility, Dexterity) flow into a full derived stat sheet: hit rating, evasion, crit, block, pierce, elemental damage, and more.

  • Equipment forging — craft, find, and upgrade gear across five slots. Push rare pieces through Artifact and Divine tiers with the Equipment Forge.

  • Sidekicks and Pets — recruit companions with unique power sets, deploy them to quests, and enhance them through their own progression tree.

  • Prestige and Constellations — reset for permanent multipliers and unlock the Constellation board for cross-run bonuses that compound over time.

  • Cultivation Manuals — 21 learnable manuals granting passive bonuses that persist through prestige.

  • Achievements and Automation — 40 achievements across 7 categories, plus an Automation tab to set-and-forget your farming loop.

A story that unfolds as you grow

Five chapters of narrative guide your hero's journey, with branching story nodes, dialogue choices, and milestone moments tied to your progress. The world has lore. The dungeons have names. The spirit beasts have history.

Play your way

No energy systems. No forced wait timers. No pay-to-win. Idle Regenerator is a game about building something — and watching that something become unstoppable.

The longer you play, the deeper it goes. [incrementaldb_verification: SuccessfulGrinding120]

store_data.about_the_game:
Travel across mysterious islands filled with ancient ruins, hidden caves, dangerous jungles, and realistic dinosaur encounters. Use interactive VR tools to excavate fossils, solve environmental puzzles, unlock secrets, and survive terrifying predators in an immersive world built for virtual reality.

Whether you are carefully uncovering dinosaur bones, escaping a giant carnivore, or exploring forgotten research facilities, every moment is designed to make you feel inside a real dinosaur adventure.

Climb, Explore, and Survive

Use your hands to climb walls, scale cliffs, and reach hidden areas.

Virtual reality movement places you directly inside the adventure, making every jump, climb, and discovery feel real.

Search every corner carefully because valuable artifacts, dinosaur eggs, and hidden collectibles may be waiting where few explorers dare to go.

Discover Fossils and Ancient Artifacts

Become a true prehistoric explorer by collecting fossils, ancient relics, and rare treasures during your journey.

Piece together the history of the island and uncover the mysteries left behind by an ancient civilization connected to the dinosaurs.

TONS OF TERRIFYING TRAPS

Keep an eye on your environment to find creative ways to boff your enemies! Decapitate the undead with spinning blades, fry them to a crisp with fire traps, crush them with a well-placed boulder and more. You wouldn’t set them on your team mates … would you?

OODLES OF PUZZLING PREDICAMENTS

Keep those peepers peeled for suspicious clues, secret entrances and ancient contraptions that need re-awakening! Who knows what alluring treasures and buried riches await you on the other side…

I saved you at the beach?!

What kind of crazy nonsense is that?

A heart-pounding memory hunt with a suspiciously handsome stranger!

If I just keep that damn promise…

Time to uncover the memories I lost ten years ago!

With stunning illustrations to enhance your immersion in the story,

Dive into the mysterious romance of three people!

Your choices will change the course of the story.

You may need time to agonize to reach the ending you desire.

Their past seems to hold something hidden...

Uncover the truth alongside the cynical protagonist, Junhui!

store_data.about_the_game:
Kingdom Chronicle is a full-fledged turn-based fantasy strategy SLG where you take command of a warlord house and set out to unify a war-torn continent. Through governance, diplomacy, intrigue, and open war, bring an age of rival warlords to an end.

■ Build a Prosperous Domain

Develop your land to raise national power, conscript and train a formidable army, and grant relief to keep your people loyal. Funds, power, loyalty, and renown intertwine into a balancing act that decides victory.

■ Diplomacy & Intrigue

Build trust through goodwill and fight side by side through alliances—or undermine your rivals from within with schemes (raids, rumors, sabotage and more) and officer poaching. Use espionage to read your opponents' hand.

■ 6 Troop Types, Real Trade-offs

Cavalry, archers, and spears form a rock-paper-scissors triangle (cavalry > archers > spears > cavalry). Swords never dominate but are a steady all-rounder that holds its own against any type, while magic is a high-variance gamble—devastating when it lands, unreliable when it doesn't. Armor is a defensive specialist that comes into its own on the counterattack rather than the assault. Soldier counts, training, and special skills all sway the outcome, and with marching, intercepting, reinforcing, and even calling on allies, each war is a battle of wits.

■ A Cast of Distinct Officers

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a dark fantasy action RPG focused on undead summoning, army cultivation, and faction confrontation. A complete single playthrough takes about 6–10 hours, delivering an immersive growth experience as a powerful necromancer.

Players take on the role of a newly risen necromancer in the undead realm and embark on a dangerous journey from scratch. Explore a variety of distinct undead territories and hunt skeletons, vengeful spirits, corrupted beasts, and countless undead creatures. With forbidden necromantic arts, you can harvest remains and absorb soul energy from fallen enemies. You may also resurrect and recruit defeated monsters as your loyal combat companions to build and expand your own undead legion.

Core Progression System

Raise your cultivation and level through continuous battles to unlock stronger necromantic powers. All undead units come with unique attack patterns and attribute strengths. You can freely adjust your army composition by mixing frontline tanks, assault damage dealers, and ranged spell units to create a battle formation that suits your personal playstyle. Collect deadly relics to enhance your spell power, soul endurance, and overall survivability, constantly breaking through your power limits.

Core Goals & Endgame Challenges

As a dark existence of the undead plane, you stand in absolute opposition to the holy light faction. After exploring dangerous zones, eliminating powerful regional foes, and reaching the peak of your cultivation, you will unlock cross-realm invasion privileges. Lead your massive undead army into the holy light domain, wage all-out war against angelic forces, challenge powerful high-rank angel bosses, and determine the final fate of the eternal conflict between darkness and light.

Key Game Features

Free Undead Recruitment: Almost every defeated undead creature can be revived and recruited as your fighting unit, offering extremely high freedom for army building.

Blend of Action & Strategy: Control your necromancer to cast spells in real time while commanding your undead army to position, flank, and focus fire. The combat system combines fast-paced action gameplay with tactical team management.

Dual-Faction Narrative: Experience a complete lore background centered on the long-standing confrontation between the undead darkness and the holy light faction.

Atmospheric Original Soundtrack: Custom soundtracks are designed for both the dark undead realm and the radiant holy light territory, greatly enhancing the immersive dark fantasy atmosphere of your conquest journey.

idle koi! is a server-driven idle pet collection game about hatching, breeding, training, and battling magical koi. - Trade and manage valuable koi through server-authoritative ownership, with Steam Inventory support planned for the Steam economy.

store_data.about_the_game:
Latticefall is a quiet game about a small colony and a slow apocalypse.

The danger here doesn't arrive all at once — it creeps. An infection seeps across the land, quiet and relentless, and your job isn't to crush it head-on but to endure: raise a settlement, draw a line, and take ground back one step at a time. Every push forward costs something — and you see the price and the risk before you make the move. No fast hands needed: pause, weigh it, decide. This is a game about deliberate choices, about the rhythm of advance and retreat, about calmly holding what you've built.

Your colony grows through the ages — from the first campfire to late-game technologies. You research, develop your base, hand tasks to your lieutenants, and decide for yourself how far to reach and what to give up when the infection presses against your walls.

What Latticefall believes:

  • It exists for how you feel, not for the beauty of a concept.

  • It must run smoothly even on weak, old hardware — smoothness is respect for you.

  • It speaks to you in your own language.

  • If something's missing, you can build it in yourself, with no programming.

  • And underneath is an engine that can open different worlds: today it's an infection, tomorrow you could turn it into encroaching snow.

content_descriptors.notes:
Latticefall is a dark post-apocalyptic survival game. Most of its mature content is delivered through text (in quests and codex entries); the visuals are stylized, with no graphic on-screen depictions.

The game contains violence: combat against infected creatures and hostile humans, use of weapons, and references to blood, wounds, death, and corpses. Occasionally there are heavier text descriptions — medical procedures (amputation without anesthesia), executions for crimes, and experiments performed on an infected human (with their consent). It also features psychological horror elements: nightmares, the voices of the dead, and an oppressive atmosphere.

Colony life involves alcohol and tobacco, as well as the medical use of painkillers/narcotic substances (anesthesia, sedation). The game includes mild profanity and dark gallows humor about death and survival.

The game contains NO sexual content, nudity, sexual violence, recreational drug use, or depictions of suicide or self-harm.

store_data.about_the_game:
TUNG. TUNG. TUNG.

He hears the island. He hears you.

Tung Tung Tung Sahur does not stop. He does not tire. He does not forget where you ran.

Little Sahur Island is his domain, and every sound you make, every snapped branch, every kicked stone, every panicked breath, is an invitation. Learn his patterns. Respect his persistence. Or don't make it to morning.

KEY FEATURES:

  • An island that wants to trap you. Explore a fully realized 1km × 1km open environment with dense biomes, hidden structures, and secrets that reward the brave and punish the reckless.

  • Scavenge to survive. Hunt down scattered boat parts across the entire island. Every component brings you one step closer to freedom, if you can reach it.

  • A relentless pursuer. Tung Tung Tung Sahur actively hunts you across the island. No safe rooms. No sanctuaries. Only distance, darkness, and luck.

  • Dynamic tension. Manage noise, light, and movement as you scavenge. The tools that help you find parts are the same ones that give you away.

Can you repair the boat before he finds you?

Little Sahur Island remembers everyone who came. It has yet to let anyone leave.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the year 2577, civilization had long since died, and the only world that remained was a single last island.

Five hundred years ago, a global nuclear war triggered the reversal of a "nuclear winter"—uncontrolled greenhouse effects and thousands of underwater nuclear explosions turned Earth into a water world. Today's oceans are a highly acidic, radioactive hell, where no life can survive except for mutated deep-sea leviathans.

We are the last of humanity. In this era of severe technological collapse, high-energy batteries are the Holy Grail, sharp alloy fragments are divine iron, and bows and arrows are luxuries more precious than gold. We wield blades forged from scrap of the old world, clad in armor stitched from mutated beast hides, struggling on this isolated island shrouded in pollution.

But the island is shrinking. As tectonic plates subside, seawater is slowly swallowing the highlands inch by inch. The only hope lies at the highest point of the island, a place legendary as the "Quantum Dome." According to archives from the old world, it was the launch silo for the Ark and the sole wormhole leading to extraterrestrial colonies.

24 survivors, a lone island, a legend. Will you share scarce resources to strengthen your defenses, or become a predator and seize everything from others? Remember, here the sea will corrode your skin, mutated beasts will tear your throat apart, and the most dangerous... is always the human behind you.

Instead, the systems are failing. Terminals are offline. Telemetry is stale. Crew logs contradict each other. Somewhere between Earth and orbit, something has gone wrong, and you are one of the few people left who might still be able to fix it.

Space Lift is a narrative-driven sci-fi adventure about an engineer trying to keep a failing orbital transport system alive. Your journey begins on Earth, continues up the space elevator, and leads into stations, spacecraft, and remote off-world locations.

Explore service decks, maintenance rooms, spacecraft interiors, and quiet facilities where the crew should still be. Restore power, unlock terminals, repair damaged machinery, operate a remote-controlled drone, and piece together what happened from logs, diagnostics, maps, and missing mission records.

The game uses a side-view 3D perspective: readable and cinematic like a side-scroller, but built as a fully 3D world with depth, navigation, and spaces to investigate.

The deeper you go, the less reliable the systems become.

  • Follow a grounded sci-fi story from Earth to orbit and beyond

  • Explore a space elevator, stations, spacecraft, and off-world facilities

  • Play as an engineer repairing damaged systems instead of fighting through them

  • Restore power, unlock terminals, operate machinery, and solve light puzzles

  • Control a remote drone to reach places you cannot

  • Investigate crew logs, diagnostics, maps, and missing mission records

  • Experience a narrative-focused adventure with walking-sim elements

  • Navigate a fully 3D world from a side-view camera perspective

  • Uncover what happened to the missing crew without knowing who, or what, to trust

store_data.about_the_game:
BitVoxel is a voxel sandbox game where you build real digital circuits inside a 3D world.

Create logic systems using AND, OR, XOR, NOT, switches, LEDs, wires and other circuit blocks. Build simple gates, full machines, computers, or massive logic creations in an endless sandbox world. Whether you want to experiment, learn how digital circuits work, or push the limits of what can be built, BitVoxel gives you the tools to create it.

Use advanced editing tools like copy, paste, move, rotate, and flip to speed up large projects. Build freely, test your designs, expand your creations, and save your worlds as you experiment with different circuit ideas.

BitVoxel also includes a component tool that lets you select a circuit, save it as a reusable component, and place it again later. Build your own library of circuit parts and reuse them across different worlds, making it easier to create larger and more complex systems without rebuilding the same designs from scratch.

BitVoxel is designed for players who enjoy building, logic, engineering, automation and creative problem solving. Start with a simple switch and light, then work your way up to more complex systems using real digital logic.

BitVoxel is currently focused on sandbox building and circuit experimentation. Future updates will expand the game with more structured learning, challenges, and progression.

Build, test, improve, and create systems only limited by your imagination.

store_data.about_the_game:
Highway Station Sim is a first-person management simulation where you turn a small roadside stop into a fully equipped highway station.

You start with a single fuel pump and a handful of empty shelves. Vehicles pull in, customers shop, sales stack up — and every dollar goes back into growing the station.

Fuel Sales

Pick up the nozzle, walk to the vehicle, attach it and hold to pump. The gauge fills, the sale closes. Keep an eye on the tank pool and restock before it runs dry.

Market & Ordering

Browse the order terminal, pick your products, wait for the delivery truck, carry the containers to the shelves and stock them by hand. Keep the shelves full, keep the customers happy.

Electric Vehicle Charging

EV customers pull in and charge automatically — no interaction needed. Invest in solar panels to raise your price per kWh and earn passive income while you focus elsewhere.

Station Upgrades

Buy new fuel pumps, extra underground tanks, electric charging stations and solar panels from the upgrade terminal. Every purchase shows up physically in the world — the station visibly grows.

Market Design

Place shelves from delivery, rotate and snap them to the market floor grid. Swap floor and wall materials to make the interior your own.

Live Traffic

Vehicles roll in from the highway based on your station's capacity. Fuel, electric and parking customers can all be active at once — manage your time across all three.

Checkout

When a customer queues at the register, step up and take payment. Fuel charges are fixed; market items are confirmed one by one. Reject an item and it goes straight back on the shelf.

store_data.about_the_game:
A return to Dreamcast-era survival horror, where every encounter is a moral choice.

Explore the cursed town of White Creek as exorcist Alicia Morelli, unearth its buried traumas, and decide whether to kill the possessed or save their souls.

Shoot or exorcise? The choice is yours. Between action and reflection, you can take the risk of exorcising the possessed and adopt a more pacifist approach to your investigation… but at what cost?

Alicia has several weapons at her disposal, in addition to her psychic powers. These abilities allow her to detect spiritual anomalies, whether they are found within the possessed or hidden throughout the environment.

Alicia can also capture and record them using her mobile phone, a crucial tool for exploration, investigation, and puzzle-solving.

Face the Exorcism Overdrive sequences, intense gameplay phases where Alicia comes face to face with a particularly corrupted possessed soul. Speak to them, confront them with the evidence gathered throughout your investigation, break through their illusions, and finally bring peace to their soul.

White Creek features around ten chapters, offering approximately 5 hours of gameplay, excluding optional content.

Support us on Kickstarter!

store_data.about_the_game:
Embark on an adventure across the continent of Veridia!

The Lund family lives in the woods just outside Greyford, a small village nestled within Veridia.

Among them is Muffin, a sweet young girl whose journey is about to begin.

Step into Muffin's shoes and explore the cold yet heartwarming land of Veridia.

Along the way, meet many friends and discover the stories they have to tell.

Dive into the enchanting world of Dear, My Marionette!

One day, a mysterious wooden bird suddenly shatters the peace, destroying Muffin's precious Anima Peryl.

Determined to restore what was lost, Muffin sets out on a long and perilous journey.

Along the way, she meets a colorful cast of characters and gradually uncovers the shocking truth behind the mysterious wooden bird...

Face Mammon in Battle!

Defeat Mammon, the bizarre creature lurking along your path!

Collect powerful cards and build the ultimate deck to master strategic combat.

Study your enemies' attributes and play the right cards to counter their strengths.

To survive the trials ahead and reach the end of your journey, you'll have to rely on your own wit and determination.

The choice is yours—and so are the consequences.

Defeat Mammon and choose the name it will carry. A single name may change everything.

Discover the fate that awaits Mammon, and see how your choices shape the ending of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Tech Store & Repair Simulator is an immersive business management tycoon and life sim that tests your entrepreneurial spirit. Set in a vibrant open world, you will start with a modest shop and build a massive electronics retail empire from the ground up.

This is not just about standing behind a cash register. You must master complex inventory control, perform delicate hardware repairs, and survive the daily grind of a dynamic economy to become the ultimate tech mogul!

Comprehensive Retail & Shopkeeper Mechanics

A premium electronics store requires flawless logistics and resource management. Purchase a wide variety of stock from the wholesaler, including the latest smartphones, premium tablets, headphones, chargers, and stylish accessories.

Physically unpack your deliveries and strategically organize your display tables and wall racks. Decorate your store with plants to increase customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends, adjust your pricing, and ensure your shelves are never empty in this highly realistic simulation.

Realistic Hardware Repair System

Stand out from the competition by offering expert technical support! You are not just a seller; you are a technician. Throughout the day, customers will bring in their broken devices. Step up to your workbench and dive into the detailed phone repair mechanics. Diagnose the issue, unscrew the chassis, replace dead batteries or faulty internal components, and reassemble the device. This highly detailed system provides a crucial secondary income stream to fund your tycoon expansion.

Time Management & Survival Elements

Success requires stamina. Tech Store & Repair Simulator features core survival and life sim elements that directly impact your strategy.

Time is money, but you cannot run on an empty stomach. Keep a close eye on your character’s hunger. If you forget to eat, your movement speed will drop, crippling your time management and making it harder to serve customers. Navigate the city streets, buy food, and sleep in your bed to stay refreshed for another profitable day.

Store Customization, Automation, and Expansion

What starts as a single, humble shop can evolve into a massive tech paradise. Use your hard-earned profits to purchase the adjacent property, doubling your floor space and inventory capacity. Experience true sandbox freedom by designing your store layout exactly how you want it.

As customer foot traffic increases, step into the role of an HR manager. Automate your daily operations by hiring a dedicated cashier to process sales and a cleaner to maintain a premium shopping environment. Pay their daily wages, optimize your overhead costs, and watch your automated retail machine generate massive wealth!

Key Features

  • Deep Business Simulator: Buy, price, and sell a huge variety of tech products in a dynamic economy.

  • Hardware Repair System: Take apart broken smartphones, replace faulty components, and repair them for extra cash.

  • Open World Life Sim: Navigate a vibrant city, manage your hunger by buying food, and sleep to restore your energy.

  • Shopkeeper & Sandbox Design: Place display tables, wall racks, checkout counters, and decorations with full freedom.

  • Tycoon Automation: Expand your business to 2 large stores and hire staff to automate your workflow.

  • Resource & Time Management: Balance your daily schedule, finances, and personal survival to keep your business afloat.

If that target is reached, all additional proceeds will go towards creating new adventures for Sofie Scout.

Run fast, jump high and make it to Poland.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a Unique 2D World

Fjellward is set in a procedurally generated 2D world, created individually for each player. Dig tunnels, build stairs, and explore your surroundings to discover hidden places full of treasures.

You’ll gather resources and meet villagers who will help you rebuild your town. Every time you restore a part of the town, your character unlocks new tools.

Shape the World

Every pixel in the world is treated individually by the engine. It can be liquid, gaseous, sandy, or solid. The player can freely alter most areas. There are only a few places that contain indestructible pixels.

Pixels are Your Resources

In Fjellward, you don't gather wood, iron or dirt. You only gather pixels. When you cut down a tree, you get brown and green pixels. Dig in the desert, and you'll mainly collect yellow pixels. What you see on the screen is the resource you get. You need these pixels to repair your town and unlock new tools.

You can obtain pixels through mining, farming or by building machines that process pixels. There are also creatures in the world that can help you collect pixels.

A note on color blindness: If you have trouble distinguishing the colors in the image above, you can still play the game. However, you’ll have to rely more on trial and error.

store_data.about_the_game:
ABOUT TOSKA-74

The year is 1974. Somewhere deep in the lush woods of Siberia, the firmament of reality has lost its grip.

Without warning, the sky turned a suffocating, dense grey, then the sky lit up. Gravity lost its stronghold on the mundane—and the chairs rose to the ceiling. Reality has turned from an absolute - to a partial existence.

"He who fights with monsters should look to it that he himself does not become a monster. And if you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you." 

SURVIVE THE PSYCHEDELIC ANOMALY

Toska-74 is an open-world survival-horror game that blends historical Soviet bleakness with surreal, mind-bending terror.

You are dropped into a massive, unforgiving Siberian exclusion zone where the environment is turning on itself in a constant loop. Scavenge for supplies, destroy the lurking stalkers of the quarantine zone, and most importantly - try to keep your sanity intact as the world brutalizes your delicate mind. 

AN (UN)COMMON ALLIANCE

The joint forces of the Yankees and the Commies have left - or been forced out of the exclusion zone. They are desperate. They are terrified. And they have agreed on one thing: something will be done, no matter the costs. Navigate the fragile politics of desperate men, fight against old, delicate Soviet robots and pillage abandoned research bunkers to uncover what really is going on. And one last thing, be careful when you go to sleep. Maybe this world isn't so bad after all.

"There are no good or bad people in this world, yet there are walking corpses and those who refuse death"

FEATURES :

  • A World of Abomination: Explore a vast, open-world Siberia filled with brutalist architecture, abandoned military installations, floating, gravity-defying anomalies and be wary of the automated Soviet drones who, just like you, will do anything to survive. 

  • Psychedelic Horror: The threat is personal and intimate. Hallucinations, reality distortions, and psychological terrors will make you question what is real and what is just your mind fracturing from the abomination.

  • Survival Of The Fittest: Ammo is scarce, robots wander and hover behind every corner, and every resource you find requires a risk-versus-reward choice.

  • 70s Soviet Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a gritty, mind-bending sci-fi atmosphere heavily inspired by 1970s aesthetics, complete with period-accurate technology, industrial drones, and a haunting, oppressive existence.

- Created and manifested by VIKCHA-

store_data.about_the_game:
Aéro Speedrun Labyrinthe is a short first-person speedrun puzzle game set inside a mysterious experimental laboratory.

Play as Aéro, a subject trapped in a strange testing facility guided by Aves, a robotic companion who observes every step of the experiment. Your goal is simple: complete each room as fast as possible, solve the laboratory’s challenges, and improve your best time with every run.

Explore a sequence of experimental rooms built around movement, timing, observation and puzzle-solving. Jump across platforms, activate mechanisms, interact with cubes, find your way through the labyrinth, and search for hidden bonus eggs. Some rooms focus on precision and speed, while others ask you to understand the logic of the experiment.

The game includes:

  • A short speedrun-focused campaign

  • Around 10 main puzzle rooms

  • Bonus eggs

  • A best-time system to encourage replayability

  • Fully voiced dialogue with Aves

  • French and English language options

  • Keyboard/mouse and controller support

  • A sci-fi laboratory atmosphere with original cinematic sequences

Aéro Speedrun Labyrinthe is designed as a compact experience: finish the experiment, learn the rooms, then replay to improve your time and discover the secrets hidden inside the laboratory.

store_data.about_the_game:
Domineering Mediator's Forbidden Surrender - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: Axel, a former running coach in London and a cold-chain logistics coordinator, was reborn after being taken over by the consciousness fragments of a photon soul refiner after his unexpected death. With his new powers, he vowed to investigate the criminal network of the FX Group. Lena, the guardian of the inheritance, formed a forbidden bond with him due to the secret clauses in the family charter. In their complex relationship, the two faced the threats from killers and the evil group together.
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a world where the surreal and the real are intertwined. Superpower elements such as photon soul refining and fate tampering are integrated into urban life. There is both the oppressive industrial atmosphere of the cold-chain warehouses in London and the natural scenery of Hyde Park, creating a mysterious, tense and fantasy - filled atmosphere.
Highlights of female character interaction: As a mature and charming mediator, Lena appears strong and rational on the outside, but inside she suppresses her forbidden desires for Axel. In her interactions with Axel, her emotions are complex and changeable, from shock and fear to the release of desire, showing a highly intense emotional conflict.
Tension in character relationships: Axel and Lena have an inescapable bond due to the secret clauses in the family charter. The relationship between the guardian of the inheritance and the beneficiary is full of moral and ethical conflicts. At the same time, Axel is also struggling with the moral dilemma of "being dead but being reborn in someone else's body", making his emotional interaction with Lena even more delicate.
Scene features: The game scenes are rich and diverse, from the - 25 - degree cold - chain logistics warehouse in London, to the mist - covered Hyde Park, and then to the Notting Hill apartment and the transnational inheritance law firm. Each scene has a unique atmosphere and details, adding a sense of realism and immersion to the story.
Immersive experience: Players will follow Axel's perspective, feel the impact of death and rebirth, experience the shock brought by superpowers, and the complex emotional entanglement with Lena. In the exciting plot, they will seem to be in that world full of fantasy and danger.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the appearance, expressions and actions of the characters, as well as the details and atmosphere of the scenes. Whether it's Axel's grey - blue eyes or Lena's charming posture, they can bring visual enjoyment to players.
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. The one - key backtracking function makes it convenient for players to review important plots, and the automatic playback function makes reading smoother. The chapter browsing function can quickly locate the chapters of interest, and the high - definition CG shows the wonderful moments, bringing players a high - quality reading experience.
