By chance, he receives an encrypted file in an anonymous express delivery. When decrypting it by the Seine River, he is attacked and possessed by the Silicon Dream Weaver, becoming a Slag Newcomer. He discovers that there is an evil conspiracy between the FX Group and the Singularity Planning Department hidden behind the data, and the gorgeous spy Beatrice is also involved. Alexander decides to take the initiative and join hands with Beatrice to fight against the enemies.
Worldview Atmosphere: The story constructs a cyberpunk world full of a sense of technology and mystery. Scenes such as the streets of Paris, offices, and watch repair shops are filled with the smell of coffee and printing paper. The data stream is intertwined with reality, and time seems to be frozen in the gaps of consciousness, making people feel a depressing and dangerous atmosphere.
Highlights of Female Character Interaction: Beatrice is gorgeous and noble. She seems strong and arrogant on the surface, but her heart is crushed by family debts. Her encounter with Alexander is full of drama. From initial vigilance to gradually trusting each other, the interaction between the two is full of tension. Alexander's strength and tenderness make Beatrice gradually let down her guard and show her vulnerable side.
Tension in Character Relationships: There is not only a cooperative relationship between Alexander and Beatrice, but also an emotional entanglement. At the same time, they are also facing threats from enemies such as Enzo. The character relationships are intricate and full of tension.

Through interactions with characters such as Beatrice, they can feel their emotional changes and experience the exciting adventure process, as if they are the protagonists in the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Plantify is a third-person farming and management game which focuses on a small cat learning how to properly take care of plants. Add entries to your Journal, Fulfil Orders for your Community and Upgrade your Garden size to the max!

The Game will teach players actual ways to care for specific plants in a simplified way. It takes actual real-life care instructions into account, such as water amounts, light requirements and correct seasons. 

At the same time, they have to help and do their part in building up the community by providing food and information on plants and care instructions to the other cats in the town.

Other features include a simple Character Creator, a Community Meter which showcases your reputation within the Cat community and a Storyline explaining the past and how the cat community will move on and work towards a better future.

NOTE:
This is a student project from the UAS St.Pölten, Austria. Expect things to not be on a AAA standard.

store_data.about_the_game:
Smoosh monsters. Climb the ladder. Cause chaos.

Drop goofy little monsters into a jar. When two of the same kind collide, they smoosh into the next creature up the ladder. Simple, right? Then the jar fills, the physics get rowdy, and one badly-aimed fuzzball brings the whole wobbling tower down on top of you.
Monster Smoosh is a Suika-style merge game with a sense of humor. Cute-monstrous critters, exaggerated physics, and death that feels like a punchline instead of a punishment.

Climb the 11-monster ladder

From the humble Fuzzball all the way up to a gloriously derpy elder god. Every merge is bigger, bouncier, and more chaotic than the last.
  • Drop & merge — match two monsters to fuse them into the next tier.
  • Chain combos — set up cascades and watch the score explode.
  • Mind the jar — let it overflow and it's game over. No pressure.

The cow economy

There's a secret second ladder, and it goes moo. An alien rancher quietly farms a herd of cows in your jar. Cultivate them, ring the cowbell, and harvest the whole herd through portals for a massive payday. Bigger herd, bigger boom.

Chaos is the point

  • Specials charge up as you play — fire the cowbell or the magnet to bend the chaos your way.
  • UFOs drift in to stir the pot when you least expect it.
  • Death as spectacle — when it all comes crashing down, it's a show worth watching.

Climb the global leaderboard

Post your best run to the online top-10, slap your name on it, and wait for some stranger to smoosh you right back off.

The vibe

No grimdark here. Even the Cthulhu is a plush. Just bright, loud, joyful chaos you can play for one minute or one very lost hour.
Aim. Drop. Smoosh. Repeat.

  • Phone conversations and text messages from NPCs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every run is a race against the Rift swallowing reality. Fall, return, push deeper. Welcome to The Rifted Skies, a VR roguelite built for speed and flow.

Parkour Without Motion Sickness

In The Rifted Skies, your body drives movement. Sprint by swinging your arms, jump by throwing them upward, leap across gaps, slide, glide and climb anything that looks like it can hold you. Feel every run and make your muscles ache, with minimal buttons and no motion sickness.

Dodge, Deflect, Survive

Combat is reactive and skill-based. Dodge, deflect, interrupt. Wield the bow or katana to send projectiles back or smash through your foes at full speed. Enemies grow tougher, fights faster, and every move matters.

Build Your Run

Collect gems from ancient altars and shape your power with every pick. Some upgrades click together, others clash. Push your luck and craft a run that feels your own. With 100+ run upgrades and permanent unlocks, including flight, grappling hook, and charged fist, no two runs feel the same.

Features

  • Sprint, leap, slide, and glide with minimum buttons and no motion sickness.

  • Climb anything you see.

  • Fast, reactive combat where enemies chase and corner you, but always play fair.

  • Fully diegetic interface.

  • Wield distinct weapons for skill-based ranged and melee combat.

  • Escape the Rift that grows more aggressive the deeper you go.

  • 100+ upgrades and countless build combinations.

  • 6 unique enemies, 3 bosses across 3 biomes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Longway Down is a high-speed downhill longboarding game built on real physics. Point your board down the hill, let gravity take over, and find out how far you can push speed before the road finds you first.

Every run is a fight between momentum and control. Lean into carves, thread tight lines through hazards, and hold your nerve as the descent gets faster and the margin for error disappears.

Race the descent
Chase the clock down winding mountain roads. Hit checkpoints, beat your best time, and push for the perfect run.

Read the road
Traffic, wandering cattle, debris, and blind switchbacks turn every hill into an obstacle course. One bad line ends in a spectacular wipeout.

Crash, rewind, repeat
Eat asphalt in full ragdoll then rewind time to a few seconds before disaster and drop straight back into your run. No loading screens, no restarts, just you and the line you should have taken.

Chase the clock
Every map tracks your best time and top speed. Shave seconds, find faster lines, and own the leaderboard.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Fusion of Karate and Fortune-Telling

When two champions stand face to face, fate shall be――

KARATE URANAI is a severe and uncompromising URANAI, in which fortune and misfortune are divined through the art of karate.

A tiger that strikes without mercy, birds that whirl through the air, a floating sage master, and an encounter with the phantom dragon.

At times, one must read the subtle workings of heaven and earth.
With a single bow, invite good fortune.
With a single fist, sever fortune from misfortune.

Aim for the summit of the Karate Score online rankings, or seek the legendary “Great Great Great Great Great Fortune”――

What the player can do is throw an avocado, offer a bow, or perhaps――

[New Feature] You can now give a “Like!” to the actions of your karate.
Your karate will learn from the player’s actions and grow.

The player’s judgment is carved into karate, and in time, becomes a single form――

The learned data can be sent into RANKED MATCH, where it will battle against the learned data of other players.

The game also features TOGETHER mode, allowing up to four players to divine their fortunes at the same time through local play or Steam Remote Play Together.
You may also divine fortune and misfortune together with your friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
You've been sent down to the deepest layer of Infinite Ball Hell.

The only way to save yourself? Meet your quota and ascend through ball purgatory by taking advantage of more than 100 combo heavy Charms, game changing Relics, unique Pegs, and more.

In Infinite Ball Heaven, you gain points from dropping a ball onto a peg or falling to the bottom of the screen, multiplied by the time it took you to fall for the first time. When you fall to the bottom, you end up back at the top! It's Infinite, remember?

I wonder what would happen if you had a charm that converted hits to falls? Or one that gave a bonus based on how quickly you fell?

Infinite Ball Heaven is a game about synergies. Your approach varies drastically depending on your build, and there's no shortage of interesting strategies to discover.

More than 18 unique bosses stand in your path to Ball Heaven as you traverse 9 layers of purgatory, forcing you to carefully consider your approach.

The game features detailed pixel art, Photorealism, and hand drawn elements.

store_data.about_the_game:
Stories Best Left Untold is an anthology of 10 chilling visual novel horror stories, each with its own characters, mysteries, and nightmares. From abandoned houses and forgotten apartments to roads that lead nowhere, every story reveals a new terror waiting in the dark.

Story 1: You Fit - The house was always available. There was a reason for that.

Story 2: Come Down - A letter from her dead grandmother leads Maren to Blackmoor, where something is waiting.

Story 3: The Night They Were Alone - Two siblings. One house. Something inside with them.

Story 4: The Key From Below - A coworker disappears. A key marked B1F is left behind.

Story 5: The Unit 3 Incident - The turbines never stopped running. Neither did whatever was beneath them.

Story 6: The Rules of Block C - Minh rents a cheap apartment. The landlord puts him on a night shift he didn't agree to.

Story 7: The Passenger System - Nick and Jonas are alone on a dark highway. The car slows for something in the road.

Story 8: The Night Bus - Riv misses the last bus home and boards a route that doesn't exist.

Story 9: The House That Keeps - Alex agrees to house-sit a strange house with rules he's expected to follow.

Story 10: The Night Ferry - The ferry arrives without a sound. By the time Eris realizes something is wrong, the shore is already gone.


The game features roughly 200 images and 25K words in total

store_data.about_the_game:
Robin Hood: Death to Tyrants is a first-person shooter inspired by classic 90s shooters, combining fast-paced combat with exploration and secret hunting.

Play as Robin Hood as you infiltrate heavily guarded castles and military outposts controlled by a tyrannical regime. Fight through groups of medieval soldiers, evade ambushes, and search every corner for hidden treasure and secret areas.

Armed with your bow and arrows, every shot matters, rewarding careful aim and quick thinking during combat encounters and ambushes.

Search each stronghold, steal enough loot and rescue prisoners to complete your mission before advancing to the next area.

Levels reward careful exploration, progress through interconnected environments, uncover hidden passages, and survive increasingly dangerous encounters as you push deeper into enemy territory.

The adventure can be completed in a single sitting, though progress can be manually saved at save stations throughout the game.

"Your decisions have a price. Your mistakes crumble you. Your debt never ends."

Trapped in a body of sand and borrowed time, you must go through three hells of experimental surrealism using a shield as a weapon. The Devil watches your journey, where your progress doesn’t destroy you arbitrarily, but your combat skill and the risks you choose to take decide your survival or your inevitable collapse.

Here, you don’t take continuous damage just from the passage of time; every crack in your body is the result of your own actions.

Challenging Roguelike Action: An intense gameplay loop where death is part of the deal. You make a pact with the Devil to come back to life, but you realize you’ve rented your own agony.

Retro PS1 Aesthetic: A distinct nostalgic and abstract visual identity that immerses you in a hostile ecosystem where organic life and inert structures collide.

The Shield as a Weapon: Master a unique combat system where your main tool for defense is also your way to take down threats.

4859050.name: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage

store_data.about_the_game:
Join Teal, a self-conscious chef, and her best friend Ludo, as they take on a new business venture of running their own restaurant! 

As Teal operates as the restaurant's chef, she will manage orders, prepare food, and get it out in a timely manner, all while building up the courage she once had.

Help Teal regain her courage in this fast-paced environment and become the best chef she was meant to be!

Meet Teal!

Growing up in the Apple Blossom Orphanage, Teal from the start, absolutely loved cooking. And was gifted at it too, making all kinds of dishes at her young age. And when the Orphanage was struggling to pay bills and was on the verge of closure, Teal used her cooking skills to open a stall and sell cucumber sandwiches to pay for it. Earning more than enough money to save the Orphanage and start a new life.

Cut to several years later, and Teal is having a hard time chasing her dreams of becoming a great cook, as no one will give her a chance. This caused the confidence in her cooking that she had as a kid to slowly diminish, with her becoming self-conscious about her food being tasted by anyone. It was around this time that Ludo, Teal's best friend from the Orphanage, approached her with a business venture he had been planning.

A delivery service from home. Teal would take orders and cook meals, essentially becoming a ghost restaurant, while Ludo delivers the orders to the customers. Teal accepts this offer thinking she won't have to face anyone. But in reality, she unaware that Ludo's plan, was the exact opposite..

This Demo will include:

  • Cooking a variety of foods

  • Earning money from completed orders

  • The first shift where you must complete the quota in the allotted time

  • An after-story custom run mode to do a shift with any kind of quota and time limit. (See if you can beat the max difficulty~)

The full game will feature:

  • Cooking a bigger variety of foods

  • Earning money to purchase items and meet deadlines

  • Upgrading zones to further enhance your completion speed

  • Side jobs to earn money and unlock new recipes

  • Custom Shift: Can you beat the max difficulty?~

  • Endless Shift: See how far you can get~

『Dice of Soul』はチンチロ×ターン制バトルの新感覚ストラテジーゲームです。

プレイヤーは個性的なキャラクターのスキルや攻撃の対象を選択、相手と自分の行動順を見極めながら戦います。

バトルでは、キャラクターのステータスとスキルだけではなく、チンチロの結果に応じてダメージが変わり、戦況を大きく変える一撃が出ることもあります。

『絶対』ということはない。大きなリターンを得るためにリスクを背負うか、堅実に攻めるか。

運と戦略の両面からゲームを組み立てることが勝利の鍵です。

ゲームの主な特徴

store_data.about_the_game:
Find containers drifting at sea, recover abandoned vehicles, seize valuable cargo, and sell or use it to make a profit. Use the money you earn to upgrade your boats, weapons, and equipment, expand your crew, and take part in more dangerous operations.

Every voyage offers different opportunities. Sometimes a container may hold luxury electronics, sometimes military equipment, and sometimes rare contraband. Collect cargo washed ashore after storms, explore sunken ships, and chase treasures hidden in the depths of the ocean.

Build and develop your own base. Construct warehouses, stockpile fuel, set up repair areas, and manage your operations from there. Negotiate with black market traders, sell contraband for higher prices in different ports, and create your own economic network at sea.

Avoid patrolling coast guard boats, hide from radar systems, or engage in high-risk chases. Organize night operations and use weather conditions such as fog and storms to your advantage.

Raid ships together with your friends, divide tasks, and work as a team to take over large merchant vessels. Bigger rewards always come with bigger risks.

  • Open-world sea exploration and freeform gameplay

  • Boarding, combat, and looting mechanics

  • Recovering and using abandoned vehicles

  • Black market, trading, and dynamic economy

  • Building a pirate base and managing operations

  • Escaping the coast guard and engaging in sea chases

  • Online co-op playable solo or with friends

store_data.about_the_game:
"Zombie Scavenger" is a first-person interactive narrative exploration game.

On an Earth buried in nuclear dust, civilization is frozen inside an "old dream of the future"—plastic white-shell buildings, blue-and-orange neon, and atomic-age advertising still running on autopilot, long after zombies, rust, and ruin swallowed them whole. You play as K-7, a "colony pre-cleanup robot" dispatched by the Blue Ring Interstellar Service Company. Your mission sounds simple: clear the contamination, capture "habitable" footage, and submit samples of human life to prove to the next wave of colonists that Earth is ready to live in again.

But there are no real "samples" here. Only the plastic family mannequins drifting through a supermarket, the radio ads looping endlessly in a subway station, and a single ostrich the system has mistaken for an "ecological specimen." You start to read the world through the logic of old advertising—treating "home" as a mission objective and "life" as a program to be reproduced. The closer your footage looks to "human," and the further your behavior drifts from cleanup protocol, the more the Blue Ring system flags you as an anomaly. What you don't know: every K-series robot has reached this exact point—right before being scrapped by the next generation.

Gameplay

  • Explore the atomic wasteland: move through supermarkets, subway stations, and automated cities, piecing together what "human life" is supposed to look like from endlessly looping retro ads.

  • Clean & document: clear contamination, photograph "habitable" footage, and file sample after sample of human life back to the Blue Ring system.

  • Interactive narrative: shape how K-7 "understands the world" through dialogue and behavioral choices—and whether it treats "home" as a destination or a directive.

  • Break protocol: the more human you become, the more the system reads you as defective. Every choice draws you closer to the truth—and to deletion.

Player Goals

  • Complete the Blue Ring Company's cleanup and documentation contracts.

  • Redefine what "home" and "life" mean within the logic of a dead era's advertising.

  • Choose between protocol and selfhood, deciding K-7's fate—and whether the K-series cycle can finally be broken.

Style & Experience

Rendered in an "atompunk-meets-wasteland" aesthetic—plastic shells, blue-orange neon, and atomic-age nostalgia layered over the desolation of zombies and rust. Combining 3D imagery with cinematic camerawork, the game builds a lonely, absurd, and restrained atmosphere, inviting you to ask—through the eyes of a single machine—what it really means to be human.

store_data.about_the_game:
Word Puzzle Master is a cozy word game built around one simple pleasure: spotting words hidden in a grid of letters. Drag across neighbouring tiles to spell a word, watch the letters lift into place, and clear the board one word at a time.

Take your time — you can't lose a level here. When there's a clock at all, it only decides your third star, never the game. Just letters, soft light, and the quiet satisfaction of a board coming clean.

WHAT'S INSIDE

• 10 themed packs — Body, City, Nature, Space, Music, History and more, each with its own words.

• Boards that grow with you — from quick 3×3 grids up to 5×5, capped by a 7×7 BOSS in every pack.

• Five ways to play:

– Category: clear the levels, earn up to three stars on each.

– Daily Puzzle: one new board every day — keep your streak alive.

– Endless: clear board after board until the words run out.

– Time Attack: how many words can you find in 1, 3 or 5 minutes?

– Hardcore: no hints. Just you and the grid.

• Hints when you need them, plus a free handful every day.

• Steam Achievements to collect.

• Fully offline, single-player, and friendly for all ages.

Pick a category, trace your first word, and see how far you get.

A note on languages: the interface is fully translated into English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and German. The puzzle words themselves are in English for now — more language packs are on the way.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wash up alone in the wilderness — nothing but your hands and what the land gives you. You chop wood, raise a shelter, and fight to stay alive as the seasons turn toward a merciless winter. Then one day, a stray dog crosses your path. Feed it. Earn its trust. Watch it grow — and it never leaves your side.

By My Side is an open-world survival-craft game about raw survival, a home you build with your own hands, and the bond that grows between you and your dog.

🐕 Your Dog, Your Story — Find a stray and raise it from a pup. Each run it's a different breed with its own look and talent. Teach it tricks, put it to work — guard, hunt, or haul a sled — and it follows your commands, watches your back, and warns you the moment danger closes in.

🏡 Build & Power a Home — From a first campfire to a walled homestead with a glass greenhouse and an upper floor. Place every foundation, wall, stair and roof freely — then bring it to life with your own power-and-water grid: solar, batteries, pumps, heaters, sprinklers, smelters and smart-relay automation that keeps the base running while you're away.

🔨 Craft Everything — Over 90 recipes across workbench, furnace, campfire and powered machines. Gather raw materials and refine them through real crafting trees — ore into iron into steel, fibre into cloth into cable — into tools, gear and the machines that run your home.

❄️ Survive the Seasons — Stay warm, fed and dry as spring, summer and autumn give way to a winter that wants you dead. Food spoils — salt it, preserve it, stock the larder before the cold. Droughts, animal migrations, wolf packs and aurora-lit nights keep every year unpredictable.

🌾 Live Off the Land — Till fields and grow crops, keep them alive year-round in a heated greenhouse, raise animals, trade with a wandering merchant, and automate the grind so your homestead works for you.

🐺 Defend What's Yours — The wild fights back, and it escalates the longer you last: harsher winters and pack sieges that strike from the first night. Read the danger, fortify your home, and hold the line beside your dog.

🧭 Every Run Is Different — Start from a fresh scenario, then take on one of a dozen origins — each a real strength and a weakness that shape how you survive. Climb the homestead ranks toward an endgame worth chasing.

🎮 Two Ways to Play — Survival (hardcore: one life, permadeath) or Story (your home and world endure when you fall).

Arrive with nothing. Leave a legacy — with your dog by your side.

🐕 Your Dog, Your Story — Find a stray and raise it from a pup. Each run it's a different breed with its own look and talent. Teach it tricks, put it to work — guard, hunt, or haul a sled — and it follows your commands, watches your back, and warns you the moment danger closes in.

🏡 Build & Power a Home — From a first campfire to a walled homestead with a glass greenhouse and an upper floor. Place every foundation, wall, stair and roof freely — then bring it to life with your own power-and-water grid: solar, batteries, pumps, heaters, sprinklers, smelters and smart-relay automation that keeps the base running while you're away.

🔨 Craft Everything — Over 90 recipes across workbench, furnace, campfire and powered machines. Gather raw materials and refine them through real crafting trees — ore into iron into steel, fibre into cloth into cable — into tools, gear and the machines that run your home.

❄️ Survive the Seasons — Stay warm, fed and dry as spring, summer and autumn give way to a winter that wants you dead. Food spoils — salt it, preserve it, stock the larder before the cold. Droughts, animal migrations, wolf packs and aurora-lit nights keep every year unpredictable.

🌾 Live Off the Land — Till fields and grow crops, keep them alive year-round in a heated greenhouse, raise animals, trade with a wandering merchant, and automate the grind so your homestead works for you.

🐺 Defend What's Yours — The wild fights back, and it escalates the longer you last: harsher winters and pack sieges that strike from the first night. Read the danger, fortify your home, and hold the line beside your dog.

🧭 Every Run Is Different — Start from a fresh scenario, then take on one of a dozen origins — each a real strength and a weakness that shape how you survive. Climb the homestead ranks toward an endgame worth chasing.

🎮 Two Ways to Play — Survival (hardcore: one life, permadeath) or Story (your home and world endure when you fall).

Arrive with nothing. Leave a legacy — with your dog by your side.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build a fortress. Hold the line.

OUTWORKS is a 3D base-defense survival game about one thing: build a fortress, and hold.

A glowing command core sits at the center. Around it you raise a layered structure — floor by floor, wall by wall — and arm every tier with turrets. Then the waves come: fast ground swarms below, gunships and bombers from above. Your design either holds, or it doesn't.

Between waves you get a breather to build: spend the scrap from each kill to expand, re-tier and upgrade, then brace for a bigger wave. That build-fast, hold-on rhythm is the heart of it — read the threat, commit to a layout, and feel the rush when your fortress holds the line (or scramble when it buckles).

⬆ Height is the whole game

Ground enemies threaten your lower floors; flyers strike from above. Deciding what to place at which altitude is the core puzzle. Stack higher for range and sightlines — but pay in resources, and in structure. Breachers and sappers tear down walls, and when a support falls, the floors and turrets above it collapse with it. Your fortress isn't just firepower; it's architecture under fire.


🏗 Build & defend

Build in three dimensions — stack up to twelve floors, lay walls (including counter-walls that reflect damage back), raise support pillars, and slot turrets across every tier.


Nine turret types — basic, rapid, heavy, sniper and anti-air to start; unlock the gatling, a piercing railgun, wall-clearing artillery and splash missiles by upgrading your command core.


Active powers — call in an orbital strike, freeze the field with an EMP, or emergency-repair your core — all spent live from your scrap, on a cooldown.


Structural collapse — destroy what holds a tower up and everything above comes down.

⚔ Survive the swarm

Fourteen enemy types — swarmers, armored tanks, shielded APCs, splitters, warpers, regenerators, jammers, turret-bombing gunships, and escalating bosses.


Draft upgrades between waves — after every wave, pick one of three run-wide boosts (damage, fire rate, range, salvage, fortify). Compounding choices shape each run.


Endless escalation — a campaign that forks twice: bank your run for a depth record, or commit to an endless rising tide and chase a score.

🌐 Beyond the run

Global leaderboards — online boards (weekly / monthly / all-time) for depth and endless runs. Plays fully offline; your local best is always kept.

Creative mode — a free-build sandbox: 18 sculpting blocks, a 12-color palette, towers up to 12 levels. No enemies, no cost — just build.


A curated military look — weathered concrete and amber-neon accents. Fourteen interface languages.


No image assets, all code — clean neon geometry, swarms, tracers, ballistic arcs and screen-shake juice. Runs light — even on integrated graphics and modest laptops.


Lean by design. One fortress, escalating pressure, and a single question: how long can you hold?

store_data.about_the_game:
Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered. 

Some people watch birds. 

You shoot them. 

Pluck Em! is a colorful arcade shooter inspired by the golden age of gaming, when all you needed was quick reflexes, good aim and a healthy disregard for wildlife. 

Travel across a world filled with forests, swamps, beaches, frozen wastelands, deserts and places that definitely weren't approved by local authorities. Along the way you'll encounter dozens of bird species, earn medals, unlock new equipment and gradually build a bestiary packed with facts, legends and the occasional complete nonsense. 

Because every bird has a story. 

Some of those stories are even true. 

 

Become a Certified Bird Expert* 

*Certification not legally recognized anywhere. 

Discover dozens of species across 11 unique biomes. 

Learn fascinating facts about nature, history and culture. 

Then immediately ruin that education by reading a rumor claiming the same bird once robbed a merchant, started a cult or refuses to cast a shadow. 

We're not saying these stories are true. 

We're just saying nobody has disproven them. 

A World Full of Feathers 

🦆 Explore 11 distinct biomes 

📖 Complete your Bestiary 

🏆 Earn medals and hunting trophies 

🎯 Master skill-based shooting challenges 

👑 Face biome bosses 

🛒 Unlock upgrades and gadgets 

🌞 Discover species active at different times of day 

🌴 Find hidden secrets scattered across the world 

 

Built With AI. Polished With Stubbornness. 

Pluck Em! is an experimental game created almost entirely with AI-powered tools. 

Visual assets and code were generated using Moonlake AI. 

Music was created with Suno AI. 

The gameplay systems, balancing, testing, bug fixing, polishing and thousands of tiny decisions required to transform a pile of generated content into an actual game were handled manually. 

In other words: 

The AI did the heavy lifting. 

The human spent weeks asking: 

"Yes, but can you make it less terrible?" 

Repeatedly. 

 

One More Thing... 

Somewhere in the desert there's a place most hunters never find. 

A quiet oasis. 

A few palm trees. 

A mysterious falcon. 

And absolutely nothing strange going on. 

Probably.

store_data.about_the_game:
MEDIEVAL ASCENDANT


You begin with nothing. A serf bound to the soil, no trade, no name worth
remembering. What you become — and what your bloodline becomes after you —
is yours to forge.

Medieval Ascendant is a deep medieval life and dynasty simulation. Live a
single life season by season, climb the rigid ranks of feudal society, and
when death comes, continue through your heir. Every choice compounds across
the generations.

⚜️ Climb the Feudal Ladder

Start as a serf and rise through the ranks — commoner, day-labourer,
patrician, nobility and beyond. Each rank unlocks new freedoms: a trade of
your own, the right to travel, to ship goods, to own land and to play the
great game of houses.

🌾 Work the Land

A real three-field farming system with persistent plots and soil quality.
Sow, harvest and let fields lie fallow — neglect your land and it grows
barren; tend it well and it feeds your house for generations.

⚒️ Master a Trade & Build an Economy

Learn a craft and turn raw materials into wealth. Construct farms, sawmills,
brickworks, quarries, mines and more — a full production chain feeding a
living, simulated market. Prices rise and fall with supply, demand, weather
and prosperity. Build a true economic empire.

🗺️ Five Provinces, One Realm

Travel an interactive map of the realm — from the agrarian heartland to the
mining mountains, the deep forests and the maritime trading port of Ostia.
Each province has its own character, its own goods, its own opportunities.
Distance matters. Travel costs you.

👑 Seize Land, Rule the Realm

Rise to the nobility and the realm itself becomes your board. There is more
than one road to power: march to open war and take land by the sword,
scheme your way into it through the intrigue of the great houses — or
turn your wealth into a weapon, starving the common folk until the
land falls into your hands. How you claim your domain is up to you.

⚔️ Wage War, Win Battles

War is fought in phases — a true campaign of strategic planning, where you
position, manoeuvre and commit before steel ever meets steel. The battle
system mirrors every phase on the field: a tactical clash of stances,
initiative and weapon choice. Gain battle experience and equip weapons and
armour with real combat stats — but beware: a lost fight can leave you
crippled by lasting wounds, or dead. On the road, bandits lie in wait too —
fight them, pay them off, or talk your way out.

🏛️ Forge a Dynasty

Marry, raise children, and feed your whole household — because a family that
goes hungry suffers, sickens, and can be lost. When you die, your heir takes
up the name. Wounds don't carry over, but your wealth, your standing and your
legacy do. Rise high enough, and the houses of the realm will reckon with
your name.

📜 A Living Realm

No two dynasties walk the same road. Procedurally generated dialogue brings
every encounter to life, and branching story arcs unfold differently with
each playthrough — your choices, your rivals and your bloodline shaping a
tale that is yours alone.

Key Features

  • Deep season-by-season life simulation across multiple generations
  • Rise from bound serf to the ruling elite of the realm
  • Persistent three-field farming with soil quality and crop rotation
  • A fully simulated economy with production chains and living markets
  • Five distinct provinces to explore, trade and settle
  • Claim land through war, intrigue or economic ruin of your rivals
  • Multi-phase warfare with strategic planning and tactical battles
  • Duel-based combat with weapons, armour and lasting wounds
  • Dynasty system: marriage, heirs, household survival and legacy
  • Procedurally generated dialogue and branching story arcs
  • Storybook art style — ink & watercolour throughout

Your name will be forgotten — unless you make it ascendant.

store_data.about_the_game:
A murder has been committed. Can you solve it?

CluDoku blends the satisfying logic of sudoku with classic murder mystery deduction. A victim has been found — your job is to place suspects into rooms using clues, eliminate the impossible, and name the killer before you run out of chances.

How it works

Each case gives you a grid of rooms and a set of suspects. Clues constrain where each suspect can be. Place them correctly, find the victim's room, and make your accusation. Every deduction is yours: no guessing, pure logic.

Two case variants

  • Classic — The victim shares a room with one suspect. Find the room, name the killer.

  • Evidence — Three weapons are hidden on the map. Investigate furniture and blocked cells to uncover them. Only when all weapons are found can you resolve the case and the combined clues reveal the true murder weapon before you make the accusation.

Play your way

  • Single-player — Solve cases at your own pace with no time pressure (or set a timer for a real challenge).

  • Local co-op (pass & play) — 2–4 detectives take turns on one device. Each detective keeps their clues private in a personal dossier, then shares deductions with the team. Placements start as color-coded proposals; a second detective must confirm each mark.

  • Online co-op — Play with friends anywhere via Steam lobbies. Just share the room code and solve together.

Features

  • Procedurally generated cases with selectable themes (mansion, cruise ship, bakery, casino) and three difficulty sizes (7×7 easy, 9×9 medium, 11×11 hard).

  • Case timer with adjustable limits.

  • Manual deduction mode: cross out any cell yourself.

  • Full controller support: Navigate every menu and solve every case with a gamepad.

  • Furniture panel showing every object, orientation, and footprint in the current case.

  • Progress history and replay by seed for your favorite cases.

  • Interface in English and Spanish.

store_data.about_the_game:
WreckingBall is a physics-based pinball roguelike where you don’t destroy the world — you bounce through it.
Aim once, fire the ball, and then try to save the run as everything goes wonderfully wrong.

🎯 One Shot. Endless Chaos.
Each attempt starts with a single shot. Once the ball is moving, you can’t simply control it directly. Instead, you manipulate the environment, trigger abilities, and hope your plan survives contact with physics.

🧱 Build the Run Room by Room
Every time you reach the goal, the finish moves farther away. A new room is added to the end of the route, and you choose which room comes next. Safer rooms make survival easier, while harder rooms reward you with more ability uses for the run.

⚡ Use Powerful Abilities to Bend the Rules
When a bounce goes wrong, your abilities can turn failure into a clutch save:

  • 🌀 Teleport the ball to a better position

  • 🔁 Fire again while the ball is still moving

  • 🪑 Place a table to create a new bounce angle

  • 👻 Ghost through objects when the path is blocked

  • 🚪 Close the last door you passed through

  • 🟡 Split the ball in two and double your chances

🏠 A Growing House of Bad Decisions
The route gets longer after every success. More rooms mean more doors, more obstacles, more angles, and more ways for your perfect shot to become a complete disaster.

💀 Roguelike Pressure, Physics-Based Skill
Every run is built from your choices. Pick risky rooms for more tools, or play it safe and hope your abilities last long enough. The farther you get, the more every bounce matters.

WreckingBall is not about breaking walls.
It is about mastering the bounce, improvising under pressure, and somehow landing the impossible shot.

store_data.about_the_game:
There is war going on. But you need to buy bread. 

This game will tell you a story about life in a warn-torn country, but far away from the front. It shows the side of the conflict that almost nobody is talking about. There are no bravery, heroism, or sacrifice that you would expect from a tale about war - just people who are trying to survive and piece together what remains of their lives. It is a tale of the Forgotten Ones, people whose stories you would otherwise never know.

Your goal is simple - find a shop, buy the bread. Key features:

  • Listen to the story about the life behind the frontline, and how civillians are coping with it.

  • Walk, walk, walk a lot! It is Breadwalk, not a Breadtalk. 

  • Ok, you can talk a bit. Communicate with bizzare locals! 

  • Listen to the music. A lot of it! 

  • Search for a way to unlock 3 hidden endings. 

It is a short journey, but, hopefully - a memorable one. 

Also.. don't get ahead of the line!

store_data.about_the_game:
Night Falls is a multiplayer social deduction game set in a village where no one is who they claim to be. Gather up to 16 players, get handed a secret role, and fight to survive or to win as the Town, the Mafia, or something far worse.

Every night the village sleeps, and killers move in the dark. Every morning the survivors gather to argue, accuse, and send someone to the gallows. Read the room, sell your lie, and figure out who's bluffing before the body count climbs.

Everyone has a role. Someone is always lying

Over 20 unique roles split across three sides — each with its own powers, secrets, and way to win:

  • Town — protect the innocent and hunt the killers. Revive the dead as the Doctor, jail and execute a suspect as the Jailor, read houses as the Investigator, inspect corpses as the Detective, snap evidence as the Cameraman, and more.

  • Mafia — a secret team that knows each other and picks the town apart. Stalk with a knife, break down doors, frame the innocent, silence loud players, and disguise your kills.

  • Werewolf — a lone predator with its own agenda. It transforms after dark, tears across the village, and hunts on its own terms — answering to no one.

  • Jester — a neutral with one deranged goal: get yourself executed. The Jester wins only by goading the town into voting you to the gallows.

Your powers play out in the world

Abilities aren't faceless menu clicks. The Doctor kneels over a body to bring it back. The Jailor straps a prisoner into the electric chair. The Cameraman's photo is pinned to the town board at dawn for everyone to study. The Mafia breaks through doors in the night, and the Werewolf tears across the village. What you do leaves traces — if someone's watching.

Talk your way out - or into a grave

Live voice chat is the real battlefield. Speak to those nearby, scheme privately with your Mafia, or sweat through a Jailor's interrogation. The best lie is the one everyone believes.

A village that breathes

A moonlit town drenched in fog, flickering lamps, and long shadows. Own your own house, learn the streets, and use the dark to your advantage — because some roles see the night more clearly than others.

Features

  • Online multiplayer for up to 16 players

  • 20+ hidden roles across Town, Mafia, and Neutral factions

  • A day/night loop of secret night actions, heated discussion, and public votes

  • Proximity + secret role-based voice chat

  • Hands-on, world-interactive role abilities

  • An atmospheric moonlit village built for paranoia

When night falls, trust is the most dangerous thing you can give. Will you survive until dawn?

store_data.about_the_game:
Rekindle the darkened Northern Lights

The Darkened Northern Lights is a family-friendly storybook RPG rooted in Finnish mythology. The Northern Lights have vanished from the sky, and only you can light them again. Journey through snowy forests, quiet shores, and ancient places—and bring the world back to life.

The game is like a living storybook, its heart beating for story and reading. On your journey, you will meet the folk of the forest, listen to their tales, and make choices that drive the adventure forward. It also offers a fun way to learn about Finnish mythology, brought to life gently and beautifully colored by the game's own magic. It features easy-to-learn dice combat and familiar role-playing elements, but there is never a rush. It is perfect to play and read together, even as a bedtime story.

In this world you can:

  • Learn about Finnish mythology and discover ancient tales in a fun, fairy-tale-inspired way
  • Free enchanted gnomes and rescue fire foxes along your journey
  • Gather companions who travel by your side and help you in battles
  • Engage in simple yet exciting turn-based dice combat
  • Make meaningful choices—all the way to the end of the adventure
  • Tend to your own garden and grow magical flowers
  • Explore the world entirely at your own pace, with no rush and no punishments

Who is this game for?

The Darkened Northern Lights is designed to encourage reading. It is a perfect fit for children, new players, and anyone looking for a gentle, peaceful adventure. Enjoy the game together with a child or immerse yourself in it on your own—just like reading a good storybook.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb out of the dark.

A thousand years ago, the world above ended. The few who survived fled underground and built a society in the dark. None of us has seen the surface. None of our parents did. None of theirs.

Then the deep shook. A roar from far above, deeper than any thunder. The ceilings we had trusted for a thousand years came down to find us. When the dust settled, there were six of us left.

The same shaking that dropped our city cracked the old gates open. For the first time in memory, the road up is there to take.

Deeprise is an underground colony survival game about six people trying to reach a light no one alive has seen. Every run is one push up through a maze of tunnels knotted by collapse and time. Reach the gate, find the keys, and open the next zone above. Die in the dark, and your colony is one fewer.

Six survivors.

The last of us are not interchangeable. Two are strong, built to carry and to break. Two are clever, hard to corner, harder to catch. Two are more machine than flesh, fitted with worn plates and tireless hands.

  • The Breaker can carry the heaviest loads, and the heaviest hits. Strong arms, strong stomach, one direct answer to most problems.

  • The Welded is half human, half salvaged machine. Tireless, armored, and at home in the deepest dark, though they cannot carry a sleeping body home.

  • The Tinker is quick, sharp-minded, and the cleverest of us. Where the Breaker takes a hit and the Welded shrugs one off, the Tinker steps aside.

The deep is not what it was.

The beasts in the maze were ordinary animals once, only rats and dogs and crawling things. Something took them. It bolted plates to their backs and bred them in the black, and fed them on whatever the dark provides. What came out is not what went in.

The Deep Ledger is the book dawnseekers carry into the maze and copy by hand as they go, every tunnel walked, every beast learned, every vein of salt found. What the Ledger holds, the colony keeps forever.

But the Ledger only comes back if its dawnseeker does. Those who die in the dark die with their pages. Whatever they learned, the colony loses with them.

A colony to feed. A climb to plan.

Between every run, the outpost waits. Fungal farms and water reclaimers keep the colony alive. Workshops, smithies, and med bays let you outfit the next runner. Stockpile salt, stalkwood, palecap, and the dead circuitry pried from the walls. Spend it on weapons, armor, research, and the salt it takes to wake a sleeper.

Some of us were left in cold glass, sealed and breathing slow. With the right hands and enough bittersalt, we can wake them. Every sleeper you carry home is one more pair of hands for the climb.

The road up is a faith.

There is nothing left below us now. The deep gave us all it had. To stay is to starve in the black. So we climb, toward a light the old stories promised and no living person has ever seen.

Up is not a direction to us anymore. It is the only one we have left.

He is the kind of man who will descend from the sky the moment you are in danger, who will lock onto you with his deep, impenetrable gaze, and who made you the absolute envy of every guest at your wedding.

Except for one glaring problem—

He refuses to touch you.

It has been three months. One hundred and three days. Your marriage remains as completely pristine as a blank sheet of paper. He refuses to graze even the very tips of your fingers, yet in the dead of night, he locks himself in the bathroom, dry-heaving violently over the toilet until the break of dawn.

You suffer from Touch Starvation. The doctors clinically define it as an illness, but in your heart, you know the truth: you simply crave to be loved, to be touched, to be entirely possessed. And Albarn is the man you fell in love with at first sight; he is the husband you pursued relentlessly until he was finally yours.

You tell yourself over and over again that he merely needs time.

That is, until a young man named Morley moves into the apartment next door. He has a brilliant, radiant smile and the gentlest eyes.

Though he is only one month younger than you, he stubbornly insists on calling you "Sister." He is the one who presses a strawberry-flavored candy into your palm when you are on the verge of tears. He is the one who gently strums his guitar for you on the nights when insomnia takes hold. And he is the one who silently, warmly grasps your hand whenever your husband leaves you out in the cold.

Morley tells you that Albarn does not love you at all.

Morley leans in and whispers—

"ma’am, I am the one who truly loves you."

Right now, you are standing at the absolute edge of a precipice.

On one side stands your apathetic husband, his towering frame hiding unfathomable, dark secrets, his physical rejection slicing into your heart like a jagged blade. On the other side stands your fervent, passionate suitor, his affection surging like a tidal wave threatening to completely drown you—yet you realize you know absolutely nothing about the shadows lurking in his past.

miniBattle is a bite-sized, turn-based battle game with an oldskool heart. Take turns moving across procedurally generated battlefields and lob shots over hills and trees — but mind the wind, or your grenade drifts wide.

Features

🎯 Turn-based tactics — 2 actions per turn, a 60-second clock, and no two battlefields alike (procedurally generated every match).

💣 Five weapons — Pistol, Machine Gun, Grenade, Cluster Grenade and a long-range Grenade Launcher that leaves craters in the ground.

🌬️ Wind & ballistics — set your angle and power; the wind does the rest. Optional Aim Assist shows a calm-weather trajectory while you still judge the gusts.

🌫️ Fog of War — you only see what's in your line of sight. Hunt enemies by the "!" sound markers they leave when they shoot or move.

🏴 Two modes — Last Man Standing and Capture the Flag.

📦 Airdrops — first-aid kits, ammo and grenades drop into the field as the fight heats up.

🤖 Smart bots — practice solo with ruthless opponents.
🛋️ Local hotseat — pass-and-play on a single screen. Gather your friends around one machine and settle the score the old-fashioned way — perfect for game nights. Like we used to.

🌐 Online multiplayer via Steam — host or browse open games, with cross-play between Windows and macOS.

26,000+ procedurally generated players across 76 leagues in 25 countries, down to the third divisions. Send scouts abroad, travel to meet wonderkids in person, and find the gem nobody else has noticed.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bet It All on a Roll of the Dice

RollRift Arena is a fast-paced dice strategy battler. Every round, both players roll at the same time — and whoever stops on the higher number seizes control of the turn. Timing your stop is timing your win. With control in hand, you move, attack, or rush into a special room to grab gear. Meanwhile the board itself is crumbling: every few rounds the outer ring of tiles cracks and collapses, forcing everyone toward the center — and a final, single-tile showdown.

Core Gameplay

Dice Showdown — both sides roll in sync; the higher roll acts first, and your stop timing decides everything

Grid Tactics — move, block, and set traps on a procedurally generated board

Collapsing Arena — outer tiles crumble round after round; stall too long and you'll be teleported off a vanishing tile

Special Rooms — Kitchen: Pot (+1 HP), Spatula (+1 Attack); Bathroom: Water Gun (+1 Range), Toilet (teleport your opponent)

Final Duel — when one tile is left it stops collapsing, and fully geared warriors clash head-on

Multiple Battle Modes

Online PvP — quick auto-match or pick a room to duel a friend directly; results count toward the global leaderboard

Player vs Computer — three AI difficulty tiers, from learning the ropes to a real challenge

Local Multiplayer — two players, one keyboard, same screen

Make Your Own Warrior

A built-in pixel-art Character Workshop with brush, bucket, eyedropper, and mirror tools. Craft a one-of-a-kind avatar to carry into battle — edits save automatically.

Easy to Learn, Deep to Master

A match takes only a few minutes and the rules click instantly — but your stop timing, item choices, and positioning before each collapse are all mind games against your opponent. Climb to the top of the leaderboard and prove you've got the luck and the brains.

store_data.about_the_game:
Pure Nun's Redemption Request - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.
Core plot introduction: On a rainy night in New York, Ethan, a food delivery guy, is attacked. At the verge of death, he merges with the 7th consciousness and becomes a super digital life form. He discovers that his grandmother's illness is related to the human experiments of the FX Group, and thus embarks on a journey to seek the truth and fight against evil. He confronts Dr. Qing'en in the clinic, maneuvers with Pei Yisha in the company, and also discovers the secrets of the underground church in the City of London .
Worldview atmosphere: The story constructs a cyberpunk world full of technological and mysterious elements. The human experiments of the FX Group, the mysterious three - mind power system, the ability to reconstruct the physical body with nanotechnology, and superpowers like teleportation make the whole world full of fantasy and also permeated with the atmosphere of conspiracy and crisis.
Highlights of female character interactions: Dr. Qing'en is cold and domineering. She is full of vigilance towards Ethan's abnormal injuries, and the interaction between them sparks. Pei Yisha looks gentle but is actually controlled by a chip. She gradually awakens with Ethan's help, and the emotional entanglement between her and Ethan is heart - warming .
Tension in character relationships: Ethan and the 7th consciousness depend on each other and face challenges together. There is both cooperation and probing between him and female characters like Qing'en and Pei Yisha, and the relationship is complex and delicate. He is in a life - and - death opposition with the FX Group and its minions, full of intense conflicts.
Scene features: From the rainy New York streets to the hidden private clinic, from the Nova Data Security Company to the underground church in the City of London, the scenes are rich and diverse. Each scene is full of unique atmosphere and stories, bringing an immersive experience to players .
Immersive experience: Players will follow Ethan's perspective to delve into this world full of fantasy and crisis, feeling his joys, sorrows, fears, and courage. Through interactions with various characters, they gradually uncover the truth behind, as if they were the protagonists of the story.
High - definition visual performance: The game uses high - definition graphics to vividly present the characters' expressions, actions, and scene details. Whether it's the rainy street view, the interior decoration of the clinic, or the characters' clothing and makeup, it gives a strong visual impact .
Functional gameplay features: It supports offline play, allowing players to immerse themselves in the story anytime and anywhere. It has a one - click backtracking function for players to review important plots. The auto - play function enables players to easily enjoy the story. The chapter browsing function allows players to quickly locate the parts they are interested in. High - definition CG provides players with a more beautiful visual experience, and the smooth reading experience ensures that players won't feel stuck.

store_data.about_the_game:
Morhval: Ravenglaire is a dark fantasy text RPG focused on exploration, character building, turn-based combat, and decisions with lasting consequences.

You are eighteen years old when hunger reaches your home. With little more than a weapon, a few supplies, and your own judgment, you leave for Ravenglaire: a fractured province of closed gates, frightened villages, old powers, desperate families, and factions fighting to define what the future should become.

This is a game about reading the world carefully. Who do you trust? What do you risk? When do you fight, flee, negotiate, lie, help, abandon, or stay silent?

Create your character

Choose your attributes and skills, then build your character around weapons, magic, stealth, persuasion, survival, investigation or direct combat. Your stats affect skill checks, dialogue options, quest solutions and how you survive hostile encounters.

Explore a fractured province

Travel through five unique cities and many other locations, including roads, villages, forests, plains, ports, ruins and strange places touched by forces beyond ordinary life.

Ravenglaire contains numerous symbolic visual maps where movement, enemies, danger, loot and nearby threats can be seen before you act. The world is not only described in text: you must also read the space around you, judge risk, and decide when to move forward.

Fight, cast, hide or flee

Combat is turn-based and driven by action points, weapons, spells, potions and target choices. A bow, a blade, a spell, a hidden position or a desperate escape can all change the outcome of a fight.

Enemies include beasts, thieves, soldiers, faction agents and things that should not exist.

Make choices in a land under pressure

Ravenglaire is shaped by hunger, war, political control, religious pressure and old magic. Some people need help. Some want power. Some will use you. Some will remember what you did.

Your decisions can affect quests, factions, rewards, alliances, access to future options and major endings.

Features

  • A dark fantasy text RPG with a serious, atmospheric tone

  • Five unique cities and many other explorable regions

  • A large world with visual maps, hostile areas, secrets and dangerous routes

  • Character creation with attributes, combat skills and magic schools

  • Turn-based combat with action points, weapons, spells, potions, hiding and fleeing

  • Skill checks in dialogue, exploration, investigation and quest resolution

  • Multiple factions, political conflicts and moral choices

  • Quests with different outcomes, rewards and consequences

  • Multiple endings shaped by choices that carry lasting consequences

  • A story about survival, power, faith, hunger and the cost of choosing a side

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Umbral Adventures is a community-driven fantasy MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online worlds. Built around player freedom, meaningful progression, and social interaction, it offers a true sandbox experience where your story is yours to create.

A Living Sandbox World

Step into a vast world filled with untamed wilderness, ancient ruins, bustling settlements, and hidden secrets waiting to be uncovered. There is no single path to follow. Whether you choose to become a legendary warrior, master craftsman, wealthy merchant, fearless explorer, or trusted ally, every playstyle has a place in the world of Umbral Adventures.

Progress Through Effort

Character progression is built around dedication and mastery. Train a wide variety of skills, improve your combat abilities, gather rare resources, craft valuable items, and steadily build your reputation. Progress is earned through gameplay, not shortcuts, making every achievement meaningful.

Adventure Your Way

Questing is only one part of the journey. Explore forgotten locations, uncover mysteries, hunt powerful creatures, discover rare treasures, participate in community events, or simply forge your own goals. The world rewards curiosity and encourages players to create their own adventures.

Meaningful Group Play

While solo play is fully supported, many of the world's greatest challenges are best overcome together. Form parties, join guilds, tackle dangerous dungeons, conquer powerful world bosses, and build lasting friendships through cooperative gameplay designed to encourage teamwork and social interaction.

Player-Driven Economy

Gather, craft, trade, and specialize. Resources gathered by players fuel the economy, while skilled crafters create equipment, tools, and consumables needed throughout the world. Every profession contributes to a living marketplace where players help shape the economy.

Persistent World

The world continues to evolve as players interact with it. Guilds rise and fall, markets fluctuate, and communities form around shared goals. Your actions contribute to a world that feels alive and worth investing in.

Key Features

  • True old-school sandbox MMORPG gameplay

  • Freedom to choose your own path and playstyle

  • Challenging group content and world bosses

  • Player-driven economy and trading

  • Gathering, crafting, and non-combat progression

  • Exploration-focused world filled with secrets

  • Community-first design with meaningful social systems

  • Fair progression with no pay-to-win mechanics

  • Persistent online world shaped by its players

Umbral Adventures is more than a destination, it's a world where every skill trained, every friendship forged, and every adventure undertaken becomes part of your story.

Forge your path. Build your legacy. Begin your adventure.

store_data.about_the_game:
A slacker has moved into the corner of your desktop

Sill Sticks is an idle app where a stick figure takes up residence on the window edges of your desktop—just sit back, watch, and enjoy.

The star of the show is "Bota." Sloppy, forever slacking off, a bit of a handful, and a bit cute—a stick figure you somehow can't bring yourself to dislike. He's got the will but not the way: he grumbles the whole time, then slacks off anyway. He looks up to cats, has a sweet tooth, holes up the moment he gets the chance, and melts away hours on "just one more round" of a game. Catch a glimpse of his mutterings in the gaps between your work. That's all this app is.

Features

  • He talks to himself, in context — Bota mutters away loosely depending on the time of day, the day of the week, and how long you've left things running. In the morning, "Still sleepy..."; late at night, "Go to bed already... me too, though." The combinations spin up fresh turns of phrase every day.
  • Just peek in — Bota has no idea you're there. Talk to him and he won't answer; he won't order you around either. That's exactly what makes eavesdropping on his honest thoughts so funny.
  • He never gets in the way — Clicks pass straight through to the window below, and he never shows up in your taskbar. He strolls along window edges, clambers up them, and now and then plays at special-move poses or warps around for fun.
  • Light, safe, offline — No communication and no AI while it runs. He never peeks at what's on your desktop, and never sends anything anywhere.

What's ahead

Fellow stick figures, seasonal and themed chatter packs, and more—Bota's world will keep widening little by little.

Sister app "Sill Cats"

From the same team behind "Sill Cats," where cats move into your desktop, comes the stick-figure edition. Stick figures (sticks) on your window sills. Enjoy another small dose of "comfort" to help you unwind.

store_data.about_the_game:
Colony 2 is a first-person psychological survival horror game that follows Gary, a young man haunted by a traumatic paranormal incident from his childhood.

Eight years ago, Gary entered an abandoned house to retrieve a cricket ball and encountered a series of terrifying supernatural events that left him with severe anxiety and PTSD. Despite years of therapy and medication, the nightmares never stopped.

Determined to uncover the truth behind his trauma, Gary begins investigating the incident himself. His search reveals a disturbing pattern of unexplained deaths, disappearances, and covered-up tragedies scattered across the country. Every clue leads to a single location:

An abandoned mental asylum hidden deep within a remote forest.

As Gary explores the asylum's decaying halls, he uncovers evidence of unethical medical experiments, mysterious patient deaths, and a doctor obsessed with creating a cure for a hereditary disease. The deeper he ventures, the more he realizes that the asylum's dark history may be connected to his own past.

Confront your fears, uncover hidden truths, and survive the horrors that await within the asylum.

Explore a Decaying Mental Asylum

Navigate interconnected corridors, patient wards, laboratories, maintenance tunnels, and hidden research facilities.

Psychological Horror Experience

Experience a slow-burn horror atmosphere driven by tension, uncertainty, and psychological distress rather than constant jump scares.

Investigation-Based Gameplay

Collect documents, audio recordings, patient files, and evidence to uncover the asylum's disturbing history.

Environmental Puzzles

Restore power, unlock restricted areas, solve mechanical puzzles, and uncover hidden paths throughout the facility.

Anxiety System

Manage Gary's PTSD and anxiety as stress affects perception, breathing, and awareness during exploration.

Immersive Storytelling

Piece together a deeply personal mystery involving family secrets, human experimentation, and long-buried truths.

store_data.about_the_game:
"At night I always dream of you"

Marliese Haugen, a rogue knight, ventures deep into dark biomes with a single goal: to rescue and reunite with her beloved, who was torn away from her life. Explore forests, dungeons, and mountains filled with enemies that will stand in your way as you strive to fulfill your mission to reach her.

"A beloved name inside my heart"

Enjoy a classic 2D Top-Down combat experience through linear levels, featuring attack, block, and counterattack mechanics. A wide variety of enemies awaits to halt your progress, all set to an original soundtrack composed by the virtuoso Black Metal artist Maidolem, alongside illustrations by the talented artist Ferys. Immerse yourself in this short but intense story of love, sacrifice, and devotion, perfect for a cold and snowy afternoon.

"Don't be afraid to kiss the dark"

Black Lily Inmortal draws on various old-school elements to create its bleak, funeral atmosphere. Featuring pre-rendered 3D graphics and analog magnetic tape effects, the game evokes the 90s Dungeon Synth and Norwegian Black Metal scenes, blending them with modern references such as the music of Opeth and the atmosphere of the video game SIGNALIS.

A dedicated elite knight known for her unwavering sense of duty and devotion. Beneath her worn and rusty armor lies a rebellious spirit, capable of defying the strictest orders and facing a desolate world just to protect and reunite with the one she loves.

The young heiress of a prestigious merchant clan, known for her gentle nature and an optimism that brightens her most difficult days. Despite her delicate health, she longs for freedom beyond her bedroom walls, finding her greatest happiness in the peaceful moments shared with Marliese.

store_data.about_the_game:
A boy came to the monastery gates.

He is sick.

His mother asks you to let him in.

But you will not be able to save everyone.

They Have Nowhere Else to Go

You are the new abbot of a poor monastery at the edge of the country. Supplies are running out, there are barely enough monks to handle the daily work, and the sick keep coming. No one knows what this disease is, where it came from, or whether it can be stopped.

Manage a Monastery on the Brink of Collapse

Every day, you decide who will stay inside the monastery to work, who will pray, who will care for the sick, and who will bury those you failed to save.

Outside the monastery walls, fear and despair are growing.

Inside, people are waiting for answers you do not have.

Everyone at the Gates Is a Risk

A refugee.

A dying peasant.

A pilgrim with a suspicious cough.

There will not be enough resources for everyone.

Let everyone in, and you risk the whole community. Close the gates, and you leave people to die.

But the Disease Threatens More Than the Body

Hunger, fear, and constant loss can destroy faith. If a monk loses faith, he may refuse to do his duties or leave the monastery at the very moment you need him most.

Who Will You Let Through the Gates?

Who will receive the last supplies?

Who will you try to save?

In the end, there will be no right answers.

Only the people you saved.

And those you could not save.

Key Features

  • Manage a poor medieval monastery during the outbreak of an unknown disease

  • Assign monks to work, prayer, care, supply runs, and burials

  • Decide who is allowed through the gates when food and medicine are running out

  • Balance food, medicine, fatigue, fear, and faith

  • Lose monks permanently to disease, hunger, or despair

  • Face a dark story about faith, guilt, survival, and the cost of mercy

store_data.about_the_game:
A little course, a hand of cards, and a hundred ways to play it.

PAR52 takes the easy charm of minigolf and hands you a deck. Every card is a shot: its number is how far the ball travels, its suit is how it gets there. Trace a line across the hex grid, watch the path light up, and change your mind as often as you like. Nothing's locked in until the ball drops.

Play it your way. There's no single right line to the pin. Lean on a suit, set up a tarot trick, swap your ball for one that rolls differently, or just take the prettiest route there. PAR52 is a game of style as much as skill: the fun is in deciding how you want to get the ball home.

♥️ Hearts skim across water

♠️ Spades power through sand

♣️ Clubs chip over anything

♦️ Diamonds ricochet off walls

A course that keeps unfolding. Play the standard nine, then a tenth-hole challenge, or take a detour. Find the windmill into the sewers, knock over enough tombstones to open the graveyard: secret side-routes branch off the main course for you to discover. Between holes you drop into the shop to buy, sell and rebuild your deck on the fly, and a single ball skin found late in a run can flip how you play everything after it.

Settle in. Every biome brings its own light, its own small wildlife on the greens, and its own music that shifts as you travel. No timers. No fail states. As gentle or as clever as you feel like being today: line up a towering Stardust combo, or just sink a few quiet holes. The board's always there when you want it, and a fresh daily challenge is waiting tomorrow.

Features

  • Minigolf reimagined as a card game: every shot is a card you play

  • Plan the route, preview the path, and only commit when the ball drops (your moves are yours to undo)

  • Four suits, four ways to move the ball, plus a tarot side-deck that bends the rules

  • A shop between holes: buy, sell and rebuild your deck mid-run

  • Ball skins that can change your whole approach to a course

  • Nine holes plus a tenth-hole challenge, and secret side-routes to uncover: the sewers, the graveyard, and more to come as the game grows

  • Biome by biome, the art and the music change around you

  • A new daily challenge each day: play for a relaxing round or chase your best run

  • Calm, single-player, pick-up-and-play. Sound on.

store_data.about_the_game:
MineEmAll is a short incremental game about mining resources, buying powerful upgrades, and clearing out a constantly growing mineshaft.

Mouse over tiles to automatically destroy them and collect resources:

Spend coins gained from resources to improve mining capabilities:

Gameplay Loop:

  • Spend energy to mine tiles, automatically collecting resources and converting them into coins.

  • End the run by clearing out the current mineshaft completely or by running out of energy.

  • Every time the mineshaft is cleared, its level increases and it grows larger.

  • Purchase upgrades that increase energy, mining size, mining speed, add bombs, reveal new resources, and much more!

  • Get back to mining and repeat the process to become more efficient and MineEmAll!

Features:

  • Stress-free incremental gameplay with no time limit.

  • Simple mouse-over controls to mine tiles (no spam clicking needed).

  • Automatically gather resources when tiles are mined.

  • Skill tree with high impact upgrades.

  • Several hours of gameplay with smooth progression.

Cream City Chaos: Origins is an early-development indie game set around Milwaukee’s East Side in 1994.

Skate, explore, take on weird errands, meet local characters, and wander through an exaggerated version of a specific city, scene, and moment in time. The game is being built from a mix of memory, research, community-submitted references, old storefronts, local legends, and the strange little details that make a neighborhood feel alive.

The project is currently in active development, with more screenshots, devlogs, and playtest information coming as the game takes shape.

store_data.about_the_game:
Naomi’s End is a short atmospheric sci-fi visual novel told through text and ink-wash images.

Naomi is a young Japanese postgraduate student in New Zealand. After an evening of surfing, she wakes up in an impossible world that should not exist.

Naomi tries to understand what happened, and whether she can return to her normal life.

This is a minimal story-focused experience with no combat, no puzzles, and no branching paths. The game is designed to be read slowly, like a short illustrated sci-fi story.

Features:

  • A short, complete sci-fi story

  • Text-based visual novel presentation

  • Atmospheric ink-wash illustrations

  • Minimal controls: move forward or back through the story

  • A quiet, melancholic mood

  • Themes of memory, identity, time, and uncertain reality

store_data.about_the_game:
TeaKnights is a fully on-rails musical shooter set on SCEPTRE-011, a space colony divided into seven tea-powered biodome kingdoms.

When one of the seven TeaKnights mysteriously disappears, an emergency selection is called for the Forest Dome. The chosen candidate is Camellia Jetsworth, a studious young apprentice who knows the knights’ creed by heart but has never proven herself on the battlefield.

To earn her title, Camellia must clear the Grading, a trial of valor that sends her across colorful low-poly 3D stages filled with enemies, hazards, bosses, and fellow knight encounters.

Armed with her TeaSetter REGALIA, a tea-powered weapon that can fire as a gun and transform into a vapor-sword, Camellia must shoot, dodge, slash, and build chain combos while the game’s dynamic soundtrack reacts to her performance.

Explore the overworld between missions, discover the distinct tea cultures of the biodome kingdoms, customize Camellia with different outfits, and uncover the mystery behind the missing seventh knight.

Features

  • Fully on-rails musical shooter action

  • Fast arcade stages built around aiming, dodging, shooting, and hazards

  • TeaSetter REGALIAS: tea-powered guns that transform into vapor-swords

  • Chain-based combo system connected to a dynamic soundtrack

  • Boss battles and real-time encounters with other TeaKnights

  • Explorable overworld set across seven tea-themed biodome kingdoms

  • Customizable outfits for Camellia

  • Low-poly 3D visuals inspired by Y2K-era games, anime, and digital culture

store_data.about_the_game:
Spellbinders: Fight for the Arcane is a frenetic, fast-paced fighting game all about managing your character's unique repertoire of powerful spells.

Spells act as this game's special moves, requiring a unique motion plus button. However, all spells have limited uses! Spells have a variety of strange, but strong effects like summoning a lingering wall of fire, trapping your opponent in an arcane arena, or creating a divine tether that yanks the enemy towards you. These aren't just standard specials, they are true SPELLS.

Other than spells, this game featuring a variety of mechanics both standard (and not so standard) to any airdasher, such as super jumps, air dashing, rebeats, etc.

Characters:

Wizard - Uses elemental magic to control the mid-range.

Warlock - Uses tricky movement spells and aggression to maintain pressure.

Paladin - Works their way in with armor to deliver devastating strikes and throws.

Druid - Summons fauna and flora to keep a safe distance from the opponent.

store_data.about_the_game:
CUT WOOD BY DAY. SURVIVE BY NIGHT.

The fire is your only protection

By day, use the limited hours of sunlight to chop trees, haul logs back to camp, split them into firewood, and build a stockpile for the coming night.

When darkness falls, horrors emerge beyond the firelight. Feed the flames, manage your dwindling supply of wood, and decide when it is worth leaving the safety of camp to fight back.

If the fire dies, the darkness closes in.

TWO WAYS TO SURVIVE

THE CURSE

Survive the nights, explore the wider forest, and hunt down four ancient cursed trees feeding the horrors. Destroy them all to break the curse and end the nightmare.

ENDLESS SURVIVAL

There is no final night.

Prepare during the day, defend the fire after dark, and survive increasingly dangerous nights for as long as possible. Enemy pressure continues to grow until the forest finally overwhelms you.

Every new morning is earned.

PHYSICALLY PREPARE YOUR FIREWOOD

Wood is more than a number in a menu.

Cut down trees, carry logs back to camp, split them into usable firewood, and stack each piece in preparation for the night ahead.

Every piece of wood matters. Poor preparation during the day can become a death sentence after sunset.

KEEP THE FIRE ALIVE

  • The fire is warmth.

  • The fire is safety.

  • The fire is survival.

Keep feeding the flames throughout the night. As the fire weakens, so does the protection surrounding your camp. Let it die, and you will be exposed to everything waiting in the darkness.

USE THE DAYLIGHT WISELY

The world follows a living day and night cycle.

Every minute spent exploring or gathering resources is a minute not spent preparing your camp. When night begins, you must survive with whatever you managed to collect.

FIGHT BACK, BUT CHOOSE CAREFULLY

Your axe can defend you, but combat is not the safest solution.

Enemies hit hard, and leaving the firelight puts you at serious risk. Fighting can reduce the pressure around camp and buy valuable time, but every encounter could end your run.

FEATURES

  • Fully first-person survival horror

  • Two game modes: The Curse and Endless Survival

  • Physical tree chopping, log splitting, and firewood stacking

  • Dynamic day and night survival cycle

  • Campfire fuel and resource management

  • Escalating enemy pressure

  • Exploration through a cursed forest

  • Desperate first-person combat

  • Endless survival progression

  • Single-player experience

store_data.about_the_game:
SSTWL: Sector Breach is a point and click survival-horror game revolving the characters and world created by Liam Vickers throughout the “Scary Story Time With Liam” YouTube channel.

Drink your coffee, recover the files, and fend off everything that goes bump in the night. It’s only six hours, what’s the worst that could happen? It’s not like the fate of the universe is at stake, right?

As a FNaF-like, Sector Breach borrows many core aspects of those games mechanics; Sit in your office, watch cameras, close doors, etc. But of course, it’s not that simple.

Use the camera lights to keep the monsters blind and disoriented, just don’t flash the wrong one. Keep your head on a swivel, don’t let what’s in the monitor distract you from what’s in your doorway. Most importantly, recover the Data Files. They are why you are here. The fate of humanity depends upon it.

The game’s story is designed to not only tie into established lore and plot lines of the SSTWL channel, but also act as a way for new fans to jump into the lore of everyone’s favorite niche internet creepypasta author.

Sector Breach is a love letter to all the incredible stories Liam Vickers has written, and the amazing community which has continued to flourish around them even all these years later. <3
