store_data.about_the_game:
Important:
This game requires a controller and cannot be played with a keyboard and mouse.

Runner × FPS

Nether Meridian is a challenging fusion of a forward-running game and a first-person shooter.

The player is constantly moving forward. The controls are simple, consisting only of left and right movement, jumping, left and right dashes, and shooting. Despite the straightforward controls, the gameplay offers considerable depth and demands quick decision-making in high-speed situations.

Aiming is a key part of the scoring system. Eliminating enemies without aiming yields fewer points, while taking the risk to aim under pressure can greatly increase your score. Taking damage will cancel aiming, forcing players to balance offense and survival.

The game is structured around four zones that make up a single loop. Each completed loop increases the difficulty, pushing players to survive longer and achieve higher scores.

Hidden throughout the game are 20 Combat Protocols. These protocols are discovered by performing specific actions during combat, and some are extremely difficult to uncover. Experiment with different techniques and challenge yourself to discover them all.

Those who discover all 20 Combat Protocols may uncover something beyond the standard experience.

Nether Meridian is designed as a score-attack experience. By combining actions effectively, players can trigger Combat Protocols and build score-boosting chains. The greater the risk, the greater the reward.

Target elimination is mandatory. If enemies are not destroyed for an extended period of time, warning messages will appear and a health drain will begin. Remaining aggressive is essential for survival.

Your performance is evaluated by rank. Reaching Rank D will immediately end the run, even if you still have health remaining.

When your health reaches zero, the run ends. Your final results are recorded on the Top 10 leaderboard, and all discovered Combat Protocols can be reviewed in the Protocol Archive.

How far can you advance?
How high can you push your score?

Test your skill and challenge your limits.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Great Diamond is an asymmetrical co-op heist adventure where two players must work together to infiltrate heavily guarded museums, steal priceless treasures, and pull off the ultimate robbery.

One player becomes the Infiltrator, sneaking through exhibits, avoiding security systems, and carrying valuable loot. The other becomes the Operator, monitoring cameras, analyzing blueprints, hacking security devices, and guiding their partner through danger from a remote command center.

Every museum presents new challenges, traps, puzzles, and surprises. Success depends entirely on communication. The Infiltrator can only see what's in front of them. The Operator sees the bigger picture. Neither player has enough information to succeed alone.

Coordinate your actions, improvise when plans fall apart, and escape with your loot before security catches up.

The biggest prize awaits those skilled enough to reach it:

The Great Diamond.

Game Features

ASYMMETRICAL CO-OP GAMEPLAY

Play two completely different roles. One player infiltrates the museum in first person while the other operates advanced systems through a unique command interface. Each role offers distinct mechanics, responsibilities, and perspectives.

COMMUNICATION IS EVERYTHING

Share clues, solve puzzles, disable security systems, and react to unexpected situations together. Clear communication is your most valuable tool.

PLAN THE PERFECT HEIST

Navigate laser grids, surveillance cameras, locked vaults, security checkpoints, and complex museum defenses. Every successful theft feels like a carefully executed operation.

EXPLORE UNIQUE MUSEUMS

Infiltrate museums filled with rare artifacts, hidden secrets, and themed exhibits. Each location introduces new mechanics, challenges, and treasures to steal.

CHAOTIC CO-OP MOMENTS

Even the best plans can go wrong. Quick thinking, teamwork, and a little luck can turn disaster into an unforgettable escape.

THE ULTIMATE SCORE

Steal increasingly valuable artifacts as you work toward the most legendary prize of all: The Great Diamond.

Note:
This game is online co-op only and requires a microphone.

The Great Diamond is an asymmetrical co-op heist adventure where two players must work together to infiltrate heavily guarded museums, steal priceless treasures, and pull off the ultimate robbery.

One player becomes the Infiltrator, sneaking through exhibits, avoiding security systems, and carrying valuable loot. The other becomes the Operator, monitoring cameras, analyzing blueprints, hacking security devices, and guiding their partner through danger from a remote command center.

Every museum presents new challenges, traps, puzzles, and surprises. Success depends entirely on communication. The Infiltrator can only see what's in front of them. The Operator sees the bigger picture. Neither player has enough information to succeed alone.

Coordinate your actions, improvise when plans fall apart, and escape with your loot before security catches up.

The biggest prize awaits those skilled enough to reach it:

The Great Diamond.

Game Features

ASYMMETRICAL CO-OP GAMEPLAY

Play two completely different roles. One player infiltrates the museum in first person while the other operates advanced systems through a unique command interface. Each role offers distinct mechanics, responsibilities, and perspectives.

COMMUNICATION IS EVERYTHING

Share clues, solve puzzles, disable security systems, and react to unexpected situations together. Clear communication is your most valuable tool.

PLAN THE PERFECT HEIST

Navigate laser grids, surveillance cameras, locked vaults, security checkpoints, and complex museum defenses. Every successful theft feels like a carefully executed operation.

EXPLORE UNIQUE MUSEUMS

Infiltrate museums filled with rare artifacts, hidden secrets, and themed exhibits. Each location introduces new mechanics, challenges, and treasures to steal.

CHAOTIC CO-OP MOMENTS

Even the best plans can go wrong. Quick thinking, teamwork, and a little luck can turn disaster into an unforgettable escape.

THE ULTIMATE SCORE

Steal increasingly valuable artifacts as you work toward the most legendary prize of all: The Great Diamond.

Note:
This game is online co-op only and requires a microphone.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grandpa's Euchre

NO TABLE TALK!!!!!!

This is the card game version of Euchre that my Grandpa taught me. I grew up in Illinois and we played this at every family gathering. 

Setup & Dealing

The Deck:

  • 24 cards (9 through Ace)

The Deal:

  • Deal 5 cards to each player. Flip the top card of the remaining deck face up.

Rotation:

  • The dealer role rotates clockwise.

Making Trump

Ordering Up:

  • Starting left of the dealer, players may pass or choose the flipped card's suit as trump.

  • If chosen, the dealer adds the card to their hand and discards one.

Stick the Dealer:

  • If everyone passes, the face-up card is turned over, and a second round begins where players can name any other suit as trump. If everyone passes again, the dealer must name a suit.

Going Alone:

  • Any player who names trump can choose to "go alone." Their partner sits out the round.

Gameplay

The Bowers:

  • The Jack of the trump suit is the Right Bower (highest card). The other Jack of the same color is the Left Bower (second-highest card and counts as trump).

The Lead:

  • The player to the dealer’s left leads the first trick.

Following Suit:

  • Players must follow the led suit if possible. If they cannot, they may play any card. Highest card of the led suit (or highest trump) wins the trick.

Scores & Points

  • Trump Makers win 3 or 4 tricks = 1 point

  • Trump Makers win all 5 tricks = 2 points

  • Defenders win 3+ tricks (a "Set") = 2 points

  • Loner wins all 5 tricks = 4 points

  • Loner wins 3 or 4 tricks = 1 point

  • First Team To 10 Points Wins!

store_data.about_the_game:
A top-down extraction roguelite about robbing a dead generation-ship blind — and getting out before the dark wakes up and hunts you by scent.

Drop in. Kill for cores. Carry the lights home. Extract before the BLACKOUT learns your name — or push one deck deeper for richer salvage and a worse death.

The lights won't last

Power dies on a cycle: LIT, the flicker, BLACKOUT. By day it's rust and hull-rats. In the dark, the things that come don't need to see you — they smell you. Your heat smears across cold steel and they pour down the corridors after the scent: relentless, patient, very fast. Carry a humming power cell home and you push the dark back a while longer. Carry one, and the whole ship finds you fascinating. You can hold the lights a little longer. You cannot hold them forever.

Greed against the dark

Every floor, the ship offers the same deal: extract now and bank everything you've earned, or descend for fatter loot and a meaner death. Cores and gear are only yours once you signal out from the Lander. Die in the field and the dark keeps its cut. Banked is banked. Greedy is dead.

There is no bottom

Past Deck 5 the world comes apart and re-mixes — a reactor's heat wearing a cryo vault's bones, corruption thickening to a violet pall the deeper you fall. Every deck is a gate; the only door is the boss. Put it down, bank a Void Relic, and your relics multiply the haul — paying out richer the deeper you dared. Somewhere down there the dark coughs up the Voidforged: the brightest loot there is, and the thing that gets rigs like you killed.

What you're signing up for

  • A dark that hunts you. BLACKOUT horrors track your heat through walls. Vision shrinks, the music turns, the corridors fill in behind you.

  • One real choice, every run. Cash out at the Lander, or push deeper. Greed is the whole game.

  • Five multi-phase deck bosses — the Custodian, the Overmind, the Frozen Core, the Reactor Warden, and the Anomaly — each a four-phase fight, the score climbing as it dies.

  • An endless Descent. Self-remixing decks past Deck 5, boss-gated, payouts compounding, the Voidforged waiting at the bottom of a manifest with no bottom.

  • Loot worth dying for. Eight rarity tiers from Stock to Voidforged, every drop graded F-to-S on its own roll, stacking affixes, and uniques that bend the rules.

  • Build, don't pick a class. A branching augment tree with locking forks and 40+ swappable Modules that ARE your kit — mines, walls, turrets, lances, portals — plus a buried way to fuse two capstones into one screen-clearing ultimate (100+ combinations).

  • 67 achievements, 67 ship liveries. Every achievement hangs a new skin in your wardrobe — from corporate chrome to the deep-Descent void skins.

Built to be replayed

Procedurally generated decks; three escalating difficulties — LOW ORBIT for the drift, DECAYING ORBIT for the intended hunt, EVENT HORIZON for when the dark smells you everywhere and death takes all of it; a run inventory that rides between runs; a death-proof Lander cargo bay; three save slots. No two drops down the same.

Options & accessibility

  • Fully rebindable controls (keyboard + mouse).

  • Three difficulty Descents, chosen per save — the dark's senses, speed, and the death penalty all scale.

  • Scalable HUD and a colorblind-friendly mode.

  • Adjustable screen-shake and crosshair, per-bus volume, and one-key mute.

  • Quality-of-life baked in: instant pickup, hold-to-equip on the move, auto-scrap rules, drag-and-drop inventory with full stat deltas, and checkpoint autosaves.

Kill what moves. Carry the lights home. Leave before the dark learns your name.

store_data.about_the_game:
Deadtale is an action-packed FPS roguelike set in a post-apocalyptic world where humans and robots share one goal: wipe out the infection that destroyed most of Earth, and is still very much alive.

Together with Buddy, your autonomous combat vehicle armed with plenty of ways to turn infected into red paste, you head into dangerous zones to kill as many infected as possible and push them further back.

The longer you survive, and the further you go, the more deadly the resistance becomes.

Jump into dangerous, procedurally generated zones filled with infected, loot, points of interest, and things that very much want you dead.

Some areas push you into close-combat chaos. Others open up into larger maps where you can explore, scavenge, fight, and decide how far you want to push before the world pushes back harder.

Loot weapons, attachments, skills, upgrades, and equipment while building around firepower, violent movement, robotic support, or whatever keeps you alive the longest.

Every run is about getting stronger, killing more, surviving longer, and making it back before confidence turns into a mistake.

Buddy is your autonomous combat vehicle. It drives beside you, tears through infected, covers your back, and works as your mobile stash.

Over time, Buddy can be upgraded far beyond the vehicle you start with. What begins as a simple combat car can eventually become a full battle machine built around destruction, survival, and support.

Drones expand your build even further, with 8 weapon types and 3 specialist variants for each.

Deadtale gives you plenty of weapons, attachments, and build combinations, but your character is not just a walking gun rack.

You are also equipped with combat and movement skills that change how you fight.

You start with Dash, a brutal movement skill that lets you smash through enemies and leave very little behind. As you progress, you unlock more ways to move, kill, launch yourself into the air, and come crashing back down as a human missile.

Every sound matters.

Fire your weapon, tear through enemies, or make enough noise in the world, and nearby Hunters can begin tracking you. Your threat meter shows when the fight is starting to turn against you.

Once a Hunter catches your scent, the game changes. You are no longer just clearing infected. You are being hunted.

Hunters are not just bigger enemies with more health. Each one has its own look, behavior, role, and skills. Some charge straight at you. Some stalk from the shadows and wait for the right moment. Others can twist the battlefield and turn the map into their own private playground.

Each Hunter pressures you in a different way and forces you to adapt.

Alphas

Kill enough Hunters, and you will eventually draw the attention of an Alpha. When one enters the fight, its battle cry echoes across the map, its own music kicks in, and every other enemy flees for its life.

The map locks down. You can no longer leave.

It is you or the Alpha.

Deadtale is filled with different enemy types, each built to pressure you in a specific way. Some overwhelm you with numbers or force you to move. Others punish you for getting too close, staying still, or ignoring the wrong target for too long.

Elite

Elite enemies control larger groups, roam independently, and can also appear during Infestations.

They are stronger, more aggressive, and harder to bring down. Some pressure you up close, while others attack from range and force you out of cover.

Special

Special enemies are designed to disrupt the flow of combat and turn simple fights dangerous.

  • Exploders rush you down and detonate on impact.

  • Radioactive enemies deal damage over time if you stay too close.

  • Runners strike from behind, then flee when seen.

  • Ranged enemies attack from a distance with shots or explosives.

  • Electric enemies stun you and leave you exposed.

  • Hybrid enemies combine multiple abilities, because apparently one problem at a time was too generous.

Normal

Normal enemies fill the world in large numbers.

One clean headshot is enough to bring them down, but hundreds of infected rushing you at once can quickly turn confidence into panic.

They may be easy to kill alone, but in a horde, they become the pressure that makes every other enemy more dangerous.

Your life always starts in the Hub.

Here you can meet NPCs, talk to humans and robots, visit merchants, upgrade your gear, check for new items, and prepare for the next run.

Some NPCs give you insight into the world. Others need help finding things out in the infected zones and will reward you well if you bring them back.

Merchants handle your weapon and skill needs, and if you just want to burn some ammo without consequences, head to the shooting range and get some aggression out - ammo is on the house.

Deadtale is being made with one main goal: to be fun.

Every system, weapon, enemy, skill, and idea is tested from every angle. If it makes the game better, it gets refined. If it does not, it gets thrown out.

This is a passion project and a game idea that has been living in my head for more than a decade. Now it is finally getting close to the point where players can try it for themselves.

Wishlist Deadtale and help support the development.

Every in-game screenshot and video on this page was captured directly from actual gameplay.

store_data.about_the_game:
ΠΟΛΙΣ is a single-city historical strategy game set in classical Athens. You take the city from Solon's reforms (594 BC) to the Lamian War and the end of the democracy (322 BC) — one complete, unbroken arc of 272 years.

This is not a sandbox. History has a current, and it runs toward 322 BC. Persia withdraws, Sparta endures, Macedon rises, Chaeronea falls in 338, the democracy ends in 322 — and no internal policy can wash those away. What you *can* change is everything in between: who holds power, which faction prevails, whether the gods favour you, how the empire's silver is spent. Even the great counterfactuals of history — making peace at Pylos, vetoing the Sicilian Expedition, holding the line at Aegospotami — are on the table, but only as steeply-priced gambles that converge back to 322 BC.

The event illustrations throughout are public-domain paintings on classical themes; the city itself is reconstructed in a clean 3D style.

**Features**

• **272 years, one city** — a complete historical arc with 332 researched events, from the archaic reforms to the Persian Wars, the age of Pericles, the Peloponnesian War, and the Macedonian dawn.

• **Tension, not number-walls** — balance the pull of aristocratic families, the favour of the Olympian gods, and the demands of the Delian and Second Athenian Leagues. Every gain is bound to a cost.

• **Statesmen with stories** — appoint historical figures, weather their ambition and the envy of rivals, face ostracism and impeachment.

• **107 public-domain paintings on classical themes** illustrate the events — drawn from museum collections in the public domain (not original artwork), each shown in a gilded frame and an in-engine sketch variant.

• **Nine languages** — English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian.

• **3D Athens** — an archaeologically-minded reconstruction of the city: the Acropolis on its limestone crag, the Agora, the Long Walls to Piraeus, the rivers of the Attic plain.

• **A shareable epitaph card** seals each playthrough; emergent endings and meme achievements reward replaying the same arc a different way.

• **For the hardcore: Ironman** — achievements are earned only in Hard + Ironman: a single ever-overwritten save, no reloading, your choices final. Normal mode plays freely with full saves for everyone else.

store_data.about_the_game:
Junkoid

The galaxy is a total mess, and you are the only hope! In Junkoid, you take command of a high-speed sanitation ship in a fast-paced action environment.

Inspired by 80s arcade classics like Asteroids, Junkoid takes that addictive survival formula and cranks the speed up to the max. Your mission is simple but challenging: navigate the void, dodge debris, and disintegrate every piece of space garbage that crosses your path before it collides with your ship.

Key Features:

  • Pure Arcade Action: Smooth 360-degree movement, pinpoint precision, and rapid-fire combat.

  • Infinite Survival: Garbage spawns randomly and constantly; the longer you survive, the more chaotic and faster the environment becomes.

  • Chase the Glory: Can you beat your own record? Compete against yourself with our persistent Highscore system.

  • Minimalist Aesthetic: A clean, sleek design that lets you focus on what really matters: cleaning up the sector, one blast at a time! 

  • They have to click any button, first the play button to play and the how to play button to exit the game

A giant toy store. 1,606 toys out of place. One mission: put everything back where it belongs.

In Toy Keeper, you'll explore a colorful three-story toy store filled with dinosaurs, robots, dolls, vehicles, blocks, plushies, and more. Pick up toys, sort them into their correct sections, and transform a mountain of chaos into a perfectly organized store.

Earn coins as you clean and spend them on the Ball Machine, where every ball grants a new upgrade to help you organize faster and more efficiently.

A Mountain of Toys to Master

Thousands of tiny items, one very determined manager. Build order from toy-store chaos and keep every shelf under control.

Unlock Powerful Perks

Choose upgrades like helper bots to automate the busywork and keep the store moving while you focus on bigger goals.

Organize Everything

Sort, place, and tidy every corner until the whole shop runs like a perfect little machine.

Take Care of Your Baby

Your smallest helper needs attention too. Keep the baby happy while the store gets busier around you.

Three Floors of Tiny Chaos

Move fast across multiple floors, discover new areas, and turn every level into a perfectly managed toy empire.

Unlock Powerful Upgrades

Build your own playstyle with dozens of perks and abilities:

  • Sprint faster

  • Throw objects

  • Highlight nearby toys

  • Attract distant objects

  • Coin magnet

  • Object magnet

  • Double, Triple, Quadruple, Quintuple, and Sextuple Jump

  • Jetpack

  • Wings

  • Direction beacon showing where items belong

  • Storage boxes for transporting multiple toys

  • Place multiple nearby objects at once

  • Helper robots that organize toys for you

  • Movement speed multipliers

  • And many more surprises

A Playful Companion

You're not alone.

A curious baby accompanies you throughout the store, playing with toys, wandering around, and occasionally creating a little extra mess for you to deal with. Sometimes helpful, sometimes distracting, always adorable.

Relaxing Chaos

Take your time, optimize your routes, unlock upgrades, and watch the store slowly transform from complete disorder into a perfectly organized toy paradise.

Can you place all 1,606 toys back where they belong?

store_data.about_the_game:
One number. One gap. A whole storm.

Gap Storm is an original shedding-style card game built on a single, razor-sharp idea: when you beat the card in front of you, the penalty isn't fixed — it's the gap between your number and the last one, multiplied by your combo type. Slam an 8 onto a 3 and the next player who folds draws (8-3)x1. Drop a pair of 9s onto a pair of 3s and that gap becomes (9-3)x2 = a brutal twelve-card storm. Play the smallest winning card and you barely sting them. Every single turn is a live risk/reward calculation.

First to empty their hand wins. Simple to learn in a minute — a lifetime to master.

The mechanics that make it sing

  • Differential penalty draw — singles x1, pairs x2, triple-with-kicker x3. The gap is recalculated every play, never stacked.
  • Bombs — four of a kind beats anything and forces a flat 8-card draw. Bigger bombs crush smaller ones.
  • The 10 steals — every 10 you play yanks a random card from whoever holds the most. Pairs and triples of 10s steal two and three.
  • Event cards — eight chaos cards seeded into the deck flip face-up as a warning, then strike the next player to draw: supply runs, forced swaps, direction reversals, x2 storms and more.
  • Deep house rules — hand size, number range (1-8 to 1-13), cards per number, bomb penalty, event mix, multipliers, match length. Tune it from a 5-minute brawl to a 10-minute strategy duel.

Adventure — a roguelike of rule-breakers

A full single-player run that rivals the deckbuilders you love. Fight through three regions and 17 duels against opponents who each bend the rules in their own way:
  • 10 rule-bending foes — the Hoarder who busts if it floods, the Sniper who doubles single-card gaps, the Oracle who literally reads your hand, and elites who turn your own pairs against you.
  • 3 bosses — the Rhythm King who pumps the penalty every few turns, the Edict Lord who bans single cards, and the Storm Emperor who doubles every multiplier.
  • 26 items + curses — drafted three-at-a-time after each win. Stack relics, gamble on a Legendary that demands a curse, and build a run that breaks the game in your favor.
  • 3 lives & Storm Heat — flat lives keep one bad hand from deleting an hour-long run, and three ascension tiers keep the climb tense long after your first clear.

Modes

  • Classic — 2-4 players. Fill empty seats with three difficulties of AI, or play with friends.
  • Online with friends — host a room and share a 6-digit code; join over LAN, direct connect, or the Steam relay backbone (no port forwarding). Drop-out seats are taken over by AI.
  • Adventure — the solo roguelike above.
  • Interactive tutorial — learn the gap, the bomb and the steal hands-on in two minutes.

Earn everything. Buy nothing.

Over 50 Steam achievements and a deep wardrobe — avatar frames, card backs, card faces, table felts, titles and loot avatars won from the enemies you beat — are 100% earned through play. There are no loot boxes, no battle pass, no pay-to-win, and no FOMO. The price on the store page is the whole game.

Made with love

Juicy, glossy casual art, cute animal avatars, an original ink-wave identity, full English & Simplified Chinese (interface, subtitles and voice), and a deterministic rules engine verified across 220,000+ simulated games for long-run fairness.

Coming after launch: Ranked ladder with seasons, and a Creative Workshop for sharing custom event packs.

store_data.about_the_game:
Build your very own Alpenbahn - an Alpine mountain railroad winding its way through dramatic landscapes inspired by Switzerland, Austria and more.

Instead of painstakingly placing each track tile, this game features an innovative building tool that lets you draw smooth tracks with your mouse. Simply choose the path and the game will effortlessly create the required bridges, viaducts or tunnels. Want to replace the cantilever bridge with a suspension bridge? No problem! Everything can be customized to support your vision of the ideal Alpenbahn.

To start off your model railroad you begin by choosing one of several maps, each representing a slice of Alpine nature featuring challenging yet beautiful terrain. It’s on you to decide whether to shape the land to build the most efficient route or whether to take the slower but maybe more elegant way through the mountains.

Bring your model railroad to life and populate it with a selection of iconic trains, from vintage steam locomotives to modern high speed units. Build train stations to connect your quaint Alpine villages with each other. Finally, enjoy your beautiful creation by hopping on one of your trains and taking in the view from the conductor’s seat.

store_data.about_the_game:
The world has fallen.

Zombie Survival Frontier is a third person open area survival shooter where players explore dangerous wastelands, eliminate infected threats, complete objectives, and travel across hostile territories using a variety of vehicles.

Take control of a survivor armed with powerful weapons and venture into zombie infested zones filled with danger. Fight your way through hordes of infected enemies, secure valuable resources, and push deeper into the frontier as new challenges emerge.

Every mission brings new risks. Every location hides new threats. Survival depends on your aim, strategy, and ability to adapt.

Cities are abandoned, supply routes have collapsed, and vast regions have become overrun by the infected. The remaining survivors are scattered across the frontier, fighting to stay alive in a world consumed by chaos.

FEATURES

Frontline Insertion

Deploy directly into infected territory and begin your mission beyond the last safe zone.

Zombie Combat

Engage in intense third person gunfights against infected enemies. Use a variety of weapons to eliminate threats and survive overwhelming attacks.

Vehicle Exploration

Travel across dangerous regions using abandoned cars, trucks, and other vehicles. Reach new locations and discover hidden areas throughout the frontier.

Open Survival Zones

Explore large environments filled with abandoned structures, hostile monster zombies, and unexpected encounters around every corner.

Vertical Exploration

Climb ladders and elevated structures to reach new areas, gain tactical advantages, and uncover hidden paths across the frontier.

Drive To Survive

Travel across the wasteland using abandoned vehicles. Cover long distances quickly, reach new objectives, and explore dangerous regions beyond the safe zones.

Deadly Zombie Variants

Face different types of infected enemies, each presenting unique challenges that require strategy and firepower to overcome.

The outbreak has already happened. The dead have already taken over. Now there is only one goal left

Survive the rusty desert wasteland.

Two separate energy bars serve distinct combat roles: Vital Energy fuels parries, quick evasions and counterattacks for instant defense and offense, while a secondary resource powers martial arts skills. Separated resources grant ample room for skillful play.

Pick challenge dungeons freely and preview all potential equipment rewards before entry. Repeated runs yield gear with random stat modifiers, which you can mix and match to craft unique combat builds.

Ideal for players who enjoy Chinese martial arts themes, story-driven single-player games, skill-based combat and customizable equipment builds.

store_data.about_the_game:
A small shop. A stack of broken phones. And inside each one, a life someone never meant for you to see.

Last Seen is a single-player investigation sim about survival, surveillance, and the cost of curiosity. You play Kaan, who loses almost everything in a single night and reopens his late father's phone repair shop just to keep a roof over his head. Then his sister vanishes — leaving behind only her phone, and a message he can't unsee:

"The Light is calling you."

She isn't the first to disappear. She won't be the last.

By Day, You Survive

Run a hands-on phone repair shop. Open the devices, find the fault, replace the parts, and earn enough to keep the lights on. But every phone that crosses your counter is a life pried open — and the data people leave behind is worth far more than the repair.

By Night, You Dig

At your desk, the real work begins. Crack locked screens, recover deleted messages, and trace every lead across the open web — and the deep web, where the answers are buried. Pin the clues to your evidence board, connect the threads, and watch a pattern emerge from the dark.

Key Features

  • Repair & Survive— A tactile phone-repair simulation under constant economic pressure. Rush a job and your reputation pays the price.

  • Extract & Investigate — Break into devices, dig through apps, and recover what people tried to bury.

  • Research the Deep Web — Follow leads across the open and hidden internet. Every search is a balance between curiosity, caution, and knowing when to log off.

  • Solve the Mystery — Build your case on an evidence board where scattered names become the truth.

  • Choices With Weight — Reveal, keep, sell, or bury what you find. There are no clean wins — only the person you become.

  • The Light Watches Back — You watch strangers through their screens. Something is watching you through yours. Dig too deep, and you become the next name that was simply… last seen.

How far will you go to find her — and what will be left of you when you do?

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Play Time: 30 ~ 60 minutes

Gameplay:
Operation is a zombie horror action game where players must survive inside an operation zone overrun by infected creatures.

Players are deployed into a dangerous area after a mysterious outbreak. Inside the zone, they must fight against zombie attacks, complete mission objectives, and survive with limited resources. Explore dark corridors, abandoned buildings, and restricted operation areas while facing the constant threat of the infected.

Situations that may be too dangerous to handle alone can be overcome through cooperation with other players. Cover your teammates, help allies in danger, and work together to complete the mission.

Zombies can appear at any moment. If players let their guard down, they may quickly become surrounded. Even simple movement through the area can become a tense decision between survival and death.

Background:
After an unknown infection incident occurred, the once-controlled operation zone was completely isolated from the outside world.

At first, the situation was believed to be a simple accident. However, as time passed, the abnormal signs became more serious. Communication was lost, personnel inside the area disappeared, and emergency signals were transmitted only in incomplete fragments.

Reports mentioned violent infected individuals, sealed-off areas, and missing survivors. Eventually, the zone was classified as a high-risk area, and everyone remaining inside was presumed dead.

Now, players enter the sealed zone as members of a new operation team. Their mission is to investigate the cause of the infection, recover the remaining clues, and escape alive.

However, the deeper they move into the operation zone, the more they begin to realize that this incident may not have been just a simple outbreak.

Key Features:

  • Tense combat against zombie threats

  • Exploration of dark and horror-themed operation areas

  • Online co-op gameplay

  • Team-based mission objectives

  • Survival with limited resources

  • The truth behind the infection hidden inside a sealed zone

  • A violent and threatening zombie horror atmosphere

Developer’s Note:
Operation was created to deliver the tension of zombie horror and cooperative survival gameplay.

The goal is not only to let players fight zombies, but also to make them feel the pressure of exploring dark spaces, cooperating with teammates, and surviving in a place where danger can appear at any moment.

The game may still have areas that need improvement, but we will continue working on it so that players can feel as if they are truly entering a dangerous operation zone and fighting to survive.

Maru Games hopes to present the fun of zombie horror, survival, and cooperative gameplay through Operation.

Distribution:
If you create videos, screenshots, live streams, or other content related to this game, we would appreciate it if you include the game title, Operation, or the Steam store page link.

This game was developed in a small-scale development environment, so there may be some rough or unfinished parts. If you find any issues while playing or have feedback, your comments will be very helpful for future improvements.

Maru Games is not responsible for any damages caused by the distribution or sharing of videos related to this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Climb a tower that never stays the same

The Spire reshapes itself every single run : new paths, new foes, new rewards. No two climbs are alike, and every choice on the map is a gamble between essence, healing, danger and treasure. Reach the top once and the real challenge only begins.

Tame the Spirelings

The creatures of this world are the Spirelings , dozens to encounter, recruit, evolve and grow attached to. Build a team of three, deepen your bond, and watch them transform into their stronger forms at the perfect moment.

Your deck is your team

There are no generic cards here. Every move in your deck comes from the Spirelings you've tamed. Teach new moves, forget the dead weight, and sculpt a deck that flows from turn to turn. Each creature is a little engine , your job is to make them sing together.

Five elements, one wheel

Ember, Bloom, Tide, Volt and Umbra each beat one and fall to another. Read the matchup, exploit the advantage, and turn a losing fight around by bringing the right element to the front. Stack burns, poisons, blocks and a dozen other statuses into combos that snowball.

Make it home

Between runs, return to the Den: spend what you earned, unlock permanent upgrades, expand your roster, and set out a little stronger each time. Progress sticks even when a run doesn't.

Push your luck with Ascension

Cleared the Spire? Crank the difficulty. Each Ascension layer piles on new rules and nastier fights for players who want the climb to bite back , all the way to a final, untouchable run.

Features

  • Roguelite deckbuilding where your cards ARE your creatures
  • Dozens of Spirelings to encounter, recruit and evolve
  • A five-element type wheel with deep status-effect combos
  • A procedurally rebuilt Spire a fresh map every run
  • A persistent Den with meta-progression and upgrades
  • Ascension difficulty layers for endless replayability
  • Full controller support and Steam Cloud saves
  • 20 achievements to chase

A cozy world with a dark heart. Tame it.

store_data.about_the_game:
The procedural maze is literally that. You explore a procedurally generated maze while trying to find your way out! Weapons are provided to make the journey easier while monsters roam the mysterious passageways.

A Very Big Maze

Every time you load a new game, you get a new maze, allowing you to replay this game to your heart's content. The maze also shifts periodically where the walls change, which adds an extra level of difficulty while keep the map dynamic and fun. You can select your maze size, smaller mazes to begin with before you work your way up to the most massive of mazes.

Monsters await

Meet a variety of monsters as you venture deeper into the maze. The threat level increases at night and towards the edges of the maze.

Spray Paint

Use a variety of spray paints to mark certain points in the maze to make your escape easier. You can spray paint anywhere, walls, floors and water is provided to wash away unwanted paint.

Experience Real Darkness

This game features a day and night cycle (with the option of day only and night only modes). Realistic lighting is featured, with a selection of flashlights provided to help you make your way during the night. Mobs have glow in the dark eyes, making every turn a spine chilling one.

store_data.about_the_game:
Aim. Launch. Splash.

AquaDucked! is a cozy physics puzzler with a competitive action streak. Load a rubber duck ball into a cannon, line up your shot, and fire
— then watch it bounce, float, and ride the water on its way to the goal. Part puzzle, part trick-shot, every level is a
little physics sandbox waiting to be solved.

Build the path

You don't just aim — you shape the course. Place tools during planning, then fire and see your plan play out:
  • Hoses blast the duck across gaps with jets of water
  • Trampolines launch it sky-high
  • Slides carve smooth ramps and curves
  • Fans nudge its arc mid-flight
  • Water that actually fills, floats, and overflows
Hit every lightning pole, or guide your duck home to mama — your tools, your route.

270+ levels across 10 worlds

From gentle starters to fiendish multi-tool contraptions, the difficulty curve keeps the "aha!" coming. Earn stars, chase
faster times, and unlock a flock of duck skins as you go.

Build your own — and dive into The Pond

A full in-game level editor lets you design, test, and share your own puzzles. The Pond is the community hub: browse
player-made levels, like and follow your favorite builders, race ghost replays, and climb the leaderboards.

Build together — live

Invite a friend into the editor and design levels side by side in real time: shared cursors, live edits, quick chat, and co-op
playtesting in the same room. Works cross-platform, so your desktop and mobile friends can build together.

Plus: Pin Golf

A relaxing bonus mode — play the duck like a golf ball across sprawling courses, reading wind, sand, and water on your way to the cup.

Hand-painted, top to bottom

Every duck, tool, and horizon is original watercolor art, set to a soft, unhurried soundtrack. Easy to pick up, hard to put
down.

Fight, Loot, Extract

Experience highly detailed top down firefights where every bullet counts on a battlefield that can change every minute. Highly detailed damage system insures that each battle requires your full attention and preparation.

Maintain and modify your weapons, equip your survivor with unique equipment and dress him up for any occasion

Find components, wood, metal and food as you explore; repair, maintain and build a shack hidden deep in the woods and make it your home where you can rest, upgrade and customize your gear, invite traders and survivors and stash your loot


Discover Terminal Falls

Terminal Falls is a small town located in Northwest Oregon.

One day, Terminal Falls sent out a strange distress signal. No one answered. 

Terminal Falls has become a wasteland, devastated by a war. 

Only issue is… 

There never was a war. Will you find out what happened?

Mysteries of Terminal Falls…

The story of Terminal Falls is a story of mystery. Where has everyone gone? Why is the town devastated? What signal did the town send? Finding answers won’t be easy. But easy was never your way, was it?

store_data.about_the_game:
Cryptid Contingent is a challenging rogue-like dungeon crawler about careful resource management and creating unique item builds to become an unstoppable powerhouse.

CONSTRUCT THE PERFECT BUILD

Enemies will often carry items that make them more challenging to defeat. However, defeated enemies will drop any held items, giving you the chance to use them yourself! Unfortunately, your bag has limited space, so you'll quickly begin needing to make hard choices about which items to keep and which ones to leave behind.

HUNDREDS OF UNIQUE ITEMS TO DISCOVER

While some grant simple stat bonus, others make your attacks explode, allow you to replicate yourself, or cause your abilities to charge strikes of lightning for you to unleash!

A BEAUTIFUL HANDCRAFTED WORLD TO EXPLORE

You may often find yourself being mercilessly chased down by a pack of wolves, getting shot at from off-screen, or dying to a golden glove wielding scout. It is in these moments we encourage you to direct your attention towards the luscious environment we've created for you, inspired by the flora and fauna found in the pacific northwest.

UNRAVEL THE SECRETS OF THE FOREST

An enormous creature causes the train in which you were being held captive to crash, and as you trespass deeper into the foliage, you may discover more questions than you do answers.

INSPIRED BY YOUR FAVORITE POPULAR MOBAS

Cryptid Contingent was designed to deliver the mechanical depth of MOBAs in a rogue-like package. Every failed run is an opportunity to learn, and there is much to learn.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Since enemies have access to the same powerful items as yourself, you'll always be facing new challenges that will demand creative solutions and test your skills.

NO HAND HOLDING HERE

Don't let the cute art deceive you! The forest is does not welcome the weak. Only those who spend their time efficiently, learn to exploit opportunity, and attend to details will survive. Many core mechanics in this game are not explicitly explained and are left for you to discover through experimentation and failure.

store_data.about_the_game:
One Neck Ahead is a charming retro-style platformer where you follow Kid Giraffe on a journey toward the heart of the forest, in a wholesome story about friendship and loss. Master precise platforming, experiment with unique mechanics, discover surprising interactions, and befriend a playful cast of characters, as you overcome hand-crafted challenges.

Key Features

  • Create your own platforms

    Pick up Boxers, collectibles that can be deployed at any time to turn into temporary platforms.

  • Combine mechanics in different ways

    Discover how the world's mechanics interact with Kid's boxes.

  • Responsive and expressive movement

    Enjoy tight controls, fluid platforming.

  • Customizable visuals

    Change your colour palette, adjust your post-processing effects, or use random palettes for a new look each level.

  • Accessibility

    For those who just want to enjoy the narrative; options such as infinite jump, no death, and additional checkpoints are available!

Experiment With Your Boxes

Pick up a box collectible, activate it at any time, and use it as a temporary platform to reach places otherwise out of reach.

Discover Interactions

See how your box interacts with the rest of the world, and combine mechanics in unexpected ways.

Pick Your Aesthetics!

Choose your own colour palette and enjoy a clean retro aesthetic in your preferred colours.

Tune The Effects!

Adjust visual effects and fine-tune the look of the game to your liking.

Representing Giraffes in games.

(Steam art provided by @Janikainen)

store_data.about_the_game:
Cytokine Storm is for fans PSX and PS2 survival horror, taking place entirely within the fractured biological systems of a woman fighting for her life. After a catastrophic medical event slips you into a deep coma, your consciousness materializes inside your own anatomy. To wake up, you must explore a grotesque, surreal interpretation of your body's vital systems, repairing the damage from the inside out before your time runs out.

Core Features:

  • Classic Retro Horror Nostalgia: Experience fixed camera angles, atmospheric lighting, and tense exploration designed to evoke the golden age of 32-bit survival horror.

  • A Dream-like Biological Setting: Navigate through varied, anatomical environments. Explore the forgotten beaches surrounded by extracellular fluid, the vibrant forest of the lungs, the pulsing vessels of the cardiovascular system, the red alert command center of a fried brain, and much more.

  • The Enemy Within: Your enemy is your own body. Battle vicious manifestations of invasive parasites, mutating viruses, and a hyper-aggressive, defective immune system that views your own consciousness as a foreign threat.

  • Outfits, Weapons, and Abilities: Explore your environment thoroughly and spend your resources wisely, as ammo is scarce. Discover unique costumes and match your active abilities and weapons to specific enemy types and environmental hazards.

  • Knowledge is Key: Solve cryptic puzzles using real-world medical knowledge. Understanding how different immune cells behave and interact in the human body will be the ultimate key to defeating them.
